Description: Sound of a person making bubbles underwater.
alt_translation1: Sonido de una persona creando burbujas bajo el agua.

Description: Sound used when calling a chicken.
alt_translation1: Sonido que se usa para llamar a una gallina.

Description: Sound of a horse or a deer snorting.
alt_translation1: Sonido de un caballo o un venado resoplando por la nariz.

Description: Sound of a hasty or rushed movement.
alt_translation1: Sonido de un movimiento apurado o atropellado.
Sonido de una campana llamando a un entierro.

Description: Small iguana with three series of spines along a wide tail. It is known in Spanish as gomaga or jama. It is not consumed but its eggs are and they are considered to be delicious.
alt_translation1: Iguana pequeña de cola ancha con tres series de espinas, conocida en castellano como gomaga o jama. No se come pero sus huevos sí y se consideran sabrosos.

Description: Iguana after she has laid her eggs.
alt_translation1: Iguana después de poner sus huevos.

Description: Sound that represents how a deaf person talks.
alt_translation1: Sonido que representa como habla una persona sorda.

Description: Fish known in Spanish as 'cuatrojo' which means 'four-eyes'.

Bird known in Spanish and English as chachalaca. It is edible and is prepared in a broth which is considered good for body pains. By analogy with the fact that the chachalaca is noisy, this lexeme can be used to refer to someone who is a chatterbox.
alt_translation1: Chachalaca. Es comestible y preparada en caldo se considera bueno para los dolores del cuerpo. Por analogía con el hecho de que la chachalaca hace mucho ruido, este lexema se puede usar para referirse a una persona parlanchina.

Description: The male of the species Quiscalus mexicanus. It is considered to be bigger and stronger than the female. Its feathers are jet black, hence its name. It is edible.
alt_translation1: El macho de la especie Quiscalus mexicanus. Se considera más grande y fuerte que la hembra. Su plumaje es muy negro, de ahí su nombre. Es comestible.

Description: Nominalizing proclitic. When it cliticizes to a verb, the derived lexeme is a noun that refers to the act or action described by the verb. When it cliticizes to a modifier or noun, the derived lexeme describes the nature or character defined by the modifier or noun.
alt_translation1: Proclítico nominalizador, es decir, partícula que se antepone a otros lexemas para generar un sustantivo, sin alterar el patrón prosódico de aquello a lo que se antepone. Cuando guenda+ se antepone a un verbo, el lexema que se deriva es un sustantivo que hace referencia al acto o a la acción descrita por el verbo. Cuando se antepone a un modificador o a un sustantivo, el lexema derivado describe una naturaleza o un carácter definido por el modificador o el sustantivo.

Description: Mind, intelligence, talent, knowledge. By association, the part of the head known as the temple.
alt_translation1: Mente, inteligencia, talento, conocimiento. Por asociación, la sien.

Description: Personality that gets into everything and anything even without a full understanding of what they are getting into.
alt_translation1: Personalidad que a todo le entra aun sin saber en qué se mete.

Description: A matter driven by love or affection.

alt_translation1: Solicitud, acto de pedir prestado o fiado.

Description: Breakfast, act of drinking including drinking to drunkedness. This nominalization can also refer to the beverage that a godmother offers during the celebration that she is sponsoring.
alt_translation1: Desayuno, acción de beber incluyendo borracheras. También se refiere a la bebida que ofrece una madrina de velación, de cantarito, o de pastel.

Description: Jiménez Girón (1979:90) describes this animal as an amphibian similar to the salamander, the size of a lizard. It takes its name from the colored stripes on its body, similar to the weave of a hammock (lit. hammock iguana).
alt_translation1: Jiménez Girón (1979:90) describe a este animal como "batracio parecido a la salamandra, del tamaño de una lagartija. Deriva su nombre del rayado a colores que lleva en el cuerpo a la semejanza del tejido de una hamaca" (lit. iguana hamaca).

Description: Like this, used for clarifying or correcting a statement.
alt_translation1: Así, dicho para aclarar o corregir.

Description: Silliness, nonsense, tomfoolery, joke, fantasy. By extension, sex.
alt_translation1: Tontería, payasada, chiste, fantasía. Por extensión, sexo.

Description: Ring made with three rings which is often decorated with a coin worth 1.50 or 2.50.
alt_translation1: Anillo de tres argollas al cual se le suele poner una moneda de 1.50 o de 2.50.

Description: Ring with a hand set on it.
alt_translation1: Anillo que lleva una manita montada.

Description: Ring with an inscription meant to commemorate a wedding.
alt_translation1: Anillo de recuerdo de bodas que lleva una inscripción.

Description: Song sung while playing the children's game known as compañiá jáu in which players bump each other with their buttocks to try to knock each other down.
alt_translation1: Cantaleta que se canta en el juego llamado compañiá jáu en el que los jugadores se pegan con las pompas hasta hacerse caer.

Description: Leather pad in a slingshot where the stone is placed before shooting.
alt_translation1: Almohadilla de cuero de una resortera donde se coloca la piedra para tirar.

Description: Needy mood in toddlers, especially when they are weaned abruptly or when they are jealous of a newborn sibling.
Weakened condition because the item in question is rotten, worn out, eaten up inside (as in the case of plants), or saggy.
alt_translation1: Condición debilitada, ya sea por estar podrido, desgastado, carcomido, bofo, o desvencijado.

Description: A game in which coins are tossed within a delimited space. The objective is to make one's coin land in the space where the other player's coin is or within its delimited space. If successful, one wins the other player's coin.
alt_translation1: Juego en el que se lanzan monedas dentro de un espacio delimitado. El objetivo es de lograr que la moneda de uno caiga en el espacio donde está la moneda de otro jugador o dentro de una cuarta. Si se logra, uno gana la moneda del otro.

Description: Town of San Pedro Huilotepec, Oaxaca.
Zapotec city known as Santo Domingo Tehuantepec, Oaxaca, Mexico.
alt_translation1: Ciudad zapoteca de Santo Domingo Tehuantepec, Oaxaca, México.

Description: Some community members in Juchitán de Zaragoza and Santa María Xadani translate this lexeme as eyelashes. Others in La Ventosa translate it as eyebrow.
alt_translation1: Algunos en Juchitán de Zaragoza y Santa María Xadani traducen este lexema como pestaña. Otros en La Ventosa lo traducen como ceja.

Description: Steam, condensation, heat from the sun.
Demonym that refers to the inhabitants of the town of Unión Hidalgo.
alt_translation1: Gentilicio referente a los habitantes de Unión Hidalgo.

Description: Skink, small lizard with smooth and lustrous skin. They are thought to be venomous but they are not.
alt_translation1: Escíncido, pequeña lagartija de piel fina y lustrosa. Se tiene la idea de que estos reptiles son venenosos, pero no lo son.

Description: Edible fish, similar to the blue pike, found in the estuaries of the lagoon known as Dead Sea.
alt_translation1: Pez comestible de los esteros de la laguna conocida como el Mar Muerto.

Description: The seductive ability and disposition of a skirt chaser.
alt_translation1: Habilidad y disposición seductora de quien es mujeriego.

Description: Community elder and knowledge bearer who leads in certain social functions such as asking for a young woman's hand in marriage, delivering the li-banà at a wedding, or facilitating conciliation of a married couple in conflict.
alt_translation1: Persona mayor y conocedora que intercede en actos sociales para pedir la mano de una muchacha, administrar el libanà en una boda, o reconciliar un matrimonio en conflicto.

Description: Disease that spreads among animals such as chickens and pigs.
alt_translation1: Enfermedad que se transmite entre los animales como los pollos, gallinas y cerdos.

Description: Food or meal. The act of eating.
Premade or processed food (ex. canned food).
alt_translation1: Comida preparada o procesada (ej. la comida de lata).

Description: Jiménez Girón (1979:82) explains that in the context of a wedding ceremony, this lexeme refers to gifts offered to the family of the bride on the Saturday prior to the wedding. These gifts include live animals, bags of corn, and condiments, all of which are presented amidst music, fireworks and celebration.
alt_translation1: Jiménez Girón (1979:82) explica que en el contexto de una celebración matrimonial, este lexema se refiere a ciertos regalos que se presentan a los familiares de la novia en el sábado que le precede a la boda. Estos regalos pueden ser animales vivos, maíz en costales, y condimentos. La entrega de dichos regalos conlleva música, cohetes y celebración.

Description: The act of putting, introducing or submerging something inside something else. This lexeme has sexual connotations.
alt_translation1: El acto de meter, introducir, encajar o sumergir una cosa dentro de otra. Este lexema puede usarse con connotaciones sexuales.

Description: The act of making someone pay for something, be it the interests on a money loan or a rent. This also refers to revenge as a way of making someone pay for a grievance committed.
alt_translation1: El acto de hacerle a alguien pagar por algo, ya sean los intereses de un préstamo de dinero o una renta. También se refiere a la venganza como una forma de hacerle pagar a alguien por algún agravio.

Description: Pounding, shaking, straining, sifting, sifting, sieving.
alt_translation1: El acto de aporrear, sacudir, colar, cernir, tamizar.

Description: The act of mockingly mimic someone or make fun of their speech and/or gesture.
alt_translation1: El acto de arremedar a alguien o de burlarse de su manera de hablar.

Description: Pounding or shaking to clean something as is done when processing dry beans.
alt_translation1: El acto de aporrear o sacudir para limpiar algo, como se hace con el frijol.

Description: This refers to a digestive ailment that can be loosely described in English as indigestion. However, culturally, this ailment is considered to be dangerous to the point of being fatal. It is caused by excessive consumption of something (ex. an infant who drinks too much maternal milk) and is perhaps a motivator for self-control.
Tuberculosis. This literally means "dry disease" because the patient becomes so skinny that they look as if they were dried up. Tuberculosis is considered a disease associated with heat.
alt_translation1: Tuberculosis. Literalmente significa "la enfermedad seca" porque el enfermo enflaca y toma una apariencia como si estuviera seco. La tuberculosis se considera una enfermedad caliente.

Description: A game in which a garment is passed from one person to another while singing the verse pasalotèngo, pasalotèngo, tindaà xhaba Juàna (pasalotengo, pasalotèngo, a piece of Jane's clothing). Whoever has the garment at the end of the song receives a punishment.
alt_translation1: Juego en el que una prenda se pasa de una persona a otra mientras se canta la cantaleta pasalotèngo, pasalotèngo, tindaà xhaba Juàna (pasalotengo, pasalotengo, una pieza de ropa de Juana). Quien se quede con la prenda al final de la cantaleta recibe un castigo.

Description: Game played with a sponge ball which is hit with the fist.
alt_translation1: Juego que se juega con una pelota de esponja que se golpea con el puño.

Description: Spinning top game. First, chips are thrown into a circle. Whoever misses the target by the greatest distance places their spinning top down and the rest try to hit it with their own spinning tops.
alt_translation1: Juego de trompo. Primero se tiran fichas dentro de un círculo. El de la ficha que queda más lejos del centro pone su trompo para que los demás lo intenten golpear con sus trompos.

Description: Some community members, especially in Juchitán de Zaragoza, translate this lexeme as eyebrow.
alt_translation1: Algunos, sobre todo en Juchitán de Zaragoza, traducen este lexema como ceja.

Description: Idiot. This also refers to a man whose wife cheats on him.
alt_translation1: Pendejo. También se refiere a un hombre al que su esposa engaña.

Description: Kind, respectful, mild mannered, well behaved.
alt_translation1: Bueno, bondadoso, respetuoso, tranquilo, que se comporta bien.

Description: Thick as in the case of cloth or fabric, or wide as in the case of someone with wide hips.
alt_translation1: Grueso como podría ser el caso de la tela, o ancho como una persona de caderas grandes.

Description: Sleepy, as if half dead, numb.
Fine, broken up. By extension and in relation to money, it also refers to coins or change.
alt_translation1: Menudo, fino, fragmentado. Por extensión y con relación al dinero, cambio o sencillo.

Description: About a flavor that is between sweet and sour, or about one that cannot be easily defined.
alt_translation1: De sabor entre dulce y amargo, o que no se puede determinar fácilmente.

Description: About a flavor that is not too sweet.
alt_translation1: De sabor que no está muy dulce.

Description: Wide, flat and rectangular like a wooden plank.
alt_translation1: Ancho, amplio, rectangular y plano como un tablón.

Description: Jiménez Girón (1979:114) defines this lexeme as referring to something that is very finely pulverized.
alt_translation1: Jiménez Girón (1979:114) define este lexema como "finamente pulverizado, liso".
Crespo, ondulado, rizado, chino en referencia al cabello.

Description: Loose, as in the case of a tooth that is about to fall, or a stake on the ground or a nail on the wall that are coming loose.
alt_translation1: Flojo, suelto, como un diente que se va a caer, o como un palo en la tierra o un clavo en la pared que se están soltando.

Description: Cracked, losing consistency, and even of viscous appearance, as when corn kernels crack open when cooked to make pozol, or when the corner of the mouth cracks due to dryness and oozes.
alt_translation1: Reventado, reblandecido, e incluso viscoso, como le ocurre al maíz cuando se cuece para hacer pozol, o a la comisura de los labios por resequedad.

Description: This describes someone's gait that has become altered to the point of walking with a limp.
Cheerful, sociable, charismatic. Describes a person of either sex who, even if they have a formal partner, will flirt with others.
alt_translation1: Alegre, sociable, carismático. Se utiliza con relación a ambos sexos para describir a una persona que aun si tiene pareja formal, le coquetea a otros.

Description: This describes an eye that is askew, as when a person has strabismus.
alt_translation1: Con el ojo chueco, como cuando se tiene estrabismo.

Description: With an off-kilter gait, as when carrying a heavy load.
alt_translation1: Que camina con el cuerpo chueco o de lado, como cuando se carga algo pesado.

Description: Twisted. This seems to apply to the extremities of the body, but not to other parts such as eyes or the back.
alt_translation1: Torcido. Se utiliza con relación a las extremidades del cuerpo, pero no a otras partes como los ojos o la espalda.

Description: To squeak or screech, as when teeth are set on edge after eating something sour or after hearing chalk against a blackboard.
alt_translation1: Con dentera, que rechina, como cuando uno aprieta los dientes hasta rechinar por comer algo agrio o por oír el sonido de un gis contra el pizarrón.

Description: For feet to buckle when bearing weight.
alt_translation1: Que se le falsean los pies.

Description: Tarnished or worn out, as in clothes.
Smooth, as in a bald head.
Hard, stiff. By extension, looking emaciated.
alt_translation1: Duro, tieso. Por extensión, flaco, raquítico.

Description: Short, shortened, cut short. By extension, short person.
Viscous and/or sticky, as in the case of infected and encrusted eyes.
alt_translation1: Viscoso y/o pegajoso, como cuando se infectan los ojos, supuran y se pegan.

Description: For vision or visibility to be clouded, foggy, or sombre.
alt_translation1: De visión o visibilidad nublada, empañada o sombría.

Description: Closed, obstructed, cloudy (in reference to the sky). It can be used to refer to a narrow-minded or ignorant person.
alt_translation1: Cerrado, tapado, nublado (con relación al cielo). Puede referirse a una personalidad cerrada o ignorante.

Description: Delicate, fragile, as in the case of something that could become damaged easily, something that is at risk, or someone whose health is seriously compromised.
alt_translation1: Delicado, frágil, como algo que fácilmente se dañaría, algo que corre peligro, o una persona que está grave de salud.
Salido, sobresalido, extendido más allá de un límite o de un contenedor.
Que no puede guardar un secreto.

Description: Very calm, tranquil, quiet or still.
Retracted onto itself, curled up. By extension, short person.
alt_translation1: Recogido, encogido, enrollado. Por extensión, chaparro.

Description: Sharp, in reference to a blade. By extension, aggressive as a person might be, or bothersome as when the sun is too strong.
alt_translation1: Afilado, filoso. Por extensión, agresivo como podría ser una persona, o que molesta como el sol fuerte.

Description: Daring, fearless, someone who gets into anything fearlessly.
alt_translation1: Atrevido, que se mete en todo sin tener miedo.

Description: Changed. Perhaps by extension or association, this participle may mean coldly or with displeasure, especially in relation to how someone speaks.
alt_translation1: Cambiado. Quizá por extensión o asociación, también se usa para describir frialdad o desagrado, sobre todo refiriéndose a la manera de hablar.

Description: Warm or hot, depending on the temperature that is optimal.
alt_translation1: Tibio o caliente, según la temperatura ideal que se busca.

Description: With company, together. This can refer to neighbors.
alt_translation1: Acompañado, unido, junto. Se puede usar para referirse a los vecinos y a sus casas.

Description: Mischievous, hyperactive, someone who is a challenge to manage.
Smooth, in the sense of worn out after having lost the original texture.
alt_translation1: Liso, en el sentido de estar gastado por haber perdido la textura original.

Description: Cold, cool. By extension, a soft drink (since it is often served cool).
alt_translation1: Frío, fresco. Por extensión, el refresco (la bebida).
Hacia abajo, y por lo tanto, hondo, profundo.

Description: To be buried. By extension, to be hidden, both in a literal sense as well as in the metaphorical sense of something secret.
alt_translation1: Enterrado, sepultado. Por extensión, escondido, tanto en el sentido literal como en el sentido figurado de ser algo secreto.

Description: Stupid, idiot. This lexeme can also refer to someone with a cognitive disability, but it does so offensively and should be avoided.
alt_translation1: Tonto, idiota, sin juicio. Este lexema también se usa para referirse a una persona con discapacidad cognitiva de manera despectiva, por lo cual debe evitarse este uso.

Description: Bent, buckled. This lexeme can be used to refer to a person who has a hunched or bent back due to age.
alt_translation1: Doblado, combo. Se puede usar este lexema para referirse a una persona jorobada o que ha perdido su postura erguida debido a la edad.

Description: Ripe. This lexeme can also be used to refer to a particular type of skin lesion that is removed or drained once it is said to have matured or reached the end of its development.
alt_translation1: Maduro, como una fruta que ya se puede comer, o como un nacido cuando ya se puede reventar y quitar.

Description: Someone who talks with a nasal sound.

alt_translation1: Gordo o gorda y con flacidez.

Description: Hollow and about to collapse, as would be the case of a tree or a house in poor condition.
alt_translation1: Bofo, carcomido y a punto de caerse, como un palo o árbol, o como una casa en malas condiciones.
Chueco, que perdió su forma original.

Description: Wasted away to the point of being bent out of shape, whether as a result of heat exposure or physical strain.
alt_translation1: Desgastado al grado de haberse enchuecado ya sea por calor o por desgaste físico.

Description: Tall and skinny. By extension, weak and unstable, as would be a newly born animal that cannot stand up yet. This participle is also used to refer to a small coastal bird.
alt_translation1: Alto y flaco. Por extensión, enclenque y débil, como un animal recién nacido que no se puede parar. Hay quienes usan este participio para nombrar a un pájaro pequeño de la costa.

Description: Heavy, especially in relation to the tongue of a person who articulates words differently from most people.
alt_translation1: Como si estuviera pesada, en referencia a la lengua de una persona que no articula las palabras como la mayoría de la gente.

Description: Shaggy, bearded, with fringes, hairy, fibrous, like some sea animals, a shaggy dog, or a fibrous palm leaf.
alt_translation1: Lanudo, barbudo, flecudo, filamentoso, como algunos animales de mar, un perro lanudo, o una palma con muchos filamentos.

Description: This lexeme describes a well-dressed, well-groomed woman who moves and speaks with many gestures, to the point of being pretentious.
alt_translation1: Este lexema describe a una mujer bien vestida, muy arreglada y que se mueve y habla con muchos ademanes, lo que la hace parecer presumida.

Description: This lexeme describes a well-dressed, well-groomed, pretentious man.
alt_translation1: Este lexema describe a un hombre bien vestido, muy arreglado, y presumido.

Description: Viscous or matted, as when hair develops residue and becomes matted, or due to accumulated dirt.
alt_translation1: Viscoso o apelmazado por mugre acumulada, o como cuando el cabello se apelmaza por suciedad o por lavarse sin champú.

Description: Describes a tortilla eaten on its own and not as part of a meal.
alt_translation1: Describe una tortilla que se come sin comida.

Description: Thin, light. With regards to money, it refers to small coins especially as opposed to bills.
alt_translation1: Menudito, suave, ligero. Con relación al dinero, se usa para referirse a las monedas en comparación con los billetes.

Description: In big strides or with legs apart.
alt_translation1: A zancadas o con las piernas separadas.

Description: This lexeme describes someone who stutterers.
Very small, tiny. Jiménez Girón (1979:140) states that this adjective is pejorative.
alt_translation1: Pequeñito, pequeñín. Jiménez Girón (1979:140) indica que este adjetivo es despectivo.
Pelón, calvo, sin pelo, sin vello.

Description: Big, in the sense of stocky or burly.
Rough, irregular, uneven. With an unkempt appearance.
alt_translation1: Tosco, irregular, disparejo. De aspecto descuidado.
Peludo, con mucho cabello, pelo o vello.

Description: Striped or mottled, as when grains are coarsely ground, or grooved, like stratiform clouds.
alt_translation1: Rayado o moteado, como cuando los granos no se muelen bien, o con forma de surco, como las nubes estratiformes.

Description: Of little substance and flavor as in the case of a Cucurbitaceae fruit (melon, watermelon, pumpkin, cucumber) that was cut too early or too late.
alt_translation1: De poca sustancia o sabor como en el caso de una fruta cucurbitácea (melón, sandía, calabaza, pepino) que se ha cortado antes de tiempo o demasiado tarde.

Description: Tender, delicate, as in the case of a newborn baby or of fresh corn on the cob.
alt_translation1: Tierno, como un bebé recién nacido o como un elote.

Description: State of fruits just before they begin to ripen and take on color.
alt_translation1: Sazón, como las frutas cuando apenas empiezan a tomar color y a madurarse.

Description: Broken, truncated, split, shortened, as in the case of a stump after a tree is felled.
alt_translation1: Tronchado, mocho, acortado, como queda el tocón después de cortar un árbol.

Description: Broken into pieces, crumbled, torn apart.
Wide-mouthed. By extension, rude or vulgar.
alt_translation1: De boca ancha. Por extensión, grosero.

Description: Some indicate that this lexeme describes the state of a baby born prematurely. Perhaps by extension, some others define it as describing a person with a sickly appearance, or who is crazy or dumb.
alt_translation1: Algunos indican que este lexema describe la condición de un bebé que nació prematuro. Quizá por extensión, algunos otros lo definen como un descriptor de una persona de aspecto enfermizo, loca, o tonta como un pazguato.

Description: Smashed, deformed, flaccid, especially as it refers to a misshapen foot. By extension, someone who has a limp due to a misshapen foot.
alt_translation1: Apachurrado, deformado, flácido, sobre todo en referencia a un pie malformado. Por extensión, alguien que cojea de un pie.

Description: Staggering or stumbling because of insufficient strength to walk.
alt_translation1: Que se tambalea o se tropieza por no tener suficiente fuerza para caminar.

Description: Grayish in color, discolored as when something becomes moldy. By extension, it can refer to ringworm affecting the scalp.
alt_translation1: De color grisáceo, despintado y descolorido, como cuando algo se enmohece. Por extensión, puede referirse a la tiña que afecta al cuero cabelludo.

Description: Arched like a branch might be, or on tiptoe.
alt_translation1: Arqueado como una rama, o de puntitas.

Description: Describes someone's limb or part of a limb that has been amputated or mutilated, and by extension may describe the person.
Unkempt, tangled or matted, referring to hair.
alt_translation1: Despeinado, enredado o enmarañado, refiriéndose al cabello.

Description: Bruised, as in the case of fruit.
Blond or of fair skin, in relation to a woman.
Blond or of fair skin, in relation to a man.
Dense or thick, in relation to liquids.
alt_translation1: Denso o espeso, con relación a líquidos.

Description: Jiménez Girón (1979:124) defines this lexeme as smooshed or deformed.
alt_translation1: Jiménez Girón (1979:124) define este lexema como "apachurrado, deformado".

Description: Bushy, full of brush, like a plot of land with a lot of wild growth.
alt_translation1: Tupido, lleno de monte, como un terreno con mucha maleza.

Description: Tangled in relation to hair, or gnarly in relation to wild plant growth.
alt_translation1: Enmarañado, ya sea con relación al cabello o a la maleza.
Que tropieza o se tambalea al caminar.

Description: Shrunken into a deformed shape, as in the case of leather or plastic exposed to high heat.
alt_translation1: Encogido, contraído, como el cuero o el plástico expuesto al calor fuerte.

Description: Atrophied, as in the case of a person's limb.
alt_translation1: Atrofiado, como en el caso de alguna extremidad del cuerpo.

Description: Cracked, broken, split, truncated. It may be used in relation to wooden objects, ex. a stick, a table, a pencil, or other hard objects such as a computer.
alt_translation1: Quebrado, roto, partido, tronchado. Se puede usar en referencia a objetos de madera, ej. un palo, una mesa, un lápiz, o un objeto duro como una computadora.

Description: Lit, bright, clear. By extension, intelligent.
alt_translation1: Iluminado, alumbrado, claro, despejado. Por extensión, inteligente.

Description: Clean, in reference to a place, an object, or a person. About the latter, and by extension, this adjective may describe someone who is arrogant, pretentious or vain.
alt_translation1: Limpio. Puede referirse a un lugar, a un objeto, o a una persona. Al tratarse de una persona, y por extensión, este adjetivo puede describir a una persona engreída, presumida o vanidosa.
De color amarillo, ámbar o miel.

Description: Funny, amusing, humorous, in reference to people, situations or speech acts.
alt_translation1: Chistoso, gracioso, humorístico. Puede referirse a personas, situaciones o algo que se dice.

Description: Weakened because the item in question is rotten, worn out, eaten up inside (as in the case of plants), or saggy.
alt_translation1: Debilitado, ya sea por estar podrido, desgastado, carcomido, bofo, o desvencijado.

Description: Plain, simple, with nothing special, as in the case of a tortilla eaten without food, or of a corn-based drink with no added sugar or flavor.
alt_translation1: Simple, sin nada especial, como en el caso de una tortilla que se come sin la comida, o del atole simple sin azúcar ni sabor agregado.

Description: Excited to the point of becoming unruly. By extension, dispersed, scattered, broken up, disintegrated.
alt_translation1: Alborotado. Por extensión, dispersado, disgregado, desintegrado, despedazado.

Description: Related to urine, whether its color or its smell.
alt_translation1: Relacionado con la orina, ya sea en referencia a su color o a su olor.

Description: Bunched up clothes. By association, suitcase.
Short, in relation to a person. By extension, this also refers to trees that are pruned to be short and have a wide canopy, as in the case of almond and mandarin trees.
alt_translation1: De baja estatura, dicho de una persona. Por extensión, también se refiere a árboles como el almendro y la mandarina que se pueden podar para que queden bajos y anchos como enramada.

Description: Dappled, mottled, as in the case of an animal, or of a person who has vitiligo or Pinta.
alt_translation1: Pinto, como en el caso de un animal pinto, o de una persona con vitíligo o con mal de Pinto.
Plegado, doblado, tableado (en el caso de la ropa).
Chueco, desviado, de lado, inclinado, oblicuo.

Description: Smelling rancid, as in the case of food that has gone bad. It can also refer to cheap perfume.
alt_translation1: Que huele a rancio o pasado. También puede referirse a un perfume de mala calidad.

Description: This adjective describes the abundance of water in deep or large bodies of water. By extension, it is used to describe other things that are abundant, such could be the case of food or money.
alt_translation1: Este adjetivo describe la abundancia de agua en cuerpos de agua profundos o caudalosos. Por extensión, se usa para describir otras cosas abundantes, como podría ser la comida o el dinero.

Description: Really? Exclamation to prompt an interlocutor to provide confirmation.
alt_translation1: ¿A poco? Exclamación para incitar al interlocutor a que confirme algo.

Description: Mud pit, especially one where pigs dwell and which used to be used to treat the sting of a wasp.
alt_translation1: Lodazal. En particular, el lodo donde se revuelcan los marranos y que se usaba para calmar el piquete de avispa.

Description: Liquid resulting from a chemical precipitate. It is used when the liquid is watery, without substance or nutritional value.
alt_translation1: Líquido resultante de un precipitado químico. Suele utilizarse específicamente cuando el líquido es acuoso, sin sustancia y carece de valor nutricional.

Description: Sound used to scare off pigs.
alt_translation1: Sonido que se usa para espantar puercos.

Description: Women who are in a relationship with the same man.
alt_translation1: Mujeres que tienen relaciones amorosas con el mismo hombre.

Description: Bound third person singular pronoun which may serve as subject as well as object and refers specifically to humans.
alt_translation1: Pronombre dependiente de tercera persona del singular que puede cumplir la función de sujeto y de objeto y que hace referencia específicamente a humanos.

Description: Proximal demonstrative that cliticizes to a noun referring to someone or something nearby. Equivalent to 'this'.
alt_translation1: Demostrativo que se adhiere a un sustantivo para referirse a algo o alguien que está cerca. Equivalente a 'este', 'esta', y 'esto'.

Description: Bound first person plural exclusive pronoun which may serve as subject as well as object.
alt_translation1: Pronombre dependiente de primera persona plural exclusivo que puede cumplir la función de sujeto y de objeto.

Description: Enclitic that attaches to demonstratives to identify and select a referent among two or more other referents.
alt_translation1: Partícula que le sigue a demostrativos para identificar y seleccionar un referente entre dos o más referentes.

Description: Medial demonstrative that cliticizes to a noun referring to someone or something neither near nor far, or to a locative phrase to refer to a location that is neither near nor far. Equivalent to 'that'.
alt_translation1: Demostrativo que se adhiere a un sustantivo para referirse a algo o alguien que no está ni cerca ni lejos, o que se adhiere a una frase locativa para referirse a un lugar que no está ni cerca ni lejos. Equivalente a 'ese', 'esa', 'eso', 'aquel', 'aquella', 'aquello'.

Description: Distal demonstrative that cliticizes to a noun to refer to someone or something far away, or cliticizes to a locative phrase to refer to a far away location. Equivalent to 'that'.
alt_translation1: Demostrativo que se adhiere a un sustantivo para referirse a algo o alguien que está lejos, o que se adhiere a una frase locativa para referirse a un lugar que está lejos. Equivalente a 'aquel', 'aquella', y 'aquello'.

Description: Distal demonstrative that cliticizes to a noun to refer to someone or something far away, or cliticizes to a locative phrase to refer to a far away location. Equivalent to 'that'.
alt_translation1: Demostrativos que se adhieren a un sustantivo para referirse a algo o alguien, o que se adhiere a una frase locativa para referirse a un lugar que está lejos. Equivalente a 'aquel', 'aquella', 'aquello'.

Description: Bound second person singular subject pronoun.
alt_translation1: Pronombre dependiente de segunda persona del singular que cumple la función de sujeto.

Description: Bound third person singular pronoun which may serve as subject as well as object and refers specifically to non-human or non-rational animals.
alt_translation1: Pronombre dependiente de tercera persona del singular que puede cumplir la función de sujeto y de objeto y que hace referencia específicamente a animales no humanos o no racionales.

Description: Bound third person singular pronoun which may serve as subject as well as object and refers specifically to inanimate objects.
alt_translation1: Pronombre dependiente de tercera persona del singular que puede cumplir la función de sujeto y de objeto y que hace referencia específicamente a objetos inanimados.

Description: Bound third person singular pronoun which may serve as subject as well as object and refers to someone being pitied.
alt_translation1: Pronombre dependiente de tercera persona del singular que puede cumplir la función de sujeto y de objeto y que hace referencia específicamente a alguien a quien se le tiene lástima.

Description: Bound first person plural inclusive pronoun which may serve as subject as well as object.
alt_translation1: Pronombre dependiente de primera persona plural inclusivo que puede cumplir la función de sujeto y de objeto.

Description: Particle that provides precision to a statement.
Adverbial particle that provides precision or sets a limit.
alt_translation1: Partícula adverbial que expresa precisión o establece un límite.

Description: Bound second person plural pronoun which may serve as subject as well as object.
alt_translation1: Pronombre dependiente de segunda persona plural que puede cumplir la función de sujeto y de objeto.

Description: Bound first person singular subject pronoun.
alt_translation1: Pronombre dependiente de primera persona del singular que cumple la función de sujeto.

Description: Bound third person singular pronoun that refers specifically to men.
alt_translation1: Pronombre dependiente de tercera persona del singular que hace referencia específicamente a hombres.

Description: Bound third person singular pronoun that refers specifically to children. This pronoun has fallen out of use in daily speech but is documented in ceremonial speeches known as libanà.
alt_translation1: Pronombre dependiente de tercera persona del singular que hace referencia específicamente a niños. Este pronombre está en desuso en el habla del diario, pero se ha documentado en los discursos ceremoniales conocidos como libanà.

Description: To be cooked, including various cooking techniques such as broiling, browning and frying.
alt_translation1: Cocerse, incluyendo varias técnicas de cocción como por ejemplo, asarse, dorarse y freírse.

Description: To be stuck, to be jammed, to be wedged in.
To lie down in order to fall asleep.
To lay down Baby Jesus in a Nativity scene.
alt_translation1: Acostar al Niño Jesús en el pesebre de Navidad.

Description: To contribute funds (lit. for money to lie down).
alt_translation1: Cooperar con dinero (lit. acostarse el dinero).

Description: To contribute funds (lit. for money to lie down).
alt_translation1: Cooperar con dinero (lit. acostarse el dinero).

Description: For a date to be set (lit. for a day to lie down).
alt_translation1: Fijarse la fecha (lit. acostarse el día).

Description: To calm down, to quiet down.
To duck under, to bend down.
To lean, to tilt, to cant, to lie sideways or on one side.
alt_translation1: Cantearse, inclinarse, ladearse, hacerse o ponerse de lado.

Description: To be awake, to pull an all-nighter, to stay alert.
alt_translation1: Estar despierto, desvelarse, mantenerse alerta, ponerse vivo.

Description: To lie belly down, to turn upside down.
For residue to settle at the bottom of a container.
alt_translation1: Depositarse residuos en el fondo de un recipiente.

Description: To plow; to clear the vegetation in a plot of land, especially prior to plowing.
alt_translation1: Barbechar, limpiar un terreno de siembra.

Description: Nixtamalization, the process through which corn kernels are cooked in water and lime prior to grinding into dough for tortilla baking.
To press with the hand. By extension, to oppress someone, to go after someone, to be cruel towards someone.
alt_translation1: Oprimir con la mano. Por extensión, oprimir a alguien, atosigarlo, ensañarse con alguien.

Description: To say, tell, or communicate to someone.
To insult someone, to offend someone.
To swallow, to ingest, to gulp down.
To burst, to explode, as when mosquitos swarm or an egg shell breaks as a bird hatches. By extension, to exude, to fester, to ejaculate.
alt_translation1: Reventarse, explotar, o brotar, como cuando revientan los mosquitos o cuando rompe el cascarón un pajarito. Por extensión, exudar, supurar, eyacular.

Description: For the eye to have discharge. This is considered an ailment associated with heat, that is not contagious, that affects children who have tonsillitis and causes their eyelids to shut closed. It can be treated by rinsing the eye with chamomille tea. It is also considered to resolve as the tonsillitis subsides.
alt_translation1: Supurarle el ojo. Se considera que es una enfermedad caliente, no contagiosa, que afecta a los niños cuando tienen anginas y hace que se les peguen los párpados. Para curarlo se lava el ojo con té de manzanilla. También se considera que se resuelve cuando se curan las anginas.

Description: To break, to split. It may be used in relation to wooden objects, ex. a stick, a table, a pencil, or other hard objects such as a computer.
alt_translation1: Quebrarse, romperse, partirse, troncharse. Se puede usar en referencia a objetos de madera, ej. un palo, una mesa, un lápiz, o un objeto duro como una computadora.

Description: To desire, to covet, to be after something.
To burst open under pressure, as when fruit is squashed and breaks open.
alt_translation1: Tronarse, como la fruta que se aplasta.

Description: This is an ailment associated with heat that can happen after experiencing significant anger. The person turns red or purple, then yellow, throws up bitter and yellow vomit, can faint and even die. This requires medical treatment and pharmaceutical medication.
alt_translation1: Derramarse la bilis. Esto le ocurre a las personas que se enojan demasiado. La persona se pone colorada o morada, luego amarilla, vomitan amargo y amarillo, se puede desmayar o hasta morirse. Se considera una enfermedad caliente, no contagiosa. Para su cura hay que acudir al doctor y tomar medicamento de farmacia.

Description: For bones to crack or for the body to be achy.
alt_translation1: Tronar los huesos o doler el cuerpo.

Description: For lactation to suddenly stop on an infant, as when the mother becomes pregnant. This expression can also be used to refer to the malnourished aspect that the child might develop as a result.
alt_translation1: Interrumpírsele la lactación a un infante, como cuando la madre está embarazada. Por lo mismo, este compuesto puede usarse para describir el aspecto de malnutrido que pudiera desarrollar el infante.

Description: To be pierced, to be perforated, to hollow out.
For a dimple to form in the cheek.
alt_translation1: Hacérsele un hoyito en la mejilla.

Description: To get wet, to get soaked, to get drenched.
To be bribed (lit. for the hand to get wet).
To nurse, to suckle, to suck.
To struggle in terms of having to make an effort to overcome a challenge.
alt_translation1: Batallar en cuanto a tener que hacer un esfuerzo para vencer un reto.

Description: To be smart about something, to be ready in order to benefit from something, to be careful.
To crumble, to break into pieces.
To be made out of clay.
To become water logged, to become flooded.
To turn out small as in the case of fruit that did not develop to its expected size. To break down into small units, as in the case of money that is made into change.
alt_translation1: Hacerse menudito o chiquito como en el caso de fruta que no creció como debería. Hacerse sencillo como en el caso de dinero en monedas.
Hacerse malo, como una persona que se hace maldosa o malvada.

Description: To become a glutton, to become a big eater.
To be stunned, to be stupefied.
For the corn harvest to be abundant.
alt_translation1: Lograrse una buena cosecha de mazorcas de maíz.

Description: To fill up with water, to become flooded.

alt_translation1: Cobrar el sueldo, o anteriormente, recibir la raya.

Description: To make an effort, to try hard.

alt_translation1: Hacerse de uno, convertirse en propiedad de uno.

Description: To be located, to be at.
alt_translation1: Encontrarse, refiriéndose a la ubicación de alguien o de algo.

Description: To be in a romantic relationship with someone.
alt_translation1: Tener compromiso amoroso con alguien, ser novio de alguien.

Description: To get fixed, to get repaired, to get better.
To get confused, to become confused.
To tremble, to shake, to shiver.
For work to be done. In a locative construction, this compound refers to work related to a celebration.
alt_translation1: Hacerse el trabajo. En una construcción locativa (que especifica una ubicación), este compuesto se refiere al trabajo relacionado con una celebración.

Description: To become skinny, to become bony.
For something to be done in the meantime or temporarily.
alt_translation1: Hacerse algo por mientras o de manera temporal.

Description: For the corn harvest to be abundant.
alt_translation1: Lograrse una buena cosecha de mazorcas de maíz.

Description: To cure, both in terms of food conservation and in terms of healing an illness or taking steps to get over a hangover.
alt_translation1: Curar, en relación con la conservación de alimentos y en cuanto a la cura de una enfermedad o de una cruda.

Description: To have an eye infection or conjunctivitis. This is an ailment associated with heat. It tends to strike during the rainy season. Symptoms include initial itchiness followed by sensitivity to light and purple discoloration around the eye. It is treated with eye drops prescribed by a doctor, and with chamomile tee compresses.
alt_translation1: Tener conjuntivitis, aflicción caliente que suele ocurrir en época de lluvias. Los síntomas incluyen comezón inicial seguida de sensibilidad a la luz y descoloración morada alrededor del ojo. Se cura con gotas que receta el médico, y con compresas de agua de manzanilla.

Description: To go crazy, to rush excessively, to become agitated.
To become hot, to feel hot.
alt_translation1: Acalorarse, tener calor, hacer calor, calentarse.

Description: To become small. By extension, to become rejuvenated, to be humiliated.
To help, to assist, to collaborate with.
To pass, to go too far.
To take advantage of, whether positively in terms of deriving a benefit, or negatively in terms of taking advantage of someone or being opportunistic.
To get scratched, in reference to a smooth surface.
alt_translation1: Rayarse, dicho de alguna superficie lisa.

Description: For a celebration or party to be held.
To secure something, to take advantage of in order to secure something for oneself.
alt_translation1: Asegurarse de algo, aprovecharse para asegurar algo para sí mismo.

Description: To slow down and/or fall behind.
To be stunned, to be stupefied.
Writhing of worms or bugs. By extension, for the stomach to grumble, for a body part to itch.
alt_translation1: Retorcerse, dicho de lombrices o bichos. Por extensión, retorcerse las tripas, tener comezón.

Description: This phrasal verb is difficult to describe because it has fallen into disuse. Jiménez Girón (1979) describes that it refers to scraped corn that becomes bitter because it is not cooked in time. In Santa María Xadani it is considered a term that refers to ears of corn that are ready to be made into baked tortillas.
alt_translation1: Este verbo de frase resulta difícil de describir debido a que ha caído en el desuso. Jiménez Girón (1979) indica que se refiere a "cuando el elote raspado toma un sabor medio amargo por no cocerse a tiempo". En Santa María Xadani se considera un término que indica que la mazorca está lista para hacerse en totopo.

Description: To be greased up, to be covered in grease.
alt_translation1: Engrasarse, cubrirse o embarrarse de grasa.

Description: To become very excited. By extension, to become sexually aroused.
alt_translation1: Ponerse alocado o emocionado. Por extensión, ponerse excitado sexualmente.

Description: To bulge or become inflamed because of an infection and the presence of pus.
alt_translation1: Abultarse o hincharse por infección y presencia de pus.

Description: For there to be an earthquake.
To put something on, especially clothes, to wear.
alt_translation1: Ponérselo, dicho de la ropa, vestirse.

Description: For a fruit or for corn to harden prior to ripening.
alt_translation1: Sazonarse, con relación a una fruta o al maíz antes de madurar.
Ser un cara dura, ser descarado, ser sinvergüenza.

Description: For corn to harden prior to ripening
alt_translation1: Sazonarse, con relación al maíz antes de madurar.

Description: To be born, in reference primarily to mammals including humans.
alt_translation1: Nacer, dicho principalmente de los mamíferos incluyendo a los humanos.

Description: To be born prematurely, in reference primarily to a stillbirth that is due to premature labor.
alt_translation1: Nacer prematuramente, dicho generalmente de cuando se nace muerto por parto prematuro.

Description: To catch something that is up in the air.
alt_translation1: Atrapar o cachar algo que está en el aire.

Description: To hear or find out about something.
To know, to learn, to be informed.
To request, to rent, to borrow including borrowing money.
alt_translation1: Solicitar, alquilar, pedir prestado, pedir fiado.

Description: To know about fear-induced ailments and how to cure them.
alt_translation1: Saberle al espanto y poder curarlo.

Description: To find out, to come to know.
To be aware, to be attentive, to be careful.
alt_translation1: Estar al tanto, fijarse, tener cuidado.

Description: To know how to love, to love, to adore.
To look after, to watch over, to guard, to protect.

alt_translation1: Velar. En San Blas Atempa, esto se refiere a una ceremonia en la que se lleva luz a una boda.

Description: To celebrate Christmas Eve with a fish meal.
alt_translation1: Celebrar comiendo pescado el 24 de diciembre.

Description: To sleep around, to have extramarital sex or sex with multiple partners.
alt_translation1: Acostarse con otros en el contexto de tener sexo extramatrimonial o con parejas múltiples.

Description: For something to happen or be done on and off, to ebb and flow (lit. to die and to revive).
alt_translation1: Ocurrir de manera intermitente o con fluctuaciones (lit. morir y revivir).

Description: End of the lunar cycle, end of the month (lit. for the moon to die).
alt_translation1: Final del ciclo lunar, final del mes (lit. morir la luna).

Description: To drown in a body of water (lit. to die in a river).
alt_translation1: Ahogarse en un cuerpo de agua (lit. morir en río).

Description: To cry to exhaustion, in reference primarily to babies and toddlers.
alt_translation1: Llorar a más no poder, dicho de infantes de muy temprana edad.

Description: To die of love. The use of this phrasal verb seems to be limited to the area of Juchitán de Zaragoza. Knowledge bearers from La Ventosa and Santa María Xadani do not use it.
alt_translation1: Morir de amor. El uso de este verbo de frase parece limitarse a la zona de Juchitán de Zaragoza, ya que ciertos conocedores de La Ventosa y de Santa María Xadani no lo utilizan.

Description: To be overly devoted to someone.
To be infuriated (lit. to die by anger).
alt_translation1: Morirse de coraje en el sentido de una situación en que alguien está sumamente enojado.

Description: To die of suffocation or asphyxiation.
To be infuriated (lit. to die by intense emotional disturbance).
alt_translation1: Morirse de coraje en el sentido de una situación en que alguien está sumamente enojado (lit. morir de alteración emocional).

Description: To be infuriated (lit. to die by anger).
alt_translation1: Morirse de coraje en el sentido de una situación en que alguien está sumamente enojado.
Morirse de hambre, ya sea literalmente o manera figurada.

Description: To spray water over someone or something.
alt_translation1: Rociar con agua, cubrir de agua.

Description: To extract, to take out, to pull out. This verb is also used to describe the practice whereby, during the first night of a couple's domestic partnership or marriage, the groom inserts a finger into the bride's vagina to extract the hymen and verify her virginity.
alt_translation1: Quitar, sacar, extraer, arrancar, restar. Este verbo también se usa para describir la práctica mediante la cual, durante la primera noche del concubinato o del matrimonio de una pareja, el novio introduce un dedo en la vagina de la novia para extraer el himen y verificar su virginidad.

Description: To stop caring for someone (lit. to rip someone out of one's heart).
alt_translation1: Desentenderse de alguien (lit. arrancarse a alguien del corazón).

Description: To uproot, to pull a plant with its roots.
To back out, to pull out. To do something without thinking it through.
alt_translation1: Rajarse, dejar algo. Hacer algo sin pensarlo bien.

Description: To do something without thinking it through.
To pull out with a tool.
To leave, to uproot oneself, to pull out.
To emerge intensely (lit. to pull out one's sharp edge). Metaphor to describe an energy that is so intense, it becomes bothersome, as when the sun comes out very strong.
alt_translation1: Salir bravo (lit. sacar su filo). Metáfora para describir una energía que molesta, como cuando sale el sol muy fuerte.

Description: To drape oneself lavishly in jewelry.
To put on, to put down, to lay down, to place.
To have a way with words in Didxazá, to write poetry or songs in Didxazá.
alt_translation1: Tener un don de palabra en didxazá, componer poesía o canciones en didxazá.

Description: To set a date, as for an event or commitment.
alt_translation1: Poner el día, seleccionar una fecha (ex. para algún evento o compromiso).

Description: To put on clothes, to get dressed.
To pawn one's property in exchange for a loan, to start one's own business (lit. to put down something of one's own).
alt_translation1: Empeñar algo propio a cambio de un préstamo de dinero, iniciar un negocio propio (lit. poner algo suyo).

Description: To make someone duck under or bend down.
To lay the head down to rest on something. By extension, to think about someone or something, to have something in mind.
alt_translation1: Recostar o descansar la cabeza sobre algo. Por extensión, pensar en algo o en alguien, tener algo en mente.

Description: To lean, to lean down, to lay something sideways or leaning.
alt_translation1: Ponerse o ponerlo de lado, inclinarse o inclinarlo.

Description: To name, to give a name.
To look over, as a task.
To put someone on notice, to warn.
To put something face down, to place upside down, to invert.
To place something face up or right side up.
To set the foundation of something, to found, to establish.
To steal, to abduct. This verb is used to describe when a young man takes his girlfriend to his house to become established as a couple.
alt_translation1: Robar, raptar. También se usa para describir cuando un chico se lleva a su novia a su casa para establecerse como pareja.

Description: To rob by way of not delivering the full amount paid for.
alt_translation1: Robar al no entregar la cantidad completa de una mercancía que se pagó.

Description: To glean, especially as it relates to the collection of corn husks left behind after the harvest.
alt_translation1: Espigar, pizcar o pepenar, en particular cuando se trata de recolectar la mazorca que se quedó en la milpa después de la cosecha.

Description: Jiménez Girón (1979:151) defines this phrasal verb as denting the grinding slab or the grinding stone.
alt_translation1: Jiménez Girón (1979:151) define este verbo de frase como "picar el metate o la piedra de moler".

Description: To rap someone on the head.
To pull out, to extract, to remove.
To perform a c-section to deliver a newborn, to perform an abortion using suction.
alt_translation1: Practicar una cesárea para dar a luz a un recién nacido, practicar un aborto mediante succión.

Description: To emit flames or sparks, to be fuming.
To obtain an abundant corn harvest.
alt_translation1: Obtener buena cosecha de la milpa.

Description: To prop up fallen corn stalks.
To skin, to peel, to shell.
This phrasal verb is used to describe when a young man takes his girlfriend to his house to become established as a couple.
alt_translation1: Este verbo de frase se usa para describir cuando un chico se lleva a su novia a su casa para establecerse como pareja.

Description: To calculate a sum, to find a solution, to find the way (lit. to pull out the way).
alt_translation1: Sacar la cuenta, hallar la solución, encontrar la manera (lit. sacar su camino).

Description: To show or stick out one's face. By extension, to make a profit by not delivering the full amount paid for.
alt_translation1: Asomar la cara. Por extensión, obtener una ganancia sobre todo al no entregar la cantidad completa de una mercancía que se pagó.

Description: To show the way, to kick out.
alt_translation1: Señalar el camino, encaminarlo, correrlo, largarlo.

Description: Laying out an irrigation canal around a crop field.
alt_translation1: Trazar un canal de riego alrededor de un campo de cultivo.

Description: To keep someone from sleeping, to keep someone up.
To sow discord, to drive a wedge.
alt_translation1: Meter cizaña, hacer grilla, sacar el diente.

Description: To skin, to strip. By extension, to clean out.

Jiménez Girón (1979:153) offers the following definitions: “castra, capa, poda, (figurative and familiar) separates for himself part of jornal”. Otherwise, the literal meaning is 'to pull out the penis'.
alt_translation1: Jiménez Girón (1979:153) ofrece las siguientes definiciones: "castra, capa, poda, (figurado y familiar) separa para sí parte de jornal". De otra manera, el significado literal es 'sacar el pene'.

Description: To extract salt (from a salt mine).
To sprout, in reference to corn.
alt_translation1: Echar espiga (inflorescencia masculina), en el maíz.

Description: To pull the head out. By extension, to stop thinking or forget about something intentionally.
alt_translation1: Sacar la cabeza. Por extensión, dejar de pensar en algo u olvidar de manera intencional.

Description: To uncoil, to untie, to untwist, to shake with an oscillating motion.
alt_translation1: Desenredar, desatar, desenrollar, destorcer, zarandear, sacudir mediante un movimiento oscilatorio.

Description: To slice meat, to cut fabric strips, to part the hair.
alt_translation1: Sacar tiras, ej. tiras de tela, tiras de carne, la raya en el cabello.

Description: To cause to slip, slide or skid.
To discard, to set aside for discarding.
To take off to one side or sideways.
To stop caring for someone (lit. to take someone out of one's heart).
alt_translation1: Desentenderse de alguien (lit. sacar a alguien del corazón).

Description: To show or stick out one's face. By extension, to make a profit.
alt_translation1: Asomar la cara. Por extensión, obtener una ganancia.

Description: Kicking and screaming (lit. beating with the arms and kicking).
To speak ill of someone, to expose someone.
alt_translation1: Hablar mal de alguien, exhibir o delatar a alguien.

Description: This phrasal verb describes the action of generating the dough from which tortillas will be made. By extension, to achieve a goal.
alt_translation1: Este verbo de frase describe la acción de generar la masa con la que se elaborarán tortillas. Por extensión, lograr un objetivo.

Description: To solve, to find a solution.
To confess, to tell the truth.
To make someone lose the desire, will, or commitment.
alt_translation1: Quitarle a alguien el deseo, el anhelo, o las ganas, hacerlo desistir.

Description: To bring out fruit that was placed in a ripening environment.
alt_translation1: Sacar una fruta después de ponerla a madurar.

Description: To let something drop or fall.
To take out on a walk or stroll.
Talking nonsense, talking for the sake of talking.
alt_translation1: Hablar tonterías, hablar por hablar, decir disparates.

Description: To stop moving, to stay still or motionless.
To wait for a long time but in vain (lit. to wait during the day, to wait during the night).
alt_translation1: Esperar por mucho tiempo pero en vano (lit. esperar de día, esperar de noche).

Description: Jiménez Girón (1979:154) defines this phrasal verb as living without paying rent. Other knowledge bearers use the expression to describe someone who is pretending to wait.
alt_translation1: Jiménez Girón (1979:154) define este verbo de frase como "vivir sin pagar renta". Otros conocedores usan la expresión para describir que alguien simula esperar.

Description: To live in a common-law marriage or domestic partnership.

Habitual: ri-b.i # ike nyee;  gu-r.i # ike nyee

Description: To choose, to select, to elect.
To stay still, to calm down.
To get late in the morning, referring to a time around 9 or 10am (lit. for fire to sit).
alt_translation1: Hacerse tarde, refiriéndose a la media mañana alrededor de las 9 o 10 am (lit. asentarse el fuego).

Description: To peel, to skin. By extension, to circumcise.
alt_translation1: Pelar. Por extensión, circuncidar (remover el prepucio del pene).

Description: To jump, to stand up abruptly.
To sit with someone to keep them company, ex. at a wake.
alt_translation1: Sentarse a acompañar a alguien, ej. en un velorio.

Description: For residue to settle at the bottom of a container.
alt_translation1: Asentarse residuos en el fondo de un recipiente.

Description: For residue to settle at the bottom of a container.
alt_translation1: Asentarse residuos en el fondo de un recipiente.
Juntarse o aglomerarse, con relación a gente.

Description: To call someone, to summon someone, to invoke someone.
For ants to scatter. By extension, this verb phrase is used to describe the tingling sensation after an extremity of the body becomes numb.
alt_translation1: Desperdigarse o desbandarse las hormigas. Por extensión, se usa esta frase verbal para describir la sensación de hormigueo cuando se entume una extremidad del cuerpo.

Description: For the taste of water to change, either because it becomes salty or because it acquires an unpleasant taste.
alt_translation1: Cambiarse el sabor del agua, ya sea porque haga salada o porque adquiera un sabor desagradable.

Description: To revive, to come back to life.
To revive (ex. plants), to reignite (ex. fire), to flare up (ex. an illness).
alt_translation1: Reavivarse, con relación a las plantas, al fuego, o a una enfermedad.

Description: To sleepwalk (lit. to wake up during sleep).
alt_translation1: Ser sonámbulo (lit. despertarse durante el sueño).

Description: Jiménez Girón (1979:152) describes this verb phrase as suffering periodically from mental disorders, epileptic seizures or parasitic effects.
alt_translation1: Jiménez Girón (1979:152) describe esta frase verbal como "sufrir periódicamente trastornos mentales, ataques epilépticos o por efectos parasitarios".
Entrar en celo (lit. despertarse la brama).

Description: To not acquire too sweet a taste, in reference to food.
alt_translation1: No adquirir un sabor muy dulce, dicho de un alimento.

Description: To wait patiently but in vain.
To be disgusted by something, to be nauseated (lit. liver overturns).
alt_translation1: Tener o sentir asco (lit. volcarse el hígado).

Description: For a plant, flower or fruit to atrophy in such a way as to develop a grainy or bumpy texture.
alt_translation1: Atrofiarse una planta, flor o fruto desarrollando una apariencia granulosa.

Description: To shout, to scream, to squeak. This also refers to the making of any noise among non-human animals, e.g., howling, neighing, singing among birds.
alt_translation1: Gritar, chillar, rechinar. También se refiere al hecho de producir cualquier ruido entre animales no humanos, ej. aullar, relinchar, cantar de un pájaro.

Description: To dry up. By extension, to become excessively thin.
alt_translation1: Secarse. Por extensión, adelgazar o enflacar en exceso.

Description: To go home or return to one's place of residence. By extension, this verb can refer to the act of a newly married woman moving to her new home, or to a woman returning to her family following the breakdown of a romantic or marital relationship.
alt_translation1: Irse a casa, volver a donde uno vive. Por extensión, este verbo se usa para referirse al hecho de entregar a una mujer recién casada a su nuevo hogar, o al hecho de que una mujer regrese a su propia familia al disolverse su relación de pareja.

Description: To get dirty, to become stained.
To be laid open or extended.
To crack open, as when corn kernels crack open when cooked to make pozol, or when the corner of the mouth cracks due to dryness.
alt_translation1: Reventarse, tronarse, como le ocurre al maíz cuando se cuece para hacer pozol, o a la comisura de los labios por resequedad.

Description: For the corner of the mouth to crack open and ooze due to dryness.
alt_translation1: Cuartearse y supurar la comisura de los labios por resequedad.

Description: To cause something to tear, rupture or rip. This lexeme is used in relation to cloth, paper, skin, as well as the soil.
alt_translation1: Hacer que se rompa, se raje, se rasgue, se desgarre. Se usa con relación a tejidos como la tela, el papel, la piel, así como la tierra.
Haraganear, flojear, hacerse flojo o perezoso.

Description: To come loose, as in the case of a tooth that is about to fall, or a stake on the ground or a nail on the wall that are coming loose.
alt_translation1: Aflojarse, soltarse, como un diente que se va a caer, o como un palo en la tierra o un clavo en la pared que se están soltando.

Description: For someone's gait to become altered to the point of walking with a limp.
For an eye to be askew or off-kilter, as when a person has strabismus.
alt_translation1: Enchuecarse el ojo, como cuando se tiene estrabismo.

Description: To walk with an off-kilter gait, as when carrying a heavy load.
alt_translation1: Caminar con el cuerpo chueco o de lado, como cuando se carga algo pesado.

Description: To twist. This seems to apply to the extremities of the body, but not to other parts such as eyes or the back.
alt_translation1: Torcer. Se utiliza con relación a las extremidades del cuerpo, pero no a otras partes como los ojos o la espalda.

Description: To become blind, focusing on the change of state of the eyes.
alt_translation1: Quedar ciego, con atención al cambio de estado de los ojos mismos.

Description: For the skin of the heel to crack from dryness.
alt_translation1: Agrietarse el talón del pie por resequedad.

Description: To become scarce, as in the case of water when its source dries out.
alt_translation1: Escasear, como el agua en alguna fuente que se seca.

Description: For teeth to be set on edge and squeak, as when eating something sour, or when hearing chalk squeak against a blackboard.
alt_translation1: Apretarse los dientes hasta rechinar, o sentir dentera, como cuando se come algo agrio o cuando rechina un gis en un pizarrón.

Description: To cringe, as when teeth are set on edge. This is said to describe someone who is shameless.
alt_translation1: Encogerse la cara como cuando se siente dentera. La referencia a este gesto se hace para describir a alguien que no tiene vergüenza.

Description: To barely touch, when the intention is to hit. By extension, to lessen.
alt_translation1: Lograr apenas rozar cuando la intención es de golpear. Por extensión, menguar.

Description: To buckle, as when something is loaded with more weight than it can hold.
alt_translation1: Falsearse, como algo que se dobla al ponerle más peso de lo que puede soportar.

Description: To become tarnished or worn out, as in clothes.
To harden, to stiffen. By extension, to slim down.
alt_translation1: Endurecerse o ponerse tieso. Por extensión, enflacar.

Description: To become viscous and/or sticky, as in the case of infected and encrusted eyes.
alt_translation1: Ponerse viscoso y/o pegajoso, como cuando se infectan los ojos, supuran y se pegan.

Description: To become clouded, to fog up, to darken.
For one's vision to become clouded or blurry.
alt_translation1: Nublarse la vista, o hacerse borrosa.

Description: To become viscous and/or sticky, as when holding candy in one's hands.
alt_translation1: Ponerse viscoso y/o pegajoso, como cuando tienes dulces in las manos.

Description: To be touched, to be palpated.
To be rubbed, to be massaged.
To close up, to become covered up or obstructed. By extension, to faint, to lose consciousness.
alt_translation1: Cerrarse, taparse. Por extensión, privarse, desmayarse, perder el conocimiento.

Description: To hunker down at home as a way to isolate oneself willingly. By extension, to be imprisoned.
alt_translation1: Encerrarse en casa por voluntad propia. Por extensión, estar preso.

Description: To be dug, to be excavated.
To slap. By association with the hand action, loom weaving or palm weaving.
alt_translation1: Dar manazos, abofetear. Por asociación con la acción de la mano, tejer en telar o tejer con palma.

Description: To weave palm leaves to build a thatch roof.
alt_translation1: Tejer palma, ej. para enramadas, para techo de casa.

Description: To be slapped, to be smacked.

alt_translation1: Santiguarse, curarse de espanto, hacerse una limpia.

Description: To reproduce, to multiply, to increase in number or quantity.
alt_translation1: Reproducirse, multiplicarse, aumentar en número o cantidad.

Description: To carry or haul, in reference to liquids or grain.
alt_translation1: Acarrearse, dicho sobre todo de líquidos o granos.

Description: To be closed up, to become covered up or obstructed. By extension, to faint, to lose consciousness.
alt_translation1: Cerrarse, taparse. Por extensión, privarse, desmayarse, perder el conocimiento.

Description: To sew, to stitch, to embroider, to suture.
To be lent, to be borrowed.
To be pulled, to be carried in, to be sucked in. By extension, to be smoked, in the sense of a cigar or cigarette being smoked.
alt_translation1: Jalarse, acarrearse, chuparse. Por extensión, fumarse.

Description: To be dragged on the floor.
To be tied, to be roped, to be lassoed.
alt_translation1: Lazarse, ser enlazado, amarrarse, ser amarrado.

Description: To tighten up, to become tight.
Spring up, flow, in reference to a liquid.
alt_translation1: Manar, brotar, dicho de un líquido.

Description: To be filled up, in reference to a liquid in a container. By extension, to fill up with pus, for a wound to become infected.
alt_translation1: Llenarse de líquido, ej. un recipiente, una olla. Por extensión, llenarse de pus, infectarse, dicho de una herida.

Description: For teeth to be set on edge.
To receive advice (lit. for the ear to be filled up).
Infection of a toenail from a blow. This condition is associated with heat. To treat it, the foot is soaked in hot water with salt and three or four flowers of the species Nerium oleander.
alt_translation1: Infectarse la uña del pie por un golpe. Esta afección se considera caliente. Para aliviarla, se suele remojar el pie en agua caliente con sal y tres o cuatro flores de rosa clavel (Nerium oleander).

Description: To receive advice to the point of saturation (lit. for the nose to be filled up).
alt_translation1: Ser aconsejado hasta la saciedad (lit. llenarse la nariz).

Description: To become lodged or stuck, as in the case of a splinter or a thorn under the skin.
alt_translation1: Enterrarse, encajarse, clavarse, sumirse (ej. una espina).

Description: To become flattened, to become dented.
For money to become plentiful. By extension, to become rich.
alt_translation1: Hacerse abundante el dinero. Por extensión, enriquecerse.

Description: To be in quarters or in a set of four.
To turn into dust or ashes, to be pulverized.
To pass through, to pass by, to overtake.
For the eyes or vision to become bleary.
To faint, especially due to hunger.
For a due date to pass.
alt_translation1: Pasarse el día, llegar la fecha límite, vencerse el plazo.

Description: To pass by quietly, without causing a stir.
To cross, to go across, to lie across.
To take a quick glance at.
For the optimal time for harvest or ripening of a fruit to pass.
alt_translation1: Pasarse el momento de maduración de una fruta o de una cosecha.

Description: To miscarry, to have an abortion.
alt_translation1: Abortar un embarazo, ya sea de manera espontánea o inducida.

Description: To poke out, to stick out.
alt_translation1: Salirse, sobresalir, extenderse más allá de un límite o de un contenedor.

Description: To fight. By extension, eclipse, given that it is defined as a battle between the sun and the moon.
alt_translation1: Pelearse. Por extensión, eclipse, puesto que se define como una batalla entre el sol y la luna.

Description: This phrasal verb describes an eclipse, defined as a battle between the sun and the moon.
alt_translation1: Este verbo de frase describe un eclipse, puesto que se define como una batalla entre el sol y la luna.

Description: To remain asleep even after the sun has risen. Some speakers use this verb phrase to describe someone with a broad forehead.
alt_translation1: Quedarse dormido aún después de que el sol haya salido. Algunos también usan este verbo de frase para describir a una persona de frente amplia.

Description: To calm down (lit. for the liver to calm down).
alt_translation1: Calmarse, apaciguarse, tranquilizarse (lit. calmarse el hígado).

Description: To gather onto itself, to retract onto itself, to curl up.

alt_translation1: Juntarse o aglomerarse, con relación a gente.

Description: To be submerged, to sink, to be overtaken by water. By extension, to be consumed, to run out.
alt_translation1: Sumergirse, hundirse, ser consumido por el agua. Por extensión, gastarse, consumirse, acabarse.

Description: To move over, to move to the side, to move out of the way.
alt_translation1: Arrimarse, quitarse, hacerse a un lado.

Description: To be solicited, to be hired, to be rented.

alt_translation1: Solicitar para santiguar, curar de espanto o hacer una limpia.

Description: To meet up. This verb phrase is often used as a farewell expression.
alt_translation1: Encontrarse, verse. Esta frase verbal se utiliza con frecuencia a manera de despedida.

Description: To be loved, to be adored, to be appreciated.
To bark. By extension, to admonish, to reprimand, to scold.
alt_translation1: Ladrar. Por extensión, amonestar, reprender, regañar.

Description: To be filled up with air, to become inflated.
To fill up the belly. By extension, to become pregnant.
alt_translation1: Llenar la barriga. Por extensión, embarazarse.

Description: To become full to the limit or to the point of distension.
alt_translation1: Llenarse hasta el tope, colmarse tanto que se expande.

Description: To warm up, to become hot.
To accompany someone, to join someone, to go with someone. By extension, to go well or look well with certain clothes.
alt_translation1: Acompañarse, juntarse con alguien, ir con alguien. Por extensión, verse bien con una ropa.

Description: To get together to fish as a group.
alt_translation1: Juntarse para pescar de manera colectiva.

Description: For a group of people to make a collective and organized purchase of corn.
alt_translation1: Comprar la mazorca de manera grupal y organizada.

Description: To meet up, to run into each other.
alt_translation1: Encontrarse, cruzarse o toparse con alguien.

Description: To become angry, irritable, aggressive or mean.
alt_translation1: Enojarse, ponerse irascible, hacerse agresivo o malo.

Description: To get tired, to become fatigued.
To have the need to fart.
alt_translation1: Tener ganas de echar un pedo.

Description: To have the need to urinate.
To have the need to poop.
To be amazed, to marvel, to be surprised.
To change, to turn into something else. By extension, to become altered, to go crazy.
alt_translation1: Cambiar, convertirse, tornarse (lit. hacerse otro). Por extensión, alterarse, alocarse.

Description: To suffer from a mental health disorder (lit. for the head to empty).
alt_translation1: Padecer de algún trastorno de salud mental (lit. vaciarse la cabeza).

Description: To become lightheaded or disoriented (lit. for the face/eyes to empty).
alt_translation1: Marearse, desorientarse (lit. vaciarse la cara/los ojos).

Description: To behave in an irrational or capricious way (lit. for the buttocks to empty).
alt_translation1: Comportarse de manera irracional, caprichosa, berrinchuda o sin juicio (lit. vaciarse las nalgas).

Description: To meet up with someone, run into someone, or face someone. By extension, to crash into someone, argue with someone, or fight with someone.
alt_translation1: Encontrarse con alguien, toparse con alguien, enfrentarse con alguien. Por extensión, chocar, pelear.

Description: To be late, as in the time of day or in regards to a schedule.
Dusk. By extension, when someone suffers a tragedy they can use this metaphorical expression to say that it is the end of the world for them.
alt_translation1: Atardecer. Por extensión, cuando alguien sufre una tragedia puede usar esta expresión figurada para decir que se le acaba el mundo.

Description: To be afraid, to be afraid of something.
To drive something in, ex. to hammer a nail in, to dig a knife into something, etc.
For dusk or darkness to set in (lit. for Earth to be covered).
To become bare and therefore smooth after having lost hair or feathers.
alt_translation1: Alisarse, por haber perdido el pelo o las plumas.

Description: To become viscerally angry (lit. for the liver to get angry).
alt_translation1: Enojarse de manera visceral (lit. enojarse el hígado).

Description: To have a nightmare (lit. to work during one's sleep).
alt_translation1: Tener una pesadilla (lit. trabajar en el sueño de uno).

Description: To be agitated, to be restless (lit. for the liver to work).
alt_translation1: Estar agitado, estar inquieto, no poder dormir (lit. trabajar el hígado).

Description: To drain, to drip, to filter through, to distill.

alt_translation1: Filtrarse a través de una grieta.

Description: To stir, to mix, to whip, in reference to cooking techniques.
To become tight. By extension, to hug each other, to squeeze each other.
To become painted, colored or dyed.
To drink, to absorb, to ingest.

alt_translation1: Absorber un olor, impregnarse de un olor.

Description: To drink or to have breakfast along with some particular food item, or in the company of someone.
alt_translation1: Beber o desayunar con algún alimento en particular, o bien, en compañía de alguien.

Description: To come. By extension, to menstruate, to ejaculate.
To catch one's breath (lit. for breath to come).
alt_translation1: Recuperar el aliento (lit. venir la respiración).

Description: For dawn to arrive (lit. to come to the night).
For something to come to mind. This verb is equivalent in meaning to the verb to remember.
alt_translation1: Venirle a la mente. Este verbo tiene un sentido equivalente al de los verbos acordarse y recordar.

Description: For a benefit to reach the person working for it, ex. that which is in the oven baking, or the earnings from a business.
alt_translation1: Llegarle a uno un beneficio por el cual está trabajando, ej. lo que se está horneando o la ganancia de un negocio.
Venir a decir, venir a avisar.

Description: To regain consciousness, to come to one's senses (lit. for light to come).
alt_translation1: Recuperar el conocimiento, volverle el juicio (lit. volver su luz).

Description: To menstruate (lit. for their lunar cycle to arrive).
For a scent to become perceptible (lit. for a smell to arrive).
To touch, to feel with the hands, to palpate, to paw, to finger.

alt_translation1: Echar, verter o regar un líquido.

Description: To advise (lit. to pour into the ear).
alt_translation1: Dar un consejo (lit. verter dentro del oído).

Description: To rub or to massage with the hand. By extension, to hit with the hand.
alt_translation1: Sobarlo o masajearlo con la mano. Por extensión, golpearlo con la mano.

Description: To dig, to burrow. By extension, to interrogate.

To slap or smack. This refers to various types of hitting actions of the hand as in spanking, flattening and shaping tortilla dough, hitting palm leaves when installing a thatched roof, or to certain actions of the hand when weaving.
alt_translation1: Golpear con la mano o dar manotazos. Se refiere a la acción de golpear con la mano, nalguear o cachetear, pero también se refiere a cuando se tortea la masa para formar la tortilla, cuando se golpea la palma al instalar un techo, o a la acción de las manos al realizar ciertos tejidos.

Description: To flap the wings, to flutter.
To do a cleansing on a person who has suffered a traumatic experience.
alt_translation1: Curar de espanto, hacer una limpia, santiguar.

Description: To spank. By association, to express joy over someone else's misfortune.
alt_translation1: Dar una nalgada. Por asociación, alegrarse por la desgracia de otra persona.

Description: To carry, in reference to liquids or granular substances such as sand or grains.
alt_translation1: Acarrear, dicho de líquidos o de sustancias granulares como la arena o los granos.

Description: To go on top of something, to climb on something.
To get the chills, to shudder.
For prices to go up, especially in relation to staples such as beans and sugar.
