alt_translation1: Subir de precio, sobre todo con relación a productos de primera necesidad como el frijol y el azúcar.

Description: For prices to go up, especially in relation to goods and services that tend to be costly to begin with.
alt_translation1: Subir de precio, sobre todo con relación a productos o servicios que suelen ser costosos.

Description: To sew, to stitch, to mend, to embroider.
To make something burst or pop. By extension, to cause ejaculation.
alt_translation1: Hacerlo reventar, hacerlo tronar. Por extensión, hacerlo eyacular.

Description: To make chicks hatch by way of brooding. By extension, to have an extended conversation.
alt_translation1: Hacer eclosionar a los pollitos empollándolos. Por extensión, platicar largo y tendido.
Desvainar los ejotes o el frijol.
Brotar, retoñar, sacar botón, dicho de las plantas.

Description: To tsk in disapproval, to grumble in protest.
alt_translation1: Tronar la boca, rezongar, refunfuñar, repelar.

Description: For the sun to shine intensely.

alt_translation1: Hacer tronar los huesos del cuerpo.

Description: To crack, in the sense of to break.
alt_translation1: Tronar en el sentido de quebrar, partir o tronchar.
Tronarse los dedos de la mano.

Description: To squash to the point of bursting the contents out of a soft container such as a fruit.
To sprout. By extension, for a skin rash to spread.
alt_translation1: Brotar, retoñar, sacar botón, dicho de las plantas. Por extensión, reproducirse una erupción de la piel.

Description: To wash. By extension, to clean someone out.
To rinse dry corn kernels with water and lime.
alt_translation1: Lavar el maíz con agua de cal.

Description: To be squeezed, to be tightened, to be compressed.
To pierce, to bore, to drill.
To borrow, especially as referred to money.
alt_translation1: Pedir prestado, dicho sobre todo del dinero.

Description: To hit, to beat. By extension, to defeat.
To trick, to fool, to deceive (lit. to stick one under the fence).
alt_translation1: Engañarlo (lit. meterle una por debajo de la cerca).

Description: To blink (lit. to strike with the eyelid).
To knock on the door, to play an instrument by striking strings (lit. to strike with the hand). By extension, to warn.
alt_translation1: Tocar la puerta, tocar la guitarra o algún otro instrumento rasgando las cuerdas (lit. golpear con la mano). Por extensión, poner sobre aviso.

Description: To bring down or knock down with a blow.
alt_translation1: Tirarlo de golpe, tumbarlo o azotarlo estrepitosamente.

Description: To kick as a way to call attention or in a playful or squirming way.
alt_translation1: Pegar con el pie, patear, patalear.

Description: To put down, to treat with disdain (lit. to strike with dirt).
alt_translation1: Despreciarlo, menospreciarlo, criticarlo (lit. golpearlo con tierra).

Description: To hit someone as if that person were one's own child.
alt_translation1: Golpearlo como si fuera su hijo.

Description: To pinch. To peck, in reference to birds.
alt_translation1: Pellizcar. Picotear, dicho de los pájaros.

Description: To take things as a game.
alt_translation1: Tomar las cosas como un juego.

Description: To race, to participate in a race.
To lay down. By extension, to put down in writing, to compose a musical piece.
alt_translation1: Poner, colocar, acostar. Por extensión, poner por escrito, componer una obra musical o literaria.

Description: To set a date, as for an event or commitment.
alt_translation1: Poner el día, seleccionar una fecha (ex. para algún evento o compromiso).

Description: To take a look, to glance at, to check out.
alt_translation1: Echar un vistazo, echar un ojo, dar una hojeada.

Description: To pawn one's property in exchange for a loan.
alt_translation1: Empeñar algo propio a cambio de un préstamo de dinero.

Description: To lay down properly, to fix up, to straighten out. By extension, to put down in writing, to compose a musical piece.
alt_translation1: Poner, colocar o acostar correctamente, arreglar. Por extensión, poner por escrito, componer una obra musical o literaria.

Description: To take a loan based on pawning one's property.
alt_translation1: Tomar un préstamo de dinero a cambio de empeñar algo propio.

Description: To set on fire, to burn.
To lay the head down to rest on something. By extension, to think about someone or something, to have something in mind.
alt_translation1: Recostar o descansar la cabeza sobre algo. Por extensión, pensar en algo o en alguien, tener en mente.

Description: To lay something sideways or leaning.
To put someone on notice, to warn.
To lay something face down, to place upside down, to invert.
To lay something face up or right side up.
To lay the foundation of something, to found, to establish.
To pull, to attract, to suck in.
To breath, to inhale, to pull in air, to vacuum air out.
To pull or drag grass. By analogy, this verb is also used to refer to smoking marihuana.
alt_translation1: Jalar o acarrear zacate. Por analogía, este verbo también se refiere a la acción de fumar marihuana.

Description: To pull on the horse by the reins.
alt_translation1: Jalar al caballo de las riendas.

Description: Lit. 'to pull in the hand' to say that financial support is pulled away from someone, or that money is being pulled in to save it.
alt_translation1: Lit. 'retirar la mano', a manera de expresar que se retira un apoyo económico o que se retrae un dinero para ahorrarlo.

Description: To step back after making a decision, a promise, or a misstep (lit. to pull one's foot back).
alt_translation1: Retroceder después de haber tomado una decisión, haber hecho una promesa, o haber dado un mal paso (lit. retirar el pie).

Description: Lit. 'to suck one's mouth in' to say that a person thinks things through before saying them.
alt_translation1: Lit. 'jalar la boca (para adentro)' a manera de decir que una persona se piensa las cosas antes de decirlas.

Description: To sniff (lit. to pull in the nose).
To enter, to put (in)side, to insert.
To illuminate, to install electricity and lighting.

This phrasal verb describes the practice whereby, during the first night of a couple's domestic partnership or marriage, the groom inserts a finger into the bride's vagina to extract the hymen and verify her virginity.
alt_translation1: Este verbo de frase describe la práctica mediante la cual, durante la primera noche del concubinato o del matrimonio de una pareja, el novio introduce un dedo en la vagina de la novia para extraer el himen y verificar su virginidad.

Description: To curse at, to swear at.
To marry a couple. Jiménez Girón (1979:166) describes this verb as the action of a civil authority to unite a couple in marriage by way of reading to them the stipulated sermon (lit. to insert word).
alt_translation1: Casarlos. Jiménez Girón (1979:166) define este verbo como "unir en matrimonio la autoridad civil, leyendo la epístola o amonestando a los contrayentes" (lit. meter palabra).

Description: To incite or produce fear, to scare.
alt_translation1: Meter o infundir miedo, asustar, espantar.

Description: To praise, to flatter with sweet talk.
alt_translation1: Alabar, adular, hablar de manera dulce o mielosa.

Description: To whistle (lit. to throw a whistling).
To be cursed, to be screwed, said of a person who commits a reprehensible act against someone who will then seek revenge.
alt_translation1: Echarse la sal, chingarse, joderse, dicho de cuando una persona comete una infracción contra alguien quien en respuesta buscará vengarse.

Description: To cook tortillas in a clay oven.
alt_translation1: Cocer las tortillas en horno de barro.

Description: To hit with a leather strap.
alt_translation1: Golpear con un cuero, dar de cuerazos.
Echar zacate ya sea al bañarse, al limpiar o al fregar.

Description: To give a donation (e.g. to the church), to give a contribution towards the costs associated with special occasions, such as weddings, wakes, and community festivities known as 'velas' in Spanish.
alt_translation1: Dar limosna (ej. en la iglesia), depositar la cooperación que se acostumbra ofrecer durante las ocasiones especiales como en bodas, velorios y las velas.

Description: To fence in, to encircle, to besiege.
To recite, to deliver a sermon.
To expel, to throw out, chase away, to fire someone from a job.
alt_translation1: Expulsar, echar fuera, correr, despedir a alguien de su trabajo.

Description: To rap someone on the head.
To act judiciously, decently and/or responsibly.
alt_translation1: Actuar con juicio, decencia y/o responsabilidad.

Description: To send representatives to ask a woman's hand in marriage.
alt_translation1: Mandar a una comitiva para solicitar la mano de una mujer en matrimonio.

Description: To worry, to cause concern (lit. to introduce a worry).
To provide heat, to heat up.
To coat the walls of a construction with plaster or adobe.
alt_translation1: Repellar, ya sea con adobe o con yeso.

Description: To salt. By extension, to jinx.
alt_translation1: Echar sal. Por extensión, dirigir la mala suerte hacia alguien, de manera comparable a la expresión 'echar la sal' en castellano.

Description: To introduce something slowly. By extension, to save up, to put or store away to safeguard.
alt_translation1: Meterlo despacio. Por extensión, ahorrar, guardar, almacenar.

Description: To turn around, to twist, to twist around.
To roar. By extension, to bawl or wail in pain.
alt_translation1: Rugir, bramar. Por extensión, quejarse de dolor.

Description: To throw something up in the air.
alt_translation1: Aventar, lanzar o tirar hacia arriba.

Description: To check out someone or something (lit. to put beans in or into).
To measure, to weigh, to gauge. By extension, to calculate the necessary amount.
alt_translation1: Tomar la medida, medir, pesar, sopesar. Por extensión, calcular la cantidad necesaria o indispensable.

Description: To add or apply the necessary amount.
To be a godmother in a ceremony in which a child is anointed with wax and flowers, not for baptism.
alt_translation1: Amadrinar en una ceremonia de unción de cera y flores, pero no de bautizo.

Description: To use or wear for the first time.
To take a look, to take a peek.
To stick one's hand into something inappropriately.
To sew seed or work the land collaboratively.
alt_translation1: Sembrar o trabajar la tierra en colaboración con alguien.

Description: To add water, to soak, to set up an irrigation system. By extension, to baptize, to inaugurate.
alt_translation1: Meter agua, remojar, meter irrigación. Por extensión, bautizar, inaugurar.

Description: To kick, to kick in a squirming way.
To whistle (lit. to throw a whistling).
To stick one's nose where it doesn't belong.
To add or put on too much of something.
To sow discord, to drive a wedge.
To add or put on too much of something.
To worry or be concerned about something (lit. to put something at the bottom of one's head).
alt_translation1: Preocuparse o inquietarse por algo (lit. meterlo al fondo de la cabeza).

Description: To be tied, to be roped, to be lassoed.
alt_translation1: Lazarse, ser enlazado, amarrarse, ser amarrado.

Description: To break. It can be used in relation to piñatas, bones, tree branches, sticks and wood in general, but not with clay, glass or cloth objects.
alt_translation1: Quebrar, tronchar, romper, partir. Se puede usar en relación con piñatas, huesos, ramas de árbol, palos y madera en general, pero no con objetos de barro, vidrio o tela.

Description: To be cut, to be chopped, to be trimmed. By extension, to be convinced.
alt_translation1: Cortarse, mocharse, truncarse. Por extensión, dejarse convencer.

Description: For a plant to sprout or to turn green again after dormancy.
To stretch upwards, to grow, to elongate.
To be grabbed, to be caught, to be captured, to be apprehended.
alt_translation1: Ser agarrado, ser atrapado, ser capturado, ser aprehendido.

Description: To become bruised, as in the case of fruits and vegetables, to be crushed.
To be buried. By extension, to be hidden.
To be counted, to be numbered.
To shut up, to become quiet.
To quicken, in reference to a person. To become wilder, in reference to a non-human animal.
alt_translation1: Hacerse rápido o veloz, dicho de una persona. Hacerse salvaje, dicho de un animal no humano.

Description: To become disabled. This includes a reference to cognitive disability (in which case this lexeme could be offensive). By extension, this lexeme can refer to an inability to be reasonable, including being pretentious.
alt_translation1: Quedarse discapacitado. Esto incluye discapacidad cognitiva (en cuyo caso pudiera ser despectivo). Por extensión, este lexema puede referirse a la incapacidad de ejercer bien su juicio, como al hacerse presumido o prepotente.

Description: To stick to, to adhere to, to join.
To bend, to fold, to buckle due to lack of strength.
alt_translation1: Doblarse, flexionarse, vencerse por falta de fuerza.

Description: To ripen, ex. a fruit so that it may be eaten.
alt_translation1: Madurarse, ej. una fruta para que se pueda comer.

Description: To be used, to be in use, to be useful. To use.
To stick, to adhere, to be affixed to a surface. By analogy, this can be used to describe that a plant is thriving, and that something is written down.
alt_translation1: Pegarse, adherirse, fijarse en alguna superficie. Por analogía, se usa para decir que una planta es fructífera, y también que algo se escribe o se plasma gráficamente sobre una superficie.

Description: To become coiled, to become entangled.
For a plant, flower or fruit to atrophy in such a way as to present a grainy or bumpy texture.
alt_translation1: Atrofiarse una planta, flor o fruto desarrollando una apariencia granulosa.

Description: For one to develop indigestion or a stomach upset from eating too much.
This verb phrase describes the feeling of the contents of the stomach fluids rushing up.
alt_translation1: Esta frase verbal describe la sensación de que el contenido del estómago se sube repentinamente.

Description: To set up a support post to hang things from.
alt_translation1: Instalar una horqueta para colgar algo.

Description: To be announced, to be called.

This expression describes mastitis. It is considered an ailment associated with heat that is not contagious. It occurs when a woman who has recently given birth is denied something, is scolded or is shunned. When this happens, the flow of milk is interrupted, the breast becomes hardened and painful, and the woman can develop a fever. It is considered preferable to consult with a healer who can massage the woman, put her affected breast in a particular type of gourd, and speak to her so that she can process her feelings. This is done three days in a row. It is considered that even when the ailment resolves, it is possible that the milk flow will not come back and even for a future child, the milk might become salty. If only one breast is used for nursing, then the breasts may become uneven. It is also possible to see a medical doctor to extract the milk with a breast pump and bandage the breast.
alt_translation1: Se usa esta expresión para describir la mastitis como vergüenza de mujer recién parida. Se describe como un padecimiento que se considera caliente y no contagioso y que ocurre cuando a la mujer recién parida se le niega algo, se le regaña o se le desprecia. Cuando ocurre, se interrumpe el flujo de la leche, la teta se endurece y duele mucho, y puede dar fiebre. Para su cura, se considera que lo mejor es ir con una curandera que soba a la mujer, le ponga la teta en una jícara de pichancha, y le hable para sacar la vergüenza. Esto se hace tres días seguidos. Aunque se resuelva, se considera que la leche podría no volver a fluir e incluso con un futuro parto la leche podría quedar salada. Entonces solo se mama de una teta y las tetas pueden quedar disparejas. También se considera que se puede ir al médico para sacar la leche podrida con un sacaleche y vendar la teta.

Description: To celebrate at the start of the month with fireworks at church. In particular, this refers to the months of June in honor of Saint John, of July in honor of Santiago, and of August in honor of the Assumption of Mary.
alt_translation1: Celebrar el inicio del mes lanzando cohetes en la iglesia. Esto se dice sobre todo de los meses de junio en honor a San Juan, de julio en honor a Santiago, y de agosto para celebrar la Asunción de la Virgen María.

Description: For corn kernels to be overcooked, which gives the corn a burnt taste and smell and makes it stick to the pot.
alt_translation1: Cocerse demasiado el maíz lo cual le da un olor y sabor a quemado y hace que se pegue a la olla.

Description: To be lit on fire, to burn.
For a thought or concept to be etched on one's mind.
alt_translation1: Pegarse o grabarse algo en la cabeza.

Description: To expect something from someone, or to depend on someone.
alt_translation1: Poner expectativas en alguien o depender de alguien.

Description: To be set aside. By extension, to be shunned, to be rejected.
alt_translation1: Ser apartado a un lado. Por extensión, ser rechazado.

Description: To cling to another, ex. a person or an animal clinging to another.
alt_translation1: Juntarse o pegarse a otro, ej. una persona a otra o un animal a otro.

Description: To form mounds of soil at the foot of corn plants as a means to provide them with support
alt_translation1: Crear montículos de tierra al pie de las plantas de maíz para darles sostén

Description: To grab, to take, to get, to obtain, to receive, to contract (ex. an illness).
alt_translation1: Agarrar, coger, tomar, obtener, recibir, contraer (ej. una enfermedad).

Description: To receive or be given a greeting.
To taste food as it is being prepared to check that it has the intended flavor.
alt_translation1: Probar la comida que se está preparando para ver si tiene buen sabor.

Description: This verb phrase describes the feeling of stomach fluids rushing up into the head. This is considered to be a life threatening ailment.
alt_translation1: Esta frase verbal describe la sensación de los líquidos del estómago subiéndose repentinamente a la cabeza. Este padecimiento se considera que puede causar la muerte.

Description: To engage in a reciprocal relationship. This includes the relationship between a child, their parent(s) and godparent(s); between a couple and their marriage sponsors; social gatherings and festivities; as well as fights.
alt_translation1: Entrar en relación recíproca. Esto incluye las relaciones de padrinazgo, las reuniones sociales y las fiestas, así como las peleas.

Description: To take in someone's words in the sense of acquiescing or letting oneself be convinced.
alt_translation1: Aceptar las palabras de alguien a manera de acceder o dejarse convencer.

Description: To seek out a partner or spouse when attempting to reconcile after a quarrel.
alt_translation1: Ir a traer a la pareja a manera de reconciliación después de una riña.

Description: To celebrate at the start of the month with fireworks at church. In particular, this refers to the months of June in honor of Saint John, of July in honor of Santiago, and of August in honor of the Assumption of Mary.
alt_translation1: Celebrar el inicio del mes lanzando cohetes en la iglesia. Esto se dice sobre todo de los meses de junio en honor a San Juan, de julio en honor a Santiago, y de agosto para celebrar la Asunción de la Virgen María.

Description: To sigh or to inhale somewhat uncontrollably as a result of having cried too much.
alt_translation1: Suspirar, inhalar un tanto de manera incontrolada después de llorar mucho.

Description: To have indigestion or a stomach upset from eating too much.
To answer back, to respond in a rude or insolent manner.
To become somewhat hard of hearing (lit. for the ear to darken).
alt_translation1: Ponerse un poco sordo (lit. oscurecerse el oído).

Description: For a hen to become broody.
To become bent, to lose its original shape.
To waste away to the point of bending out of shape, whether as a result of heat exposure or physical strain.
alt_translation1: Desgastarse al grado de enchuecarse, ya sea por calor o por desgaste físico.

Description: For something to break, crack, split, sectioned, divide, referring to objects that are hard.
alt_translation1: Romperse, quebrarse, partirse, cuartearse, seccionarse, dividirse, dicho de objetos duros.

Description: To become flooded, to become waterlogged.
To slim down, to become thin.
To feel compassion for, to feel pity.
To tie oneself, to become entangled. By extension, to become engaged to fulfill an obligation.
alt_translation1: Amarrarse, atarse, enredarse. Por extensión, comprometerse.

Description: To be tied, to be roped, to be lassoed.
alt_translation1: Lazarse, ser enlazado, amarrarse, ser amarrado.

Description: To break. It can be used in relation to piñatas, bones, tree branches, sticks and wood in general, but not with clay, glass or cloth objects.
alt_translation1: Quebrarse, troncharse, romperse, partirse. Se puede usar en relación con piñatas, huesos, ramas de árbol, palos y madera en general, pero no con objetos de barro, vidrio o tela.

Description: To throw oneself towards someone or something.
To pick up air, to be affected by an air current that is considered spiritually negative.
alt_translation1: Agarrar aire, agarrar un mal aire.

Description: To bump against each other, for people to throw themselves against each other in a playful manner.
alt_translation1: Aventarse los unos contra los otros a manera de juego.
Hacerse flexible pero duro, ponerse correoso.

Description: To become untied, to become loose.
For a marriage to break up.
For one's hair to be parted.
alt_translation1: Partirse el cabello, hacerse la raya del cabello.

Description: For an edge to be dented or chipped.
For one's voice to become hoarse.
To separate, to split apart, referring to people who were initially together and then separated for whatever reason.
alt_translation1: Separarse, apartarse, dicho de personas que inicialmente estaban juntas y después se separaron por cualquier razón.

Description: For a pregnant person's water (amniotic sac) to break prior to birth.
alt_translation1: Romperse la fuente (saco amniótico) antes del parto.

Description: To chase away, to put away.
For something to be emptied out of a container.
To go or become crazy, specifically in reference to a woman.
alt_translation1: Ponerse loca, dicho específicamente de una mujer.

Description: To go or become crazy, specifically in reference to a man.
alt_translation1: Ponerse loco, dicho específicamente de un hombre.

Description: To become fat (lit. to become round).
To become heavy or feel heavy, specifically in reference to how the tongue feels when swollen or due to oral anesthesia.
alt_translation1: Hacerse o sentirse pesada, específicamente refiriéndose a la lengua cuando se hincha o por anestesia oral.

Description: To go crazy, to become anxious, to become agitated.
To be swept. By extension, to be cleaned out.
For something to end, conclude, or expire. By extension, to ejaculate.
alt_translation1: Terminarse, acabarse, finalizarse. Por extensión, eyacular.

Description: To show, to seem, to resemble.
To roll, in reference to cigarettes.
To become stunted, as in the case of a fruit that was developing well and suddenly becomes stunted and does not ripen.
alt_translation1: Atrofiarse, como en el caso de una fruta que se estaba desarrollando bien y de pronto se estropea.

Description: To increase in size and/or volume.
To thicken, in the sense of increasing in size.
To become dirty, to dirty oneself.
To catch or seize something that is in motion.
alt_translation1: Detener o atrapar algo que está en movimiento.

Description: To move, to stir, to sway.
To accept, to agree, to consent.
To be weighed, to become heavy.
To become haphazardly accumulated, matted or thick, for instance, due the accumulation of residue.
alt_translation1: Apelmazarse o hacerse grueso, por ejemplo, por tener residuos.

Description: To thicken, in the sense of gaining weight.
alt_translation1: Hacerse grueso, en el sentido de engordar.

Description: To take someone by the hand.
To grab or hold something that is not in movement.
alt_translation1: Detener o sostener algo que no está en movimiento.

Description: To thicken, in the sense of becoming dense.
To make something break, crack, split, section, divide, referring to objects that are hard.
alt_translation1: Hacer que se rompa, se quiebre, se parta, se cuartee, se seccione, se divida, dicho de objetos duros.
Hacer que algo se despegue o se desprenda.

Description: To become reduced, to diminish, to decrease.
To lower, whether physically bringing something down from a higher location, or metaphorically as in the case of prices that are lowered.
alt_translation1: Bajar, ya sea físicamente de algún punto alto a uno más bajo, o figuradamente como en el caso de precios que se bajan.

Description: To discolor a piece of clothing.
alt_translation1: Despintar o descolorar una prenda de ropa.

Description: To get hot, to heat up.
To smell, to give off a smell.
To smell rotten, to smell bad.
To smell rancid, to smell like vulture (or rather carrion). It can also describe that something smells of cheap perfume.
alt_translation1: Oler a rancio, oler a zopilote. También puede referirse a que algo huele a perfume de mala calidad.

Description: To give off the smell of something burning, especially hair or animal horn.
alt_translation1: Oler a quemado, sobre todo a cabello o cuerno quemado.

Description: Jiménez Girón (1979:169) defines this verb as to smell of sweat or grime.
alt_translation1: Jiménez Girón (1979:169) define este verbo como "oler a sudor o a mugre".

Description: To give off a sour smell, as something that is fermenting.
alt_translation1: Oler acedo, como algo que se está fermentando.

Description: To smell like a goat or like a sweaty armpit.
alt_translation1: Oler a chivo o a sobaco.

Description: To give off an offensive smell.
To give off an acrid or sour smell.
To give off the smell of raw egg or blood.
alt_translation1: Oler a choquilla, a sangre, a huevo.

Description: To give off a pleasant smell.
To smell of something burning or burned.
To take long to do something or to arrive.
To plow, especially when it is done with machinery.
alt_translation1: Arar, barbechar, especialmente cuando se hace con maquinaria.

Description: To make something break, crack, split, section, or divide, with the use of a tool.
alt_translation1: Hacer que algo se rompa, se quiebre, se parta, se cuartee, se seccione, o se divida, por medio del uso de una herramienta.

Description: To make someone's heart break, to make someone feel pity.
alt_translation1: Hacer que se le rompa el corazón o le dé lástima.

Description: For obsessive thinking to make someone's head break (metaphorically speaking).
alt_translation1: Hacer que se le quiebre la cabeza (de manera figurada) de tanto pensar en algo.

Description: For something one is thinking to break one's head (metaphorically speaking).
alt_translation1: Romperle la cabeza a uno algo en lo que se está pensando.
Hacer que se separaren o se aparten.

Description: To boil. By extension, this verb can also refer to actions that generate noise such as thunder or the purr of a motor vehicle.
alt_translation1: Hervir. Por extensión, este verbo puede referirse también a acciones que generan ruido, ej. retumbar del trueno, ronronear de un carro.

Description: To wheeze when breathing due to asthma or some other respiratory disease. This ailment is associated with heat.
alt_translation1: Resollar al respirar debido al asma o a otra enfermedad respiratoria. Este malestar se considera caliente.

Description: To be born, to sprout, to send out shoots, in reference primarily to plants.
alt_translation1: Nacer, germinar, brotar, retoñar, dicho principalmente de las plantas.

Description: For a lesion, a lump or a tumor to emerge.
alt_translation1: Brotar un grano, una bola, o un tumor.

Description: For water to spring up, for water to flow.
For a person to emerge and take the place of another, ex. a squatter that has taken over a property, a person who has taken over someone else's job.
alt_translation1: Surgir una persona que se afianza en la posición de otro, ej. paracaidista que invade permanentemente una propiedad, persona que usurpa el puesto de trabajo de otro.

Description: For the day to break (lit. for the sun to emerge).
For a child's teeth to come in.
alt_translation1: Salir los dientes, con relación a los niños pequeños.

Description: To appear, to emerge, to begin to manifest.
To smell, to sniff (lit. to pull with the nose).
alt_translation1: Oler, olfatear, husmear (lit. jalar con la nariz).

Description: To spoil a child (lit. to lick the face).
alt_translation1: Consentir, dicho de los hijos (lit. lamerle la cara).

Description: To smack (lit. lick) one's lips out of hunger or a craving.
To pick people up, as in the case of public transportation buses. By extension, to recruit.
alt_translation1: Levantar gente, como en el caso de un autobús de pasajeros. Por extensión, reclutar.

Description: To buck, in reference to horses (lit. to raise the buttocks).
alt_translation1: Encabritarse, dicho de un caballo (lit. levantar la nalga).

Description: To start up a business. Jiménez Girón (1979: 170) also describes the action of plow oxen raising their heads, which prevents the plow from penetrating properly.
alt_translation1: Hacer arrancar un negocio. Jiménez Girón (1979: 170) también describe la acción de los bueyes de arado de levantar la cabeza, lo que impide que el arado penetre adecuadamente.

Description: To lift something with the help of a lever or some other tool.
alt_translation1: Levantar algo con la ayuda de una palanca u otra herramienta.

Description: To become slow, to slow down.
To become big, to increase in size either due to growth or due to weight gain.
alt_translation1: Hacerse grande, agrandarse, aumentar de tamaño por crecimiento o por subir de peso.

Description: For eyes to open large and wide, or for eyes to appear so because of dark circles under them.
alt_translation1: Hacerse grandes los ojos ya sea porque se abren mucho o por tener ojeras.

Description: To get easily angry or become irritable.
alt_translation1: Ponerse quisquilloso, enojón, irascible, o delicado.

Description: To say, to name, to articulate, to declare, to recite.
alt_translation1: Hablar, decir, nombrar, pronunciar, declarar, declamar.

Description: To chat, to talk, to discuss.
To whisper, to speak in someone's ear.
To speak one's own language (lit. to speak one's own words).
alt_translation1: Hablar en su propia lengua (lit. decir sus propias palabras).

Description: To whisper, to speak in someone's ear.
To talk for the sake of talking, baselessly.
To speak with the intention of annoying or harassing.
To speak or say something clearly.
To think, to wonder, to imagine.
To talk with a heavy tongue, describing the speech of a person who articulates words differently from most people.
alt_translation1: Hablar con la lengua pesada, en referencia a una persona que articula sus palabras de manera distinta a la de la mayoría de la gente.

Description: To speak in a melodious way.
To speak but not be listened to.
alt_translation1: Hablar sin que se le haga caso a uno.

Description: To speak softly, to be soft spoken.
To discuss in order to coordinate or to reach an agreement.
To speak too much. By extension, to speak carelessly, to speak without thinking.
alt_translation1: Hablar demasiado. Por extensión, hablar a tontas, hablar sin pensar.

Description: To smell, for a smell to be perceived.
To grow up, to grow old, to age.
To turn into water, to become watery, to melt.
To lose mental acuity due to illnesses such as the various types of dementia (lit. for light to be lost).
alt_translation1: Perder capacidades cognitivas por enfermedades como los distintos tipos de demencia (lit. perderse la luz).

Description: To approach. By extension, to accompany, to join, to collaborate with.
alt_translation1: Acercarse, aproximarse. Por extensión, acompañar, convivir, colaborar.

Description: To get sticky, the way fingers get sticky after eating a juicy fruit.
alt_translation1: Hacerse pegajoso, como ocurre con las manos después de comer una fruta jugosa.

Description: To develop a bad or an unhealthy habit, to become addicted to a vice.
alt_translation1: Agarrar una mala maña o una mala costumbre, enviciarse.

Description: To eat. By extension: to burn, to itch; have to deal with anger or disappointment; to have sex.
alt_translation1: Comer. Por extensión: arder, picar, dar comezón; tener que aguantar un coraje o una frustración; tener sexo.

Description: To take a hard knock on the head with the knuckles, to be greatly disappointed.
alt_translation1: Llevarse un coscorrón, llevarse un fiasco.

Description: To be disappointed, to be tricked.
alt_translation1: Llevarse un fiasco o decepción, caer en una trampa.

Description: To be jealous, to be angry.
Referring to dogs, to bite without prior warning in the form of a growl or a bark.
alt_translation1: Dicho de los perros, morder sin antes prevenir con un gruñido o ladrido.

Description: To nibble, to mash one's gums.
To be jealous, to be angry.
To bite. By extension, to cast the evil eye on someone.
alt_translation1: Morder. Por extensión, hacerle mal de ojo a alguien.

Description: To become smooth, to become flat, to be cleared out or stripped to be made smooth or flat.
alt_translation1: Alisarse, nivelarse, limpiarse de manera que quede liso.

Description: To become crushed, to be deformed under weight.
To become bent, to buckle, to warp.
For the heart to beat fast.
To become smaller, to reduce in size.
To get the heebie-jeebies, to feel the physical manifestations of fear.
alt_translation1: Sentir ñáñaras, sentir las manifestaciones físicas del miedo.

Description: To feel the physical manifestations of fear even in the anus due to the intensity of the fear.
alt_translation1: Sentir las manifestaciones físicas del miedo hasta en el culo debido a la intensidad del miedo.

Description: For drunkedness to be evident in the face.
alt_translation1: Hacerse evidente en la cara la intoxicación por alcohol.

Description: To feel the physical manifestations of shame in the eyes (i.e. to look down in shame).
alt_translation1: Sentir en los párpados las manifestaciones físicas de la vergüenza (i.e. bajar la vista por vergüenza).

Description: To become big, in the sense of gaining weight.
alt_translation1: Hacerse grande, en el sentido de engordar.

Description: To leave, to get out, to appear, to escape, to extricate oneself.
alt_translation1: Salirse, sacarse, quitarse, aparecer, escaparse o zafarse de algo.

Description: For interest or desire to leave the person.
To appear in front of one's eyes.
To take a measurement, to measure.
To come out of an arduous task such as giving birth, raise children until they become financially independent, to dock a vessel, or from a situation of uncertainty.
alt_translation1: Salir de una situación que representó mucho esfuerzo como por ejemplo parir, criar hijos hasta que logran su independencia económica, atracar una barca, terminar una tarea ardua, o pasar de lo incierto a lo seguro.

Description: To be discarded, to be set aside for discarding.
To end up losing because of a bad business deal.
alt_translation1: Salir perdiendo por haber hecho un mal negocio.

Description: For meat to be sliced, for fabric to be cut in strips, for hair to be parted.
alt_translation1: Salir en tiras, ej. tiras de tela, tiras de carne, la raya en el cabello.

Description: To fall on one's butt after stepping on something slippery.
alt_translation1: Caer de sentón al pisar algo que se hizo resbaloso.

Description: To end up in a jam as a result of a bad business deal that generated losses and/or debt.
alt_translation1: Acabar en un atorón por haber hecho un mal negocio que causó pérdidas y/o deudas.

Description: For a horse to come out bucking.

For the fireworks bull to come out. This is a bamboo frame roughly shaped as a bull, and which is outfitted with fireworks. A man carries the frame on his shoulders and runs around among attendees to a festivity, playfully chasing after them.
alt_translation1: Salir el torito de los fuegos artificiales que se acostumbran en las fiestas.

Description: For skin to peel off, to be skinned.
This verbal collocation is used in the completive aspect as an imperative expression to make someone leave.
alt_translation1: Esta colocación se usa en el aspecto completivo a manera de orden para correr a alguien, ej. ¡sácate de aquí!
Salir a seguirle, perseguirle, corretearle, correrle.

Description: This phrasal verb describes how the dough from which tortillas will be made is kneaded. By extension, for a goal to be achieved.
alt_translation1: Este verbo de frase describe la acción de generarse la masa con la que se elaborarán tortillas. Por extensión, lograrse un objetivo.

Description: To bolt or flee hurriedly as a result of being startled or tricked.
alt_translation1: Salir disparado por llevarse un susto o un chasco.

Description: For an irrigation canal to be dug around a crop field.
alt_translation1: Trazarse un canal de riego alrededor de un campo de cultivo.

Description: To be skinned, to be stripped, to molt.
alt_translation1: Pelarse, despellejarse, descortezarse, mudar (dicho de los animales que cambian de plumaje o de pelaje).

Description: To become detached, loose or unsecured to the point of falling.
alt_translation1: Zafarse o soltarse al punto de caerse.

Description: For the limbs to tire out, and more generally, to weaken.
alt_translation1: Cansarse las extremidades del cuerpo, debilitarse.

Description: To graduate, to finish a schooling cycle (lit. for dregs to be removed).
alt_translation1: Titularse, terminar un ciclo educativo (lit. salirse los residuos).

Description: To run out, to be consumed.
For the day to break (lit. for the night to end).
This verb phrase has a meaning similar to that of adverbs such as "completely" and "comprehensively".
alt_translation1: Esta frase verbal tiene un significado comparable al del adverbio "completamente" y "exhaustivamente", o las frases adverbiales "del todo" y "hasta acabar".

Description: To become scraped. By extension, to be cleaned by way of friction.
alt_translation1: Rasparse, pelarse. Por extensión, limpiarse a base de fricción.

Description: To become rough, scratchy, or coarse.
To be spread out, to be spilled, to be broadcasted, to be disseminated.

During the velas celebration, a floats parade takes place. Those on the floats traditionally throw fruit as gifts for spectators. This verb refers to this action. Nowadays, fruit has been largely replaced by gifts of everyday use such as soap, utensils, etc.
alt_translation1: Este verbo describe la actividad cultural conocida como la regada de frutas durante las velas.

Description: To distribute among everyone without exception.
To be spread out, to be spilled, to be broadcasted, to be disseminated. This verb alludes to the fact that what was dispersed ended up in small and scattered parts.
alt_translation1: Esparcirse, regarse, diseminarse, difundirse. Con este verbo se hace alusión al hecho de que lo que se regó acabó en partes pequeñas y dispersas.

Description: To become sunken and/or leathery, as in the case of stunted fruits (ex. cucurbits such as melon, watermelon, pumpkin, cucumber) when cut too early or too late.
alt_translation1: Enjutarse, como cuando una fruta (ej. las cucurbitáceas como el melón, sandía, calabaza, pepino) pierde sustancia y sabor porque se ha cortado antes de tiempo o demasiado tarde.

Description: To become tangled in, to become wrapped in.
To trip over one's own feet.
alt_translation1: Tropezarse porque se enredan los pies.

Description: To tear, to rupture, to rip. This lexeme is used in relation to cloth, paper, skin, as well as the soil.
alt_translation1: Romperse, rajarse, rasgarse, desgarrarse. Se usa con relación a tejidos como la tela, el papel, la piel, así como la tierra.

Description: To get or turn upside down.
To turn as red as blood.
To become swollen in a round, bulging shape.
In a pair, for one of the items to be left odd, as in the case of a pair of socks where one is lost and the other remains.
alt_translation1: Hacerse non o impar, como en el caso de un par de calcetines donde se pierde uno y queda el otro non.

Description: To grow, to increase in size.
To be spread out, said of corn kernels when they are spread on a griddle for roasting.
alt_translation1: Esparcirse, dicho de los granos de maíz cuando se esparcen sobre un comal para tostar.

Description: For a liquid to be sprinkled on something. This verb phrase is used to refer to the act of sprinkling holy water on an infant who dies prior to being baptized.
alt_translation1: Rociarse. Esta frase verbal se utiliza para describir la acción de rociar agua bendita sobre los infantes que mueren antes de ser bautizados.

Description: To cut back, to shorten, to truncate, to amputate.
To break off, to split off, to be shortened.
To break into pieces, to crumble, to fall apart.
To break into pieces, to crumble, to fall apart, in all cases producing very small pieces or particles.
alt_translation1: Despedazarse, desmoronarse, desbaratarse, en todo caso muy finamente.

Description: To be peeled, to be stripped.
To cost, to be of a certain value.
To make oneself be valued. By extension, to be swimming in money.
alt_translation1: Darse a valer, hacerse valorar. Por extensión, hincharse de dinero.

Description: To become tall, to grow upwards.
To become flattened, to become dented.
To become flattened, to become dented.
To stagger or to stumble because of insufficient strength to walk.
alt_translation1: Tambalearse o tropezarse por no tener suficiente fuerza para caminar.

Description: To come loose, to become misaligned or off kilter.
To fade, to become discolored, to become whitish in color.
To become scrawny to the point of being wrinkled, in relation to human and non-human animals as well as fruits.
alt_translation1: Enjutarse, con relación a animales humanos y no humanos, y a frutas.

Description: To become unsteady when standing or walking.
alt_translation1: Tambalearse al estar de pie o caminar.

Description: For a wound to heal and scar over.
alt_translation1: Curarse una herida dejando una cicatriz.

Description: To lose weight to the point of becoming shaky.
alt_translation1: Adelgazarse y, por lo tanto, debilitarse al punto de hacerse tembloroso.

Description: To go grey, in reference to hair.
alt_translation1: Encanecer, con relación al cabello que se ha hecho blanco.

Description: To turn, to spin, to roll.
To be ashamed, to feel ashamed, to be embarrassed.
alt_translation1: Avergonzarse, tener o sentir pena o vergüenza.

Description: To cause something to be inserted, introduced, or submerged. This lexeme can have sexual connotations.
alt_translation1: Hacerlo que se meta, se introduzca, se encaje, o se sumerja. Este lexema se puede usar con connotaciones sexuales.

Description: To cause to lose consistency, spread out, or disperse, as when insects are agitated and swarm.
alt_translation1: Hacer que pierda consistencia, se riegue, o se disgregue, como cuando uno alborota insectos y se hace un hervidero.

Description: To fill up with air. By extension, to insist, to persist, to persevere.
alt_translation1: Llenar de aire. Por extensión, insistir, persistir, empeñarse, perseverar.

Description: To cause someone or something to become inflamed.
alt_translation1: Hacer que se inflame o se hinche.

Description: To fill up the belly. By extension, to make the most of, to take advantage of.
alt_translation1: Llenar la panza. Por extensión, aprovechar.

Description: To fill up the mouth. By extension, to bite.
alt_translation1: Llenar la boca. Por extensión, morder.

Description: Fill the cheeks with air to bulge them.
alt_translation1: Llenar los cachetes de aire para abombarlos.

Description: To grasp with the hand sharply or by handfuls.
alt_translation1: Agarrar con la mano bruscamente o a puñados.

Description: To spit on (lit. to fill/cover in saliva).
To make something change, to change something.
alt_translation1: Hacer que se cambie, hacerlo cambiar, cambiarlo.

Description: To molt, in relation to feathers.
To move, in relation to changing dwellings.
alt_translation1: Mudarse de casa, cambiar de casa.
Mudar, dicho de algún recubrimiento, ej. ropa, piel, plumas.

Description: To make clean by removing something smeared.
alt_translation1: Hacer que se limpie quitando algo embarrado.

Description: To make something hot, to heat up.
To cause something to come loose, to loosen up.
alt_translation1: Hacer que se afloje o se suelte, aflojarlo.

Description: To join in collective efforts to cover an expense or some other need.
alt_translation1: Cooperar a manera de contribuir para cubrir gastos o alguna otra necesidad.

Description: To compare sizes, to check one thing against another.
To meet face to face, to go meet someone, to welcome someone, to cause an encounter.
alt_translation1: Encontrarse de frente, ir a encontrar a alguien, darle la bienvenida a alguien, causar un encuentro.

Description: To make hands come together. By extension, Jiménez Girón (1979:183) also defines this verb as meaning to marry.
alt_translation1: Hacer que se unan las manos. Por extensión, Jiménez Girón (1979:183) también define este verbo como "contrae matrimonio".

Description: Jiménez Girón (1979) defines this lexeme as meaning to deliver a sermon to a couple prior to marriage. Other knowledge bearers define it as meaning to start a fight.
alt_translation1: Jiménez Girón (1979) define este lexema como "amonestar a la pareja de enamorados". Otros conocedores lo definen como buscar pleito.

Description: To criticize someone, to speak ill of someone, to gossip about someone.
alt_translation1: Criticar a alguien, hablar mal de alguien, chismosear sobre alguien.

Description: Jiménez Girón (1979:183) defines this lexeme as meaning to get together with someone who one just met (and does not know well). Other knowledge bearers define it as meaning to be in bad company.
alt_translation1: Jiménez Girón (1979:183) define este lexema como "juntarse con alguien que apenas conoció". Otros conocedores lo definen como estar en mala compañía.

Description: To be whipped. By extension, to have sex, to make love.
alt_translation1: Batirlo. Por extensión, tener sexo, hacer el amor.

Description: To alter, to upset, to confuse, to stun.
To make someone dizzy or disoriented. By extension, to fool, to mislead.
alt_translation1: Hacer que se maree o que se desoriente. Por extensión, engañarlo.

Description: To cause a mental disorder, to make someone lose their mind, ex. in reference to what alcohol or drug abuse can do to someone.
alt_translation1: Causarle algún trastorno mental o hacer que se aloque, ej. dicho del abuso del alcohol o las drogas.

Description: To err, to make a mistake.
alt_translation1: Equivocarse, fallar, errar, cometer un error.

Description: To scatter, to disperse, to distribute, to spread around.
To make something disperse in all directions or among everyone without exception.
alt_translation1: Hacer que algo se distribuya en todas direcciones o entre todos sin excepción.

Description: To make something spread out, be broadcasted, or be disseminated extensively.
alt_translation1: Hacer que se esparza, se riege, se disemine, o se difunda ampliamente.

Description: To make someone get married, to marry a couple by officiating their wedding.
alt_translation1: Hacerlos que se casen, casarlos, unirlos en matrimonio, oficiar un matrimonio.

Description: To make objects and/or people collide.
To cause a clash between personalities, moods or sensitivities, and thus, to generate a conflict between people.
alt_translation1: Causar un choque entre personalidades, humores o sensibilidades, y por lo tanto generar un conflicto entre personas.

Description: To cause someone to be blinded, to blind.
To make someone or something get entangled, wrapped up, or twisted around.
alt_translation1: Hacer que se enrede o se envuelva.

Description: For someone to trip because their feet got entangled. By extension, to make out.
alt_translation1: Hacerlo tropezar al enredarse los pies. Por extensión, cachondear.

Description: To make threads tangle. Jiménez Girón (1979: 184) specifies that this phrasal verb can be used to refer to the act of competing with kites by tangling them up, with each team running to save theirs. He also states that it can also refer to throwing a fishing net over people watching floats during the festivities known in Spanish as 'velas', especially the one in honor of fishermen.
alt_translation1: Hacer que se enreden los hilos. Jiménez Girón (1979:184) especifica que este verbo de frase se puede usar para referirse a la práctica de "competir con los papalotes enredándolos y corriendo cada grupo por salvar el suyo", y de lanzar "la atarraya sobre la gente que se acerca al paso de los carros alegóricos" durante una vela, sobre todo la vela de los pescadores.

Description: To cause fear, to scare, to frighten.
To cause to squeak or creak.
To set the teeth on edge and squeak, as when eating something sour, or when hearing chalk squeak against a blackboard.
alt_translation1: Hacer rechinar los dientes, causar dentera, como lo haría algo agrio que se come o el rechinido de un gis en un pizarrón.

Description: To make something be covered or blocked.
alt_translation1: Hacer que se tape o se cubra, taparlo, cubrirlo.

Description: To make someone angry, to anger.
To beat. By extension, to nag, to bother, to annoy.
alt_translation1: Hacerlo espumar. Por extensión, molestarlo, fastidiarlo, agitarlo.

Description: To cause agitation or worry. By extension, to have a feeling that something bad will happen.
alt_translation1: Causar agitación o inquietud. Por extensión, presentir algo malo.

Description: To make something limp or hobble.
To make someone come closer or approach. By extension, to call someone before an authority.
alt_translation1: Hacerlo acercarse, acercarlo. Por extensión, hacer que una persona se presente ante la autoridad.

Description: To make something harden or stiffen up.
To cause to fall, to dump on the ground.

alt_translation1: Hacer que se acorte o se recorte.

Description: To cause to break off, split off, or be shortened.
alt_translation1: Hacer que se tronche, se moche, o se acorte.

Description: To produce unrefined sugar molded into cones known in Spanish as 'piloncillo', 'panela', or 'melcocha'.
alt_translation1: Elaborar azúcar sin refinar moldeada en forma de cono, conocida en castellano como piloncillo, panela o melcocha.

Description: To cause to become viscous and/or sticky, as in the case of infected and encrusted eyes.
alt_translation1: Hacer que se ponga viscoso y/o pegajoso, como cuando se infectan los ojos, supuran y se pegan.

Description: To cause to shorten or be cut.
alt_translation1: Hacer que se corte, se acorte, o se recorte.

Description: To hurt the eyesight, to cloud the vision, to blind (temporarily, ex. by bright light).
alt_translation1: Lastimar la vista, nublar la vista, deslumbrar.

Description: Jiménez Girón (1979:185) defines this lexeme as a metaphoric way of describing draining water or some other liquid.
alt_translation1: Jiménez Girón (1979:185) define este lexema como una manera figurada de decir "hacer escurrir el agua / algún líquido".

Description: To make something fry. Jiménez Girón (1979:185) specifies that this refers to frying in lard.
alt_translation1: Hacerlo freír. Jiménez Girón (1979:185) especifica que se refiere a "dorar en manteca".

Description: To cause to become viscous and/or sticky, as when holding candy in one's hands.
alt_translation1: Hacer que se ponga viscoso y/o pegajoso, como cuando tienes dulces in las manos.

Description: Jiménez Girón (1979) defines this lexeme as the action of continuously expelling fecal matter caused by diarrhea.
alt_translation1: Jiménez Girón (1979) define este lexema como la acción de "expulsar de continuo las materias fecales causadas por diarrea".

Description: To cause to be peeled, to peel, to strip.
alt_translation1: Hacerlo que se pele o se monde, pelarlo, mondarlo.

Description: To peel off the corn husks.

To make someone take off their clothes, to undress. By extension, to clean out. This verb is also used to describe the process by which boys remove themselves skin off the penis, possibly the foreskin.
alt_translation1: Hacer que se quite la ropa, desnudarlo. Por extensión, desvalijarlo. Este verbo también se utiliza para describir el proceso mediante el cual los niños se eliminan ellos mismos la piel del pene, posiblemente el prepucio.

Description: Jiménez Girón (1979) defines this lexeme as to make something drain.
alt_translation1: Jiménez Girón (1979) define este lexema como "hacer que se escurra".

Description: To undo, to disassemble, to break down, to destroy. This includes separating people who are fistfighting. Jiménez Girón (1979:184) also explains that this verb is used to refer to the meticulous and customary documentation done by the godmothers of a bride at the request of her family, to attest to the bride's virginity at the moment of being taken by her groom. He, in turn, commits to legally marrying the bride, or to indemnify her if he fails to do so.
alt_translation1: Deshacer, desbaratar, destruir. Esto incluye el separar a personas que están peleando a golpes. Jiménez Girón (1979:184) también indica que este verbo se usa para referirse al "registro minucioso y acostumbrado que a nombre de familiares se manda hacer por las madrinas y acompañantes en la persona de la ahijada raptada, con fines persuasivos de que era doncella hasta el momento de ser llevada por su novio, quien, cumpliendo con su promesa, se unirá legalmente en matrimonio con ella o la indemnizará en caso contrario".

Description: To cause to extend or stretch out.
To break someone's face (lit. to make the face extend).
alt_translation1: Romperle la cara a alguien (lit. hacer que se extienda la cara).

Description: To smile (lit. to make the teeth extend).
alt_translation1: Sonreír (lit. hacer que se extiendan los dientes)

Description: To branch out, to put out branches (lit. to make arms extend).
alt_translation1: Sacar ramas (lit. hacer que se extiendan los brazos).

Description: To give, to hand over, to deliver, to provide.
To lend a hand, to help.
To tell, to communicate, to inform (lit. to give word).
alt_translation1: Decirle, comunicarle, informarle, avisarle, manifestarle (lit. darle palabra).

Description: To let loose (lit. to give rope). By extension, to spoil, to be overly permissive.
alt_translation1: Darle cuerda, darle rienda suelta. Por extensión, consentir.

Description: To set a deadline (lit. to give the day).
alt_translation1: Establecer una fecha límite (lit. dar día).

Description: To give work, meaning to employ someone and to make someone struggle.
alt_translation1: Dar trabajo en el sentido de emplear a alguien, y de causar dificultad.

Description: To deliver correctly or in its entirety.
To let through, to let in, to admit (lit. to give place).
alt_translation1: Dar paso, dejar entrar, admitir (lit. darle lugar).

Description: To pass in front, to cut someone off, to go over someone or something.
alt_translation1: Pasar enfrente, pasar por encima, atravesarse.
Hacer enojar, causar disgusto o muina.

Description: To faint, to feel faint (lit. make someone get darkness).
To cooperate in raising funds towards a family or community expense.
alt_translation1: Cooperar para algún gasto familiar o comunitario.

Description: To let through, to let in, to admit (lit. to give way).
alt_translation1: Dar paso, dejar entrar, admitir (lit. darle camino).

Description: To ensure proper completion of a responsibility or labor.
alt_translation1: Hacer cumplir un compromiso o una faena, dar cumplimiento, finalizar debidamente.

Description: To give a hand, ex. when shaking someone's hand as a greeting. By extension, to lend a hand, to help.
alt_translation1: Dar la mano, ej. al saludar de mano. Por extensión, ayudar, apoyar.

Description: To give each other something, to exchange.
To turn the back at. By extension, to reject with disdain.
alt_translation1: Volver la espalda. Por extensión, despreciar.

Description: To make something return. By extension, to repeat.
To respond, to answer back. By extension, to discuss, to be in a verbal dispute.
To turn around to see. By extension, to help someone financially.
alt_translation1: Voltear a ver. Por extensión, ver por alguien económicamente.
Voltear la cara, dar la cara, enfrentarse a, afrontar.

Description: To make something go up, to raise something, to elevate something. By extension, to cultivate, in reference to plant cultivation.
alt_translation1: Subirlo, alzarlo, levantarlo. Por extensión, sembrarlo, cultivarlo.

Description: To take something up on a roof. By extension, to roof, to lay tile on a roof.
alt_translation1: Subir al techo. Por extensión, techar, poner teja en un techo.

Description: To smooth out. By extension, to epilate.
To be in a romantic relationship.
alt_translation1: Estar en una relación amorosa o de noviazgo.

Description: To make others meet, run into each other, or face each other. By extension, to make others crash into each other, argue with each other, or fight with each other.
alt_translation1: Hacer que se encuentren, se topen uno con el otro, se enfrenten uno al otro. Por extensión, hacer chocar, hacer pelear.

Description: To drive something in, ex. to hammer a nail in, to dig a knife into something, etc.
For the sun to make the skin burn.
alt_translation1: Hacer que se queme la piel.

Description: To make something stir or mix by inserting a utensil.
alt_translation1: Hacer que algo se bata, remueva o menee metiendo un utensilio o un dedo en la mezcla.

Description: To tear the hymen by inserting a finger. This practice is part of the marriage process and is performed by the groom on the wedding night to verify the bride's virginity.
alt_translation1: Romper el himen mediante la inserción de un dedo. Esta es una práctica que forma parte del proceso de contraer matrimonio y la realiza el novio durante la noche de bodas para verificar la virginidad de la novia.

Description: To root, in reference to common pig behavior.
alt_translation1: Hocicar, hociquear, dicho del comportamiento común de los cerdos.

Description: Jiménez Girón (1979:186) describes this lexeme as to search in every nook and cranny.
alt_translation1: Jiménez Girón (1979:186) este lexema como "registrar buscando por todos los rincones".

Description: Jiménez Girón (1979:186) defines this lexeme as having something serious or difficult simmering in the mind without being able to resolve it.
alt_translation1: Jiménez Girón (1979:186) define este lexema como "bullir en la mente algo grave o difícil sin poder resolverlo".

Description: Jiménez Girón (1979:186) describes this lexeme as to search in every nook and cranny.
alt_translation1: Jiménez Girón (1979:186) describes this lexeme as "registrar buscando por todos los rincones".

Description: To stir with the hand, ex. when searching inside a purse or pocket. By extension, to paw, to pick pocket.
alt_translation1: Remover con la mano, ej. al buscar en una bolsa o bolsillo. Por extensión, manosear, esculcar, bolsear.

Description: To mix with the feet, ex. to mix clay for bricks.
alt_translation1: Revolver con los pies o patas, ej. para mezclar el barro en la fabricación de ladrillos.

Description: To be in a romantic relationship.
alt_translation1: Estar en una relación amorosa o de noviazgo.

Description: To make something tight, to tighten.
For a situation or obligation to pressure someone (lit. to squeeze someone tight).
alt_translation1: Generarle una presión a alguien por una situación u obligación (lit. apretarle).

Description: To make something get stuck, to jam, to obstruct.
alt_translation1: Hacer que se atore o se atasque, trabar, obstruir.

Description: To make someone lie down in order to fall asleep. To put on paper texts or music.
alt_translation1: Acostarle para dormir. Por extensión, poner por escrito textos o piezas musicales.

Description: To make someone duck under or bend down.
To make something bend, to bend.
To make someone or something lie belly down or upside down.
alt_translation1: Hacer que se acueste boca abajo, acostarlo boca abajo.

Description: To set something to cook, broil, brown or fry.
alt_translation1: Ponerlo a cocer, asar, dorar o freír.

Description: To set adobe bricks to bake.
alt_translation1: Poner a hornear ladrillos de adobe.

Description: To make the oxen plow or clear the vegetation in a plot of land.
alt_translation1: Hacer a la yunta barbechar o limpiar un terreno de siembra.

Description: To make something hang, to hang something. By extension, to catch up to someone, to provoke someone.
alt_translation1: Hacer que algo cuelgue, colgarlo. Por extensión, alcanzarlo, provocarlo.

Description: To wedge, to squeeze into something, to plug into something. By extension, to anger someone.
alt_translation1: Encajar, atorar, enchufar. Por extensión, causar coraje.

Description: To bribe (lit. to make someone's hand wet).
alt_translation1: Sobornar, dar mordida (lit. hacer que la mano de otro se moje).

Description: To make a baby nurse or suckle.
alt_translation1: Hacer que chupe, amamantar, dar de mamar.

Description: To dress someone (lit. to cause to wear).
alt_translation1: Vestirlo (lit. hacer que se lo ponga).

Description: To make someone guard or look after something.
alt_translation1: Dar a guardar, dar a cuidar, dar a custodiar.

Description: To make someone or something become covered, ex. by drenching, by dusting with sugar. By extension, to make someone wear a clothing item.
alt_translation1: Hacer que se cubra, ej. bañándolo con agua, rociándolo con azúcar. Por extensión, hacerlo portar o ponerse ropa.

Description: To dress with a traditional long, ornate skirt.
To sprinkle with water, in reference to pouring water on a child at baptism.
alt_translation1: Rociar con agua, con relación a la aplicación de agua bendita a un niño durante el bautismo.

Description: To make someone bathe, to bathe.
To flog, to whip, to strike with a leather belt.
alt_translation1: Dar de latigazos, azotar, pegar con cinturón.

Description: To hit with the hand, to slap.
alt_translation1: Golpear con la mano, dar manotazos.

Description: To grill (lit. to make something bathe in fire).
To poison (lit. to make someone drink poison).
To breath, to inhale (lit. to air to be pulled in).
alt_translation1: Respirar, inhalar (lit. hacer que se jale el aire).

Description: To make someone or something drag on the floor.
To insult (lit. to make someone hear words).
alt_translation1: Insultar (lit. hacer que alguien escuche palabras).

Description: Cause to be tied, roped or lassoed.
alt_translation1: Hacer que se enlace o se amarre.

Description: To enter, to put (in)side, to insert (lit. to make someone or something enter).
alt_translation1: Meter, insertar, introducir, ingresar (lit. hacer que se meta).

Description: To cause to twist (lit. to introduce turns).
alt_translation1: Hacer que se tuerza, torcer (lit. meterle vueltas).

Description: To belt with a leather belt.
To introduce lime (calcium oxide), ex. for nixtamalization, to paint walls.
alt_translation1: Incorporarle cal (óxido de calcio), ej. para el nixtamal, para pintar paredes.

Description: To give a donation (e.g. to the church), to give a contribution towards the costs associated with special occasions, such as weddings, wakes, and community festivities known as 'velas' in Spanish.
alt_translation1: Dar limosna (ej. en la iglesia), hacer entrega de la cooperación que se acostumbra ofrecer durante las ocasiones especiales como en bodas, velorios y las velas.

Description: To fence in, to encircle, to besiege.

alt_translation1: Echar la sal, en el sentido de desearle mala suerte a alguien.

Description: To smoke. This may be in reference to filling a house with smoke in order to cleanse it. For this purpose, dry chilly peppers are roasted to produce smoke. This practice is done on a Tuesday or a Friday.
alt_translation1: Sahumar. Puede ser en referencia a la práctica de llenar una casa con humo de chile de árbol para limpiarla. Se considera que esta práctica se hace en martes o en viernes.

Description: To brand, in reference to cattle
alt_translation1: Marcar o herrar, dicho del ganado.

Description: To throw something up in the air.
alt_translation1: Aventar, lanzar o tirar hacia arriba.

Description: To measure, to weigh, to gauge.
alt_translation1: Tomar la medida, medir, pesar, sopesar.

Description: To add or apply the necessary amount.
To make something whistle or screech.
alt_translation1: Hacer chiflar, hacer silbar, hacer chillar.

Description: To light a fire, to ignite.
To fire from a job (lit. to put on the street).
alt_translation1: Despedir de un trabajo (lit. meterle en la calle).

Description: To kick, to kick in a squirming way.
To put in too much of something.
To harvest fruit when it is still green.
alt_translation1: Cortar fruta cuando aún está verde.

Description: To cause worry or consternation (lit. to put something at the bottom of the head).
alt_translation1: Causar preocupación o inquietud (lit. hacer que se meta al fondo de la cabeza).

Description: To make something toss or stir.
alt_translation1: Hacer que se revuelva o se mezcle.

Description: To cause to bear, in reference to objects and responsibilities.
alt_translation1: Hacer cargar, dicho de objetos y de responsabilidades.

Description: To scream, to yell (lit. to cause someone to bear noise).
To cut, to chop, to trim (lit. to cause something to shorten). By extension, to convince.
alt_translation1: Cortarlo, mocharlo, truncarlo (lit. causar que algo se recorte). Por extensión, convencerle.

Description: To make someone or something lie belly up.
alt_translation1: Hacer que se acueste boca arriba, acostarlo boca arriba.

Description: To diagnose a disease correctly so that the treatment offered cures the patient.
alt_translation1: Diagnosticar una enfermedad correctamente de manera que el tratamiento que se ofrece cura al enfermo.

Description: To make something be counted, to count something.
To pull, to carry, to haul.
To sniff (lit. to make the nose pull in).
alt_translation1: Olfatear, husmear (lit. hacer retraer la nariz).

Description: For the mother of the groom to offer a beverage to the mother of the bride.
alt_translation1: Dar la madre del novio una bebida a la madre de la novia.

Description: Jiménez Girón (1979:188) defines this lexeme as the act of sending a wedding gift to the bride's house consisting of cakes, marquesote bread, special chocolates, and chickens.
alt_translation1: Jiménez Girón (1979:188) define este lexema como "mandarse el "presente de boda" a casa de la novia, que consiste en tortas, marquesotes, chocolates muy especiales y unas gallinas".

Description: To give a hard knock on the head with the knuckles.

To make threads tangle. Jiménez Girón (1979: 184) specifies that this phrasal verb can be used to refer to the act of throwing a fishing net over people watching floats during the festivities known in Spanish as 'velas', especially the one in honor of fishermen.
alt_translation1: Hacer que se revuelvan los hilos. Jiménez Girón (1979:184) especifica que este verbo de frase se puede usar para referirse a la práctica de lanzar "la atarraya sobre la gente que se acerca al paso de los carros alegóricos" durante una vela, sobre todo la vela de los pescadores.

Description: To mix seeds for cultivation, especially corn, beans, squash, watermelon and melon seeds.
alt_translation1: Revolver semillas para la siembra, sobre todo las semillas de maíz, frijol, calabaza, sandía y melón.

Description: To hand mix. This refers to mixing seeds for cultivation, especially corn, beans, squash, watermelon and melon seeds. It also refers to kneading dough for tortilla making until it is optimally smooth.
alt_translation1: Revolver a mano. Este lexema se refiere al proceso de mezclar semillas para la siembra, sobre todo las semillas de maíz, frijol, calabaza, sandía y melón. También se refiere a amasar, ej. para hacer la masa finita para las tortillas.

Description: To twist the legs of an iguana to prevent it from escaping.
alt_translation1: Trenzar las patas de la iguana para que no se escape.

Description: To cause to become bruised or crushed, as in the case of fruits and vegetables.
alt_translation1: Hacer que se mallugue o se machuque.

Description: To bury. By extension, to hide, to conceal, to cover up.
alt_translation1: Enterrar, sepultar. Por extensión, esconder, ocultar, encubrir.

Description: To cause to become stupid. Jiménez Girón (1979:191) adds the meaning to cause someone to become disabled by means of abuse.
alt_translation1: Atontar, hacerlo tonto, idiotizar. Jiménez Girón (1979:191) agrega "dejar inválido de tanto maltratar".

Description: To cause to harden or stiffen, to pack, to compress, to compact.
alt_translation1: Endurecer (lit. hacer que se ponga duro), apisonar, pisonear, compactar.

Description: For raise prices (lit. to make prices go up), especially in relation to staples such as beans and sugar.
alt_translation1: Subir el precio (lit. hacer subir de precio), sobre todo con relación a productos de primera necesidad como el frijol y el azúcar.

Description: To squeeze, to tighten, to compress.
To squash or crush by stepping on something (lit. to compress with the foot).
alt_translation1: Pisotear, aplastar con el pie (lit. apretar con el pie).

Description: To stick to, to adhere, to affix, to add to, to join (lit. to cause to stick).
alt_translation1: Pegar, adherir, fijar, añadir, unir (lit. hacer que se pegue).

Description: To make someone embrace or hold in the arms. Jiménez Girón (1979:191) explains that, by extension, this lexeme also means to place something in someone's arms or hands that they insist must be accepted.
alt_translation1: Hacer abrazar o tomar en brazos. Jiménez Girón (1979:191) indica que por extensión, este lexema también significa "poner en los brazos o manos de alguien, algo que él insiste sea aceptado". Por lo tanto, enjaretar.

Description: To make someone cross their arms. Jiménez Girón (1979:191) adds that this would be done to a child to have them greet someone.
alt_translation1: Hacerle cruzarse de brazos. Jiménez Girón (1979:191) agrega que esto se le hace "a una criatura para que salude".

Description: To cause to fart, to cause flatulence.
alt_translation1: Hacer que se pedorree o eche pedos, causar flatulencia.

Description: To make someone pay for something, be it the interests on a money loan or a rent. This also refers to making someone pay by way of revenge
alt_translation1: Hacerle a alguien pagar por algo, ya sean los intereses de un préstamo de dinero o una renta. También se refiere a hacerle pagar a alguien a manera de venganza.

Description: To cause to bend, fold, or buckle due to lack of strength.
alt_translation1: Hacer que se doble, se flexione o se venza por falta de fuerza, doblar, flexionar, encorvar, arquear.

Description: To soften (i.e. to cause to become soft).
alt_translation1: Ablandar, suavizar (lit. hacer que se ablande).

Description: Cause to be tied, roped or lassoed.
alt_translation1: Hacer que se enlace o se amarre.

Description: To dress someone (lit. to cause to have on).
alt_translation1: Vestirlo (lit. hacer que se lo ponga).

Description: To make someone stop and think, to halt someone.
To sexually arouse (lit. to make the liver wake up).
alt_translation1: Excitar sexualmente (lit. hacer que se despierte el hígado).

Description: To dry up, to exhaust (lit. to cause to dry up).
alt_translation1: Secar, agotar (lit. hacer que se seque).

Description: To cause to be stuck or jammed.
alt_translation1: Hacer que se atore o se trabe.

Description: To speak with reduced fluency (lit. to make the mouth be jammed).
alt_translation1: Hablar con fluidez reducida (lit. hacer que se atore la boca).

Description: To stick, adhere, or affix (lit. to cause to stick). By analogy, to sow, to install, to write, to represent graphically.
alt_translation1: Pegar, adherir, fijar (lit. hacer que se pegue). Por analogía, sembrar, instalar, escribir, plasmar gráficamente.

Description: To inject, to vaccinate, to inoculate, when done with a syringe or similar. Also, to treat with acupuncture.
alt_translation1: Inyectar, vacunar, inocular, dicho de la aplicación con jeringa o similar. También tratar con acupuntura.

Description: To cause to twist (lit. to stick turns).
alt_translation1: Hacer que se tuerza, torcer (lit. pegar vueltas).
Hacer que se cuartee, se raje, o se agriete.

Description: To cause to become coiled or entangled.
alt_translation1: Hacer que se enrede o se enmarañe.

Description: To leave, to flee, to take off, to run away, to desert.
alt_translation1: Liar los petates, marcharse, huir, fugarse, desertar.

Description: To give an earful, to criticize, to contradict.
To whistle at someone (lit. to slap a whistling on).
alt_translation1: Chiflarle o silbarle a alguien (lit. pegarle un chiflido).

Description: To wear or put on leather sandals.
To make tortillas (lit. to adhere tortilla, in reference to the technique of adhering tortilla dough on the walls of a clay oven for cooking).
alt_translation1: Echar tortilla (lit. pegar tortilla, en referencia a la técnica de adherir la masa para tortilla en la pared del horno de barro para que se cueza).

Description: To glue paper on a surface, ex. flyers on walls. Jiménez Girón (1979:181) defines this lexeme as mailing letters.
alt_translation1: Pegar papeles, ej. propaganda en las paredes. Jiménez Girón (1979:181) define este lexema como "manda[r] carta" en el sentido de enviar correspondencia.
Tocar las campanas de la iglesia.

Description: To yell, to scream, to yell at, to call by way of yelling.
alt_translation1: Gritar, pegar un grito, llamar a gritos.

Description: To whistle at someone (lit. to slap a whistling on).
alt_translation1: Chiflarle o silbarle a alguien (lit. pegarle un chiflido).

Description: To tie up, to chain. By extension, to demand excessive attention from someone.
alt_translation1: Amarrar, atar, encadenar. Por extensión, requerirle demasiada atención a una persona.

Description: To infect with rabies (lit. to stick rabies on someone).
alt_translation1: Contagiar de rabia (lit. pegarle la rabia).

Description: To cast a spell on someone.
To brand, in reference to cattle
alt_translation1: Marcar o herrar, dicho del ganado.

Description: To inject, to vaccinate, to inoculate, when done with a syringe.
alt_translation1: Inyectar, vacunar, inocular, dicho de la aplicación con jeringa.

Description: Jiménez Girón (1979:181) defines this lexeme as to be devoted to someone or something (lit. stick one's heart)
alt_translation1: Jiménez Girón (1979:181) define este lexema como "apegarse con dedicación y empeño" (lit. pegar el corazón).

Description: Jiménez Girón (1979) defines this lexeme as “to wind thread or yarn, to roll up.”
alt_translation1: Jiménez Girón (1979) define este lexema como "devanar el hilo o la hilaza, enrollar".

Description: To whistle at someone (lit. to slap a whistling on).
alt_translation1: Chiflarle o silbarle a alguien (lit. pegarle un chiflido).

Description: To bar a door or a window.
To tether, especially in relation to cattle. By extension, to give free rein to someone, ex. children.
alt_translation1: Atar con suficiente cuerda para permitir movimiento controlado, dicho del ganado. Por extensión, darle rienda suelta a alguien, ej. los niños.

Description: To light on fire, to burn. To sexually arouse.
alt_translation1: Hacer quemar, hacer arder, encender (una flama). Por extensión, excitar sexualmente.
Pensar intensamente en algo o alguien, meterle seso a algo.

Description: To push aside. By extension, to shun.
alt_translation1: Empujar, hacer a un lado. Por extensión, despreciar.

Description: To carry holding the load against the abdomen.
alt_translation1: Cargar manteniendo el bulto contra la panza.

Description: To invoke the saints. Jiménez Girón (1979:182) defines this lexeme as kissing the saints or their graphic representations.
alt_translation1: Convocar a los santos. Jiménez Girón (1979:182) define este lexema como "besar a los santos o a sus imágenes".

Description: To carry holding the load against the abdomen.
alt_translation1: Cargar manteniendo el bulto contra la panza.

Description: To convince, to persuade, for romantic purposes.
To turn over the soil in an agricultural field.
alt_translation1: Voltear la tierra en la milpa.

Description: To sniff by moving the nose close to the source of a smell.
alt_translation1: Olfatear acercando la nariz al punto de origen del olor.

Description: To request, to order, to entrust.

alt_translation1: Enterrar, sepultar, o inhumar a un difunto.
Irse de pinta, faltar a la escuela.
Irse de pinta, faltar a la escuela.

Description: To speak with reduced fluency (lit. to make the mouth be jammed).
alt_translation1: Hablar con fluidez reducida (lit. hacer que se atore la boca).

Description: To whiten, to cause to become white, to bleach.
alt_translation1: Blanquear, emblanquecer, hacer que se haga blanco.

Description: To toast, to crisp, to grill (lit. to cause to toast).
alt_translation1: Tostar, dorar, asar (lit. hacer que se tueste).

Description: To cause a desire, a will, or a commitment.
alt_translation1: Darle antojo o ganas, hacerlo desear o anhelar, hacer que se comprometa.

Description: To cause a desire or a will.
alt_translation1: Darle antojo o ganas, hacerlo desear o anhelar.

Description: To wrinkle, to contract (lit. to cause to wrinkle).
alt_translation1: Arrugar, contraer (lit. hacer que se arrugue).

Description: To awaken someone, to make someone aware.
To stop from moving, to block (lit. to cause to stay).
alt_translation1: Detener, parar, impedir que se mueva (lit. hacer que permanezca).

Description: To shut someone up (lit. to cause someone's mouth to stop).
alt_translation1: Callarlo (lit. hacer que se detenga su boca).

Description: To set (lit. to cause to sit). By extension, to build, to lay down (in relation to construction), to seat (in relation to a job or post), to set food to cook.
alt_translation1: Asentar (lit. hacer que se siente). Por extensión, construir, edificar, colocar en una posición (con relación a un cargo o puesto), poner comida a cocer.
Masturbarse un hombre haciéndose una chaqueta.

Description: To calm down, to soothe, to appease.
To cause residue to settle at the bottom of a container.
alt_translation1: Hacer que se asienten los residuos en el fondo de un recipiente.

Description: To deafen (lit. to cause to become deaf).
alt_translation1: Ensordecer (lit. hacer que se haga sordo).

Description: To dress someone (lit. to cause to wear).
alt_translation1: Vestirlo (lit. hacer que se lo ponga).

Description: To save, to rescue (lit. to cause to be safe).
alt_translation1: Salvarlo, rescatarlo (lit. hacer que esté a salvo).

Description: To provoke verbally (lit. to throw words)
To pull with the head, as oxen do when pulling the yoke.
alt_translation1: Tirar con la cabeza como hacen los bueyes al jalar la yunta.

Description: To root, in reference to common pig behavior (lit. to push with the nose).
