alt_translation1: Hocicar, hociquear, dicho del comportamiento común de los cerdos (lit. empujar con la nariz).

Description: To order dogs to attack someone.
alt_translation1: Echarle los perros a alguien, en el sentido de hacer que los perros lo agredan.
Largar, correr, o expulsar a alguien.

Description: Jiménez Girón (1979:189) defines this lexeme as caresses, flatters.
alt_translation1: Jiménez Girón (1979:189) define este lexema como "acaricia, halaga".

Description: To pay attention to, to attend to.
Jiménez Girón (1979:189) defines this lexeme as to kick.
alt_translation1: Jiménez Girón (1979:189) define este lexema como patalear.

Description: To show, to reveal, to expose (lit. to cause to appear). Also, to seem, to resemble.
alt_translation1: Mostrar, enseñar, delatar (lit. hacer que se muestre). También parecerse, asemejarse.

Description: To point at with the hand.
To desire, especially in relation to food (lit. to cause the liver to appear).
alt_translation1: Tener antojo (lit. hacer que se muestre el hígado).

Description: To cause to move, stir, or sway.
alt_translation1: Hacer que se mueva, se menee o se meza. Agitar.

Description: To let the head drop as when nodding off.
To cause to become flooded or waterlogged.
alt_translation1: Hacer que se inunde o se anegue.

Description: To cause to become tied or entangled, to tie, to fasten, to entangle.
alt_translation1: Hacer que se amarre, amarrarlo, atarlo, enredarlo.

Description: To sweep (lit. to cause to be swept). By extension, to clean out.
alt_translation1: Barrerlo (lit. hacer que se barra). Por extensión, saquear.

Description: To finish, to complete, to conclude. By extension, to euthanize.
alt_translation1: Terminarlo, acabarlo, finalizarlo, completarlo, concluirlo. Por extensión, realizarle la eutanasia.

Description: To throw, to toss, to shoot, specifying that the trajectory of the object in question is forward, not upward.
alt_translation1: Lanzar, aventar, tirar, disparar, especificando que la trayectoria del objeto en cuestión es hacia adelante, no hacia arriba.

Description: To let go (lit. to cause to become loose).
To spy, to watch, to observe, to stalk, to snoop.
alt_translation1: Espiar, observar, acechar, estar de mirón.

Description: To spy on the school, in reference to a student who skips school but watches from afar when school lets out and goes home as if they had attended.
alt_translation1: Espiar la escuela, dicho de un estudiante que no asiste, pero de lejos espera la hora de la salida para volver a casa como si hubiese asistido.

Description: To sniff. Jiménez Girón (1979:189) specifies that this verb is restricted to refer to quadrupeds.
alt_translation1: Husmear, olfatear. Jiménez Girón (1979:189) especifica que este verbo "se aplica más propiamente a los cuadrúpedos".

Description: To inhale, ingest, pull toward oneself or into the body. By extension, Jiménez Girón (1979:189) defines this lexeme as carefully saving part of one's winnings in gambling so that, in case one's luck changes, one does not lose everything.
alt_translation1: Inhalar, ingerir, jalar hacia uno o hacia adentro del cuerpo. Por extensión, Jiménez Girón (1979:189) define este lexema como "guardar cautelosamente parte de lo ganado en el juego para en caso de cambiar su suerte no perderlo todo".

Description: Jiménez Girón (1979:189) defines this lexeme as turning a bull into a steer by twisting its testicles.
alt_translation1: Jiménez Girón (1979:189) define este lexema como "convertir al toro en novillo volteándose sus testículos".

Description: Jiménez Girón (1979:189) defines this lexeme as to administer an enema.
alt_translation1: Jiménez Girón (1979:189) define este lexema como "dar lavativa".

Description: To jam, to force in, in reference to a sharp object.
alt_translation1: Encajar, meter forzadamente, dicho de un objeto punzocortante.

Description: To blow, to fan, to ventilate.

Jiménez Girón (1979:190) defines this verb as the practice whereby, during the first night of a couple's marriage, the groom inserts a finger into the bride's vagina to extract the hymen and verify her virginity.
alt_translation1: Jiménez Girón (1979:190) define este lexema como la práctica mediante la cual, durante la primera noche del matrimonio de una pareja, el novio introduce un dedo en la vagina de la novia para extraer el himen y verificar su virginidad.

Description: To smear (lit. to cause to be smeared).
alt_translation1: Embarrarlo, embadurnarlo, untarlo (lit. hacer que se embarre).

Description: Jiménez Girón (1979) defines this lexeme as to compete. At present, knowledge bearers consider this verb as part of old Didxazá.
alt_translation1: Jiménez Girón (1979) define este lexema como "concursar, competir". Actualmente, algunos consideran que este verbo pertenece al didxazá antiguo.

Description: To kick in a squirming way (lit. to make the legs or feet shake).
alt_translation1: Patalear (lit. hacer menear las piernas o los pies).

Description: To cause to be lost. By extension, to notice the absence of someone or something.
alt_translation1: Hacer que se pierda o se extravíe. Por extensión, echar de menos.

Description: To have a lapse in judgement, to lose awareness, to lose consciousness.
alt_translation1: Perder el juicio, perder conciencia, perder el conocimiento.

Description: To cause the disappearance or destruction of something.
To peel by way of scraping. By extension, to sand (i.e. smooth out a piece of wood), to carve, to sculpt, to epilate.
alt_translation1: Pelar raspando. Por extensión, mondar, limar, tallar, labrar, esculpir, depilar.

Description: To peel the skin, ex. of fruit.
alt_translation1: Pelar la cáscara, ej. de una fruta.
Limar, tallar, labrar o esculpir madera.

Description: To request someone's presence, or their help within the context of mutual service.
alt_translation1: Pedir la presencia de alguien, solicitar servicio recíproco de alguien.

Description: To cause to become penniless, to clean out.
alt_translation1: Hacer que se quede sin dinero, desvalijarlo.

Description: To cough. By extension, to boast loudly about courage.
alt_translation1: Toser. Por extensión, presumir alardosamente de valentía.

Description: To spread out seeds or kernels on a griddle for roasting.
alt_translation1: Esparcir granos sobre un comal para tostar.

Description: To sprinkle with holy water an infant who dies prior to being baptized or statuettes.
alt_translation1: Rociar con agua bendita los infantes que mueren antes de ser bautizados y las reliquias.

Description: To hook, to snag, as barbed wire does to clothes.
alt_translation1: Enganchar, agarrar, atorar, como le hace el alambre de púas a la ropa.

Description: Jiménez Girón (1979: 193) defines this verb as to become skinny. Members of the current Didxazá-speaking community do not use this verb, which suggests it may have fallen into disuse.
alt_translation1: Jiménez Girón (1979:193) define este verbo como enflaquecer. Los miembros de la comunidad de habla didxazá actual no lo utilizan, por lo que es posible que haya caído en desuso.

Description: To leave something. By extension, to quit an activity.
alt_translation1: Dejarlo. Por extensión, parar de hacer algo.

Description: To leave something (lit. to make it be there / remain).
To take down, to knock down, to demolish (lit. to cause to fall down).
alt_translation1: Tirar, tumbar, derribar, derrumbar, demoler (lit. hacer caer).

Description: To have sex, applicable only to men.
alt_translation1: Tener sexo, dicho únicamente de un hombre.

Description: To hit with the hand (lit. to make the hand come down).
alt_translation1: Golpear o pegar con la mano (lit. hacer caer la mano).

Description: To close (lit. to make something close). By extension, to cover, to shut down, to enclose, to lock up.
alt_translation1: Cerrar (lit. hacer que se cierre). Por extensión, tapar, clausurar, encerrar, encarcelar.

Description: To send a wedding gift to the bride's house consisting of cakes, marquesote bread, chocolates, and chickens.
alt_translation1: Mandar el presente de boda a casa de la novia, que consiste en tortas, marquesotes, chocolates, y unas gallinas.

Description: To send representatives to ask a woman's hand in marriage.
alt_translation1: Mandar a una comitiva para solicitar la mano de una mujer en matrimonio.

Description: To send representatives headed by a xuaana (person known and respected in the community who presides at social engagements) to ask a woman's hand in marriage.
alt_translation1: Mandar a una comitiva encabezada por un xuaana (persona conocida y respetada en la comunidad quien preside en los compromisos sociales) para solicitar la mano de una mujer en matrimonio.

Description: To send a notification or warning.
To send a notification or warning.
To send someone in search of someone else or something.
To teach, to instruct (lit. to cause to learn).
To cause light or a device to turn itself off, or fire to go out.
To weaken, referring to the effect of decomposition, corrosion, or wear on an organic object.
alt_translation1: Debilitar, dicho del efecto de la descomposición, la corrosión o el desgaste en algún objeto orgánico.

Description: To cause something to be lacking or missing.
To cause to become enlarged by way of opening something, ex. the eyes.
alt_translation1: Hacer que se agrande abriéndolo, ej. los ojos.

Description: To open the eyes wide (lit. to cause the eyes to become enlarged).
alt_translation1: Pelar los ojos, (lit. hacer que se agranden los ojos).

Description: To light up, to shine light.
To illuminate the mind (lit. the head) in the sense of to inform, to instruct, to educate.
alt_translation1: Alumbrar o iluminar la mente (lit. la cabeza) en el sentido de informar, instruir, o educar.

Description: Jiménez Girón (1979:193) defines this verb as to cause to recover one's sight (lit. to cause to illuminate the face)
alt_translation1: Jiménez Girón (1979:193) define este verbo como "hacer recuperar la vista" (lit. hacer alumbrar la cara).

Description: To make something go out of sight, whether by moving it far away, submerging it, or covering it with something.
alt_translation1: Hacer que se pierda de vista, ya sea alejándolo, sumergiéndolo, o cubriéndolo.

Description: To put to sleep, to cause drowsiness (lit. to cause to sleep).
alt_translation1: Dormirlo, adormecer, dar sopor (lit. hacer dormir).

Description: To cause to lose consistency, soften, or disintegrate, as when one crumbles or beats something with the hand, or when one soaks the hands in water for too long.
alt_translation1: Hacer que pierda consistencia, se reblandezca, o se disgregue, como ocurre cuando uno desmorona o bate algo con la mano, o cuando uno remoja los dedos demasiado tiempo.

Description: To cause to take advantage or make the most of something. Jiménez Girón (1979:193) indicates that this verb refers to emptying or extracting the contents of hard shelled fruits, and to cleaning pus from a tumor and, by extension, caring for a sick person.
alt_translation1: Hacer que aproveche o se aproveche. Jiménez Girón (1979:193) indica que este verbo se refiere a "vaciar o extraer contenidos de los frutos cascarudos, limpiar de pus un tumor" y por extensión, atender a un enfermo.

Description: Jiménez Girón (1979) defines this verb as to stupefy.
alt_translation1: Jiménez Girón (1979) define este verbo como "atontar, atolondrar".

Description: To open up (lit. to cause to become open).
To cause to sting or to burn, ex. when something is spicy, when pouring alcohol on a wound.
To cool down (lit. to cause to cool down). By extension, to cure, to heal, given that illness is often associated with heat.
alt_translation1: Enfriarlo (lit. hacer que se enfríe). Por extensión, curar, sanar, dado que la enfermedad suele asociarse con el calor.

Description: To explain, to instruct (lit. to cause to understand).
To cause to fade, become discolored, or become whitish in color (lit. to cause its color to fade).
alt_translation1: Despintar, desteñir, descolorar, hacer blancuzco (lit. hacer que se le baje el color).

Description: To remind, to cause to remember, to evoke.
To cause something to be worn out or deteriorated.
alt_translation1: Hacer que se acabe, se desgaste o se deteriore.

Description: To disintegrate, to dissolve, to melt (lit. to cause to disintegrate).
alt_translation1: Deshacer, desintegrar, disolver, fundir (lit. hacer que se deshaga).
Limpiar mediante el uso de una herramienta.

Description: To make someone or something be hurt.
alt_translation1: Hacer que algo o alguien se lastime o se dañe.

Description: To make someone become accustomed, get used to, or get comfortable (ex. in a new living situation, in a new city).
alt_translation1: Hacer que se acostumbre, se halle, se habitúe, se ambiente.

Description: To toss a coin in the air as a way to make a selection.
To cause to turn black or dark-colored.
To unsettle, to stir (lit. to cause to become unsettled). By extension, to disperse, to scatter, to break up.
alt_translation1: Alborotar (lit. hacer que se alborote). Por extensión, dispersarse, disgregarse.
Alegrar, regocijar (lit. hacer que se ponga contento).

Description: To cause to be destroyed or squashed.
To cause to age or become old.
To cause to wear out, fray, or unravel, said of objects made with long fibers, ex. a hammock.
alt_translation1: Gastar, desgastar, deshilachar, dicho de objetos hechos con fibras largas, ej. una hamaca.
Hacer que se revuelva el estómago, dar náuseas.

Description: To cause to look or search for something.
To cause pain (lit. to cause to hurt).
To drive, to conduct, to drive forward, to move forward, in relation to vehicles (raft, cart, bicycle, car) and of social and religious festivities.
alt_translation1: Manejar, conducir, hacer andar, hacer avanzar, dicho de vehículos (balsa, carreta, bicicleta, auto) y de celebraciones sociales o religiosas.

Description: For hens or other birds to lay eggs in a nest that is not their own, or for a man to have an extramarital lover.
alt_translation1: Poner huevo en un nido que no es el suyo, dicho de las gallinas y otras aves, así como de un hombre que tiene amante extramatrimonial.

Description: For a couple to break up or divorce.
alt_translation1: Separarse o divorciarse de la pareja.

Description: To fight (lit. to drive forward with).

alt_translation1: Avanzar e ir a la cabeza.

Description: To bring together, to complete, to conclude, to achieve (in the case of a work task).
alt_translation1: Juntar, acompletar, completar, cumplir (en el caso de una tarea laboral).

Description: For a cycle of a month to elapse.
For a cycle of a year to elapse.
To make good on one's word.
To value, to appreciate, to recognize the value of (lit. to cause to value).
alt_translation1: Valorar, valorizar, apreciar, reconocer el valor de algo o alguien (lit. hacer valer).

Description: To send an envoy, ex. to request a loan, to make an inquiry, to hire someone or a service, to ask the hand of a woman in marriage.
alt_translation1: Mandar una diligencia, ej. para pedir prestado, para hacer una averiguación, para contratar, para pedir la mano de la novia.

Description: To air dry, or to dry as a result of a drought.
alt_translation1: Hacer que algo se seque al aire o bien a causa de una sequía.

Description: To cause to become thin or skinny.
To itch (lit. to cause to itch).
alt_translation1: Dar comezón, picar (lit. hacer que sienta comezón).

Description: To cause the taste of water to change, either by making it salty or by making it acquire an unpleasant taste.
alt_translation1: Hacer que cambie el sabor del agua, ya sea que la haga salada o que adquiera un sabor desagradable.

Description: To cause to revive or come back to life.
To cause not to acquire too sweet a taste, in reference to food.
alt_translation1: Hacer que no adquiera un sabor muy dulce, dicho de un alimento.
Hacer que se estreche o se haga angosto.

Description: To dirty (lit. to cause to become dirty).
To cause to become swollen or puffed up.
To cause the mouth to puff up.
alt_translation1: Hinchar o abombar la boca (lit. hacer la boca abombada).

Description: To make something foam or froth.
To cause something to come loose, to loosen up.
alt_translation1: Hacerlo que se afloje o se suelte, aflojarlo.

Description: To dress up, to attire in fancy clothes.
To cause loose stools or diarrhea.
alt_translation1: Hacer que se suelte la panza, dar diarrea.

Description: To set the teeth on edge and squeak, as when eating something sour, or when hearing chalk squeak against a blackboard.
alt_translation1: Hacer rechinar los dientes, causar dentera, como lo haría algo agrio que se come o el rechinido de un gis en un pizarrón.

Description: To make something limp or hobble.
To tarnish or wear out, as in clothes (lit. to cause to become tarnished).
To embarrass (lit. to cause someone's eyelid to tarnish).
To embarrass (lit. to cause someone's face to tarnish).
To harden (lit. to cause to become hard or stiff).
alt_translation1: Endurecer (lit. hacer que se haga duro).

Description: To harden (lit. to cause to become hard or stiff).
alt_translation1: Endurecer (lit. hacer que se haga duro).

Description: To shorten (lit. to cause to become short). By extension, to break off, to split off.
alt_translation1: Acortarlo (lit. hacerlo corto). Por extensión, cortarlo, troncharlo, mocharlo.

Description: To cause to become viscous and/or sticky, as in the case of infected and encrusted eyes.
alt_translation1: Hacer que se ponga viscoso y/o pegajoso, como cuando se infectan los ojos, supuran y se pegan.

Description: To blur, in reference to vision (lit. to make blurry). By extension, to cloud up, to fog up, to darken.
alt_translation1: Enturbiar, dicho de la vista (lit. hacerla turbia). Por extensión, nublar, empañar, oscurecer.

Description: To soften (lit. to cause to become soft).
To cause to waddle like a hen with short legs.
alt_translation1: Hacerlo caminar chueco, como una gallina de patas cortas.

Description: To cause to spring up or flow, in reference to a liquid. By extension, to make one's mouth water from a desire to eat something.
alt_translation1: Hacer manar o brotar, dicho de un líquido. Por extensión, hacer que se le haga agua la boca en el sentido de darle antojo.

Description: To cause to become infected, in reference to a wound. (lit. to cause to fill up with liquid).
alt_translation1: Hacer que se infecte, dicho de una herida (lit. hacer que se llene de líquido).

Description: To cause to be emptied out, to empty out.
To cause to become sexually aroused.

alt_translation1: Hacer que se calme, se apacigüe o se tranquilice.

Description: To spend out, to consume, to finish something up (lit. to cause to be consumed).
alt_translation1: Gastar, consumir, acabarlo (lit. hacer que se consuma).

Description: To tire out, to fatigue (lit. to cause to become tired).
alt_translation1: Cansar, fatigar (lit. hacer que se canse).

Description: To cause a lapse in judgement or mental health disorder (lit. to cause the head to become empty).
alt_translation1: Trastornarlo, dicho de la coherencia y la salud mental (lit. hacer que se le vacíe la cabeza).

Description: To wet something (lit. to cause to become wet).
To smooth out. By extension, to epilate.
To cause to decrease in quantity or become scarce.
alt_translation1: Hacerlo aminorarse, escasear, o reducirse en cantidad.

Description: To cool down, to refresh (lit. to cause to become cold).
alt_translation1: Enfriarlo, refrescarlo (lit. hacer que se haga frío).

Description: To hand over the care of someone or something, to entrust (lit. to cause to look after).
alt_translation1: Encargarle el cuidado de algo o alguien, encomendarle (lit. hacer que cuide).

Description: To make someone read or study.
To make something green, as when a plant is transplanted or when it is cared for after it began to wilt.
alt_translation1: Hacer reverdecer, como cuando una planta se trasplanta o cuando una planta que se está marchitando se cuida.

Description: To stretch, to elongate (lit. to cause to become long).
alt_translation1: Estirarlo, alargarlo (lit. hacer que se haga largo).

Description: To make someone shut up or become quiet, to quiet down.
alt_translation1: Hacer que se calle o se calme, silenciar.

Description: To cause baldness at the crown of the head.
alt_translation1: Hacerlo que se le haga calva la coronilla.

Description: To age (lit. to cause to become old).
alt_translation1: Envejecerlo (lit. hacer que se haga viejo).

Description: To soften (i.e. to cause to become soft).
alt_translation1: Ablandar, suavizar (lit. hacer que se ablande).

Description: To help a dying person to die well (literally, making the dead person sing), referring to the practice whereby a prayer woman or man accompanies the person, prays for them, tells them what will happen when they die and which river they will cross, and also makes them pray, sing, or talk so that they can die well.
alt_translation1: Ayudar a una persona agonizante a morir bien (lit. hacerle cantar al muerto), dicho de la práctica mediante la cual una rezadora o un rezador acompaña a la persona, le reza, le cuenta qué va a pasar cuando muera y qué río va a atravesar, y también le hace rezar, cantar, o hablar para que pueda morir bien.

Description: To cause to ripen, ex. in reference to a fruit so that it may be eaten.
alt_translation1: Hacerlo madurar, ej. a una fruta para que se pueda comer.

Description: To cause to rain, in reference to the rainy season.
alt_translation1: Hacer llover, dicho de la época de lluvias.

Description: To cause to bend, fold, or buckle due to lack of strength.
alt_translation1: Hacer que se doble, se flexione o se venza por falta de fuerza, doblar, flexionar, encorvar, arquear.

Description: To darken, to blur (lit. to cause to darken).
alt_translation1: Oscurecer, hacerlo borroso (lit. hacer que se ponga oscuro).

Description: To deafen (lit. to cause the ear to become dark).
alt_translation1: Ensordecer (lit. hacer que se oscurezca el oído).

Description: To whiten, to cause to become white, to bleach.
alt_translation1: Blanquear, emblanquecer, hacer que se haga blanco.

Description: To wrinkle, to contract (lit. to cause to wrinkle).
alt_translation1: Arrugar, contraer (lit. hacer que se arrugue).

Description: To deafen (lit. to cause to become deaf).
alt_translation1: Ensordecer (lit. hacer que se haga sordo).

Description: To deafen (lit. to cause the ear to become deaf).
alt_translation1: Ensordecer (lit. hacer que se haga sordo el oído).

Description: To cause to become bent, to make something lose its original shape.
alt_translation1: Hacer que se enchueque o que pierda su forma original.

Description: To cause something to be bent out of shape.
To cause to stand up like a tuft or pompadour.
alt_translation1: Hacer que se pare como copete.

Description: To make something or someone thin.
To broaden (lit. to cause to become wide).
alt_translation1: Ensanchar, ampliar (lit. hacer que se haga ancho).

Description: To fatten (lit. to cause to become round).
alt_translation1: Engordar (lit. hacer que se haga redondo).

Description: To cause to increase in size and/or volume.
alt_translation1: Hacer que aumente de tamaño y/o volumen.

Description: To thicken (lit. to cause to become thick).
To soil (lit. to cause to become filthy).
alt_translation1: Ensuciar, emporcar (lit. hacer que se haga sucio)

Description: To cause to become haphazardly accumulated, matted or thick, for instance, due the accumulation of residue.
alt_translation1: Hacerlo apelmazado o grueso, por ejemplo, por tener residuos.

Description: To tip (ex. a waiter), to donate (especially a monetary donation), to bribe.
To heat (lit. to cause to become hot).
alt_translation1: Calentar (lit. hacer que se haga caliente).
Amargar (lit. hacer que se haga amargo).

Description: To cause to smell or give off a smell.
alt_translation1: Hacer que huela o emane olor.

Description: To cause to smell of urine.
To throw, to toss, to shoot, specifying that the trajectory of the object in question is forward, not upward. By extension, to let loose.
alt_translation1: Lanzar, aventar, tirar, disparar, especificando que la trayectoria del objeto en cuestión es hacia adelante, no hacia arriba. Por extensión, soltar.

Description: To boil (lit. to cause to boil). By extension, to cause to produce noise.
alt_translation1: Hervir (lit. hacer que hierva). Por extensión, hacer que haga ruido.

Description: To cause to be born, sprout, or send out shoots, in reference primarily to plants.
alt_translation1: Hacer nacer, germinar, brotar, o retoñar, dicho principalmente de las plantas.

Description: To slow down (lit. to cause to become slow).
To enlarge (lit. to cause to become big). By extension, to fatten, to thicken.
alt_translation1: Agrandar (lit. hacer que se haga grande). Por extensión, engordar, aumentar de grosor.

Description: To cause the face to become deformed, ex. as in a case of facial paralysis.
alt_translation1: Hacer que se deforme la cara, ej. por parálisis facial.

Description: To make someone talk, referring to the practice whereby a prayer woman or man accompanies a dying person, prays for them, tells them what will happen when they die and which river they will cross, and also makes them pray, sing, or talk so that they can die well.
alt_translation1: Hacer hablar, dicho de la práctica mediante la cual una rezadora o un rezador acompaña a una persona agonizante, le reza, le cuenta qué va a pasar cuando muera y qué río va a atravesar, y también le hace rezar, cantar, o hablar para que pueda morir bien.

Description: To enter into a kinship relationship by way of lighting candles during the marriage ceremony. For a marriage ceremony, people close to the bride and groom are selected and asked to gift important elements of the ceremony. These chosen people then enter a close relationship of support with the bride, the groom and their parents that is as strong as a kinship relationship.
alt_translation1: Apadrinar una boda, hacerse padrino(a) de velación.

Description: To raise, to rear, ex. a child.

alt_translation1: Hacer que se pierda o se extravíe.

Description: To cause to become smooth or flat, to clear out or strip as to be made smooth or flat.
alt_translation1: Hacer que se alise, que se nivele, o que se limpie de manera que quede liso.

Description: To crush, to deform (lit. to cause to become crushed).
To cause to become big, in the sense of gaining weight.
alt_translation1: Hacer que se agrande, en el sentido de engordar.

Description: To make something run out or be consumed.
To tangle (lit. to cause to become entangled).
To empty (lit. to cause become empty or hollow).
alt_translation1: Vaciarlo (lit. hacer que se haga vacío o hueco).

Description: To cause to become swollen in a round, bulging shape.
alt_translation1: Hacer que se hinche o se inflame en forma de bola.

Description: To make something big or increase in size.
To cause to become penniless, to clean out.
alt_translation1: Hacer que se quede sin dinero, desvalijarlo.

Description: To duplicate, to repeat, to double (lit. to cause to become two).
alt_translation1: Duplicar, repetir (lit. hacer que se duplique).

Description: To put to sleep, to cause drowsiness (lit. to cause to sleep).
alt_translation1: Dormirlo, adormecer, dar sopor (lit. hacer dormir).

Description: To value, to appreciate, to recognize the value of (lit. to cause to value).
alt_translation1: Valorar, valorizar, apreciar, reconocer el valor de algo o alguien (lit. hacer valer).

Description: To lighten (ex. to cause to become light, i.e. not heavy).
alt_translation1: Alivianar, aligerar (lit. hacerlo liviano o ligero).
Hacerse crecer de altura (lit. hacerlo alto).

Description: To cause to become flattened or dented.
alt_translation1: Achatar, aplastar, abollar (lit. hacer que se abolle).

Description: To smash, to dent (lit. to cause to become smashed or dented).
alt_translation1: Apachurrar, sumir, abollar (lit. hacer que se apachurre, se suma o se abolle).

Description: To cause to become loose, misaligned or off kilter.
alt_translation1: Aflojar, desajustar (lit. hacer que se afloje).

Description: To cause to become unsteady when standing or walking.
alt_translation1: Hacer que se tambalee al estar de pie o caminar.

Description: To stretch, to tense, to make taut.
To cause one to lose their youthful complexion and instead become gaunt, flaccid, or worn out.
alt_translation1: Hacer que pierde la complexión joven y se ponga enjuto, flácido, o acabado.
Avergonzar, hacer que sienta pena o vergüenza.

Description: To loosen (lit. to cause to become flaccid or baggy).
alt_translation1: Aflojar (lit. hacerlo flácido, holgado o guango).

Description: To stun, to stupefy (lit. to cause to become stupid).
To age (lit. to cause to become old).
To hurt, to cause physical harm, to cast the evil eye on someone.
alt_translation1: Hacer daño, causar un mal físico, hacerle el mal de ojo.

Description: To shrink, to reduce in size (lit. to cause to become small). By extension, to take years off in appearance.
alt_translation1: Achicar, empequeñecer, encoger, reducir de tamaño (lit. hacerlo chico). Por extensión, rejuvenecer.

Description: To cause to appear in sight, to come into view, to show.
alt_translation1: Hacer que se vea, poner a la vista, enseñar, mostrar.

Description: To cause to give birth, to assist a birth. By extension, it also refers to the action of a man impregnating a woman in an unplanned manner.
alt_translation1: Hacer parir, dar a luz, o aliviarse de un parto. Por extensión, también se refiere a la acción de un hombre de embarazar a una mujer de manera no planeada.

Description: To cause to sound or ring, to play an instrument.
alt_translation1: Hacer sonar, tocar (ej. un instrumento, la puerta).

Description: To sneeze (lit. to cause a sneeze).
To cause a plot of land to become full of brush or wild growth.
alt_translation1: Hacer que un terreno se llene de hierba o maleza.

Description: To take away from, to reduce, to diminish.
To laxate (lit. to cause to poop). By extension, to beat someone intensely to the point of causing them to defecate.
alt_translation1: Laxar (lit. hacer cagar). Por extensión, golpear con tal intensidad que se provoque la defecación.

Description: To cause to become brittle, as when something like a tortilla is toasted. By extension, to toast.
alt_translation1: Hacerlo quebradizo, dicho de cuando se tuesta algo como una tortilla. Por extensión, tostar.

Description: To make someone or something dance.
To cause to become sour, acid or acrid.
alt_translation1: Hacer que se ponga agrio, ácido o acedo.

Description: To cause to shine or reflect light, ex. by way of polishing.
alt_translation1: Hacer brillar, hacer resplandecer, ej. al pulir.

Description: To make someone beg for money.
To anger (lit. to cause to become altered).
alt_translation1: Enojar, hacer enojar (lit. hacer que se altere).
Hacer que algo empeore o se agrave.

Description: To cause to run. By extension, to chase away, to cause to flee, to cause to run away.
alt_translation1: Hacerlo correr. Por extensión, ahuyentar, hacerlo huir, hacerlo fugarse.

Description: To cause to scrunch up or wrinkle up.
alt_translation1: Hacer que se encoja o se arrugue.

Description: To reduce in quantity (lit. to cause to become less).
alt_translation1: Reducir en cantidad (lit. hacer que se haga menos).

Description: To make someone be stripped or cleaned out.
alt_translation1: Hacer que quede despojado o desvalijado.

Description: To cause someone to be blinded, to blind.

alt_translation1: Hacer que se acorte o se recorte.

Description: To turn into dust, to pulverize, to turn to ashes.
alt_translation1: Hacerlo polvo, pulverizarlo, dejar en cenizas.

Description: To cause to fart, to cause flatulence.
alt_translation1: Hacer que se pedorree o eche pedos, causar flatulencia.

Description: To cause to become lodged or stuck, as in the case of a splinter or a thorn under the skin.
alt_translation1: Hacer que se entierre, enterrarlo, encajarlo, clavarlo, sumirlo (ej. una espina).

Description: To stab (lit. to cause metal to inserted).
alt_translation1: Apuñalar (lit. hacer que se clave el metal).

Description: To sow discord, to cause strife (lit. to stick a thorn in).
alt_translation1: Meter cizaña, causar intrigas, causar discordia (lit. hacer que se entierre una espina).

Description: To close, to cover, to obstruct.

alt_translation1: Bloquear un camino, ej. con una barricada, por control policiaco.

Description: To make a fist in defiance. Also, to be apprehended.
alt_translation1: Cerrar el puño como gesto para retar a alguien o protestar por algo. También, ser aprehendido.

Description: To bring together, to gather, to amass, to pile up.
To jail, to imprison, to incarcerate.
To cause to become loose, misaligned or off kilter.
alt_translation1: Aflojar, desajustar (lit. hacer que se afloje).

Description: To reproduce, to multiply, to make something increase in number or quantity.
alt_translation1: Reproducirlo, multiplicarlo, hacer que algo aumente en número o cantidad.

Description: To close, to cover, to obstruct.
To sell something, to put something up for sale.
To let oneself be robbed, to have important things taken away, ex. a spouse, money.
alt_translation1: Dejar que le roben o le quiten lo importante, ex. el cónyuge, dinero.

Description: To paint, to color, to dye.
To cause to become flattened or dented.
alt_translation1: Achatar, aplastar, abollar (lit. hacer que se abolle).

Description: To cause to become flattened or dented.
alt_translation1: Achatar, aplastar, abollar (lit. hacer que se abolle).

Description: To smash, to dent (lit. to cause to become smashed or dented).
alt_translation1: Apachurrar, sumir, abollar (lit. hacer que se apachurre, se suma o se abolle).

Description: To terminate a pregnancy, to have an abortion.
To stick a foot or leg out to cause someone to trip.
alt_translation1: Meter el pie, meterle una zancadilla.

Description: To make someone or something go or lie across.
alt_translation1: Hacer que se atraviese o se cruce.

Description: To pass an object from one person to another. To give extra.
alt_translation1: Pasar un objeto de una persona a otra. Dar demás, dar un pilón.

Description: To stretch, to tense, to make taut.
To make something gather onto itself, retract onto itself, or curl up.
alt_translation1: Hacer que se recoja, se encoja, o se enrolle.

Description: To give birth and raise children of different fathers (lit. to pick up children).
alt_translation1: Embarazarse y criar hijos de diferentes padres (lit. juntar niños).

Description: To collect what is owed (lit. to gather what was borrowed).
alt_translation1: Cobrar lo que se debe (lit. recoger lo prestado).

Description: To pick up something as a favor or out of consideration.
To gather refuse as a means to make a living.
To pick up food a little bit everywhere. By extension, to be a freeloader.
alt_translation1: Comiendo por aquí y por allá, dicho de los animales. Por extensión, andar de gorrón.

Description: To save up, to store, to stock up.
To gather things in a rush.
To make something turn, spin, or roll.
alt_translation1: Hacer rodar, hacer girar, hacer que se revuelque.

Description: To drag someone or something and roll it around on the ground.
To make something into a ball with the hands.
To move over, to move to the side, to move out of the way.
alt_translation1: Arrimar, quitar, hacer a un lado.

Description: To make a dog bark, to provoke a dog.
alt_translation1: Hacer ladrar a un perro, azuzar, provocar a un perro.
Avergonzar, hacer que sienta pena o vergüenza.

Description: To flatten, to oppress, to crush (lit. to cause to become flat).
alt_translation1: Aplastar, oprimir, atropellar (lit. hacer que se aplaste).

Description: To open up (lit. to cause to become open). By extension, to separate, to perform an autopsy.
alt_translation1: Abrir (lit. hacer que se abra). Por extensión, separar, efectuar una autopsia.

Description: To cause to sound or ring, to play an instrument.
alt_translation1: Hacer sonar, tocar (ej. un instrumento, la puerta).

Description: To tighten. By extension, to tie around the waist, to wring, to milk.
alt_translation1: Apretar. Por extensión, ceñir, exprimir, ordeñar.

Description: To cause to spill or overflow, in reference to water.
alt_translation1: Derramar, tirar, regar, en referencia al agua (lit. hacer que se derrame).

Description: To cause to go out of order or break down and no longer function.

alt_translation1: Emborrachar, embriagar (lit. hacer que se embriague).

Description: To cause to scrunch up or wrinkle up.
alt_translation1: Hacer que se encoja o se arrugue.

Description: This verb phrase refers to the process of confession of guilt before the person known as bigaana, at the same time that the confessor prepares either the species of Sporobolus spartinus grass known as gizhi donda or totomoxtle as a guilt necklace to later splash it with blood and burn it.
alt_translation1: Esta frase verbal se refiere al proceso de confesión de culpas ante la persona conocida como bigaana, al mismo tiempo que el confesante prepara ya sea la especie de pasto Sporobolus spartinus conocida como gizhi donda o totomoxtle a manera de collar de culpas para después salpicarlo de sangre y quemarlo.
Hacer el dobladillo o la bastilla.

Description: To laxate (lit. to cause to poop). By extension, to beat someone intensely to the point of causing them to defecate.
alt_translation1: Laxar (lit. hacer cagar). Por extensión, golpear con tal intensidad que se provoque la defecación.

Description: To undo, to destroy, to tear down, to bring down, to disassemble, to erase.
alt_translation1: Deshacer, destruir, derrumbar, tumbar, desbaratar, borrar.

Description: To be hard on someone. By extension, to overfeed cattle.
alt_translation1: Cargarle la mano a alguien. Por extensión, dar de comer abundantemente al ganado.

Description: To step on, to trample. By extension, to oppress, to humiliate.
alt_translation1: Pisar, pisotear. Por extensión, oprimir, humillar.

Description: To have sex (lit. to cause to become rough).
To cause to become deformed or misshapen.
To make faces, whether due to pain, anger or a tantrum.
alt_translation1: Hacer muecas o caras ya sea por dolor, enfado o berrinche.

Description: To be broody, to cluck. By extension, for a woman to flirt or show signs of being in love.
alt_translation1: Culequear, cacarear. Por extensión, coquetear o demostrar su enamoramiento, dicho de una mujer.

Description: To cause to sound using the hand, to knock the door
alt_translation1: Hacer sonar con la mano, tocar la puerta.

Description: To tut, to smack the lips.
alt_translation1: Tronar la boca, chasquear la boca.

Description: To cause a plot of land to become full of brush or wild growth.
alt_translation1: Hacer que un terreno se llene de hierba o maleza.

Description: To tie up with a rope.
To tie a piece of cloth tight around the head, ex. to alleviate a headache.
alt_translation1: Ceñirse la cabeza, ej. para aliviar un dolor de cabeza.
Ceñir la cintura, fajar la cintura.

Description: To strangle (lit. to cause the neck to be tightened).
alt_translation1: Ahorcar (lit. hacer que se apriete el cuello).

Description: To blow one's nose (lit. to cause the nose to be expressed).
alt_translation1: Sonarse la nariz (lit. hacer que se exprima la nariz).

Description: To cause to become entangled in relation to hair, or gnarled in relation to wild plant growth.
alt_translation1: Hacer que se enmarañe, ya sea con relación al cabello o a la maleza.

Description: To set a hen to brood.
alt_translation1: Poner a una gallina a que empolle sus huevos.

Description: To lay a tortilla flat on a griddle to cook it.
alt_translation1: Hacer que se extienda la tortilla sobre un comal para que se cueza.

Description: To cause the face to extend or become distorted.
alt_translation1: Hacer que se extienda o distorsione la cara.

Description: Jímenez Girón (1979:200) defines this verb as to smooth or draw lines on a clay jug before it is fired.
alt_translation1: Jiménez Girón (1979:200) define este verbo como "alisar o trazar rayas en al cántaro antes de ser cocido".

Description: To squint and contract the face as a reaction to burning or to sourness.
alt_translation1: Apretar los ojos como reacción a un ardor o a algo agrio.

Description: To cause to become brittle, as when something like a tortilla is toasted. By extension, to toast.
alt_translation1: Hacerlo quebradizo, dicho de cuando se tuesta algo como una tortilla. Por extensión, tostar.

Description: To undo, to destroy, to tear down, to bring down, to disassemble, to erase.
alt_translation1: Deshacer, destruir, derrumbar, tumbar, desbaratar, borrar.

Description: To feed, to nourish, to provide for.
To rap someone on the head.
To feed one's family, to provide for one's family.
alt_translation1: Alimentar a su familia, mantener a su familia.

Description: To serve dinner (lit. to feed dinner).
alt_translation1: Dar de cenar (lit. alimentar (con) la cena).

Description: To look or search for something.
To get into an argument (lit. to search for word).
To make a living (lit. to find the way to live).
alt_translation1: Buscarse la vida, ganarse la vida.

Description: To make a living (lit. to find the way to live).
alt_translation1: Buscarse la vida, ganarse la vida.

Description: To make, to manufacture, to build, to construct.
alt_translation1: Hacer, realizar, elaborar, confeccionar, fabricar, construir, edificar.

Description: To burn, to set on fire, to incinerate (lit. to cause to burn).
alt_translation1: Quemar, incendiar, incinerar, prenderle lumbre (lit. hacer que se queme).

Description: To cook corn kernels with lime for nixtamalization.
alt_translation1: Poner el maíz a cocer con cal para nixtamal.

Description: For corn kernels to be cooked in water and lime prior to grounding for nixtamalization.
To lightly cook corn for a drink that resembles porridge but is lighter and smoother.
Habitual: r.u-z.aande nee ya!a; ~ r.u-z.aande nye* ya^a
alt_translation1: Cocer ligeramente el maíz para hacer atole.

Description: To cook corn until kernels break open. The corn is then made into a drink.
alt_translation1: Cocer el maíz hasta que se reviente para hacer pozol.

Description: To cause to shine or reflect light.
To cause to shine or reflect light intensely.
alt_translation1: Hacer brillar o resplandecer con fuerza.

Description: To cause to turn or spin.
To mention, to remind, to evoke, to allude to.
Ruminate, to chew the cud (lit. to chew its grass).
To make someone regret their actions.
To make an object, especially one that is thin and/or pointed and long, go through another, as when threading something onto string, passing water down the throat, or running a comb through hair.
alt_translation1: Hacer que un objeto delgado, largo y/o puntiagudo pase a través de otro, como por ejemplo al ensartar algo con una aguja e hilo, al pasar agua por la garganta, o al pasar un peine por el cabello.

Description: To scratch, with an emphasis on sinking claws or fingernails into the skin.
Habitual: r.u-zaa # bi-zhuga*; ~ r.u-zaa # xu*ga*; ~ r.u-zaa # zhu*ga*
alt_translation1: Arañar, rasguñar, rascar con énfasis en el hecho de penetrar la piel con las uñas.

Description: To cut meat or fish in a stripped pattern prior to salting.
alt_translation1: Cortar rayas en la carne o en un pescado para que le penetre sal.

Description: To encircle the neck with something, as when wearing a plumeria necklace, or when placing a helicon or a tuba on a musician.
alt_translation1: Rodear el cuello con algo, como cuando se cuelga un collar de cacalosúchitl en el cuello, o cuando se coloca un helicón alrededor del cuello de quien lo va a tocar.

Description: To attend to or to care for.
alt_translation1: Hacer caso a algo, atender algo, preocuparse por algo.

Description: To deliver a religious discourse, notably one which would be delivered once a week prior to the celebration of a wedding and which allows, among other things, for the community to be informed about upcoming weddings. It may also refer to the act of offering bread and a drink to bring to an end the celebration that follows three weeks after a young woman leaves with her chosen partner or when a couple celebrates their marriage in a civil ceremony.
alt_translation1: Dar la amonestación religiosa previa a un matrimonio que se daría una vez a la semana y que, entre otras cosas, permitiría que la comunidad se entere de los matrimonios que están por celebrarse. También puede referirse al momento en que se ofrece pan y bebida para concluir una celebración tres semanas después de que se huye una novia o cuando una pareja se casa por el civil.

Description: To make something pass through the mouth. By extension, to be a good speaker whether in relation to delivering a speech, or in terms of speaking a language well.
alt_translation1: Hacer correr algo por la boca. Por extensión, ser buen orador o hablar bien una lengua.

Description: To raise something, especially with the hand, so that someone perceives or acknowledges it. By extension, to owe someone something, especially money.
alt_translation1: Elevar algo, sobre todo con la mano, para que alguien lo perciba. Por extensión, deberle algo a alguien, sobre todo dinero.

Description: To announce, to communicate, to inform, to disseminate information.
alt_translation1: Anunciar, comunicar, relatar, informar, divulgar, propagar, difundir.

Description: To have something pending, in reference to commitments or responsibilities.
alt_translation1: Tener un pendiente, dicho de compromisos y responsabilidades.

Description: To raise or extend the head to see something. By association, to be nosy.
alt_translation1: Elevar o extender la cabeza para ver algo. Por asociación, chismosear.

Description: To raise or extend the hand as when greeting someone or waving at them.
alt_translation1: Elevar o extender la mano como se hace al saludar.

Description: To scatter, to spread around. By extension, to irrigate. This verb is also used to describe the action of tracing designs, ex. with sugar on bread known as "marquesote".
alt_translation1: Regar, irrigar. También se utiliza para describir la acción de trazar diseños, ej. con azúcar sobre el pan conocido como marquesote.

Description: To make the sign of the cross on oneself.
To speak competently, generally in reference to a language.
alt_translation1: Hablar competentemente, dicho generalmente de una lengua.

Description: To call someone's name, to do a roll call.
alt_translation1: Mencionar el nombre de una persona, pasar lista.

Description: To mention, to remind, to evoke, to allude to.

This verb refers to the risk that a pregnant woman is considered to run if she defecates in the woods. Because animals also defecate there, it is believed that an animal may invade the woman and eat the fetus. In that case, after six months of pregnancy, the woman goes into labor, the dead animal is expelled, but the fetus is no more.
alt_translation1: Este verbo hace referencia al riesgo que se considera que corre una mujer embarazada si defeca en el monte. Debido a que los animales también defecan ahí, se considera que puede ocurrir que a la mujer la invade un animal que se come al feto. En ese caso, al cabo de seis meses de embarazo hay dolores de parto y sale el animal muerto, pero ya no hay feto.

Description: To burst in laughter, to split one's sides laughing, to laugh loudly.
Habitual: r.u-zhidxi* sa!; ~ r.u-zhidxi sa; ~ r.u-zhidxi sa!
alt_translation1: Reír a carcajadas, desternillarse de risa, reír a mandíbula batiente.

Description: To laugh a little, to smile.
To run. By extension, to flee, to escape.
alt_translation1: Correr. Por extensión, huir, fugarse, escapar.

Description: To navigate (lit. to run on the water).
To escape, to flee, to hide from others.
alt_translation1: Escaparse, fugarse, esconderse de la gente.

Description: To elope (lit. to run away with the woman).

alt_translation1: Hacer el dobladillo o la bastilla.

Description: This verb phrase refers to the process of confession of guilt before the person known as bigaana, at the same time that the confessor prepares either the species of Sporobolus spartinus grass known as gizhi donda or totomoxtle as a guilt necklace to later splash it with blood and burn it.
alt_translation1: Esta frase verbal se refiere al proceso de confesión de culpas ante la persona conocida como bigaana, al mismo tiempo que el confesante prepara ya sea la especie de pasto Sporobolus spartinus conocida como gizhi donda o totomoxtle a manera de collar de culpas para después salpicarlo de sangre y quemarlo.

Description: To cause to break into pieces.
To imagine, to remember, to think about someone.
To make someone be stripped or cleaned out.
alt_translation1: Hacer que quede despojado o desvalijado.

Description: To have heartburn, to have acid reflux.
To create a single file or a vertical pile.
alt_translation1: Poner en fila, ya sea horizontal o verticalmente.

Description: To cause to lean against something.
alt_translation1: Hacer que se recueste, se recargue, o se apoye.

Description: To begin, to initiate, to start, to create.
alt_translation1: Comenzar, empezar, iniciar, dar principio, crear.

Description: To cause to become thick, in the sense of gaining weight.
alt_translation1: Hacerlo grueso, en el sentido de engordarlo.

Description: To straighten (lit. to cause to become straight).
To bend, to buckle (lit. to cause to become bent).
To turn upside down. By extension, to dive (head first).
alt_translation1: Poner de cabeza. Por extensión, echarse un clavado.

Description: To fatten (lit. to cause to become fat).
alt_translation1: Engordar (lit. hacer que se haga gordo).

Description: To take responsibility for a harmful act that one has committed.
alt_translation1: Aceptar o reconocer un daño que uno ha cometido.

Description: To throw a tantrum, to throw a fit, to protest, to cry.
To place upright, to cause to stand.
To cause to lean, to tilt, to cant, to place sideways or on one side.
alt_translation1: Hacerlo cantearse, inclinarse o ladearse, ponerlo de lado.

Description: To straighten (lit. to cause to become straight).
Jiménez Girón (1979:201) describes the meaning of this lexeme as to seem, to appear as.
alt_translation1: Jiménez Girón (1979:201) describe el significado de este verbo como parecerle, imaginarse, o creer ver.

Description: To massage, to rub for healing purposes (lit. for the hand to stand).
alt_translation1: Sobar, dar masaje (lit. pararse la mano).

Description: To stand, to place upright. By extension, to plant trees, to have an erection.
alt_translation1: Parar, poner de pie. Por extensión, plantar árboles, tener una erección.

Description: For the hair on the back of the neck to stand up.
Habitual: ri-zu # gicha ladi; ~ r-u-zu=waa # gicha ladi

Description: To advocate, to defend, to serve as witness.
To be head of household, to be responsible for a family celebration (lit. to stand inside the house).
alt_translation1: Llevar la responsabilidad de un hogar, ser jefa o jefe de familia, hacerse cargo de una celebración familiar (lit. estar de pie dentro de casa).

Description: To get down on all fours.
alt_translation1: A gatas, en pies y manos, en cuatro patas.

Description: To step or stand on something.
To impose, usually aggressively and even by hitting.
alt_translation1: Imponer, asentar, generalmente de manera agresiva e incluso dando golpes.

Description: To pout (lit. to make the mouth protrude).
alt_translation1: Hacer puchero (lit. hacer la boca trompuda).

Description: To have a feeling or a hunch.
To knead, to smooth out, to grind, to crush, to chew.
alt_translation1: Amasar, hacerse fino o parejo, triturar, moler, masticar.

Description: Jiménez Girón (1979:201) defines this verb as to be sad or to wilt (lit. to grind the liver).
alt_translation1: Jiménez Girón (1979:201) define este verbo como "ponerse triste, marchitarse, entristecerse" (lit. moler el hígado).

Description: To chew properly. Jiménez Girón (1979:201) defines this verb as to imitate, to parody, in relation to voice and singing.
alt_translation1: Masticar adecuadamente. Jiménez Girón (1979:201) define este verbo como "imitar, remedar" con relación a la voz o el canto.

Description: To make someone or something be hurt.
alt_translation1: Hacer que algo o alguien se lastime o se dañe.

Description: To cause to become flattened or dented.
alt_translation1: Achatar, aplastar, abollar (lit. hacer que se abolle).

Description: To cause to fade, become discolored, or become whitish in color.
To carry out horse races (lit. to make horses run).
alt_translation1: Realizar carreras de caballos (lit. hacer correr caballos).

Description: To bathe, said of a woman when she washes her body and hair (cf. raze, verb used when only the body is washed). The verb ru'cha' also refers to bathing of a woman who has just given birth.
alt_translation1: Bañarse, dicho de una mujer cuando se lava el cuerpo y el cabello (cuando solo se lava el cuerpo, se utiliza el verbo raze). El verbo ru'cha' también se refiere a cuando se baña una mujer que acaba de dar a luz.

Description: To penetrate, to puncture, to prick, to stab. By extension, to throb.
To hear, to listen, to heed.
To hear, to listen, to heed.
To braid, to twist, especially in reference to cordage.
alt_translation1: Trenzarlo, torcerlo, dicho sobre todo de la elaboración de riatas y cuerdas.

Description: To be or to announce an omen, especially a bad omen.
alt_translation1: Anunciar un presagio o mal augurio.

Description: To work, to do chores (ex. for a festivity).
alt_translation1: Trabajar, hacer faena (ej. en torno a una festividad)

Description: To do harm to someone through black magic.
alt_translation1: Hacerle maldad o brujería a alguien.

Description: To hunt, to prey on an animal.
To mess with someone's head as to convince them of something.
alt_translation1: Jugar o manipular la psicología de alguien para convencerle de algo.

Description: To feint, to fake a move.
To fix, to make even, to be fair.
To make a gesture of affection, e.g. a caress, a smile, a kind offer.
alt_translation1: Hacer un gesto de cariño, ej. una caricia, una sonrisa, algún ofrecimiento amable.

Description: To make someone hate someone else.

alt_translation1: Menospreciar a alguien haciéndole sentirse pequeño.

Description: To attend premarital talks at church.
alt_translation1: Asistir a pláticas prematrimoniales en la iglesia.

Description: To make noise, to shrill, to scream.
To imitate someone, to mimic someone.
To disappoint, to deceive, to dupe.
To make an effort, to push through.
alt_translation1: Hacer un esfuerzo, hacer fuerza, pujar.

Description: To make a racket, to cause a commotion.
Pouting. Specifically, this verb phrase refers to when the lower jaw protrudes more than the upper jaw.
alt_translation1: Hacer puchero. En particular, esta frase verbal se refiere a cuando la mandíbula inferior sobresale más que la superior.

Description: To sow corn or break up dried corn kernels.
To pretend. By extension, to do a job without charging money.
alt_translation1: Fingir. Por extensión, también se refiere al hecho de hacer un trabajo sin cobrar.

Description: Jiménez Girón (1979) defines this verb phrase as to sustain a whim, but to eventually give in.
alt_translation1: Jiménez Girón (1979) define esta frase verbal como "sostener un capricho, pero doblegarse".

Description: To make something foam or froth.
To recognize someone. This may entail that there is a trust relationship with the person identified.
alt_translation1: Reconocer, identificar. Puede implicar que se le tiene confianza a la persona que se reconoce.

Description: To repair, to fix, to fix up.
To pulverize, to break into pieces.
To make someone shake or shiver.
To make a mess of something, to muck up.
To do something on purpose or with a particular purpose in mind.
alt_translation1: Hacer algo a propósito o con propósito.

Description: To damage, to make someone or something unwell, to make someone nauseous.
For there to be a leak.
To make the casting of a building.
alt_translation1: Hacer el colado de una construcción.

Description: To do or say something in a sensible or wise manner.
To try hard in order to achieve something.
To rush someone, to agitate someone, to make someone lose their bearings.
To cause pain, to hurt someone, to offend someone.

alt_translation1: Hacer algo mal o a medias.

Description: To notice something, to be aware of something.
To set the formwork for the casting of a building.
alt_translation1: Poner las cimbras para el colado de una construcción.

Description: To make an effort to finish something promptly.
To tolerate, to bear, to endure.
To claim as one's own, to appropriate.
To glean, especially in reference to corn. By extension, to rob purses and wallets.
alt_translation1: Pizcar, shishiar maíz. Por extensión, bolsear, robar carteras.

Description: To cover in or soil with dirt or dust.
alt_translation1: Llenarlo de tierra, embarrarlo de tierra, empolvarlo.

Description: To grease, to cover in grease.
To excite. By extension, to sexually arouse.
To make something rot or become infected.
alt_translation1: Hacer que se pudra o que se infecte.

Description: To make something or someone worse.
To haggle whiningly when buying something.
alt_translation1: Regatear gimoteando al momento de una compra.

Description: To sob, as when the pain is deep and persistent but the tears have dried up (lit. for the liver or heart to cry).
alt_translation1: Sollozar, dicho de cuando el dolor es demasiado profundo, pero las lágrimas se han secado (lit, llorar el hígado o corazón).

Description: To read the bible. By extension, to preach.
alt_translation1: Leer la biblia. Por extensión, predicar.

Description: To kill, to assassinate, to sacrifice (lit. to cause to die). By extension, to cause to suffer.
alt_translation1: Matar, asesinar, sacrificar (lit. hacer morir). Por extensión, causar sufrimiento.

Description: To let a child cry until they calm down on their own.
alt_translation1: Dejar llorar a un niño hasta que se canse.

Habitual: r.uuti* n.a^ti*; ~ r.uuti* na*ti*; ~ r.uti* na*ti*; ~ <r.uuti=nati>

Description: To stop the flow of blood in order to stop a hemorrhage.
alt_translation1: Parar el flujo de sangre para detener una hemorragia.

Description: To infuriate someone (lit. to kill by anger).
alt_translation1: Matar de coraje en el sentido de una situación en que a alguien se le hace enojar demasiado.

Description: To cause excessive anger and even cause fainting from it.
alt_translation1: Causar coraje excesivo e incluso causar desfallecimiento de coraje.

Description: To infuriate someone to the point of fainting from anger.
alt_translation1: Matar de coraje en el sentido de causar un desmayo por coraje.

Description: To infuriate someone to the point of fainting from anger.
alt_translation1: Matar de coraje en el sentido de causar un desmayo por coraje.

Description: To infuriate someone (lit. to kill by anger).
alt_translation1: Matar de coraje en el sentido de una situación en que a alguien se le hace enojar demasiado.

Description: To starve to death, to neglect to death, to keep someone in poverty.
alt_translation1: Matar de hambre, matar por descuido o negligencia, tener en la miseria.

Description: To grind down to a powder.
To knead. By extension, to massage.
alt_translation1: Amasar con la mano. Por extensión, masajear.

Description: To step on, ex. to knead clay with the feet as part of the process to make adobe bricks.
alt_translation1: Pisar, pisotear, ej. amasar barro con los pies para hacer ladrillos de adobe.

Description: To see, to look, to look over, to observe, to contemplate.
alt_translation1: Mirar, ver, observar, contemplar. Por extensión, supervisar.

Description: To contemplate quietly, to stare at.
alt_translation1: Contemplar tranquilamente, ver fijamente, quedársele mirando.

Description: To watch over, to look after.
alt_translation1: Mirar con cuidado. Por extensión, cuidar.

Description: To look at someone with disdain.
alt_translation1: Verlo con recelo, ver con malos ojos, verlo feo.

Description: To look at someone with disdain.
alt_translation1: Verlo con recelo, ver con malos ojos, verlo feo.

Description: To reduce in size or volume.
alt_translation1: Disminuir de tamaño o de volumen.

Description: For there to be shouting or noise.
To come loose, to become loose-fitting or baggy.
To be stunned, to act like a fool.
To turn itself off, to switch itself off.
To become sick with an undiagnosed ailment.
alt_translation1: Enfermarse de un mal grave y que no ha sido diagnosticado.

Description: To reflect, to become transparent, to appear in sight, to come into view, to be discerned.
To display signs of boredom or annoyance.
To become ugly to the point of being considered monstrous due to being disproportionate.
alt_translation1: Ponerse feo al grado de considerarse monstruoso por estar desproporcionado.

Description: To become ugly to the point of being considered monstrous because of a disproportionate face.
alt_translation1: Ponerse feo al grado de considerarse monstruoso por tener la cara desproporcionada.

Description: To become deformed or misshapen. By extension, to make faces.
alt_translation1: Apachurrarse, deformarse. Por extensión, hacer muecas.

Description: For land to become covered with brush.
To become entangled in relation to hair, or become gnarled in relation to wild plant growth.
alt_translation1: Enmarañarse, ya sea con relación al cabello o a la maleza.

Description: To become gaunt, pale or melancholy-faced.
alt_translation1: Demacrarse, ponerse pálido o de rostro melancólico.

Description: For the face to acquire a gaunt, pale or melancholic look.
alt_translation1: Ponérsele la cara demacrada, pálida o melancólica.

Description: Stumbling or staggering when walking due to a misshapen leg.
alt_translation1: Tropezarse o tambalearse al caminar por tener una pierna torcida.

Description: To shrink into a deformed shape, as in the case of leather or plastic exposed to high heat, or of a foot that cramps.
alt_translation1: Encogerse, contraerse, arrugarse, como el cuero o el plástico expuesto al calor fuerte, o como cuando el pie se acalambra.

Description: To shrink into a deformed shape, as in the case of leather or plastic exposed to high heat.
alt_translation1: Encogerse, contraerse, como el cuero o el plástico expuesto al calor fuerte.

Description: To become brittle, as when something like a tortilla is toasted. By extension, to be toasted.
alt_translation1: Hacerse quebradizo, dicho de cuando se tuesta algo como una tortilla. Por extensión, tostarse.

Description: To spread out, thereby covering all allowable space, ex. spread out wings, when smiling broadly, when occupying all space on a bed.
alt_translation1: Extenderse y ocupar todo el espacio, ej. alas extendidas, cuando uno sonríe ampliamente, cuando uno ocupa toda la cama.

Description: To disintegrate, ex. as when ice melts or a solid dissolves in water.
alt_translation1: Deshacerse, desintegrarse, ej. como cuando el hielo se derrite, o un sólido se diluye en el agua.

Description: For the skin to develop sores (lit. for the skin to disintegrate).
alt_translation1: Salir llagas en la piel (lit. deshacerse la piel).

Description: To be made, to be manufactured, to be built.
To be burned, referring figuratively and colloquially to having taken an ill-supported position that was therefore shamefully rejected.
alt_translation1: Quemarse, refiriéndose de forma figurada y familiar al hecho de haber tomado una postura mal sustentada que por ello fue rechazada de manera vergonzosa.

Description: To flash, to give off strong light like that of a lightning bolt.
alt_translation1: Relampaguear, despedir luz fuerte como la de un rayo.

Description: To be cheated on by a romantic partner.
alt_translation1: Ser engañado por la pareja romántica.

Description: To climb, to ascend, to mount. By extension, to have sex, to make love.
alt_translation1: Subirse, treparse, encaramarse, montarse, ascender. Por extensión, tener sexo, hacer el amor.

Description: For saliva to rise to the head. Sudden ailment that some consider to be life-threatening.
alt_translation1: Subírsele la saliva a la cabeza. Algunos consideran que esta afección repentina puede poner en riesgo la vida.

Description: For liquid to rise, ex. when water evaporates, when having acid reflux. This also refers to the action of lightning without rain based on the idea that rain is still accumulating.
alt_translation1: Elevarse un líquido, ej. al evaporarse el agua, al tener reflujo gástrico. También se refiere a la acción de relampaguear sin llover por la idea de que la lluvia se está acumulando.

Description: To be washed. By extension, to be cleaned out.
To have a tingling sensation after an extremity of the body becomes numb.
alt_translation1: Tener una sensación de hormigueo como cuando se entume una extremidad del cuerpo.

Description: To lack, to be lacking, to be short of, to not show up.
To lack courage (lit. for the heart to be lacking).
alt_translation1: Tener pena, faltarle valor (lit. faltarle el corazón).

Description: To be quiet, to be slow in reacting, possibly due to a cognitive disability.
alt_translation1: Estar callado, ser lento en reaccionar, posiblemente debido a una discapacidad cognitiva.

Description: To plow, to clear the vegetation in a plot of land.
alt_translation1: Barbecharse, abrirse surco, limpiarse un terreno de siembra.

Description: To remain, to be left behind.
To end up in poverty (lit. to be left under the sun).
alt_translation1: Quedar en la pobreza (lit. quedar bajo el sol).

Description: To be stuck on the way, to stay or fall behind.
To be detained, to be suspended, to be interrupted.
alt_translation1: Quedar detenido, quedar suspendido, ser interrumpido.

Description: To be dumped on the ground. By extension, to be abandoned or left to one's own devices.
alt_translation1: Quedarse tirado, quedarse botado. Por extensión, quedarse abandonado a su suerte.

Description: For someone's eyes to be bulging or to be opened wide.
alt_translation1: Hacérsele los ojos saltones, abrírsele los ojos, pelársele los ojos.

Description: To light up, to become lit, to clear up thereby letting light in.
alt_translation1: Alumbrarse, iluminarse, despejarse dejando entrar la luz.

Description: This phrasal verb has the literal meaning for one's head to be cleared. This is interpreted in two ways: to go bald, and to have clarity of thought.
alt_translation1: Este verbo de frase tiene como significado literal despejarse la cabeza. Esto se interpreta de dos maneras: quedarse calvo, y aclararse la mente.

Description: To completely light up, become lit, or clear up.
alt_translation1: Alumbrarse, iluminarse o despejarse por completo.

Description: To be cared for, to be looked after, to be protected, to be guarded.
This phrasal verb refers to activities related to a wake, in particular, guarding lighted candles during the nights of the ninth day and fortieth day after the passing of a loved one.
alt_translation1: Este verbo de frase se refiere a las actividades en torno a un velorio, con énfasis en cuidar las velas encendidas durante las noches de los nueve días y de los cuarenta días posteriores al fallecimiento.

Description: This phrasal verb refers to the communal activity that takes place during Lent and consists of guarding the dried or fried fish that will be offered in a meal after mass, so that no animal comes near them.
alt_translation1: Este verbo de frase se refiere a la actividad comunitaria que se lleva a cabo durante la Cuaresma y consiste en cuidar los pescados secos o fritos que se van a ofrecer para comer después de la misa, para que no se los coma ningún animal.

Description: This phrasal verb refers to the communal activity involving contribution, processing and cooking of chickens in the context of weddings. It involves each guest bringing a chicken to the wedding site on Saturday morning. All the chickens are slaughtered and hung on a rope next to the head of the bull that was also slaughtered. On Saturday night the chickens are prepared in mole sauce, which is then served on Sunday morning.
alt_translation1: Este verbo de frase se refiere a la actividad comunitaria de contribución, procesamiento y cocción de pollos que se lleva a cabo en torno a las bodas. Consiste en que cada invitado traiga un pollo el sábado por la mañana al lugar donde se celebrará la boda. Todos los pollos se sacrifican y se cuelgan en una pita junto a la cabeza del ganado que también se sacrificó. El sábado por la noche se preparan los pollos en mole, el cual se sirve el domingo por la mañana.

Description: This phrasal verb refers to the communal activity that consists of guarding the foods that will be offered during a wedding, so that no animal comes near them.
alt_translation1: Este verbo de frase se refiere a la actividad comunitaria que consiste en cuidar los alimentos que se van a ofrecer en una boda, para que no se los coma ningún animal.

Description: This phrasal verb refers to the care that is offered to someone who is nearing death.
alt_translation1: Este verbo de frase se refiere a los cuidados que se le otorgan a un moribundo.

Description: This phrasal verb refers to the care that is offered to someone who is nearing death.
alt_translation1: Este verbo de frase se refiere a los cuidados que se le otorgan a un moribundo.

Description: To be pulled out, to be torn off.
To be inserted, as something that pierces or penetrates, submerges in liquid, or is introduced among people so that it may be shared.
alt_translation1: Introducirse. Por extensión, encajarse, meterse, o sumergirse, así como introducirse de manera que se reparte.

Description: To be introduced. By extension, to be wedged, to get in, to be submerged, or to be introduced among people for sharing.
alt_translation1: Introducirse. Por extensión, encajarse, meterse, sumergirse, o introducirse de manera que se reparte.

Description: To become inflamed (lit. for fire to come down).
To develop cataracts (lit. for mold to come down).
alt_translation1: Desarrollarse cataratas en los ojos (lit. caer el moho).

Description: To become moldy. By extension, to develop cataracts (lit. for mold to come down).
alt_translation1: Enmohecerse. Por extensión, desarrollarse cataratas en los ojos (lit. caer el moho).

Description: For corn and other harvested plants to be stricken by disease.
alt_translation1: Caerle una plaga a la milpa y a otras cosechas.

Description: For the wind to blow (lit. for the wind to come down).
alt_translation1: Soplar el viento (lit. caer el viento).

Description: For plants to be stricken by disease causing atrophy and a grainy or bumpy texture.
alt_translation1: Caerle una plaga a las plantas de manera que se atrofian y desarrollan una apariencia granulosa.
Acumularse (lit. caer) el sereno o el rocío.

Description: For a birthday or onomastic to be celebrated. Onomastic celebrations are on the day of the Saint after whom a person is named. In fact, this lexeme literally means "for the day of their saint to fall".
alt_translation1: Celebrarse un cumpleaños o un onomástico (lit. caer el día de su santo).

Description: To be excessive with a given action, to go overboard on something (lit. for the hand to come down). By extension, to be punished.
alt_translation1: Írsele o pasársele la mano (lit. caer la mano). Por extensión, castigarse.

Description: For cold weather to set in, to get cold (lit. for cold to come down).
alt_translation1: Enfriarse, hacer frío (lit. caer el frío).

Description: To rain (lit. for rain to come down).

alt_translation1: Caerse para atrás, irse de espaldas.

Description: To fall down out of carelessness. This is used in reference to someone old enough to pay attention to avoid falling down, not in reference to a young child.
alt_translation1: Caerse por descuido, dicho de alguien que ya está en edad de poder poner atención para no caerse, y no de las infancias.

Description: To lose consistency, to become soft, mushy or dispersed, as when corn kernels crack open when cooked, when the tip of the fingers become wrinkled do to water exposure, or when insects become agitated and swarm.
alt_translation1: Perder consistencia, reblandecerse, disgregarse, como le ocurre al maíz cuando se cuece, a los dedos cuando pasan tiempo en el agua, cuando se hace un hervidero de insectos, etc.

Description: For people to crowd and mill around.
To become foamy, to thicken up, like beaten eggs.
alt_translation1: Espumarse, espesarse, como el huevo batido.

Description: For a cooked item to reach the point where it is optimally soft (lit. for ants to swarm).
alt_translation1: Cocerse bien un alimento y quedar suave (lit. hacerse un hervidero de hormigas).

Description: For the tips of the fingers to wrinkle up due to prolonged water exposure. By extension, to yield, in relation to a woman's effort to beat eggs to make a bread called marquesote, and whether the beaten eggs will yield enough to make the desired amount of bread.
alt_translation1: Arrugarse la piel de los dedos de las manos por estar demasiado expuestos al agua. Por extensión, rendirle la mano, dicho de la labor de una mujer que bate huevos para la elaboración del pan llamado marquesote.

Description: For water to sprinkle out of control.
For the feet to wrinkle up due to prolonged water exposure.
alt_translation1: Arrugarse la piel de los pies por estar demasiado expuestos al agua.

Description: For a cloud of dust or dirt to form.
For a cloud of dust or dirt to form.
For corn kernels to soften as they are cooked.
For the seed or fruit to develop a cotton-like structure and disperse in the wind (by anemochory).
alt_translation1: Esponjarse y dispersarse la semilla o el fruto, dicho de las plantas cuyos frutos (vilanos) están cubiertos de un material algodonoso para que sean transportados por el viento (propagación por anemocoria).

Description: To be made, to be manufactured. By extension, to take advantage or make the most of something.
alt_translation1: Hacerse, elaborarse, fabricarse. Por extensión, hacerse de algo, aprovechar, aprovecharse.

Description: To take advantage or make the most of something.
To overdo it, to go overboard on something.
alt_translation1: Hacer algo de manera exagerada, excederse. Clavarse (en la jerga mexicana).

Description: To open up, to become open.
To originate, for an idea or an intention to come from within oneself.
alt_translation1: Nacerle, ej. una idea, una consideración.
Nacer prematuro, nacer antes de tiempo.

Description: To heal, to recover from an illness, to become healthy again.
To get up, to stand up.
To sleepwalk (lit. to get up during sleep).
alt_translation1: Ser sonámbulo (lit. levantarse durante el sueño).

Description: To get up suddenly or abruptly.
To get up suddenly or abruptly.
To sleepwalk (lit. to get up during sleep).
alt_translation1: Ser sonámbulo (lit. levantarse durante el sueño).

Description: To feel compassion for, to feel pity.
To become full, to become impregnated, ex. with a smell, smoke, dust, or liquid.
alt_translation1: Llenarse, impregnarse, ex. de un olor, de humo, de polvo o de algún líquido.

Description: For a wound or burn to heal, to scar over.
To close up, to become covered up or obstructed. By extension, to faint, to lose consciousness.
alt_translation1: Cerrarse, taparse. Por extensión, privarse, desmayarse, perder el conocimiento.

Description: To hunker down at home as a way to isolate oneself willingly. By extension, to be imprisoned.
alt_translation1: Encerrarse en casa por voluntad propia. Por extensión, estar preso.

Description: For the belly to ripple, as when the belly of a pregnant woman moves because of pressure applied by the fetus. By extension, for the belly to writhe, to have diarrhea.
alt_translation1: Ondear la panza, como cuando la panza de una mujer embarazada se mueve por la presión del feto. Por extensión, retorcerse la panza o tener diarrea.

Description: For the hips of a woman to sway.
alt_translation1: Menear las caderas, dicho de una mujer.

Description: To open up, to become open.
To be in agreement with someone.
alt_translation1: Entenderse o ponerse de acuerdo con alguien.

Description: To go downwards, to come down. By extension, based on the notion of coming down (getting off/out) from a mode of transportation, this lexeme can refer to a stop during travel and even allude to lodging in the stopping place. Metaphorically, this can also refer to a reduction in intensity, as when colors become dull.
alt_translation1: Ir hacia abajo, bajarse. Por extensión, y en alusión a bajar de un medio de transporte, se puede referir a hacer una parada durante un viaje e incluso implicar hospedaje en el lugar de la parada. También se puede hacer una referencia metafórica para referirse a una reducción de intensidad, como cuando un color baja de intensidad porque se despinta o se destiñe.

Description: For the wind to start to blow (lit. for the wind to come down).
alt_translation1: Empezar a soplar el aire (lit. bajar el aire).

Description: To do a roll call, to name names.
To talk about a topic repeatedly or after a period in which it was forgotten (lit. to come down and awaken).
alt_translation1: Volver a hablar de un tema una y otra vez, o después de algún tiempo de estar en el olvido (lit. bajar y despertar).

Description: For the nose to bleed. This ailment is associated with heat. To stop the bleeding some resort to placing a hierba santa leaf on the forehead of the affected person.
alt_translation1: Sangrar la nariz. Este malestar se considera caliente. Para detener la hemorragia se acostumbra poner una hoja de hierba santa en la frente de la persona afectada.

Description: For a price to come down.
To come down in reference to prices, to color or to intensity.
alt_translation1: Bajar de precio, bajar de color, bajar de intensidad.

Description: To remember, to evoke, to reminisce.
To be braided, to be twisted, especially in reference to cordage.
alt_translation1: Trenzarse, torcerse, dicho sobre todo de la elaboración de riatas y cuerdas.

Description: For light to be cast over something, for electricity to be installed in a home or a community (lit. light is brought in).
alt_translation1: Alumbrar, instalar el alumbrado (lit. meterse la luz).

Description: To be married in a civil wedding (lit. word is brought in).
alt_translation1: Casarse por lo civil (lit. meterse la palabra).
Llegar el día o la fecha.

Description: This verb phrase is used to refer to the act of a man taking his female partner to his family's home in order to establish themselves as a couple intending to marry. This is generally done in a consensual way.
alt_translation1: Esta frase verbal se utiliza para referirse al acto de un hombre de llevar a casa de su familia, a su pareja mujer a manera de establecerse como pareja con vistas al matrimonio. En castellano esta expresión se traduce como 'robarse a la mujer' aunque este acto suele ser consensuado.

Description: To be fenced in, to be encircled, to be besieged.

This verb phrase describes offering words of advice to the bride and groom during their wedding. Those chosen to sponsor and guide the couple during this important rite of passage perform this act, thereby acquiring an important kinship role.
