alt_translation1: Esta frase verbal describe el acto de ofrecer palabras de consejo por parte de los padrinos a los novios durante la boda de estos.

Description: For consciousness or reason to be regained.
alt_translation1: Volverle la razón o el conocimiento.

Description: For a contribution to be made towards the costs associated with special occasions, such as weddings, wakes, and community festivities known as 'velas' in Spanish.
alt_translation1: Entregarse la cooperación que se acostumbra ofrecer durante las ocasiones especiales como en bodas, velorios y las velas.

Description: To worry (lit. for worry to enter someone).
To join, to come together, to work together, especially when it comes to organizing a festivity as a group.
alt_translation1: Juntarse, reunirse, solidarizarse, sobre todo para colaborar o cooperar para una celebración.

Description: For air to enter the body. This is a discomfort that is associated with heat and can affect different parts of the body. It occurs when the body is warm or hot and one is exposed abruptly to the cold. Arnica, avocado leaf baths, as well as cupping, are often used to relieve the discomfort. The importance of seeing a doctor is also recognized.
alt_translation1: Meterse el aire en el cuerpo. Este es un malestar que se considera caliente y puede afectar diferentes partes del cuerpo. Ocurre cuando el cuerpo está caliente y uno se expone al frío. Para aliviar el malestar se suele recurrir al árnica, a los baños de hoja de aguacate, y a las ventosas. También se reconoce la importancia de acudir a un médico.

Description: To jump, to hop, to take flight as when on a swing.
alt_translation1: Brincar, saltar, agarrar vuelo como cuando uno se columpia.

Description: For the devil to possess someone.
To listen (lit. for the ear to enter).
For a contribution to be made towards the costs associated with special occasions, such as weddings, wakes, and community festivities known as 'velas' in Spanish.
alt_translation1: Entregarse la cooperación que se acostumbra ofrecer durante las ocasiones especiales como en bodas, velorios y las velas.

Description: To be wetted. By extension, to be baptized.
To smell, to sniff. By extension, to suspect, to have a hunch.
alt_translation1: Oler, olfatear, percibir un olor. Por extensión, presentir, sospechar.

Description: For something to be stored away carefully.
This verb phrase refers to the act of sending a delegation to ask for a woman's hand in marriage.
alt_translation1: Esta frase verbal se refiere al acto de enviar emisarios a pedir la mano de una novia en matrimonio.

Description: To be braided, in relation to hair.
Intertwine the legs or nails of an iguana after catching it so that it does not escape.
alt_translation1: Entrelazarse las patas o las uñas de la iguana después de atraparla para que no se escape.

Description: To be braided, in relation to hair.
To be sung, to be recited, to be read (especially out loud).
alt_translation1: Cantarse, declamarse, leerse (sobre todo en voz alta).

Description: To wear out or to deteriorate due to aging or long-term use.
alt_translation1: Acabarse, desgastarse o deteriorarse por vejez o por el uso.

Description: To be kneaded, to be made smooth. By extension, to digest.
alt_translation1: Amasarse, hacerse fino o parejo. Por extensión, digerir.

Description: For light (or similar) to go out. By extension, for someone to be discouraged.
To chat, to tell, to narrate.
To chat, to explain, to advise.
To become clean, to be cleared out, to become uncluttered.
To feel pity or compassion for someone.
alt_translation1: Tenerle lástima, compadecerse de, apiadarse de.

Description: To be stubborn, to impose one's will.
alt_translation1: Encapricharse, ponerse terco, imponer su voluntad.

Description: To get hurt, to hurt oneself.
To become accustomed, to get used to, to get comfortable (ex. in a new living situation, in a new city).
To become weakened because the item in question is rotten, worn out, eaten up inside (as in the case of plants), or saggy.
alt_translation1: Debilitarse, ya sea por estar podrido, desgastado, carcomido, bofo, o desvencijado.

Description: To lack courage (lit. for the liver to be lacking).
alt_translation1: Tener pena, faltarle valor (lit. faltarle el hígado).
Carecer de inteligencia o de juicio.

Description: To remain calm, to remain motionless.
To go out of sight, in reference to an object that moves far away, is submerged in liquid, or covered by something.
alt_translation1: Perderse de vista, ya sea por alejarse, por hundirse, o por taparse.

Description: To scrape the pulp out of a fruit such as a calabash (Crescentia alata), pumpkin or coconut. By extension, to drain a zit or other infected wound.
alt_translation1: Despulpar un fruto como el morro (Crescentia alata), la calabaza o el coco. Por extensión, drenar un grano o herida infectada.

Description: To sting, to burn, ex. when something is spicy, when pouring alcohol on a wound.

alt_translation1: Arder el pecho, como cuando tiene uno acidez estomacal.

Description: To burn when urinating. This ailment is associated with heat. There are infusions that are used to treat this ailment such as infusions of annatto, horsetail or cat's claw.
alt_translation1: Arder al orinar. Esta afección se considera caliente. Para aliviarla, se acostumbran algunas infusiones ya sea de achiote, de cola de caballo o de uña de gato.

Description: This verb phrase describes the process by which corn is stunted, becomes acrid and/or goes bad.
alt_translation1: Esta frase verbal define lo que le ocurre al elote cuando se enjuta, se pone amargo, y/o se pone feo.

Description: To become agitated, to become unsettled, to stir. By extension, to disperse, to scatter, to break up.
To lose consciousness, to lose one's capacity to reason (lit. for intelligence to go away).
alt_translation1: Perder el conocimiento, perder el juicio (lit. irse la inteligencia).

Description: To suffocate, to choke (lit. for one's air to go away).
To suffocate, to choke (lit. for one's breath to go away).
To come and go, to swing.
To go on, to continue, to persist.
To be happy, to enjoy oneself.
To be or become wholeheartedly happy.
alt_translation1: Alegrarse, regocijarse, o ponerse contento de corazón.

Description: To be destroyed, to be squashed.
To become sour, to become acid or acrid.

This verb describes the formation of something long and thin, in analogy with the central fiber of a rope or the wick of a candle. Thus, this verb can describe the formation of a path in the undergrowth or on a stone due to the transit of animals, a strip of torn fabric, etc.
alt_translation1: Este verbo describe la formación de algo largo y delgado, esto en analogía con la fibra central de una riata, o el pabilo de una vela. Así, este verbo puede describir la formación de una vereda entre la maleza o sobre una piedra por el tránsito de animales, la hilacha de alguna tela, etc.

Description: This verb describes the process by which a fabric wears out leaving a loose thread or a strip.
alt_translation1: Este verbo describe el proceso mediante el cual una tela se desgasta y se deshilacha.

Description: This verb is used to describe the formation of a thin line of smoke when a fire is first lit.
alt_translation1: Este verbo se utiliza para describir la formación de una fina tira de humo cuando se enciende un fuego por primera vez.

Description: For dust to become airborne. It is possible that this verb specifically describes this event when the dust rises forming a thin strip.
alt_translation1: Levantarse una polvareda. Es posible que este verbo describa específicamente este evento cuando el polvo se levanta formando una delgada tira.

Description: This verb describes how the ground is made smooth by some external force, e.g. rain. By association, it also describes the dust that is raised by performing an action that makes the ground smooth.
alt_translation1: Este verbo describe cómo se hace lisa la tierra por alguna fuerza externa, ej. la lluvia. Por asociación, también describe la tira de polvo que se levanta al llevar a cabo una acción que alisa la tierra.

Description: This verb describes how the ground is made smooth by some external force, e.g. rain. By association, it also describes the dust that is raised by performing an action that makes the ground smooth.
alt_translation1: Este verbo describe cómo se hace lisa la tierra por alguna fuerza externa, ej. la lluvia. Por asociación, también describe la tira de polvo que se levanta al llevar a cabo una acción que alisa la tierra.

Description: To become stunted, to become ugly, as in the case of plants, or of people who are unwell, especially women who after giving birth do not recover and appear unhealthy.
alt_translation1: Atrofiarse, ponerse feo, como en el caso de plantas que no crecen bien, o de personas que no se encuentran bien, sobre todo las mujeres que después de un parto se demacran y no se recuperan.

Description: To act rapidly, hurriedly, or even violently.
alt_translation1: Actuar de manera rápida, apresurada, incluso violenta.

Description: To look or search for something.
For the lower back to hurt because of menstruation.
alt_translation1: Doler la espalda baja y/o la cadera debido a la menstruación.

Description: Process which causes corn stored in humid conditions to sprout making the corn unsuitable for consumption.
alt_translation1: Pudrirse, infectarse, descomponerse, corromperse. Proceso en el cual la mazorca guardada en la humedad genera retoños que evitan que pueda consumirse la mazorca.

Description: To close up, to become covered up or obstructed. By extension, to faint, to lose consciousness.
alt_translation1: Cerrarse, taparse. Por extensión, privarse, desmayarse, perder el conocimiento.

Description: For light or a device to turn itself off.
To walk, to walk around, to stroll around, to wander.
For a fight to be in progress.
To comb (lit. for the comb to pass through).
For beer to be handed out continuously to keep all the guests at a celebration well served.
alt_translation1: Servirse las cervezas de manera constante para mantener atendidos a todos los invitados a una celebración (lit. circular la cerveza).

Description: For a cacao-based drink to be served to guests at a celebration.
alt_translation1: Servirse el pozol entre los invitados a una celebración.

Description: For breakfast or drinks to be served.
alt_translation1: Servirse el desayuno, servir de beber.

Description: For a meal to be served.
For fire to burn continually. By extension, for war to continue to be waged.
alt_translation1: Continuar ardiendo el fuego. Por extensión, continuar la guerra.

Description: For the volume of something to increase, e.g., in the case of fruits as they ripen, or by friction, exposure to heat, or a process of dilation.
alt_translation1: Aumentar de volumen, ej. en el caso de las frutas al madurar, o por dilatación, fricción, o exposición al calor.

Description: For a meal to be served.
To be out late, to be up late.
To be attentive of or attend to someone or something (lit. for the liver to walk around).
alt_translation1: Andar al pendiente o al tanto de alguien o algo (lit. andar el hígado).

Description: To crawl (lit. for the hand to walk).
To follow, to go after (lit. to walk while hanging)
To rinse (lit. for water to pass through).
To crab crawl (as opposed to crawling on hands and feet).
alt_translation1: Andar de nalgas como lo hacen algunos bebés en vez de gatear.

Description: To walk on the knees as when asking for a miracle or for forgiveness.
alt_translation1: Andar de rodillas como se hace al rogar por un milagro o pagar alguna penitencia.

Description: To be threaded. By analogy with the process of stringing a necklace until both ends are brought together, this verb can also mean to be completed and can refer to a cycle that closes.
alt_translation1: Ensartarse, enhebrarse. Por analogía con el proceso de ensartado de un collar hasta juntar los dos extremos, este verbo también significa completarse o cumplirse.

Description: To take flight, to be launched into the air. By extension, to go into debt.
alt_translation1: Echarse a volar, lanzarse al aire. Por extensión, endeudarse, endrogarse.

Description: For a weapon to be pointed.
For someone or something to draw or attract one.
alt_translation1: Ser atraído hacia algo o alguien.

Description: To be announced, for information to be disseminated. By extension, for words of praise to be pronounced.
alt_translation1: Anunciarse, difundirse la información. Por extensión, pronunciarse palabras de elogio.

Description: To wish someone well whether by congratulating them, welcoming them, wishing them good health and good fortune, or by presenting one's condolences.
alt_translation1: Expresarle buenos deseos a alguien, ya sea a manera de felicitaciones, para dar la bienvenida, para desear buena salud y suerte, o para dar el pésame.

Description: To happen, to occur, to take place.
For something to happen to someone.
For something to happen to someone.
To become scattered or spread around. By extension, to irrigate. This verb is also used to describe the action of tracing designs with sugar on bread known as "marquesote".
alt_translation1: Regarse, irrigarse. También se utiliza para describir la acción de trazar diseños con azúcar sobre el pan conocido como marquesote.

Description: For designs to be traced with sugar on bread known as "marquesote".
alt_translation1: Adornar el pan conocido como marquesote con diseños de azúcar.

Description: To open up, to become open.
To become wide open as in the case of a door.
To go out of order, to break down and no longer function.
To be erased. By extension, to be demolished, to disappear.
To become flattened. It could also mean to lose height, as this verb is used to describe the action of a tree falling.
alt_translation1: Aplastarse. También podría significar perder altura, pues este verbo se usa para describir la acción de un árbol al tumbarse o caerse.

Description: For people to assemble into a crowd pressed up against each other.
For food to be stuffed, especially as it relates to the intensive feeding of pigs for fast weight gain.
alt_translation1: Embutirse la comida, sobre todo con relación a la alimentación intensiva de los marranos para acelerar su engorda.

Description: To give birth. By extension, to generate gossip.
alt_translation1: Parir, dar a luz, aliviarse de un parto. Por extensión, inventar chismes.

Description: To turn dappled or mottled, as in the case of an animal, or of a person who has vitiligo or Pinta.
alt_translation1: Ponerse pinto, como en el caso de un animal pinto, o de una persona con vitíligo o con mal de Pinto.

Description: To go nuts, to become very excited. By extension, to be sexually aroused.
alt_translation1: Alocarse, emocionarse demasiado. Por extensión, excitarse sexualmente.

Description: To move apart, to move out of the way.
For the sound of a festivity to be heard.
For something to sound broken, for a sound to be very loud.
alt_translation1: Sonar a quebrado, sonar muy fuerte.
Tronar la panza, sonar las tripas.

Description: For the nose to make noise, whether due to heavy breathing or to snoring.
alt_translation1: Sonar la nariz, ya sea por respirar con dificultad o fuerza, o por roncar.

Description: To be pleated, to be folded, as fabric that is folded for pleats and seams in clothing.
alt_translation1: Plisarse, plegarse, como en el caso de la tela cuando se hacen tablones y costuras.

Description: To be squeezed tight. By extension, to be tied tight around the waist, to be wrung, to be milked.
alt_translation1: Apretarse. Por extensión, ceñirse, exprimirse, ordeñarse.

Description: To be tied tight around the waist.
To spill, to overflow, in reference to water.
alt_translation1: Derramarse, tirarse, regarse, en referencia al agua.

Description: To bleed (lit. for blood to be expressed).
alt_translation1: Tener una hemorragia (lit. exprimirse la sangre).

Description: This phrasal verb is the equivalent of to tighten the belt, as a way to talk about living in austerity.
alt_translation1: Apretarse el cinturón a manera de ser austero.

Description: To lose its normal shape and become crooked or slanted, or to fall sideways.
To drag a foot due to a disability.
alt_translation1: Arrastrar el pie debido a alguna discapacidad.

Description: To slither on one's back, to rub one's back against something.
alt_translation1: Arrastrarse de espaldas, o frotarse la espalda contra algo.

Description: To rub something on repeatedly, to rub the necessary amount in the case of medication.
alt_translation1: Untar repetidas veces, untar la cantidad necesaria en el caso de un medicamento.

Description: To caress, to massage, to rub.
To drag something on the ground.
To scrunch up and wrinkle up from exposure to fire. By extension, to be born with shrunken or incomplete feet.
alt_translation1: Encogerse y arrugarse por exposición al fuego. Por extensión, nacer con los pies encogidos o incompletos.

Description: To lick one's lips to clean them.
alt_translation1: Chuparse o lametearse los labios para limpiarlos.

Description: To become crippled, especially in relation to the loss of movement of a limb due to a disease such as poliomyelitis.
alt_translation1: Tullirse o lisiarse, sobre todo en relación con la pérdida de movimiento de alguna extremidad debido a una enfermedad como la poliomielitis.

Description: To smear, to cover, ex. a house with plaster
alt_translation1: Untarse, embadurnarse, cubrirse, ej. repellar una casa.

Description: To lay down, in particular as it relates to hens as they lay down to brood eggs. This verb is also used in reference to other activities where an entity is extended, as in the case of tortillas extended over a griddle to cook, or seeds scattered over a griddle to toast. Similarly, this verb refers to the action of swimming, possibly in reference to the extension of the body needed for swimming.
alt_translation1: Tenderse, particularmente con relación a las gallinas cuando se posan sobre sus huevos para empollarlos. También se aplica a otras actividades donde el sujeto se extiende, como en el caso de las tortillas extendidas sobre un comal, o semillas esparcidas sobre un comal para tostarse. De igual manera se refiere a la acción de nadar, posiblemente debido a la extensión del cuerpo al nadar.

Description: To break off dried corn kernels from the cob.
For a tortilla to cook on a griddle.
alt_translation1: Cocerse la tortilla en el comal.

Description: To break off dried corn kernels from the cob.

This verb phrase refers to the process of confession of guilt before the person known as bigaana, at the same time that the confessor prepares either the species of Sporobolus spartinus grass known as gizhi donda or totomoxtle as a guilt necklace to later splash it with blood and burn it.
alt_translation1: Esta frase verbal se refiere al proceso de confesión de culpas ante la persona conocida como bigaana, al mismo tiempo que el confesante prepara ya sea la especie de pasto Sporobolus spartinus conocida como gizhi donda o totomoxtle a manera de collar de culpas para después salpicarlo de sangre y quemarlo.

Description: For the hem to be tucked in and sewn.
alt_translation1: Meterse el dobladillo o la bastilla.

Description: To drag oneself on the ground.
To defecate, to poop. By extension, to screw up.
alt_translation1: Cagar, defecar, hacer popó. Por extensión, cagarla, en el sentido de haber hecho algo mal o de no lograr un objetivo.

Description: To have diarrhea that is green in color. This is considered to affect children who are suffering from indigestion or are teething, as well as mothers who have recently given birth and whose hips are thought to be too open still.
alt_translation1: Tener diarrea verde. Se considera que esto le ocurre a los niños por empacho o cuando les va a salir un diente, o a las madres que recién han parido con base en la noción de que aún tienen la cadera abierta.

Description: To have diarrhea that is yellow in color. This is considered to affect children who are suffering from indigestion.
alt_translation1: Tener diarrea amarilla. Se considera que esto le ocurre a los niños por empacho.

Description: To have diarrhea that is white in color. This is considered to affect children who are suffering from indigestion.
alt_translation1: Tener diarrea blanca. Se considera que esto le ocurre a los niños por empacho.

Description: To cut or break into pieces.
To be bought, to be purchased, to be acquired.
To be reduced, to become scarce, to become less and less, to diminish, to dwindle.
alt_translation1: Reducirse en cantidad, hacerse poco o menos, escasear, mermar, menguar.

Description: To end up naked. By extension, and most commonly, to end up stripped or cleaned out, to become reduced as spinach does when cooked.
alt_translation1: Quedar desnudo. Por extensión, el uso más común de este lexema es quedarse pobre, quedar despojado o desvalijado, quedar reducido como las espinacas al cocerse.

Description: To buy, to purchase, to acquire.
To buy the love of a man.
alt_translation1: Comprar el cariño de un hombre.

Description: To take someone's word as truthful and making a commitment based on it.
alt_translation1: Confiar en la palabra de alguien y adquirir un compromiso con base en ello.

Description: Fulfill a duty or responsibility, ex. a work day.
alt_translation1: Cumplir un compromiso, ej. una jornada de trabajo.

Description: To find the way to convince, manipulate or deceive someone.
alt_translation1: Lograr la manera de convencer, manipular o engañar a alguien.

Description: To take responsibility for a harmful act that one has committed.
alt_translation1: Reconocer un daño que uno ha cometido.

Description: To whip, to mix, to stir. By extension, to bother, to pester.
alt_translation1: Batir, mezclar, menear. Por extensión, molestar, importunar.

Description: To stand something up. By extension, to fuck or to fuck someone.
alt_translation1: Pararlo. Por extensión, coger o cogerse a alguien, en el sentido de tener sexo con alguien.

Description: To end up naked. By extension, to end up stripped or cleaned out.
alt_translation1: Quedar desnudo. Por extensión, quedarse pobre, quedar despojado o desvalijado.

Description: To massage, to rub for healing purposes (lit. for the hand to stand).
alt_translation1: Sobar, dar masaje (lit. pararse la mano).

Description: To be kneaded, to be made smooth.
To be hurt, to be injured.
Sound of fish or of a small corn tortilla frying.
alt_translation1: Sonido de pescado o garnachitas friéndose.

Description: Sound of Rosaura López Cartas' cry when she was little.
alt_translation1: Sonido del lloriqueo de Rosaura López Cartas cuando era chiquita.

Description: Sound of a stone rasping against iron.
alt_translation1: Sonido de una piedra lijando contra hierro.

Description: Sound of the start of snivelling.
Sound of a person for whom their beer hit the spot.
alt_translation1: Sonido de una persona a quien le cae sabroso la cerveza.
Sonido que hace el coyote al aullar.

Description: Sound of a child who fell and is about to start crying.
alt_translation1: Sonido de un niño que se cayó y está a punto de llorar.

Description: Listen!, exclamation to call people's attention.
Listen!, exclamation to call people's attention.
Sound of something being forced in a space where it doesn't fit.
alt_translation1: Sonido de algo siendo forzado donde no cabe.

Description: Sound of a punch to the neck, shoulder, or stomach, or of the palm of the hand striking a wooden table.
alt_translation1: Sonido de un puñetazo en el cuello, hombro o panza, o de la palma de la mano contra una mesa de madera.

Description: Sound of slapping the face, especially of two slaps to the face in rapid succession.
alt_translation1: Sonido de cachetadas, sobre todo de dos cachetadas rápidas.

Description: Sound of hitting with a belt or a hand.
alt_translation1: Sonido de un golpe de cinturón o de manazo.
Ir a entrometerse, ir de chismoso.

Description: To go to cut as in to go harvest or to go and clear a field that is overgrown.
alt_translation1: Ir a cortar en el sentido de ir a cosechar o de ir a desmontar.

Description: To go back home. It also refers to the first time a bride is dropped off at her partner's house where she will live from then on.
alt_translation1: Ir de regreso a casa. También se refiere a la primera vez en que una novia es entregada a la casa de su pareja para vivir ahí a partir de ese momento.

Description: To go stick one's nose in other people's business.
alt_translation1: Ir a meterse en lo que no debe.

Description: To go clean a plot of land of weeds and plant overgrowth.
alt_translation1: Ir a limpiar un terreno o a cortar maleza.

Habitual: ri+ g.anna*; ~ ri!+ ganna*; ~ re+ g.anna*; ~ re!+ ganna*

Description: To go have breakfast, to go drinking alcohol.
alt_translation1: Ir a desayunar, ir a tomar bebidas alcohólicas.

Description: This verb describes the process of change in the quality of ambient light during twilight at both dawn and dusk.
alt_translation1: Este verbo describe el proceso de cambio en la calidad de la luz ambiental durante el crepúsculo al amanecer y al anochecer.

Description: To go or fall sideways. By extensionón, to leave quietly as to be unnoticed.
alt_translation1: Irse de lado. Por extensión, irse sigilosamente, sin que otros se den cuenta.

Description: To go in pursuit of something or someone.
alt_translation1: Andar siguiendo algo o a alguien.

Description: To go around gleaning, to go around scavenging.
To be resembling someone, especially a family member.
alt_translation1: Ir pareciéndose a alguien, sobre todo a un familiar.

Description: To go show someone the way, to go clear a path.
Habitual: re+ ndee* # neza; ~ ri+ ndee* # neza
alt_translation1: Ir a encaminar a alguien, ir a trazar camino.

Description: To go on a night vigil.
To be taking or bringing something along.
alt_translation1: Ir llevando o trayendo algo consigo.

Description: For the devil to be taking someone away.
alt_translation1: Estar el diablo llevándose a alguien.
Ir a sobar o dar un masaje.

Description: To go and saturate with water (ex. plants) or fill with water (ex. a receptacle).
alt_translation1: Ir a llenar de agua, ya sea regando algo o llenando un recipiente.

Potential: chi!+ za*;  re+ za*;  ye+ za*;  kana+ za*

Description: Sound of a shout with the purpose of scaring someone.
alt_translation1: Sonido de un grito para espantar a alguien.

Description: Expression of gratitude equivalent to "thank you" (lit. may God pay).
alt_translation1: Expresión de agradecimiento equivalente a "gracias" (lit. que Dios pague).

Description: Sound used to scare away a cow.
alt_translation1: Sonido que se usa para espantar a una vaca.

Description: Sound of something heavy being put down.
alt_translation1: Sonido de bajar algo muy pesado.

Description: Sound of a painting falling off a wall.
alt_translation1: Sonido de una pintura soltándose de la pared.

Description: Sound of a person drinking broth.
alt_translation1: Sonido de una persona bebiendo caldo.

Description: Sound of a person drinking broth.
alt_translation1: Sonido de una persona bebiendo caldo.

Description: Sound of a sigh or a whine.
alt_translation1: Sonido de un suspiro o quejido.

Description: Sound of a person slurping soup.
alt_translation1: Sonido de una persona sorbiendo sopa.

Description: Sound made by a person who hurt themself or was surprised by something.
alt_translation1: Sonido de una persona que se lastimó o se sorprendió.

Description: Sound used to call a pretty young woman.
alt_translation1: Sonido que se usa para llamar a una muchacha bonita.

Description: Revolutionary man known as José Lucho.
alt_translation1: El revolucionario conocido como José Lucho.

Description: He was the Municipal President of Juchitán de Zaragoza, of Juchitán and Chiapas origin. He is considered a vengeful person and is known for having banished Mariànu Xhabá' and assassinated him when he returned to Juchitán. It is also said that the Municipal Palace was built by Pàncho León's enemies, condemned to forced labor.
alt_translation1: Fue Presidente Municipal de Juchitán de Zaragoza, de origen juchiteco y chiapaneco. Se le considera una persona vengativa y se le conoce por haber desterrado a Mariànu Xhabá' y haberlo asesinado cuando este regresó a Juchitán. También se dice que el Palacio Municipal lo construyeron los enemigos de Pàncho León, condenados a trabajos forzados.

Description: Sound of a horse grabbing grass to eat.
alt_translation1: Sonido de un caballo agarrando pasto para comer.

Description: Sound of a washcloth cleaning a table.
alt_translation1: Sonido de un trapo limpiando una mesa.

Description: Swishing sound that a long skirt makes as the wearer walks.
alt_translation1: Siseo que hace una falda larga cuando camina quien la lleva puesta.

Description: Phrase intended to reprimand someone who, through a dismissive attitude, displays a lack of intelligence or capacity.
alt_translation1: Frase que se usa para reprocharle a alguien que mediante una actitud de desidia no demuestra inteligencia o capacidad.

Description: Clay vessel with two handles. Small pocket bottle for carrying an alcoholic beverage.
Exclamation of joy, especially from happy little girls.
alt_translation1: Exclamación de alegría, sobre todo de niñas alegres.

Description: Exclamation by a person who hit themself.
alt_translation1: Exclamación de una persona que se pegó.

Description: At. Only used to introduce a time.
alt_translation1: A las. Solo se utiliza para introducir una hora o un horario.

Description: Cursed soul that is wandering in sorrow. A traditional healer can provide relief.
alt_translation1: Alma condenada y que anda penando. Una médica tradicional puede aliviarla.

Description: Measurement unit based on capacity of a culturally-defined container and used primarily for grains.
Name given to Ángela and Eliodoro Charis as a couple
alt_translation1: Pareja formada por Ángela y Heliodoro Charis.

Description: Earring. In the community of La Ventosa, this may be restricted to hoop-shaped earrings whereas in Santa María Xadani, it may refer to earrings of any shape.
alt_translation1: Arete. En la comunidad de La Ventosa puede estar limitado a los aretes en forma de argolla, mientras que en Santa María Xadani se refiere a aretes de cualquier forma.

Description: Earrings featuring five coins in circulation in the mid 1900s, worth two pesos and fifty cents each.
alt_translation1: Aretes compuestos de cinco monedas de dos pesos con cincuenta centavos, monedas en uso a mediados del siglo veinte.

Description: Since, from. Introduces a phrase which specifies a point of origin in time or space, or fictive.
alt_translation1: Desde. Introduce una frase que especifica un punto de origen en el tiempo, en el espacio, o ficticio.

Description: Expression that alludes to the amount of time the speaker has known the interlocutor. Equivalent to "since I'm with you" (as a couple) or "since I've known you" (not as a couple).
alt_translation1: Expresión que hace alusión a la longevidad de la relación entre el hablante y su interlocutor. Equivalente a "desde que me junté contigo" (como pareja) o "desde que te conozco" (no de pareja).

Description: Expression that suggests that the interlocutor is being stubborn and stands to suffer consequences from it.
alt_translation1: Expresión que sugiere que el interlocutor está siendo terco y que podría sufrir consecuencias por ello.

Description: Phrase that seeks to obtain precision about a measurement, size or quantity or an emphatic statement about them. Sometimes equivalent to 'how?', 'how much?', 'what amount?', 'what size?'.
alt_translation1: Locución que se usa para preguntar con precisión acerca de una medida, tamaño o cantidad, o un comentario enfático sobre estos. Puede ser equivalente a '¿mero qué tanto?', '¿qué medida exactamente?', '¿qué tamaño exactamente?', '¿qué tan?'.

Description: Phrase that asks the precise location of something or someone. Sometimes equivalent to 'from where to where, exactly?'.
alt_translation1: Locución que se usa para preguntar con precisión la ubicación de algo o alguien. Puede ser equivalente a '¿de dónde a dónde, exactamente?'.

Description: Expression equivalent to "that's the only way".
alt_translation1: Expresión equivalente a "solo de esa forma/manera".

Description: Grandma, as said in the community of Santa María Xadani.
alt_translation1: Abuelita, según se dice en la comunidad de Santa María Xadani.

Description: Mom!, my mom, as said by young children.
alt_translation1: ¡Mamá!, mi mamá, dicho por niños pequeños.

Description: Mom!, my mom, as said by young children.
alt_translation1: ¡Mamá!, mi mamá, dicho por niños pequeños.
¡Mamá!, llamado que hacen los niños pequeños.
¡Papá!, llamado que hacen los niños pequeños.

Description: Grandpa, as said in the community of Santa María Xadani.
alt_translation1: Abuelito, según se dice en la comunidad de Santa María Xadani.

Description: Dad!, my dad, as said by young children.
alt_translation1: ¡Papá!, mi papá, dicho por niños pequeños.

Description: Dad!, my dad, as said by young children.
alt_translation1: ¡Papá!, mi papá, dicho por niños pequeños.

Description: Vagabond. This can also refer to someone who leaves home without permission or without telling anyone, and roams around.
alt_translation1: Vago o vaga. También se puede referir a una persona que sin avisar o pedir permiso sale y anda deambulando.
Ariel, en referencia al detergente en polvo.

Description: Veil used to cover the face of a bride during a wedding.
alt_translation1: Velo que cubre la cara de la novia en una boda.

Description: Needle whether for sewing, knitting, weaving fishing nets, leather work, or injecting.
alt_translation1: Aguja. Se aplica a cualquier aguja, ya sea para coser, tejer con estambre, tejer redes de pescar, o para trabajar el cuero, así como para inyectar.

Description: Awl used to make small holes in leather.
alt_translation1: Lezna para hacer agujeros en el cuero.

Description: Needle used for weaving fishing nets.
alt_translation1: Aguja para tejer red de pescar.

Description: One of two types of offerings that can be prepared during All Saints celebrations. This offering is based on a single or on multiple surfaces, all highly decorated. The other type of offering is biguie'.
alt_translation1: Uno de los dos tipos de ofrendas que se preparan para Todos Santos. El otro tipo de ofrenda es biguie'.

Description: Children's game that follows the song "A la víbora de la mar". It is a game in which two children form a bridge with their arms, while the rest of the children form a line and pass under the bridge. All children sing the song and when the song comes to an end, the two children forming the bridge catch the child passing through at the moment. That child is taken out of the game, and the song is sung again.
alt_translation1: Juego de niños que se juega cantando la canción "A la víbora de la mar".

Description: Name given to Alicia and Leobardo as a couple.
alt_translation1: Pareja formada por Alicia y Leobardo.

Description: Sound of the motor when a car is idling.
alt_translation1: Sonido del motor de un carro cuando está parado.

Description: Handler of mules and other pack animals.
Government body in charge of tax collection.
alt_translation1: Entidad gubernamental que gestiona el pago de impuestos.

Description: Sound of a weak sneeze with little air.
alt_translation1: Sonido de un estornudo débil o de poco aire.

Description: Inflammation of the opening of the stomach. This condition is associated with heat. It is attributed to drinking something cold when the body is hot. Several types of tea are known as remedies to treat this type of inflammation, such as tea made with the vine known as luba' golondrina or with the one known as la'pa' che le'cu' neither of which is considered adequate for children. A drink can also be prepared with yerba santa, rosa de castilla, rice, cinnamon and pepper to drink on an empty stomach. Safras is also used as an enema.
alt_translation1: Inflamación de la boca del estómago. Esta afección se asocia con el calor. Se atribuye al hecho de beber algo frío cuando el cuerpo está caliente. Se conocen varios tipos de té que se preparan para tratar la inflamación como el té de luba' golondrina o de la'pa' che le'cu', ninguno de los cuales se consideran aptos para los niños. También se conoce una horchata de yerba santa, rosa de castilla, arroz, canela, y pimienta que se bebe como agua de tiempo en ayunas. También se suele preparar el safrás en lavativa.

Description: Abdominal inflammation. This condition is associated with heat. It is attributed to drinking something cold when the body is hot. Several types of tea are known as remedies to treat this type of inflammation, such as tea made with the vine known as luba' golondrina or with the one known as la'pa' che le'cu' neither of which is considered adequate for children. A drink can also be prepared with yerba santa, rosa de castilla, rice, cinnamon and pepper to drink on an empty stomach. Safras is also used as an enema.
alt_translation1: Inflamación del vientre. Esta afección se asocia con el calor. Se atribuye al hecho de beber algo frío cuando el cuerpo está caliente. Se conocen varios tipos de té que se preparan para tratar la inflamación como el té de luba' golondrina o de la'pa' che le'cu', ninguno de los cuales se consideran aptos para los niños. También se conoce una horchata de yerba santa, rosa de castilla, arroz, canela, y pimienta que se bebe como agua de tiempo en ayunas. También se suele preparar el safrás en lavativa.
Cicatrizado de manera que queda una carnosidad levantada.

Description: Sprain of a body joint. This is considered an ailment associated with heat. To alleviate it, some will boil the leaf of an avocado tree, let the water cool to a tolerable temperature, and soak the sprained part in it. This is considered to extract the air that entered the joint at the moment of injury.
alt_translation1: Torcedura de alguna articulación del cuerpo. Se considera que es un mal asociado con el calor. Para aliviar el dolor, algunos hierven una hoja de aguacate y cuando el agua baja a una temperatura tolerable, sumergen la parte lastimada en esta. Se considera que así se saca el aire que entró en la articulación al momento de la lesión.

Description: Torsion or twisting of fibers in thread and cordage production.
alt_translation1: Torsión de fibras para producir hilo o mecate.

Description: Fine, broken up. By extension and in relation to money, it also refers to coins or change.
alt_translation1: Menudo, fino, fragmentado. Por extensión y con relación al dinero, cambio o sencillo.

Description: Look!, see!, exclamation that directs someone's attention towards something important.
alt_translation1: ¡Mira!, ¡ve!, exclamación para dirigir la atención de una persona hacia algo importante.

Description: Look who it is!, exclamation of surprise upon the identification a person.
alt_translation1: ¡Mira quien es!, exclamación de sorpresa al identificar a una persona.

Description: Look, it's no big deal!, exclamation meant to minimize the importance of something.
alt_translation1: ¡Mira que es poca cosa!, exclamación para quitarle importancia a algo.

Description: Look, it's a little shit!, exclamation meant to minimize the importance of something.
alt_translation1: ¡Mira que es una mierdita!, exclamación para quitarle importancia a algo.

Description: Corn that is stunted, becomes acrid and/or goes bad.
alt_translation1: Elote que se enjuta, se pone amargo, y/o se pone feo.

Description: Lump that forms on a person's flank and is attributed to running too much or to drinking too much water.
alt_translation1: Bola que sale en el costado del cuerpo de una persona. Se atribuye al hecho de correr mucho o de tomar demasiada agua.

Description: Smoke that precedes the flame when lighting a fire.
alt_translation1: Humo que precede la llama de una fogata.

Description: Stunted, as in the case of plants, or of people who are unwell, especially women who after giving birth do not recover well and appear unhealthy. By extension, ugly.
alt_translation1: Atrofiado, como en el caso de plantas que no crecen bien, o de personas que no se encuentran bien, sobre todo las mujeres que después de un parto se demacran y no se recuperan. Por extensión, feo.

Description: Sound of a duck or goose.
Knock on the head. By extension, fiasco, disappointment.
Hard knock on the head with the knuckles.
Stick that is about the length of an arm.
Measure calculated from the tip of the fingers in one arm, to the shoulder of the opposite arm. This measure is used in horse racing as well as to measure fabric or wooden beams.
alt_translation1: Medida que va de la punta de los dedos de un brazo al hombro del brazo opuesto. Se usa en carreras de caballos y también para medir telas o vigas.

Description: The longest of the marimba mallets.
alt_translation1: La más larga de las baquetas para tocar marimba.

Description: Vertical beams that form the walls of a cart.
alt_translation1: Maderas verticales que forman la pared de una carreta.

Description: Pole for carrying buckets with water.
alt_translation1: Vara para cargar cubetas con agua.

Description: A type of scale for manual weighing that is shaped on one end like the blade of a machete.
A bare space such as a bald spot on someone's head, or a clearing on a hill.
alt_translation1: Espacio pelón, como la calva de una persona o el claro en un cerro.

Description: Wooden tub generally used for clothes washing.
A senseless, wandering dream that is not a nightmare.
alt_translation1: Un sueño vagabundo, inofensivo, sin sentido ni significado

Description: Spindle used by fishermen to wind thread used in fishing net weaving.
alt_translation1: El huso en que los pescadores devanan el hilo con que hacen las atarrayas.

Description: Raft, canoe. Jiménez Girón (1979:4) explains that this lexeme can also be used to refer in endearing terms to a shack.
alt_translation1: Balsa, canoa. Jiménez Girón (1979:4) indica que también se puede usar este lexema para referirse de manera familiar a un jacalito.

Description: Honor, virtue, virginity, in the context of the value assigned to a woman's virginity and the bleeding from her first sexual experience.
alt_translation1: El honor, la honra, la virginidad, dicho en el contexto del valor que se le asigna a la virginidad y al sangrado de la primera experiencia sexual de una mujer.

Description: Shallow, as in the case of shallow waters.
alt_translation1: Poco profundo, como en el caso de aguas someras.

Description: Shadow, shade. In its possessed form, and if the subject is a person, this noun refers to the soul. By extension, silhouette or image projected from an object including a photograph.
alt_translation1: Sombra. En su forma poseída y si el sujeto es una persona, este sustantivo se refiere al alma. Por extensión, silueta o imagen proyectada desde un objeto y, por lo tanto, fotografía.

Description: Embankment built on a river or stream.
alt_translation1: Paredón que limita los cauces de un río o arroyo.

Description: Drift wood and anything else that flowing waters may drag.
alt_translation1: Cosas que el agua corriente arrastra a su paso, como troncos, ramas o basura.

Description: Banana leaf. It is considered to have medicinal properties useful in the treatment of burns.
alt_translation1: Hoja de plátano. Se considera que tienen propiedades curativas en caso de quemaduras.

Description: Cape made out of palm leaves and designed for rain protection.
alt_translation1: Capa elaborada con hoja de palma diseñada para protegerse de la lluvia.

Description: Crown of the head. By extension, the top of a roof, or a tree, or hell, as well as the highest point of the horizon line between the sea and the sky.
alt_translation1: Coronilla. Por extensión, la parte más alta de un techo, de un árbol, del infierno, y el punto más alto del horizonte entre el mar y el cielo.

Description: Sand covered with flowers that is shaped to represent a deceased and is placed at the foot of the home altar upon their passing. It is kept in the home throughout the nine initial days of mourning.
alt_translation1: Representación de una tumba de un reciente difunto que se elabora de arena cubierta de flores, se coloca en el piso en la casa del difunto al pie del altar del hogar, y se conserva a lo largo de los nueve días posteriores al fallecimiento.
Pieza cilíndrica de madera que se usa para generar fuego por fricción.

Description: Child who is mischievous or hyperactive.
alt_translation1: Niña o niño travieso, inquieto o hiperactivo.

Description: Child of a mother without a responsible co-parent.
alt_translation1: Hijo de madre sin pareja responsable. Expresión despectiva.

Description: Rude child who says bad words.

Women hired by the organizer of a celebration to visit the home of all those in the guest list to extend the invitation in person.
No
alt_translation1: Mujeres contratadas por alguien que organiza una fiesta para que visiten en sus casas a todas las personas en la lista de invitados y les extiendan la invitación personalmente.
Niño que nació prematuro. Niño tonto.

Description: Bedeviled child (lit. child offspring of the devil).

alt_translation1: La muchacha, la joven, la niña.
La muchacha, la joven, la niña.
El muchacho, el joven, el niño.

Description: Grown man, mature, intelligent and with formal education.
alt_translation1: Hombre completo, maduro, inteligente y con estudios.
El muchacho, el joven, el niño.

Description: Grown child. By extension, it can refer to various aspects of a person's development. This includes sexual development and maturity (free or coerced). Also, it can refer to decision-making about one's sexuality and achievements throughout life.
alt_translation1: Niño o niña que ya ha crecido. Por extensión, se puede referir a varios aspectos del desarrollo de una persona. Esto incluye el desarrollo y madurez sexual (libre o bajo coerción). También, se puede referir a la toma de decisiones sobre la sexualidad propia y los logros a lo largo de la vida.

Description: Baby. This term can also be used to refer to a fetus.
alt_translation1: Bebé. También se puede usar para referirse a un feto.

Description: Demonym that refers to the inhabitants of Zapotec communities in the Central Valleys of Oaxaca. They are known as vendors of herbs.
alt_translation1: Vallistos, personas pertenecientes a las comunidades zapotecas de los Valles Centrales de Oaxaca. Se les conoce por su venta de hierbas.

Description: Prickle. Structures similar to very small prickly hairs (pubescence) present in many plants. By association, this lexeme is used to refer to itching. By analogy, it can also refer to sexual arousal.
alt_translation1: Ahuate. Estructuras similares a pelos espinosos muy pequeños (pubescencia) presentes en muchas plantas. Por asociación, se usa este lexema para referirse a la comezón. Por analogía, también se puede hacer referencia a la excitación sexual.

Description: Evil eye, as it is known in the communities of El Espinal and La Ventosa. A condition associated with heat that affects young children. It is considered that it can come upon them if someone outside the family wants to carry them and the parents do not allow it. If the person is drunk, it is considered that the evil eye can kill the child. It is difficult to diagnose the evil eye, but constant crying that does not seem to have a cause is considered to be a key symptom. To alleviate the evil eye, it is recommended to go back to the people who wanted to play with or hold the child and allow them to do it.
alt_translation1: Mal de ojo, como se le conoce en las comunidades de El Espinal y La Ventosa. Condición asociada al calor que afecta a los y las niñas pequeñas. Se considera que puede afligirles si alguien de fuera de la familia quiere cargarles y los padres no lo permiten. Si la persona está borracha, se considera que el mal de ojo puede matar a la niña o el niño. Se considera difícil diagnosticar el mal de ojo, pero se tiene en cuenta un síntoma como el llanto constante que no parece tener causa. Para aliviar el mal de ojo, se recomienda volver con las personas y permitirles cargar y jugar con el niño o la niña.

Description: Part of the yoke that is connected to the cart.
alt_translation1: Parte del yugo que se conecta a la carreta.

Description: About a flavor that is between sweet and sour, or about one that cannot be easily defined.
alt_translation1: De sabor entre dulce y amargo, o que no se puede determinar fácilmente.

Description: Horizontal beams the long of a cart.
alt_translation1: Maderas horizontales a lo largo de una carreta.

Description: About a flavor that is not too sweet.
alt_translation1: De sabor que no está muy dulce.

Description: Spokes in the wheels of a wagon.
alt_translation1: Rayos de las ruedas de una carreta.

Description: Male pig, as well as the male of other animals such as the dog, the bull and the iguana. By extension, it is used to refer to a man who is a womanizer.
alt_translation1: Varraco, macho de cerdo, pero también de otros animales como el perro, el toro y la iguana. Por extensión, se usa para referirse a un hombre que es mujeriego.
Poza de marea donde descansan los peces.

Description: Long piece of wood for furniture making and for construction.
alt_translation1: Pieza larga de madera para muebles y para construcción.

Description: Unstable, specifically in relation to a person.
alt_translation1: Inestable, con respecto a una persona.

Description: Wide, flat and rectangular like a wooden plank. By extension, this lexeme can be used on its own to refer to the palm of the hand.
alt_translation1: Ancho, amplio, rectangular y plano como un tablón. Por extensión, se puede usar este término por sí mismo para referirse a la palma de la mano.

Description: Hand, front paw. By extension, a unit of measure.
alt_translation1: Mano, palmar de un animal de cuatro patas. Por extensión, unidad de medida.
Pie, palmar de un animal de cuatro patas.
Batería, ya sea una pila, una batería de carro, o algo similar.

Description: Nickname given to a man by the name of Delfino.
alt_translation1: Apodo que designa a un hombre llamado Delfino.

Description: Colored scarf worn by a bride during her civil wedding.
alt_translation1: Mascada de colores que lleva la novia a la boda civil.

Description: White handkerchief where the hymen of a bride is placed to show that she was a virgin.
alt_translation1: Pañuelito blanco donde se pone el himen de una novia para demostrar que era virgen.

Description: Work bandana, often red in color.
alt_translation1: Paliacate, pañuelo de trabajo. Suele ser rojo.

Description: A bow and arrow set. By extension based on analogy with the arrow, something that is thin and long, or someone with a flat abdomen.
alt_translation1: El conjunto del arco y la flecha.  Por extensión con relación a la flecha, algo que es de forma espigada, o una persona que tiene el abdomen plano.

Description: Mold. By extension, eye ailment known as cataracts.
alt_translation1: Moho. Por extensión, enfermedad de los ojos conocida como catarata.

Description: Crocodile, alligator, caiman. By extension, avaricious, greedy, a merchant who charges too much.
alt_translation1: Cocodrilo, lagarto, caimán. Por extensión, avaro, codicioso, que cobra demasiado.

Description: Sound of a hammer hitting metal.
alt_translation1: Sonido de un martillo pegando el metal.

Description: Nickname given to a man by the name of Alberto who sells fish. Benda means 'fish'.
alt_translation1: Apodo que designa a un hombre llamado Alberto y que vende pescado. Benda significa 'pescado'.

Description: Nickname given to a man by the name of Alberto who slaughters pigs. Biwi means 'pig'.
alt_translation1: Apodo que designa a un hombre llamado Alberto y que mata marranos para vender. Biwi significa 'marrano' o 'cerdo'.

Description: Nickname given to a man by the name of Alberto from the town of Unión Hidalgo. Bòlla is a demonym that refers to the inhabitants of the town of Unión Hidalgo.
alt_translation1: Apodo que designa a un hombre llamado Alberto de Unión Hidalgo. Bòla es un gentilicio referente a los habitantes de Unión Hidalgo.

Description: Nickname given to a man by the name of Alberto. Guìdxa means 'stupid'.
alt_translation1: Apodo que designa a un hombre llamado Alberto. Guìdxa significa 'tonto'.

Description: Nickname given to a man by the name of Alberto.
alt_translation1: Apodo que designa a un hombre llamado Alberto.

Description: Nickname given to a man by the name of Alberto who as a child would call a pepsi-cola pèji.
alt_translation1: Apodo que designa a un hombre llamado Alberto que de niño le decía pèji a la pepsi-cola.

Description: Candles brought by women to a wake.
alt_translation1: Vela que llevan las señoras a un velorio.

Description: This refers to the amniotic sac when a baby has an en caul birth. This is rather rare and is therefore considered good luck.
alt_translation1: Se refiere al saco amniótico cuando un bebé nace cubierto por este. Esto ocurre muy rara vez por lo cual se considera de buena suerte.

Description: Name given to Benita and Julio as a couple.
alt_translation1: Pareja formada por Benita y Julio.

Description: Nickname given to a man by the name of Alberto because he sells chickens. Bere means 'chicken'.
alt_translation1: Apodo que designa a un hombre llamado Alberto porque vende pollos. Bere significa 'pollo'.

Description: Nickname given to a man by the name of Alberto who is short. Huiini means 'small'. He is known for telling good jokes.
alt_translation1: Apodo que designa a un hombre llamado Alberto por ser de baja estatura. Huiini significa 'pequeño'. Se le conoce porque es bueno para contar chistes.

Description: Peso, the monetary unit in Mexico.
alt_translation1: Peso, en el sentido de la unidad monetaria de México.

Description: Truth. By association, exclamation equivalent to 'really?'
alt_translation1: Verdad. Por asociación, este lexema se usa como exclamación equivalente a ¿de verdad?.

Description: Skunk. By extension, someone who strives for political gains, or a man who tries to take advantage of women.
alt_translation1: Zorrillo. Por extensión, alguien que se aprovecha políticamente, o un hombre que se aprovecha con las mujeres.

Description: Black and white skunk whose fur looks as if it had flowers.
alt_translation1: Zorrillo de color blanco y negro que parece floreado.

Description: A person with a cleft palate.
Jiménez Girón (1979:114) defines this lexeme as referring to something that is very finely pulverized.
alt_translation1: Jiménez Girón (1979:114) define este lexema como "finamente pulverizado, liso".

Description: Bird that has lost its feathers, or a child so thin that they are just skin and bones.
alt_translation1: Ave sin plumas, o una niña o un niño tan flaquito que parece que es puro pellejo y huesitos.

Description: Mange. It can affect anyone. It is an ailment that is considered alive and is associated with heat. Therefore, it requires a heat-based remedy to kill it. A known treatment is the use of a burnt cherry tree leaf mixed with sulfur to rub the skin with for three days. There are also sulfur-based ointments and washes.
alt_translation1: Sarna. Puede afectar a cualquiera. Es una enfermedad que se considera viva y se asocia con el calor por lo cual requiere un remedio caliente para que se muera. Para su curación se puede usar la hoja de cualquier ciruelo quemada y con azufre para tallar la piel con eso durante tres días. También hay pomadas y aguas de azufre.

Description: To honor a deceased one who may have passed away at least 6 months prior to the month of October, an offering is set up. This offering can be one of two types. One type is the offering called biyee or biguie' and it is made up of several components. One of them is a square frame with a cross on it. Both are hung from a structure made with four beams that serve as columns. This frame is called beedxe' or 'jaguar' and the cross is called ique beedxe' or 'head of the jaguar'. Both are decorated with flowers including marigolds, guie' daana' (Piper variifolium, 'cordoncillo' in Spanish) and 'cresta de gallo'.
alt_translation1: En honor a un difunto reciente, fallecido seis meses o más antes del mes de octubre, se acostumbra instalar una ofrenda la cual puede ser de dos tipos. Uno de ellos se conoce como biyee o biguie' y consiste de varios elementos. Uno de ellos es un armazón cuadrado con una cruz encima que se cuelgan de una estructura formada por cuatro morillos que funcionan como columnas. El armazón se llama beedxe' o 'jaguar' y la cruz se llama ique beedxe' o 'cabeza de jaguar'. Ambos se adornan con flores de cempasúchil, guie' daana' (Piper variifolium, cordoncillo) y cresta de gallo.

Description: Strategy game played with one bean that represents a coyote and 12 corn kernels that represent chickens or dogs. The game is played on a small version of the beedxe', the frame that is part of the larger structure of an offering for a deceased one. In the game, the coyote tries to eat the chickens or the dogs, and they in turn try to corner the coyote.
alt_translation1: Juego de estrategia que se juega con un grano de frijol que representa a un coyote y doce granos de maíz que representan gallinas o perros. El juego se juega sobre una trama igual al beedxe', el armazón de la ofrenda para los difuntos que se conoce como biyee o biguie'. En el juego, el coyote intenta comerse a las gallinas o a los perros mientras que estos intentan acorralar al coyote.

Description: House post, rung. They are used horizontally to build the roof of a canopy or at an angle to build a thatched roof.
alt_translation1: Paral de una casa, morillo o travesaño. Los travesaños se usan en horizontal para formar el techo de una enramada o inclinados para formar el techo de un jacal.

Description: Rungs arranged in groups of four to build the frame of a thatched roof.
alt_translation1: Travesaños colocados en número de cuatro para formar caballetes en el techo de un jacal.

Description: Ocelot. Dwells mostly within the tree canopy.
alt_translation1: Ocelote, tigrillo. Pasa la mayor parte del día en los árboles.

Description: Flesh, meat. By extension, the fleshy growth known as pterygium or surfer's eye that develops on the surface of the eye due to exposure to UV rays.
alt_translation1: Carne, ya sea del cuerpo humano o de animales no humanos comestibles. Por extensión, la carnosidad conocida como pterigión que se forma en la superficie de los ojos por estar expuestos a los rayos ultravioletas.
Carne que venden los que roban y matan ganado.

Description: Meat intended for roasting in a clay oven. In the town of Heroica Villa De San Blas Atempa, this refers to the small pieces of beef that are offered along the path of a procession during Holy Week.
alt_translation1: Carne para hornear en horno de barro. En la Heroica Villa De San Blas Atempa se refiere a los pedacitos de carne de res que se ofrecen a lo largo de las procesiones de Semana Santa.

Description: The fleshy growth known as pterygium or surfer's eye that develops on the surface of the eye due to exposure to UV rays. This also refers to the flesh of the face in a literal sense.
alt_translation1: La carnosidad conocida como pterigión que se forma en la superficie de los ojos por estar expuestos a los rayos ultravioletas. También se refiere de manera literal a la carne de la cara.

Description: Edge of the eyelid from which eyelashes grow.
alt_translation1: Orilla del párpado de donde crecen las pestañas.

Description: Meat that has been salted and air-dried for conservation.
alt_translation1: Carne salada y oreada para su conservación como la cecina.

Description: Meat with fat that is made into tamales with a red sauce known in Spanish as 'molito rojo'.
alt_translation1: Carne con grasa que se hace en tamal con molito rojo.

Description: Bulging flesh on the sides of the breasts of both men and women.
alt_translation1: Carne que se cuelga a los lados de los pechos en hombres y mujeres.
Cuerito que sale a los lados de las uñas conocido en castellano como padrastro.

Description: Pork cooked with tomato, garlic, and ground annatto but without oil.
alt_translation1: Carne de cerdo que se cuece con jitomate, ajo y achiote molido pero sin aceite.
Víbora de cascabel, posiblemente de la especie Crotalus ravus.

Description: A type of non-venomous snake, possibly Coniophanes quinquevittatus or similar.
alt_translation1: Tipo de serpiente no venenosa que pudiera ser la especie Coniophanes quinquevittatus.

Description: Venomous snake whose coloring resembles that of a jaguar. It is considered very dangerous. Some people know it in Spanish as 'cantil de agua' or 'nauyaca'.
alt_translation1: Serpiente venenosa de colorido similar al de un jaguar. Se considera muy peligrosa. Algunos le conocen en castellano como cantil de agua o como nauyaca.
Cantil de agua, posiblemente Agkistrodon bilineatus.

Description: Non-venomous snake with bright colors. It is known in Spanish as 'petatilla' (possibly Drymobius margaritiferus).
alt_translation1: Culebra no venenosa de brillante colorido. Se le conoce en castellano como petatilla (posiblemente Drymobius margaritiferus).

Description: Name that possibly identifies the species Boa constrictor imperator. It is known in Spanish as 'boa', 'mazacuata', or 'víbora sorda'. It is considered not venomous although some people report that this snake can bite and kill cattle. Its skin is used to produce belts.
alt_translation1: Nombre que posiblemente designa a la especia Boa constrictor imperator. Es conocida en castellano como boa, mazacuata o víbora sorda. Se considera que no es venenosa aunque algunos indican que puede matar al ganado con una mordedura. Su piel se usa para elaborar cinturones.

Description: Snake, possibly belonging to the genus Crotalus. It is known in Spanish as 'víbora de cascabel', 'serpiente de cascabel', or 'crótalo'. It is venomous and is considered very dangerous.
alt_translation1: Víbora que probablemente pertenece al género Crotalus. Se le conoce en castellano como víbora o serpiente de cascabel, o como crótalo. Es venenosa y se considera muy peligrosa.

Description: Non-venomous snake that eats rodents. It tends to wrap itself around tree branches. Víctor Cata (personal communication) considers the possibility that this might be the species that Bernardino de Sahagún describes as a snake that could be domesticated for rodent control in the home and in the corn fields.
alt_translation1: Víbora no venenosa que come ratones. Se enreda en las ramas de los árboles. Víctor Cata (en conversación) considera la posibilidad de que este reptil sea la serpiente que Bernardino de Sahagún describe como un reptil que se domesticaba para controlar la población de ratones en la casa y en la milpa.

Description: A type of non-venomous snake that eats rodents.
alt_translation1: Tipo de culebra ratonera no venenosa.

Description: Thin, long, green snake which wraps itself around branches within the greenery, making it difficult to see. It is known in Spanish as 'bejuquillo' or 'cordelilla'. It is not venomous but it is described as a snake that whips people with its tail. This might be the species Oxybelis aeneus although it is not green as beendaluba' is described.
alt_translation1: Culebra conocida en castellano como bejuquillo o cordelilla. Es larga y delgada y se enrosca como bejuco entre el follaje. Como es verde, se camuflajea fácilmente. No es venenosa, pero se describe como una culebra que chicotea a la gente con la cola. Podría tratarse de la especie Oxybelis aeneus aunque esta no es verde como se describe a la beendaluba'.

Description: Snake known in Spanish as 'falso coralillo' or "false coral snake" because of its resemblance to the venomous coral snake. The referent is possibly Lampropeltis triangulum polyzona.
alt_translation1: Serpiente parecida al coralillo, por lo que se conoce en castellano como falso coralillo. Es posible que este lexema se refiera a la especie Lampropeltis triangulum polyzona.

Description: Green worm that grows in the cornfields during the rainy season. It voraciously eats the leaves of the corn plant. This lexeme is also used to refer to the light rain that falls on sunny days and that creates the conditions for this worm to propagate.
alt_translation1: Gusano verde que se hace en la milpa por la lluvia. Come vorazmente las hojas de la milpa. También se usa este lexema para referirse a la lluvia ligerita que cae cuando hay sol y que produce dicho gusano.
Culebra de tierra, posiblemente la especie Typhlops tenuis.

Description: This lexeme translates literally as 'cattle snake'. Jiménez Girón (1979:7) explains that it refers to the water snake, a mythological monster with the body of a snake and the head of a cow or bull, which was considered to be responsible for cyclones and floods.
alt_translation1: Jiménez Girón (1979:7) explica que este lexema que literalmente significa 'serpiente ganado' se refiere a la culebra de agua, un monstruo mitológico "con cuerpo de serpiente y cabeza de vacuno, al cual se le atribuían los diluvios o ciclones".

Description: In the town of La Ventosa, this lexeme refers to what is possibly an insect that lives underground but comes above ground during the rains. Its bite produces a lot of itchiness.
alt_translation1: En la comunidad de La Ventosa, este nombre se le da a un animal que vive bajo la tierra y que sale cuando llueve. Pica y causa mucha comezón.

Description: Water snake, possibly Thamnophis proximus rutiloris.
alt_translation1: Culebra de agua, posiblemente Thamnophis proximus rutiloris.

Description: In the region of Juchitán de Zaragoza, this lexeme refers to a small snake. As explained in Jiménez Girón (1979:7), its bite can be dangerous, especially for cattle.
alt_translation1: En la zona de Juchitán de Zaragoza, este lexema se refiere a una pequeña serpiente que como explica Jiménez Girón (1979:7), tiene una mordedura que "es muy peligrosa, especialmente para el ganado". Dicha serpiente es conocida en castellano como chatilla.

Description: This lexeme translates literally as 'grinding stone snake'. It refers to a snake that is as thick as the tubular stone used for grinding on the flat stone surface known in Spanish as 'metate'.
alt_translation1: Este lexema significa literalmente 'serpiente mano de metate'. Se le denomina así a una culebra que es gruesa como la mano del metate.

Description: Lunar cycle known for the arrival of the northern winds. It occurs sometime within the months of February and March.
alt_translation1: Ciclo lunar cuando pega el viento del norte. Ocurre en los meses de febrero y marzo.

Description: Full moon. It is considered that this is the best time in the lunar cycle for cutting firewood and harvesting corn.
alt_translation1: Luna llena. Se considera que en este momento del ciclo lunar se puede cortar leña y milpa.

Description: Month dedicated to the candelaria celebrations in February.
alt_translation1: Mes de la candelaria en febrero.

Description: Month in which someone's birthday or patron saint is celebrated.
alt_translation1: Mes del cumpleaños o del santo de alguien.

Description: Month during which Holy Week is celebrated.
alt_translation1: Mes en el que se celebra la Semana Santa.

Description: Rainy season which extends from June through September.
alt_translation1: Época de lluvias que va de junio a septiembre.

Description: Month of August when the Virgin of Santa Rosa de Lima is celebrated.
alt_translation1: Mes de agosto cuando se celebra a la Virgen de Santa Rosa de Lima.

Description: Question and answer game in song format that children used to play with their parents.
alt_translation1: Juego de preguntas y respuestas en forma de cantaleta que los niños jugaban con sus papás.

Description: Crescent moon. During this time, trees are not to be cut down because they will be full of insects, nor are plants planted because they may be hit by a plague. It is thought that a crescent moon affects people, especially those who have some mental disorder, and makes them say nonsense.
alt_translation1: Luna nueva. En estos días no se cortan los árboles porque tienen insectos, ni se siembra porque se teme una plaga. Se considera que la luna nueva afecta a la gente, sobre todo a quienes tienen algún trastorno mental, y les hace decir disparates.

Description: Time of the year when All Saints are celebrated. The celebrations begin with prayers on October 23rd and 24th, and run through October 30 when children are honored, and October 31 when adults are honored.
alt_translation1: Temporada de Todos Santos que va desde el inicio de los rezos entre el 23 y el 24 de octubre e incluye el día 30 de octubre para honrar a los niños difuntos y el 31 de octubre para los adultos difuntos.

Description: Morning star which begins to shine around five in the morning and remains for a while.
alt_translation1: Lucero de la mañana que sale a las cinco de la mañana y permanece un tiempo.

Description: Star constellation in the shape of a fire blower like the ones made out of palm leaves. May be the Big Dipper (also known as Ursa Major).
alt_translation1: Constelación de estrellas en forma de soplador que posiblemente sea la Osa Mayor.

Description: Star that is considered the sky cross.
alt_translation1: Estrella que se considera como la cruz del cielo.

Description: Expression used in games to indicate that a player is approaching the target. Equivalent to 'warm, warm'. Also used to describe that something happened very quickly, at lightning speed.
alt_translation1: Expresión que se usa en los juegos para indicar que un jugador se está acercando al objetivo. Equivalente a 'caliente, caliente'. También se usa para describir algo que ocurrió muy rápidamente, como relámpago.

Description: Fish known in Spanish as 'paloma', tuna.
Fish similar to the one known in Spanish as 'sabalote'.
Fish baked in a clay oven, flavored with salt, and eaten along with corn-based beverage.
alt_translation1: Guisado de pescado que se cocina con sal en el horno de olla de barro y se come acompañado de pozol.

Description: Fish known in Spanish as 'paloma', tuna.
Fish, often the type called 'corvina' in Spanish, stuffed with onions, tomato and chilli peppers, and grilled. This also refers to air-dried fish.
alt_translation1: Pescado, generalmente corvina, que se rellena con cebolla, tomate y chile y se prepara en las brasas. También se le llama así al pescado seco.
Babosa (molusco de tierra que generalmente no tiene concha).
Insecto llamado langosta similar al chapulín y que se come la milpa.

Description: Edible fish similar to the tilapia, that is the size of a red snapper and has a red body and a large head and is very tasty.
alt_translation1: Pez comestible similar a la mojarra, grande como el huachinango, de cuerpo rojo y cabeza grande, y muy sabroso.

Description: The sister of a woman who is a third party to the conversation.
alt_translation1: La hermana de una mujer que no es participante en la conversación.

Description: Mud, clay, swamp, bog, marsh, quagmire.
Fine clay used by potters to make pots and other vessels meant to contain liquids, and also for fine finishes.
alt_translation1: Arcilla o barro fino que usan los alfareros para hacer tinajas, ollas y otros recipientes para líquidos, y para los terminados finos.

Description: Adobe mix for making bricks made with straw or with a plant known as guixi bataà.
alt_translation1: Mezcla para hacer ladrillos de adobe que utiliza paja o incluso la planta conocida como guixi bataà.

Description: Fine clay used by potters for pots and other vessels and for fine finishes, or in construction or wall plastering.
alt_translation1: Arcilla o barro fino que usan los alfareros para hacer tinajas y ollas y para los terminados finos, o que se usa en la construcción para el acabado de las paredes.

Description: Clay that is coarse or has pebbles which make the final product porous. For this reason, this type of clay is used for objects that will not contain liquids, as might be piggy banks, clay figurines and other crafts.
alt_translation1: Barro que por ser rugoso o tener piedrecitas desarrolla poros. Por eso se utiliza para elaborar objetos que no van a contener líquidos como por ejemplo alcancías, muñecas de barro y otras artesanías.

Description: Hand drill. The frame of the hand drill.
Wild bird similar to a hen that walks as if it were blind.
alt_translation1: Tipo de ave silvestre similar a una gallina que camina como si estuviera ciega.

Description: Chicken dish prepared by washing the chicken in lemon, rinsing it, rubbing it with garlic, pepper and annatto, and cooking it in a clay pot or in a pan.
alt_translation1: Asado de pollo. Para preparar, se lava el pollo con mucho limón, se enjuaga, se le unta ajo, pimienta y achiote molidos, y se pone a asar en tepalcate o en un sartén.

Description: Roasted chicken, different from bere ñee suquiì, because it is prepared with raisins and a bit of cinnamon and cooked in a broth.
alt_translation1: Pollo horneado distinto de bere ñee suquiì, pues lleva pasas y un poco de canela y se cuece en un poco de caldo.

Description: Type of hen that has a featherless head.
alt_translation1: Tipo de gallina que no tiene plumas en la cabeza.

Description: Roasted chicken commonly sold at the market.
alt_translation1: Pollo horneado como el que se vende en el mercado.

Description: A type of black hen used to cure someone who has been the object of black magic.
alt_translation1: Gallina negra para curar de brujería.

Description: Chicken cooked in a clay oven.
alt_translation1: Pollo horneado en horno de barro.

Description: Roasted chicken commonly sold at the market.
alt_translation1: Pollo horneado como el que se vende en el mercado.

Description: White type of chicken that is brought from outside the region in cages.
alt_translation1: Pollo blanco que se trae de fuera en jaulas.

Description: Type of hen that has a comb.
A type of hen that is sought out for purchase in markets.
alt_translation1: Gallina de rancho que se busca específicamente en los mercados para comprarla.

Description: Roasted chicken commonly sold at the market.
alt_translation1: Pollo horneado como el que se vende en el mercado.

Description: Type of ant that builds its colony in the shape of a volcano and eats the insects that fall in it.
alt_translation1: Hormiga león que hace su hormiguero como volcán y se come a los insectos que caen en él.

Description: Type of hen native to the region.

alt_translation1: Gallina con el cuello sin plumas.

Description: This refers to a song that is played to celebrate that a bride was confirmed to be a virgin.
alt_translation1: Canción que se toca para celebrar que una novia salió virgen.

Description: The eyes of any fish. By extension, a type of skin lesion referred to as fish eye. This results from a piece of glass or a splinter embedded in the foot. It can affect anyone but it can be especially dangerous for diabetics who risk amputation of the foot. This is an ailment associated with heat and requires treatment from a doctor.
alt_translation1: Los ojos de un pez o pescado. Por extensión, el grano al que se le llama ojo de pescado. Sale en el pie por algún pedacito de vidrio o astilla que se haya enterrado. Le puede salir a cualquier persona. Es muy peligroso para las personas diabéticas y puede causar amputación del pie afectado. Es un problema de salud que se considera caliente y requiere de un médico para su curación.

Description: Pimple, or a similar lesion on the face. It can happen to anyone, especially during puberty. It is also said that pimples happen when one's blood is running hot or when someone is feeling sexually aroused. Pimples are considered an ailment associated with heat. They can be treated with an avocado face mask. It is also said that pimples resolve upon marriage.
alt_translation1: Barro o granito de la cara. A cualquiera le puede salir sobre todo durante la pubertad. También se considera que sale porque la sangre anda caliente o porque una persona siente deseos sexuales. Se considera un malestar caliente. Para su cura se recomienda una mascarilla de aguacate. También se dice que casarse puede resolver los barritos.

Description: Air, wind. By association, breathing or breath.
alt_translation1: Aire, viento. Por asociación, respiración o aliento.

Description: Harmful air generated by the testicles. A person's testicles are considered to generate a particular type of air that makes a woman become bloated. This occurs when a woman who recently gave birth has sex before the 40-day period of care post-partum. This bloating is considered to be an ailment associated with heat and one that has no cure.
alt_translation1: Mal aire que generan los testículos. Se considera que los testículos generan un aire particular. Este aire hace que la mujer se empanzone, no por embarazo sino porque la matriz se llena con el aire. Esto ocurre cuando la mujer está recién parida y tiene relaciones sexuales antes de cumplir los 40 días después del parto. Este mal que genera el bi talèga se considera que es caliente y no tiene cura.

Description: Friend, as said by men to men, similar to English 'brother' or 'bro' (although the latter is now used by women as well). This is also the way elderly men refer to their brothers.
alt_translation1: Amigo, compañero, dicho de hombre a hombre. También es la manera de los ancianos de llamar a sus hermanos.

Description: Sound of a hammer hitting a rock.
alt_translation1: Sonido de un martillo pegando una piedra.

Description: Sound of a hammer hitting iron.
alt_translation1: Sonido de un martillo pegando fierro.

Description: Glass (i.e. the translucent substance). By extension, the windshield of a car.
alt_translation1: Vidrio. Por extensión, parabrisas de carro.

Description: Skinny, so much so that the person looks as if they had dried up.
alt_translation1: Flaco, tanto que parece que está seco.

Description: A disease of pigs in which white cysts develop between the muscle (most likely porcine cysticercosis).
alt_translation1: Enfermedad del marrano en la que se desarrollan bolitas blancas (quistes) en los músculos (muy probablemente cisticercosis porcina).
Crespo, ondulado, rizado, chino en referencia al cabello.
Vino (la bebida alcohólica hecha de uva).

Description: Tall Virgin. This is a nickname given to a woman who sells chicken at the market for being tall.
alt_translation1: Virgen Alta. Se le da como apodo a una señora que vende pollo en el mercado por ser alta.

Description: Birria. Name that can be given to a dog.
alt_translation1: Birria. Nombre que se le puede dar a un perro.

Description: Small, anchovy-like fish that are abundant by the seashore.
alt_translation1: Pececitos pequeños como el boquerón que abundan en las orillas del mar.

Description: Marsupial mammal belonging to the Didelphimorphia order, known in Spanish as 'tlacuache' and in English as opossum. Jiménez Girón (1979:33) explains that by extension, this lexeme can be used to refer to someone who fakes an ailment in order to avoid a task.
alt_translation1: Mamífero marsupial del orden Didelphimorphia conocido en castellano como tlacuache. Jiménez Girón (1979:33) explica que por extensión, se usa este lexema para referirse a alguien que finge un achaque para salirse de algún encargo.
