Description: Jiménez Girón (1979) states that this lexeme derived from the verb 'to cut' refers to lots of uncultivated land that the chiefs or heads of villages (nguaxi) provided upon request to workers to cultivate, earning only half of the products they obtained. The question: ¨pàgàlla cuchú'ugu'lu' ra cà?” to say ‘how much do you earn there?’ is related to this concept.
alt_translation1: Jiménez Girón (1979) indica que este lexema que se deriva del verbo 'cortar' se refiere a "jornales agrarios de tierra inculta que los jefes o cabeza de pueblos (nguaxi) proporcionaban previa solicitud, a los trabajadores para cultivar, ganando solo la mitad de los productos que obtuvieren. De aquí viene la pregunta: ¨pàgàlla cuchú'ugu'lu' ra cà?" para decir '¿cuánto ganas ahí?'

Description: Sound of paper being pierced by a pencil.
alt_translation1: Sonido de un papel siendo agujereado por un lápiz.

Description: For vision or visibility to be clouded, foggy, or sombre.
alt_translation1: De visión o visibilidad nublada, empañada o sombría.

Description: Sound of water thrown on a fire.
alt_translation1: Sonido de agua echada en la lumbre.

Description: Closed, blocked. It can be used to refer to a narrow-minded person.
alt_translation1: Cerrado, tapado. Puede referirse a una personalidad cerrada.

Description: Soft. By extension, this lexeme can serve as a diminutivizer following an adjective.
alt_translation1: Blandito, suavecito. Por extensión, puede modificar a un adjetivo a manera de diminutivo.

Description: Filled with liquid including pus as in the case of wounds.
alt_translation1: Lleno de líquido o incluso de pus como en el caso de una herida.

Description: This adjective describes a fat chicken with short legs. By extension, it is also used to refer to a person who is short. Whether this adjective is pejorative was not documented.
alt_translation1: Este adjetivo describe a una gallina gorda de patas cortas. Por extensión, también se usa para referirse a una persona de baja estatura. No se documentó si este adjetivo tiene connotaciones despectivas.

Description: Stuffy, in relation to the nose specifically. Condition associated with cold and can affect anyone although it is not considered to be contagious. It requires a heat-based remedy. Sniffing the root of the plant known as xcu be'te 'skunk root' (Petiveria alliacea y Fridericia mollissima) is done to resolve this condition, as well as applying Vicks Vaporub and chamomile.
alt_translation1: Congestionado a nivel de la nariz. Malestar que se asocia con el frío y que le puede dar a cualquiera, pero no se considera contagioso. Se requiere un remedio caliente para curarlo. Se puede oler la raíz de la planta conocida como xcu be'te o 'raíz de zorrillo' (Petiveria alliacea y Fridericia mollissima). También se usa Vicks Vaporub y manzanilla.

Description: Jiménez Girón (1979:65) explains that this lexeme refers to the last marble in a game which as such has double value.
alt_translation1: Jiménez Girón (1979:65) indica que con este lexema se designa "la última canica que se apuesta en un juego, con doble valor, por ser el último recurso".

Description: Music and associated dance known in Spanish as 'danzón'.
Small hand-woven reed mat for children.
Jiménez Girón (1979:65) states that this lexeme refers to a low quality mat generally made of left over unprocessed palm leaves.
alt_translation1: Jiménez Girón (1979:65) indica que este lexema se refiere a un "petate corriente, generalmente de palmas verdosas de desecho".

Description: Lodged or stuck, as in the case of a splinter or a thorn under the skin.
alt_translation1: Enterrado, encajado, clavado, sumido (ej. una espina).

Description: Woven, interlaced. By extension, full of people.
alt_translation1: Tejido, entrelazado. Por extensión, lleno de gente.

Description: Stick insects (likely of the Phasmatodea order).

High quality hand-woven reed mat. Jiménez Girón (1979:65) explains that this lexeme refers to the mat used on a bed, or in the altar known as biguie' either to kneel on it, or to place the fruits and flowers being offered during All Saints days.
alt_translation1: Petate fino. Jiménez Girón (1979:65) define este lexema como "petate fino que se pone en la cama o se tiene ante el altar hogareño (biguie') para hincarse a orar o rezar, o para poner frutas y flores en los días de Todos Santos".

Description: Jiménez Girón (1979:65) explains that this lexeme refers to a large hand-woven reed mat that is very strong and can therefore be used to cover wagons, as an awning, or to wrap bundles.
alt_translation1: Jiménez Girón (1979:65) explica que este petate es "amplio y muy resistente que se usa como toldo en las carretas o en los puestos de mercancías, como envoltura de bultos".

Description: Very soft, very floppy, very limp. This would be used to describe, for instance, a mango past its prime where the pulp becomes watery.
alt_translation1: Muy blando, muy flojo, muy aguado, como un mango que se aguadó y ya no tiene pulpa.

Description: Containment barrier, either a permanent dam or a temporary structure (e.g., using bricks to prevent a house from flooding).
alt_translation1: Barrera de contención, ya sea una represa o una estructura temporal (ej. de ladrillos para evitar que se inunde una casa).

Description: Stiffness of some part of the body due to repetitive stress.
alt_translation1: Engarrotamiento de alguna parte del cuerpo por estrés repetitivo.

Description: Sound of someone knocking on a door.
alt_translation1: Sonido de alguien tocando a la puerta.

Description: Hills, small to medium size mountains.
Dust. By extension, ash, gunpowder and powder in general as in the case of detergent.
alt_translation1: Polvo. Por extensión, ceniza, pólvora, y otros productos en polvo como el detergente.

Description: Superlative or intensifier used with modifiers denoting smallness.
alt_translation1: Superlativo o intensificador que se usa con modificadores que denotan pequeñez.

Description: Fine dust that causes itchiness, ex. corn chaff.
alt_translation1: Polvo que causa comezón, ej. tamo de maíz.

Description: Closed, blocked. It can be used to refer to a narrow-minded person.
alt_translation1: Cerrado, tapado. Puede referirse a una personalidad cerrada.

Description: Congested chest that causes wheezing and coughing.
alt_translation1: Pecho congestionado que resuella y produce tos.

Description: According to Jiménez Girón (1979:66), this expression is used when playing marbles to refer to the right that the player acquires to be able to win, when their shots hit a certain number of holes”.
alt_translation1: Según Jiménez Girón (1979:66), esta expresión se usa en el juego de canicas para referirse al "derecho que el jugador adquiere para poder ganar, cuando acierta entre sus tiradas que la suya caiga en un determinado número de hoyos".

Description: Name given to Adela and Cipriano as a couple.
alt_translation1: Pareja formada por Adela y Cipriano.

Description: Of, from. Introduces various kinds of information about the subject of the utterance such as physical properties (posture, composition, color, etc.) and qualities, manner in which an action takes place, as well as a point of origin in time or space.
alt_translation1: De. Introduce información de varios tipos sobre el sujeto del enunciado como por ejemplo sus propiedades físicas (postura, composición, color, etc.) o cualidades, la manera como se lleva a cabo una acción, así como un punto de origen ya sea en el tiempo o en el espacio.

Description: Sound of a person falling onto their back.
alt_translation1: Sonido de una persona que cae de espalda.

Description: Five by five, describing a 5-base counting system using lines.
alt_translation1: De cinco, de cinco en cinco, describiendo el sistema para contar con rayas con base de cinco.

Description: Counting system based on squares and used in baseball.
alt_translation1: Sistema de conteo usando cuadrados que se utiliza en el béisbol.

Description: Of this kind. As of a given day.
alt_translation1: De este, como este. A partir de un día en particular.

Description: Day before yesterday, a few days ago.
All the way to the bottom/to the end.

alt_translation1: De ahí, a partir de ahí.

Description: A day or two after the day after tomorrow.
alt_translation1: Uno o dos días después de pasado mañana.

Description: All the way to/from the root.
All the way to/from the root.
The back of a person or an animal.
Back of the hand or instep of the foot.
alt_translation1: Dorso de la mano o el empeine del pie.

Description: Cuticle of the fingers or the toes.
alt_translation1: Cutícula de las uñas de las manos o de los pies.

Description: Jiménez Girón (1979:66) explains that this expression describes someone whose turning in all directions to make sure there is no danger in sight.
alt_translation1: Jiménez Girón (1979:66) explica que esta expresión se usa para describir cuando se mira por todos lados para asegurarse de que no corre uno peligro.

Description: Top or front of the penis.

alt_translation1: Línea que forman el dorso del hueso y de los cartílagos de la nariz.

Description: A day or two after the day after tomorrow.
alt_translation1: Uno o dos días después de pasado mañana.

Description: Expression used when someone wishes to signal that they intend to relax, especially after having finished the daily chores.
alt_translation1: Expresión mediante la cual una persona indica que se va a relajar, generalmente después de terminar los quehaceres.

Description: Adverb indicating a high degree of some property mentioned in the discourse or that intensifies it. Comparable to 'very'.
alt_translation1: Adverbio que indica alto grado de alguna propiedad mencionada o que la intensifica. Similar a 'muy' o al morfema '-ísimo'.

Description: Coward, negligent, ex. a man who leaves his sick wife and his children.
alt_translation1: Cobarde, insensible, que abandona a otros, ej. un hombre que deja a su esposa enferma y con hijos.
Que. Introduce lo que alguien más dijo.

Description: Disease that affects chickens. Jiménez Girón (1979:66) describes that scales form under the tongue of hens, although it can affect roosters as well. As a result, hens cannot cluck and roosters cannot crow.
alt_translation1: Enfermedad que le da a los pollos. Jiménez Girón (1979:66) explica que se trata de una "escama que se forma debajo de la lengua de las gallinas" aunque puede afectar a los gallos también. Por ello, las gallinas no pueden cacarear ni los gallos pueden cantar.

Description: Hangnail or abscess that forms on the side of a finger or toenail.
alt_translation1: Pellejito o absceso que se forma a un costado de la uña.

Description: Crosswise, positioned across. This can refer to to the sideways position of a fetus before birth.
alt_translation1: Atravesado, cruzado. Puede referirse a la posición transversal de un feto antes del parto.

Description: Nickname given to a man by the name of Pedro.
alt_translation1: Apodo que designa a un hombre llamado Pedro.

Description: Sound of a metal object hitting something or being struck, such as a wrench hitting the floor, or when the bells are rung to call to mass.
alt_translation1: Sonido de algo de metal que se golpea, como por ejemplo si se cae una herramienta como una perica en el piso, o cuando tocan las campanas para llamar a misa.

Description: Drawing, specifically a drawing for huipil decoration.
alt_translation1: Dibujo, en particular, el dibujo de un huipil.

Description: Outstanding, that stands out, that sticks out.
Word. By extension, language, conversation, story, rumor or news. Jiménez Girón (1979:66) explains that this lexeme also refers to the discourse in a civil or religious wedding.
alt_translation1: Palabra. Por extensión, lengua o idioma, plática, cuento, rumor o noticia. Jiménez Girón (1979:66) indica que este lexema también se puede referir a "la presentación o anuncio nupcial civil o religioso".

Description: Words choked with emotion, e.g. due to crying, as in a priest's sermon.
alt_translation1: Palabras entrecortadas por alguna emoción, ej. por llorar, como las del sermón de un sacerdote.

Description: Words of moral value, such as advice, words of reassurance, poetry, sacred words, ceremonial speeches such as the libanà.
alt_translation1: Palabras de valor moral, ej. un consejo, palabras tranquilizadores, poesía, palabras sagradas, discursos ceremoniales como el libanà.

Description: Swear words, profanity, words with sexual connotations, slander.
alt_translation1: Groserías, leperadas, palabras con connotaciones sexuales, calumnia.

Description: Zapotec language of the Binniza peoples of the Isthmus of Tehuantepec region.
alt_translation1: Idioma zapoteco, específicamente de los pueblos binniza de la región del Istmo de Tehuantepec.

Description: Jiménez Girón (1979) explains that this lexeme refers to the top leader of a male-only religious society.
alt_translation1: Jiménez Girón (1979) explica que se trata del jefe supremo de una sociedad religiosa de varones.

Description: The month of December. From Spanish "diciembre".
Trembling, shivering. When reduplicated, this lexeme describes an action that is carried out in a repetitive and hurried manner.
alt_translation1: Temblorina, escalofríos. De manera reduplicada, se utiliza para describir una acción que se realiza de manera repetida y apresurada.

Description: Mite that hosts in chickens and birds in general (probably Dermanyssus gallinae).
alt_translation1: Ácaro de los pollos y de los pájaros en general (probablemente Dermanyssus gallinae).

Description: Adjective that adds precision to the use of a noun, or that intensifies it.
alt_translation1: Adjetivo que modifica a un sustantivo para establecer la precisión de su uso, o para intensificarlo. Similar al adjetivo 'mero' en castellano.

Description: Coin worth 50 cents and known in Spanish as 'real'.
alt_translation1: Moneda de 50 centavos conocida como real.
Don (tratamiento de respeto hacia un hombre adulto).

Description: Rope that is tied to the nose ring of the ox.
alt_translation1: Cuerda que se ata al anillo de la nariz del buey.

Description: Strap made of leather or natural fibers that is placed on the forehead and holds a load carried on the back.
Narrative, story, tale (lit. words strung together).
Oviduct, ex. in birds and iguanas.
alt_translation1: El ducto por donde sale el huevo de un ovíparo, ej. de pájaros e iguanas (oviducto).

Description: Natural fiber often derived from select agaves and used for rope making.

alt_translation1: Cadena o alambre de algún metal.

Description: String apt for weaving into a hammock.
Rope that is tied to a rock or boulder to anchor a vessel.
alt_translation1: Cuerda que se amarra a una piedra para anclar una balsa.

Description: Rope used to close a fishing net and which is thicker than the string used to weave the net itself.
alt_translation1: Cuerda que se usa para cerrar una red de pescar y que es más gruesa que la que se usa para tejer la red misma.

Description: Braided rope that allows for corners of clothes to be wedged in to be hung out to dry.
Jiménez Girón (1979:68) describes this type of rope as made of hand-twisted natural fibers used in fishing. It has a wooden needle at one end which is inserted through the eye of fish to hang them.
alt_translation1: Jiménez Girón (1979:68) describe este tipo de mecate como "ojero de palma torcido a mano, y provisto de una aguja de madera en un extremo, sirve para que los pescadores de lisas ensarten sus piezas".

Description: Rope used specifically to weave fishing nets.
alt_translation1: Cuerda especial para hacer redes de pescar.

Description: Rope that is tied to the nose ring of the ox.
alt_translation1: Cuerda que se ata al anillo de la nariz del buey.

Description: Core fiber, ex. the wick of a candle, the agave fiber used in rope making, the non-elastic inner rubber liner in tires.
alt_translation1: Fibra central, ej. la mecha de una vela, la fibra de agave que se usa en la elaboración de cuerdas, el revestimiento interior de hule no elástico de los neumáticos.

Description: Thread woven into the edge of a circular fishing net to hold the weights that pull it down to catch bottom feeders.
alt_translation1: Hilo que se teje en el borde de una atarraya y que sujeta los plomos de esta.

Description: Rope that is tied to the nose ring of the ox.
alt_translation1: Cuerda que se ata al anillo de la nariz del buey.

Description: Jiménez Girón (1979:68) describes this lexeme as rope made by hand with twisted palm fiber.
alt_translation1: Jiménez Girón (1979:68) describe este lexema como "el mecate de palma torcido a mano".

Description: Sound of a horse defecating while walking.
alt_translation1: Sonido de un caballo defecando al caminar.

Description: This lexeme refers to something flat that has been rolled up. In particular, it is used to refer to green palm leaves rolled up to make a whistle. Jiménez Girón (1979:68-69) mentions that children would play around with these whistles at weddings. By extension, some use this lexeme to refer to the telephone.
alt_translation1: Este lexema se refiere a algo plano que ha sido enrollado. En particular, se usa para referirse a la palma verde que se enrolla para hacer un pito para silbar. Jiménez Girón (1979:68-69) menciona que con estos pitos "se divierten los niños en los casamientos el día de la enramada". Por extensión, algunos usan este lexema para referirse al teléfono.

Description: Gross!, exclamation of disgust generally directed at a dirty person or animal.
alt_translation1: ¡Guácala!, exclamación de asco sobre todo dirigida hacia una persona sucia o un animal sucio.

Description: Jiménez Girón (1979:68) explains that this lexeme refers to fleshy maguey leaves cooked and sweetened.
alt_translation1: Jiménez Girón (1979:68) describe este lexema como "la penca cocida y dulce del maguey".

Description: Jiménez Girón (1979:68) states that this lexeme refers to a head stand.
alt_translation1: Jiménez Girón (1979:68) describe este lexema como "la parada de cabeza perpendicularmente".

Description: Exclamation to alert a child not to touch something that is hot.
alt_translation1: Exclamación para alertar a un niño para que no toque algo caliente.

Description: Fresh water fish found in estuaries and rivers. It is black in color and is known in Spanish as popoyote.
alt_translation1: Pez de agua dulce que se encuentra en los esteros y en los ríos. Es de color negro y se le conoce en castellano como popoyote.

Description: Young corn plant at three to five days from sprouting.
alt_translation1: Milpita tierna que tiene de tres a cinco días de haber brotado.

Description: Sharp, in reference to a blade. By extension, the way a person might be aggressive, or bothersome as when the sun is too strong.
alt_translation1: Afilado, filoso. Por extensión, agresivo como podría ser una persona, o que molesta como el sol fuerte.

Description: Magical creature who takes children out to the woods to play. Only children can see them but everyone can see their tracks.
alt_translation1: Duende que se lleva a los niños a jugar en el monte. Solo los niños le ven, pero todos pueden ver sus huellas.

Description: Sound of a rat nest bursting.
alt_translation1: Sonido de un nido de ratas reventando.

Description: Sound of a wet shoe when stepping on the ground.
alt_translation1: Sonido que hace un zapato mojado al pisar.

Description: Sound of a fishing net being thrown.
alt_translation1: Sonido de una red de pescar siendo lanzada.

Description: Changed. Perhaps by extension or association, this participle may mean coldly or with displeasure, especially in relation to how someone speaks.
alt_translation1: Cambiado. Quizá por extensión o asociación, también se usa para describir frialdad o desagrado, sobre todo refiriéndose a la manera de hablar.

Description: Isn't that right?, isn't that true?, exclamation to request validation or confirmation by the interlocutor.
alt_translation1: ¿Verdad?, ¿no es así?, exclamación para solicitar la validación o confirmación del interlocutor.

Description: Unpleasant smell such as the smell of armpits or of goats.
alt_translation1: Olor feo, como de axila o de chivo.

Description: This phrase refers to the presence of intestinal parasites. It is considered to arise among children from eating dirt and walking on the floor, and among adults from drinking beer. Symptoms include an inflammation of the belly that even makes it shine, as well as itching of the nose and anus. There are several methods used to relieve this condition at home in combination with medical care.
alt_translation1: Esta frase se refiere a la presencia de parásitos intestinales. Se considera que entre los niños surge por comer tierra y andar en el piso, y entre los adultos por beber cerveza. Los síntomas incluyen una inflamación de la panza que incluso la hace brillar, así como comezón en la nariz y el ano. Existen varios métodos que se usan para aliviar este mal en casa en combinación con atención médica.

Description: Full of air. This refers to a condition that affects infants. It is attributed to taking in air when drinking from a baby bottle. To alleviate it, babies are lightly tapped on their backs.
alt_translation1: Lleno de aire. Esto se refiere al mal que afecta a los bebés. Se atribuye al hecho de tomar aire al beber del biberón. Para aliviarlo se le dan golpecitos en la espalda a los bebés.

Description: Intestinal inflammation, intestinal fever. This ailment is associated with heat. It is attributed to lying or sitting on a hot surface and then drinking something cold. Symptoms include tiredness, pain, vomiting, constipation and/or fever. There are several methods used to alleviate this condition at home in combination with medical care.
alt_translation1: Inflamación intestinal, fiebre intestinal. Este mal se asocia al calor. Se atribuye a acostarse o sentarse sobre una superficie caliente y luego beber algo frío. Los síntomas incluyen cansancio, dolor, vómitos, estreñimiento y/o fiebre. Existen varios métodos que se usan para aliviar este mal en casa en combinación con atención médica.

Description: Inflammation of the kidneys. This disease is associated with heat. It is considered to arise from not drinking enough water or from physical exertion and bathing with a hot body. There are several methods used to alleviate this condition at home in combination with medical care.
alt_translation1: Inflamación de los riñones. Este mal se asocia con el calor. Se considera que surge por no beber suficiente agua o por realizar un esfuerzo físico y bañarse con el cuerpo caliente. Existen varios métodos que se usan para aliviar este mal en casa en combinación con atención médica.

Description: Inflammation of the tonsils. This ailment is associated with heat. It is thought to arise from getting wet, getting cold, or walking barefoot. Symptoms include fever, body aches, sore throat, and difficulty swallowing. There are several methods used to alleviate this condition at home in combination with medical care.
alt_translation1: Inflamación de las anginas. Este mal se asocia con el calor. Se considera que surge por mojarse, por enfriarse, o por andar descalzo. Los síntomas incluyen fiebre, dolor de cuerpo, ardor de garganta, y dificultad para tragar. Existen varios métodos que se usan para aliviar este mal en casa en combinación con atención médica.

Description: Distal demonstrative referring to someone or something. Equivalent to 'that'.
alt_translation1: Demostrativo que apunta hacia algo o alguien que está lejos. Equivalente a 'aquel', 'aquella', y 'aquello'.

Description: Warm or hot, depending on the temperature that is optimal.
alt_translation1: Tibio o caliente, según la temperatura ideal que se busca.

Description: With company, together. This can refer to neighbors.
alt_translation1: Acompañado, unido, junto. Se puede usar para referirse a los vecinos y a sus casas.

Description: Maiden, young woman, especially one who is a virgin.

alt_translation1: Don (tratamiento de respeto hacia un hombre adulto).

Description: Young man!, call directed to a young man as to not use his name.
alt_translation1: ¡Muchacho!, ¡joven!, dicho a manera de llamar a un hombre joven sin usar su nombre.

Description: Sound of something very wet, such as a wet shoe. By extension, this sound symbolic expression is used to refer to someone who is very drunk.
alt_translation1: Sonido de algo que está muy mojado como por ejemplo un zapato mojado. Por extensión, se usa para expresar que alguien está muy borracho.

Description: Adjective describing a broken container whose condition can only be determined by the sound it makes when struck with the fingers.
alt_translation1: Adjetivo que describe un recipiente roto cuyo estado solo se puede determinar por el sonido que produce al ser golpeado con los dedos.

Description: Ash Wednesday. The day the 1982 eruption of the Chichonal Volcano (lit. day ashes fell).
alt_translation1: Miércoles de Ceniza. El día de la erupción del Volcán el Chichonal en 1982 (lit. día en que cayeron las cenizas).
Días importantes de la Semana Santa.

Description: Birthday, celebration associated with the saint after whom someone is named.
Mischievous, hyperactive, someone who is a challenge to manage.

alt_translation1: Sonido de algo colgado que se mueve.

Description: Wooden frame, plank or piece, depending on its function. In embroidery, this lexeme refers to the frame that stretches the fabric to be embroidered. In terms of fishing nets, it is the plank used to guide the weave. This lexeme also refers to a flat piece of wood on which a top is made to spin.
alt_translation1: Tabla, marco o bastidor, según la función del objeto. Con relación al bordado, este lexema se refiere al bastidor. Con relación al tejido de redes de pescar se refiere a la tabla que se usa en su elaboración. También se refiere a la tabla que se usa para hacer bailar un trompo o sonador de morro.

Description: Before, long ago, then, back then, in the past.
alt_translation1: Antes, anteriormente, en aquel entonces, entonces, en una época anterior.

Description: Adjective used to describe a person with compassion or pity. Similar to 'poor' as in 'poor him'.
alt_translation1: Adjetivo que describe a una persona con compasión o lástima. Similar a 'pobre' como cuando se dice 'pobre de él'.
Sonido de platos que se lavan.

Description: Constantly, always, all the time (lit. day night).
alt_translation1: Constantemente, siempre, todo el tiempo (lit. día noche).

Description: Sound of someone walking with a very full basket.
alt_translation1: Sonido de alguien caminando con un canasto muy lleno.

Description: Sound of horse testicles when they run.
alt_translation1: Sonido de los testículos de caballos cuando corren.

Description: Fright (including the illness that is considered to be caused by fright), fear, dread.
alt_translation1: Susto, espanto (incluyendo la enfermedad provocada por el espanto), miedo, temor.

Description: Illness resulting from fright caused by an experience associated with driving.
alt_translation1: Enfermedad de espanto causado por una experiencia al ir en un vehículo.

Description: Illness resulting from fright caused by a dog.
alt_translation1: Enfermedad de espanto causado por un perro.

Description: Fear that happens when dreaming that one falls down.
alt_translation1: Espanto por soñar que uno se cae.

Description: Illness resulting from fright caused by an experience associated with water.
alt_translation1: Enfermedad de espanto causado por una experiencia que involucra el agua.

Description: Illness resulting from fright caused by falling from a tree.
alt_translation1: Enfermedad de espanto causado por caerse de un árbol.

Description: Illness resulting from fright after being chased by cattle.
alt_translation1: Enfermedad de espanto que causa el que el ganado le persiga a uno.

Description: Disease caused by the deep shame that may be felt when making love and, especially, when watching a couple make love. It is associated with heat, can affect anyone, and is considered very dangerous. It causes sadness, fatigue, headache, weight and hair loss, fever, and a cough that announces that the sick person is close to death. To avoid the disease, it is recommended to tell what was done or seen. In the latter case, the people seen making love become ill. Medications are not useful in treating this disease.
alt_translation1: Enfermedad causada por la profunda vergüenza que pudiera sentirse al hacer el amor y, sobre todo, al ver a una pareja hacer el amor. Se asocia con el calor, puede afectar a cualquiera, y se considera muy peligrosa. Causa tristeza, sueño, dolor de cabeza, pérdida de peso y del cabello, fiebre, y tos que anuncia que el enfermo está cerca de la muerte. Para evitar la enfermedad, se recomienda contar lo que se hizo o se vio. En el segundo caso, la pareja que se vio se enferma. Los medicamentos no son útiles para aliviar esta enfermedad.

Description: Bare and therefore smooth after having lost hair or feathers.
alt_translation1: Liso, por haber perdido el pelo o las plumas.

Description: Work by and for the community.
Jiménez Girón (1979:70) translates this lexeme as walking stiff or as staff.
alt_translation1: Jiménez Girón (1979:70) traduce este lexema como bastón o bordón.

Description: Completely lit up, completely cleared up. By extension, unambiguously.
alt_translation1: Completamente iluminado, completamente claro. Por extensión, sin ambigüedad.

Description: Lightly candied banana or plantain sweets.
Lightly candied sweets made with a small hard-skinned squash.
alt_translation1: Dulce hecho con una calabaza pequeña de cáscara dura.

Description: Lightly candied sweets made with the fruit of the tree identified as Malpighia mexicana.
Sweets made with fried pieces of dough brought together into a ball with syrup made from unrefined brown sugar.
Sweets made with fried pieces of dough brought together into a ball with syrup made from unrefined brown sugar.
Honey from a natural bee hive.
Large human bone. For some, this lexeme refers specifically to the tibia, fibula and femur, and/or the humerus, ulna and radius.
alt_translation1: Hueso grande del cuerpo humano. Para algunos, este lexema se refiere específicamente a la tibia, el peroné y el fémur, y/o al húmero, cúbito y radio.

Description: Large bones of the arm, (humerus, ulna and/or radius). By association, forearm.
alt_translation1: Huesos grandes del brazo (húmero, cúbito y/o radio). Por asociación, antebrazo.
Huesos grandes de las piernas (tibia y/o peroné).
Falange, hueso del dedo y/o de la mano.
Falange, hueso del dedo del pie.

Description: Cricoid cartilage known as Adam's apple.
alt_translation1: El cartílago cricoides conocido en castellano como manzana de Adán o nuez de Adán.
Huevo de gallina que sale blando.

Description: Dewclaw in dogs. Those that have it are considered good for hunting.
alt_translation1: Espolón de perro. Aquellos que lo tienen se les considera buenos para la cacería.

Description: Yolk and albumen of a chicken egg prior to shell formation.
alt_translation1: Yema y albúmina de un huevo de gallina antes de formarse la cáscara.

Description: Skull, or more specifically, parietal bone.
alt_translation1: Cráneo, o más específicamente hueso parietal.
Hueso frontal (de la frente) del cráneo.

Description: This lexeme refers to any protruding bone such as those of the human hip or the shins of quadrupeds. It also refers to a skinned bone.
alt_translation1: Este lexema se refiere a cualquier hueso salido o protuberante como los de las caderas de humano o los de las espinillas de animales cuadrúpedos. También se refiere a un hueso descarnado.

Description: This lexeme is used to describe a child who is malnourished and boney, either at birth due to the mother's own malnourishment during pregnancy, or due to breastfeeding that is insufficient or abruptly interrupted.
alt_translation1: Este lexema se usa para describir a un niño desnutrido y flaco ya sea al nacer por falta de nutrición adecuada de la madre durante el embarazo, o por una lactancia insuficiente o interrumpida abruptamente.

Description: Tibia or shinbone and other leg bones.
alt_translation1: Tibia y otros huesos de la pierna.

Description: Forearm bones, i.e., the radius and ulna.
alt_translation1: Los huesos del antebrazo, es decir, el radio y el cúbito.
Huesos de la muñeca y del codo.
Cartílago del borde de las costillas (borde costal).

Description: Temple bone (possibly the sphenoid bone), temporal bone.
alt_translation1: Hueso de la sien (posiblemente el esfenoides), hueso temporal.

Description: Fish skull bones around and behind the eye.
alt_translation1: Huesos del cráneo de los peces alrededor y detrás del ojo.

Description: Possibly the cervical vertebrae or the dewlap of a bird.
alt_translation1: Posiblemente las vértebras cervicales o la barbilla de una ave.

Description: Hind quarters of a horse, and in particular the bone that looks like an ankle.
alt_translation1: Cuartilla trasera del caballo y en particular el hueso que parece tobillo.

Description: Occipital bone and bones of the nape.
alt_translation1: Hueso occipital y huesos de la nuca.

Description: Pope's nose, bishop's nose or parson's nose in chickens (pygostyle).

alt_translation1: Huevo de gallina que sale blando.

Description: Beef on the bone. By association, beef broth with bone.
alt_translation1: Carne de res con hueso. Por asociación, caldo de res con hueso.

Description: Meat on a bone which has been air-dried and is used to flavor a broth.
alt_translation1: Carne con hueso oreada que se usa para darle sabor al caldo.

Description: Meat on a bone which has been air-dried and is used to flavor a broth.
alt_translation1: Carne con hueso oreada que se usa para darle sabor al caldo.

Description: Loincloth, male bottom garment made of a single piece of white woven cotton cloth.
alt_translation1: Taparrabos, calzón de manta blanca de hombre.

Description: Man who does not belong to the community and/or does not speak Didxazá, foreigner, outsider, stranger, and even soldier, as the latter are usually sent by outside entities.
alt_translation1: Hombre que no pertenece a la comunidad y/o no habla didxazá, extranjero, fuereño, forastero, e incluso soldado, pues estos últimos suelen ser enviados desde fuera.

Description: Man who does not belong to the community and/or does not speak Didxazá, foreigner, outsider, stranger, and even soldier, as the latter are usually sent by outside entities.
alt_translation1: Hombre que no pertenece a la comunidad y/o no habla didxazá, extranjero, fuereño, forastero, e incluso soldado, pues estos últimos suelen ser enviados desde fuera.

Description: A derogatory term used to refer to foreign troops during the second French occupation of Mexico between. Jiménez Girón (1979:203) describes the soldiers as exceedingly dirty “because in their exhausted bodies you could see for miles their filth due to not having bathed for a long time” (translation by Pérez Báez).
alt_translation1: Gentilicio despectivo para referirse a las tropas extranjeras durante la segunda ocupación francesa en México. Jiménez Girón (1979:203) describe este lexema de la siguiente manera: "Soldados remugrosos. Era el apodo que en Juchitán (Guidxiguie') recibieron aquellos franceses, porque en su extenuado cuerpo solo se advertía a leguas la asquerosa mugrosidad de largo tiempo de no bañarse".

Description: Sound of a water pitcher filling up.
alt_translation1: Sonido de un ánfora de agua llenándose.

Description: Jiménez Girón (1979:72) states that this lexeme refers to the bird know in Spanish as 'tordo'. In La Ventosa, this lexeme is understood to refer to a small bird with distinct plumage on the chest.
alt_translation1: Jiménez Girón (1979:72) indica que este lexema se refiere al pájaro conocido en castellano como tordo. En La Ventosa se describe a este pájaro como uno de tamaño pequeño con plumaje distintivo en el pecho.

Description: Sound of a puppy suckling or of a baby sucking from a baby bottle.
alt_translation1: Sonido que hace un cachorrito al mamar o que hace un bebé al beber de una mamila.

Description: Basket or similar containers made of hand-woven palm fibers or synthetic materials.
Shallow basket used for shopping at the market.
alt_translation1: Canasto chaparrito para llevar al mercado.

Description: Palm basket with a handle used for storing eggs.
alt_translation1: Canasta de palma con agarradera que se usa para guardar huevos.

Description: Jiménez Girón (1979:71) describes this basket as made of reed or palm leaves and designed for harvesting corn on the cob. He indicates that its capacity is the third part of unit of measure called 'redada'.
alt_translation1: Jiménez Girón (1979:71) describe este canasto de carrizo o de pencas de palma como "canasto grande para la pizca de mazorca, cuya capacidad es la tercera parte de una redada".

Description: Basket made of reeds or palm leaves, designed with a handle for storing tortillas.
alt_translation1: Canasto de carrizo o de pencas de palma con agarradera para guardar tortillas.

Description: Basket made of reeds or palm leaves, and designed to suit the needs of fishermen. The basket has two leather side handles through which a leather strap is looped. The leather strap is placed on the forehead and the basket is carried on the back.
alt_translation1: Canasto elaborado con carrizo o pencas de palma y diseñado para los usos de los pescadores con asas de cuero donde se inserta el mecapal.

Description: Basket made of reeds or palm leaves with a wide and round shape for multiple purposes including storing bread.
alt_translation1: Canasta elaborada con carrizo o pencas de palma y de forma redonda y ancha para satisfacer distintos usos incluyendo para guardar pan.

Description: Basket made of reeds and designed with a shoulder strap to use in harvesting.
alt_translation1: Canasta elaborada con carrizo y diseñada para la pizca con un mecate para cargar en el hombro.

Description: Jiménez Girón (1979:71) describes this basket as made of reed or palm leaves and designed for harvesting corn on the cob. He indicates that its capacity is the third part of unit of measure called 'redada'.
alt_translation1: Jiménez Girón (1979:71) describe este canasto de carrizo o de pencas de palma como "canasto grande para la pizca de mazorca, cuya capacidad es la tercera parte de una redada".

Description: Unrefined sugar molded into cones known in Spanish as 'piloncillo', 'panela', or 'melcocha'.
alt_translation1: Azúcar sin refinar moldeada en forma de cono, conocida en castellano como piloncillo, panela o melcocha.

Description: Ear. By extension, this may refer to handles in certain types of containers.
alt_translation1: Oreja, oído. Por extensión, asa de algunos recipientes.

Description: Beam built into a wall to support a window.
alt_translation1: Travesaño que se inserta en la pared para empotrar una ventana.

Description: This lexeme has been described in multiple ways by different knowledge bearers. With respect to plants, it has been documented to designate corn smut, the bark of a particular tree, and a part of a bush. In relation to certain animals that are eaten, such as goat or deer, this lexeme can designate two small appendages found between the animal's organs.
alt_translation1: Este lexema ha sido descrito de múltiples maneras por distintos conocedores. Con respecto a las plantas, se ha documentado que designa el huitlacoche, la corteza de un árbol en particular, y una parte de una mata. Con relación a ciertos animales que se consumen como la cabra o el venado, este lexema puede designar a dos pequeños apéndices que se encuentran entre los órganos del animal.

Description: Deaf person. This lexeme also refers to an ear that is oozing due to an infection. Given the latter, it is possible that this is a pejorative term when it is used to refer to a person.
alt_translation1: Persona sorda. También se refiere a una oreja que supura por infección. Por lo último, es posible que este lexema tenga connotaciones despectivas si se refiere a una persona.

Description: Ear that is not well formed.
alt_translation1: Oreja que no está bien formada.

Description: Beam built into a wall to support a door.
alt_translation1: Travesaño que se inserta en la pared para empotrar una puerta.

Description: Exclamation of protest to denounce unequal treatment.
alt_translation1: Exclamación de protesta que denuncia un trato desigual.

Description: Sound of a car or bus.
alt_translation1: Sonido que hace un coche o un camión.

Description: That's it!, exclamation to indicate that an object or an objective was obtained.
alt_translation1: ¡Eso mero!, ¡así mero!, exclamación para indicar que un objeto se obtuvo o un objetivo se logró.

Description: Sound of a donkey before braying.
alt_translation1: Sonido de un burro antes de rebuznar.

Description: Drops of vaginal blood placed on a handkerchief as proof of a bride's virginity.
alt_translation1: Gotas de sangre vaginal que se colocan en un pañuelo como prueba de la virginidad de una novia.

Description: Name given to Eresma and Rosalino as a couple.
alt_translation1: Pareja formada por Eresma y Rosalino.

Description: Nickname given to a man by the name of Rómulo.
alt_translation1: Apodo que designa a un hombre llamado Rómulo.

Description: Expression used in the game of hide-and-seek, known as guendarigaachi' sinturón, to announce that the player who is to find a hidden belt is heading out to look for it.
alt_translation1: Expresión que se usa en el juego de escondidillas conocido como guendarigaachi' sinturón, y que anuncia que el jugador que tiene que encontrar el cinturón va a salir a buscarlo.

Description: Sound of the symptomatic manifestation of vomit.
alt_translation1: Sonido de la manifestación sintomática del vómito.

Description: Public land known as Ejido Chari.
Public land known as Ejido Zapata.

alt_translation1: Sonido del motor de un bulldozer.

Description: The month of January. From Spanish "enero".
A person who organizes people for the purposes of a festivity.
alt_translation1: Persona que organiza a la gente para hacer una fiesta.
Juego de niños de los encantados.

Description: A woman who is a healer.
A healer woman who diagnoses ailments by feeling a person’s pulse. She can also carry out a spiritual cleansing or blessing ritual.
alt_translation1: Curandera que con tomar el pulso puede diagnosticar un mal, y que también santigua.

Description: A man who is a healer.

alt_translation1: Playera de manga corta y cuello.

Description: A shovel-shaped tool which, when pressure is applied to it, allows you to dig without bending down.
alt_translation1: Herramienta en forma de pala que al aplicarle presión permite escavar sin agacharse.

Description: Triangle-shaped guide with right angles used for drafting and cutting.
alt_translation1: Escuadra para dibujo geométrico y para cortar.

Description: Dewclaw in dogs or spur in roosters.
alt_translation1: Espolón de perro o de gayo.

Description: Beef stew made with pineapple, apples, banana, bread, guajillo chilli, annatto and lard.
alt_translation1: Carne cocida con piña, manzana, plátano, pan, guajillo, achiote y manteca.

Description: Sound of smoke blowing or rising.
alt_translation1: Sonido de echar humo o de humo levantándose.

Description: Sound of a light turning on and off very quickly.
alt_translation1: Sonido de una luz encendiéndose y apagándose muy rápidamente.

Description: Sound of a big bird's wings beating quickly.
alt_translation1: Sonido de las alas de un pájaro grande batiendo rápidamente.

Description: Sound of a woman running in a dress or long skirt.
alt_translation1: Sonido de una mujer corriendo en un vestido o falda larga.

Description: Exclamation used to scare off a drunk.
alt_translation1: Exclamación para espantar a un borracho.

Description: Sound of a bird's wings flapping.
alt_translation1: Sonido del aletear de un pájaro.

Description: Nickname given to a man by the name of Juan de José.
alt_translation1: Apodo que designa a un hombre llamado Juan de José.

Description: Nickname given to a man by the name of Juan.
alt_translation1: Apodo que designa a un hombre llamado Juan.

Description: Nickname given to a man by the name of Juan. Gusuyu is a variation of a verb meaning 'let (him) turn it into dirt'.
alt_translation1: Apodo que designa a un hombre llamado Juan. Gusuyu es una variación de la forma verbal 'que lo haga tierra'.

Description: Name given to Juan and Eugenia as a couple.
alt_translation1: Pareja formada por Juan y Eugenia.

Description: Nickname given to a man by the name of Juan as he is robber. The second part of the name is short for quí rasi meaning 'he doesn't sleep'.
alt_translation1: Apodo que designa a un hombre llamado Juan por ser un asaltante. La segunda parte del apodo es una contracción de quí rasi que significa 'no duerme'.

Description: Name given to Juan and Clara as a couple.
alt_translation1: Pareja formada por Juan y Clara.

Description: Nickname given to a man by the name of Juan as he identifies as muxé'.
alt_translation1: Apodo que designa a un hombre llamado Juan por ser muxé'.

Description: Nickname given to a man by the name of Juan as he still breastfed at the age of five. Niìdxì' means 'milk'.
alt_translation1: Apodo que designa a un hombre llamado Juan porque a los cinco años todavía mamaba leche materna. Niìdxì' significa 'leche'.

Description: Nickname given to a man by the name of Juan. Pàllu is a Spanish loanword meaning 'stick'.
alt_translation1: Apodo que designa a un hombre llamado Juan.

Description: Nickname given to a man by the name of Juan as he has a crooked neck. Pàndu means 'bent out of shape'.
alt_translation1: Apodo que designa a un hombre llamado Juan por tener el cuello chueco.

Description: Nickname given to a man by the name of Juan as he is bald. Píiru means 'shaved'.
alt_translation1: Apodo que designa a un hombre llamado Juan por estar calvo. Píiru significa 'rasurado'.

Description: Nickname given to a man by the name of Juan for having lost a lot of weight.
alt_translation1: Apodo que designa a un hombre llamado Juan por haber enflaquecido.

Description: Nickname given to a man by the name of Juan as he is the son of Telésfora.
alt_translation1: Apodo que designa a un hombre llamado Juan por ser el hijo de Telésfora.

Description: Nickname given to a man by the name of Juan as his head is lopsided. Tá'ba' means 'dented'.
alt_translation1: Apodo que designa a un hombre llamado Juan por tener la cabeza aplastada. Tá'ba' significa 'achatado'

Description: Nickname given to a man by the name of Juan. Xtùbi means 'alone'.
alt_translation1: Apodo que designa a un hombre llamado Juan. Xtùbi significa 'solo'.

Description: Nickname given to a man by the name of Juan.
alt_translation1: Apodo que designa a un hombre llamado Juan.

Description: Sound of a plastic cup hitting the earth.
alt_translation1: Sonido de un vaso de plástico pegando la tierra.

Description: Sound of a tree in the wind.
alt_translation1: Sonido de un árbol en el viento.

Description: Nickname given to a man by the name of Juan as he has a crooked neck. Chuèca is a Spanish loanword meaning 'crooked' in the feminine gender.
alt_translation1: Apodo que designa a un hombre llamado Juan por tener el cuello chueco.

Description: Name given to Juana and Miguel as a couple.
alt_translation1: Pareja formada por Juana y Miguel.

Description: Nickname given to a man by the name of Juan.
alt_translation1: Apodo que designa a un hombre llamado Juan.

Description: Sound of a thick cloth being rubbed.
alt_translation1: Sonido de tela gruesa siendo frotada.

Description: Bushel, as a measure equivalent to twenty-four liters.
alt_translation1: Fanega, medida equivalente a veinticuatro litros.

Description: Name given to Juanita and Demetrio as a couple.
alt_translation1: Pareja formada por Juanita y Demetrio.

Description: Nickname given to a man by the name of Fernando Sánchez López as a reference to a fish called yolo which has a red body and large head.
alt_translation1: Apodo que designa a un hombre llamado Fernando Sánchez López por referencia al yolo, un pescado rojo de cuerpo y de cabeza grande.

Description: The month of February. From Spanish "febrero".
Nickname given to a woman who was a traditional healer in Juchitán de Zaragoza. She was known to be a nahual who could turn into a dove.
alt_translation1: Apodo que designa a una mujer de Juchitán de Zaragoza que era médica tradicional y se le conocía como nahual de forma de paloma.

Description: Sound of a branch or riding crop whipping.
alt_translation1: Sonido de chicote o rama que golpea.

Description: Sound of a barrel falling to the bottom of a well.
alt_translation1: Sonido de un tambo cayendo al fondo de un pozo.

Description: Sound of walking in sticky mud.
alt_translation1: Sonido de caminar en lodo pegajoso.

Description: Sound of something being ripped off.
alt_translation1: Sonido de algo que se arranca.

Description: Name that can be given to cattle, after the flower called flor de China in Spanish.
alt_translation1: Flor de China. Nombre que se le puede dar al ganado.

Description: Name that can be given to cattle, after the flower called flor de campo in Spanish.
alt_translation1: Flor de campo. Nombre que se le puede dar al ganado.

Description: Name that can be given to cattle, after the flower called flor de canela in Spanish.
alt_translation1: Flor de canela. Nombre que se le puede dar al ganado.

Description: Whistle, especially a high pitch, high volume one.
alt_translation1: Silbido, chiflido, sobre todo si es agudo y estridente.

Description: Cuts made to meat or fish when salted, or on certain fruits as they are prepared and flavored to be eaten.
alt_translation1: Cortes que se hacen en la carne o el pescado al salarlos, o en algunas frutas al momento de alguna preparación.

Description: Oral membrane (frenum) of the venomous snake known as beendabeedxe' in Didxazá or 'cantil' in Spanish.
alt_translation1: Frenillo o membrana bucal de la serpiente venenosa conocida como beendabeedxe' o en castellano cantil, o los colmillos con los que muerde.

Description: Sound of a door opening or closing.
alt_translation1: Sonido de una puerta cerrándose o abriéndose.

Description: Sound of a horse defecating while walking, or that a donkey makes when it farts and defecates.
alt_translation1: Sonido de un caballo que defeca mientras camina, o de un burro cuando echa pedos y defeca.

Description: Sound of a cork being removed.
Sound of the movement of a snake's tongue.
alt_translation1: Sonido del movimiento de la lengua de una culebra.

Description: Ugly (referring to a person's look), sour-faced.
alt_translation1: Feo (refiriéndose a la apariencia de una persona), malencarado.

Description: Cold, cool. By extension, a soft drink (since it is often served cool).
alt_translation1: Frío, fresco. Por extensión, el refresco (la bebida).
Hacia abajo, hondo, profundo. Por extensión, el sur.

Description: Menstruation, period (lit. coming down from the abdomen).
alt_translation1: Menstruación, regla (lit. que le está bajando del abdomen).

Description: Sound of ice on a wet back.
alt_translation1: Sonido de hielo sobre una espalda mojada.

Description: Sound of gas in the stomach, or of a hungry stomach.
alt_translation1: Sonido de aire en la panza o de un estómago hambriento.

Description: Matured and grown tall or long, in relation to plants.
alt_translation1: Dicho de alguna planta, que ha madurado y crecido alta o larga.

Description: To be buried. By extension, to be hidden, both in a literal sense as well as in the metaphorical sense of something secret.
alt_translation1: Enterrado, sepultado. Por extensión, escondido, tanto en el sentido literal como en el sentido figurado de ser algo secreto.

Description: Baby born after only seven months of gestation.
alt_translation1: Sietemesino, bebé que nace después de solo siete meses de gestación.

Description: Frame of a hacksaw or fretsaw.
Boyfriend (whether of a man or a woman), or a man who likes to date.
alt_translation1: Novio (de hombre o de mujer), noviero.

Description: Small, in relation to a person or an object.
alt_translation1: Chiquito, ya sea con relación a una persona o a un objeto.

Description: Describes a tortilla eaten on its own and not as part of a meal.
alt_translation1: Describe una tortilla que se come sin comida.

Description: Measurement that translates as a quart.
I don't care!, could care less!, exclamation of disregard used mainly in response to an insult or some similar provocation.
alt_translation1: ¡No me importa!, ¡me vale!, exclamación para expresar indiferencia, sobre todo en respuesta a un insulta u otra provocación.

Description: The center or the middle, and by association, a half.
alt_translation1: Centro, y por asociación, la mitad.

Description: At the center of a top or summit.
alt_translation1: En el mero centro de una cima.

Description: Half of a bunch or cluster, ex. half of a bunch of grapes, half a dozen.
alt_translation1: Mitad de un conjunto, ej. la mitad de un racimo, de un bonche, de una docena.
Medio día, las doce del día.
Nada, sin, no hay, vacío, desprovisto de.

Description: Hundreds of thousands, a large amount (lit. hundred of hundred).
alt_translation1: Cientos de miles, una cantidad grande (lit. cien de cien).
Novenario, los nueve días posteriores al fallecimiento de una persona.

Description: Nine palms, nine spans, the depth at which graves are dug.
alt_translation1: Nueve palmos, nueve cuartas, medida de profundidad para cavar una tumba.

Description: Counted, numbered, in the sense of few, or of something existing in small numbers easy to count.
alt_translation1: Contado, en el sentido de poco o de que algo existe en números tan reducidos que son fáciles de contar.

Description: Thirty-one (lit. twenty and ten near one).
alt_translation1: Treinta y uno (lit. veinte diez cerca de uno).

Description: Plane (i.e. woodworking tool to even a surface).
Small thick tortilla on top of which shredded beef cooked with chipotle (or similar) is served.
alt_translation1: Tortilla chica y gruesa sobre la cual se sirve carne en chipotle y otros guisados.
A menudo, a cada rato, con frecuencia, frecuentemente.
De vez en cuando, a veces, con cierta frecuencia.

Description: Sound of a dog lapping up water.
alt_translation1: Sonido de un perro bebiendo agua a lengüetazos.

Description: Big, large (in relation to humans and other animals). By extension, it may refer to a priest.
alt_translation1: Grande (con relación a humanos y a otros animales). Por extensión, también puede referirse a un sacerdote o a un cura.

Description: Jiménez Girón (1979: 78) indicates that this lexeme refers to a tufted eagle. In the community of La Ventosa, this lexeme refers to a large animal, similar to a rabbit or a raccoon, which eats corn plants and has the particularity of having paws that look like the feet of a child.
alt_translation1: Jiménez Girón (1979: 78) indica que este lexema hace referencia al águila copetona. En la comunidad de La Ventosa, este lexema se refiere a un animal grande, similar a un conejo o a un mapache, que se come la milpa y que tiene la particularidad de tener patas que parecen los pies de un niño.

Description: Nickname given to a family in La Ventosa.
alt_translation1: Apodo de una familia de La Ventosa.

Description: Depth (ex. of a body of water), thickness (ex. of a forest), abundance (ex. of the corn harvest).
alt_translation1: Profundidad (ej. de un río), espesura (ej. en un bosque), abundancia (ej. de la milpa).

Description: The literal translation of this toponym is ‘place where alligators abound’. It refers to a site near the Laguna Superior where the Holy Cross named Cruz Pasión Ge'la Bé'ñe is located. This Holy Cross is considered to watch over cattle ranchers. Therefore, numerous celebrations at different times of the year are devoted to it.
alt_translation1: Este topónimo puede traducirse de manera literal como "lugar donde los lagartos abundan" y se refiere a un sitio cerca de la Laguna Superior donde se ubica la Cruz Pasión Ge'la Bé'ñe. Esta es una cruz que se considera patrona de los rancheros y ganaderos y a la cual se le dedican celebraciones en distintos momentos del año.

Description: Jiménez Girón (1979:79) describes this place as pond or bog off of the Laguna Superior located south of Salineras, named as such due to its mangrove called bigupi in Didxazá.
alt_translation1: Paraje que Jiménez Girón (1979:79) describe como "una rebalsa de la Laguna Superior ubicada al sur de Salineras, por abundar en sus orillas una especie de mangle llamado en zapoteco bigupi.

Description: Jiménez Girón (1979:79) defines this lexeme as the name of a lagoon surrounded by a thicket, located southeast of Juchitán, that by extension also refers to any place with similar vegetation.
alt_translation1: Jiménez Girón (1979:79) define este lexema como el "nombre de una laguna circundada por un monte chaparral, ubicada al sureste de Juchitán" y que por extensión se refiere también a "cualquier lugar de este tipo de vegetación".

Description: The dead, the deceased, the departed.
Cylinder. By extension, trachea, esophagus, throat, neck.
alt_translation1: Cilindro. Por extensión, traquea, esófago, garganta, pescuezo.

Description: The segment between the knots of a reed. It is used to make flutes. By extension, paper cylinder for firecrackers.
alt_translation1: Segmento entre los nudos de un carrizo. Sirve para fabricar flautas. Por extensión, carrete para cohetes.

Description: Powdered corn mixed with sure which is whipped into a drink.
Leather sandal with a woven design.
alt_translation1: Huarache de cuero con diseño de tejido.

Description: Leather sandal with a three-strap design.
alt_translation1: Huarache de cuero de tres correas.

Description: Leather sandal with a two-strap design.
alt_translation1: Huarache de cuero de dos correas.

Description: Leather sandal with a cross-cutting design.
A person's animal counterpart in the spiritual realm.
Position, especially as it pertains to the rank within the social hierarchy of service in a community.
Cowardice, fear. This term is used in a pejorative way to refer to the personality of men who do not conform to binary heteronormative gender norms.
alt_translation1: Cobardía, miedo, temor. Este término se usa con connotaciones negativas para referirse a la personalidad de hombres que no se adhieren a los cánones binarios y heterosexuales de género.

Description: Childhood, childishness. It may also be used to refer to virginity.
alt_translation1: Niñez, niñería, cosa de niños. También puede usarse para referirse a la virginidad.

Description: Behavior and cultural practices of those external to the community. May be used to refer to cases in which someone rejects their traditional practices and adopts those of some other community.
alt_translation1: Comportamiento y prácticas culturales de quien es extranjero. También se refiere al caso de una persona que rechaza las prácticas culturales de su comunidad y adopta aquellas de otra.

Description: Pretentious and arrogant personality of someone who sticks their nose everywhere shamelessly, thinks they are a know-it-all, and never acknowledges not to know something.
alt_translation1: Personalidad pretenciosa y engreída de alguien que no le importa dónde se mete, no le da pena, dice que todo lo sabe y nunca reconoce cuando no sabe algo.

Description: Something cutesy or adorable. Also, to monkey around.
alt_translation1: Monería, o portarse como un mono.

Description: Having the means to live comfortably.
alt_translation1: El hecho de tener los medios para vivir cómodamente.

Description: Name given in Juchitán de Zaragoza to a children's game played with a ball. Each child makes a hole in the ground to be their individual base. In addition, there is a common base and a line where the players stand at the start. From the line, a child throws the ball into one of the holes. The child to whom the hole corresponds must fetch the ball and stand in the hole. Meanwhile, the other players run to the base. When the child has the ball, they throw it in the air and everyone runs to their respective hole. When the child catches the ball, he tries to throw it to any child who has not reached their hole. If the ball hits a child, that child puts a pebble in their hole. Whoever gets to three pebbles gets a punishment.
alt_translation1: Nombre que se le da en Juchitán de Zaragoza a un juego infantil que se juega con una pelota. Cada niño hace un agujero en la tierra para que sea su base individual. Además, hay una base común y una raya donde los jugadores se colocan al empezar. Desde la raya, un niño lanza la pelota a uno de los agujeros. El niño al que le corresponde el agujero debe ir por la pelota y pararse en el agujero. Mientras, los demás jugadores corren hacia la base. Cuando el niño tiene la pelota, la lanza al aire y todos corren a su respectivo agujero. Cuando el niño atrapa la pelota intenta lanzársela a algún otro niño que no haya llegado a su agujero. Si lo toca, el niño al que ha tocado pone una piedrita en su agujero. El que llegue a tres piedrecitas recibe un castigo.

Description: Jiménez Girón (1979:82) explains that, in the context of dog behavior, this lexeme refers to the act of biting without prior warning in the form of a growl or a bark.
alt_translation1: Jiménez Girón (1979:82) explica que en el contexto del comportamiento de perros, este lexema se refiere al acto de morder sin antes prevenir con un gruñido o ladrido.

Description: To join in collective efforts to cover an expense or some other need. Jiménez Girón (1979:82) mentions the common practice among women to buy together corn in bulk. The corn is then distributed based on each woman's contribution.
alt_translation1: Cooperación para cubrir gastos o alguna otra necesidad. Con relación a este concepto, Jiménez Girón (1979:82) menciona la práctica de las mujeres de juntarse entre varias para comprar mazorca a granel, lo cual implica una repartición de la mazorca según la cooperación de cada mujer.

Description: Jiménez Girón (1979:82) describes the meaning of this lexeme as an admonition put in verse, and with a humorous bent, that groups of young people used to make until the early half of the XXth century, to furtive lovers, with the intention of denouncing someone's reprehensible behavior. These admonitions were delivered on Easter or Christmas nights, in public, out loud, near the home of the person being denounced.
alt_translation1: Jiménez Girón (1979:82) describe el significado de este lexema como "amonestación versificada y jocosa que grupos de jóvenes en voz alta y a guisa de discurso rimado, solían hacer hasta hace poco a los furtivos enamorados, con delatoras intenciones en las noches de Pascua o Navidad, parándose en las cercanías hogareñas correspondientes".

Description: The act of joining hands, and by extension, marriage or wedding.
alt_translation1: El acto de juntar las manos, y por extensión, el casamiento o la boda.

Description: Game played with a ball which is aimed at holes on the ground that are used as bases.
alt_translation1: Juego de pelota que utiliza hoyos como base, y uno apunta con la pelota a estos.

Description: The literal meaning of this lexeme refers to the act of making an animal sit. However, it is used to describe the act of smoking marijuana.
alt_translation1: Este lexema significa literalmente el hacer que un animal se siente, pero se usa para describir el acto de fumar marihuana.

Description: Sniff. Jiménez Girón (1979:189) specifies that the verb associated with this nominalization is restricted to refer to quadrupeds.
alt_translation1: Olisqueo, husmeo. Jiménez Girón (1979:189) especifica que el verbo asociado con este lexema "se aplica más propiamente a los cuadrúpedos".

Description: For a marriage ceremony, people close to the bride and groom are selected and asked to gift important elements of the ceremony. These chosen people then enter a close relationship of support with the bride, the groom and their parents that is as strong as a kinship relationship. This lexeme refers to the act of entering into this relationship by way of lighting candles during the marriage ceremony.
alt_translation1: Este lexema se refiere al momento en que los padrinos de boda alumbran velas como una forma de consolidar su apadrinamiento.

Description: Act of painting and more specifically, coloring.
alt_translation1: Acción de pintar, iluminar, dar color.

Description: The act of spitting. A spit.
alt_translation1: El acto de escupir. El escupitajo.
Una cogida, un polvo (manera coloquial de referirse a tener sexo).

Description: Wake. Jiménez Girón (1979:232) refers to a hospice-type visit made at night to someone who is dying.
alt_translation1: Velorio. Jiménez Girón (1979:232) hace alusión a "la visita nocturna que se hace a un moribundo para darle asistencia".

Description: Blessing of the bride and groom by the zhuaana ngola who leads a wedding ceremony.
alt_translation1: La bendición nupcial llevada a cabo por el xuanna' ngola quien dirige la ceremonia de matrimonio.

Description: Game in which chips are thrown into a circle and whomever is furthest from the center has to expose their spinning top to for others to hit with their own spinning tops.
alt_translation1: Juego de trompo en el que se tiran fichas a un círculo y el que queda más lejos pone su trompo para que otros le peguen con sus trompos.

Description: Game in a belt is hidden so that it can be found.
alt_translation1: Se refiere a un juego en donde se esconde un cinturón y hay que encontrarlo.

Description: For a marriage ceremony, people close to the bride and groom are selected and asked to gift important elements of the ceremony. These chosen people then enter a close relationship of support with the bride, the groom and their parents that is as strong as a kinship relationship. Jiménez Jiménez & Marcial Cerqueda (2000) describe the meaning of this lexeme in the context of this relationship of support. This lexeme refers to the moment within a marriage ceremony in which the parents of the bride and the groom, and those who supported the wedding, give each other a hug in recognition of their new relationship.
alt_translation1: Jiménez Jiménez & Marcial Cerqueda (2000) explican que este lexema se refiere al abrazo entre compadres y consuegros como un momento que se celebra en un casamiento.

Description: For a marriage ceremony, people close to the bride and groom are selected and asked to gift important elements of the ceremony. These chosen people then enter a close relationship of support with the bride, the groom and their parents that is as strong as a kinship relationship. Jiménez Girón (1979:81) describes the meaning of this lexeme in the context of this relationship of support. This lexeme refers to the moment within a ceremony when the marriage is blessed and in which the parents of the bride and the groom, and those who supported the wedding, give each other a hug in recognition of their new relationship.
alt_translation1: Jiménez Girón (1979:81) define este lexema como "el abrazo mutuo de compadres y consuegros en la noche de la bendición nupcial".

Description: Attitude of taking things as a game.
alt_translation1: Actitud de tomar las cosas como un juego.

Description: Completion, end. Jiménez Girón (1979:81) defines this lexeme as the act of bringing something to completion.
alt_translation1: Término, fin. Jiménez Girón (1979:81) define este lexema como "el acto de terminar o acabar".

Description: Rotting, putrefaction, infection (in reference to a body part).
alt_translation1: Podredumbre, putrefacción, infección (dicho de una parte del cuerpo).

Description: Term of address for General Heliodoro Charis Castro.
Sweet tamal usually offered when adobe is applied to a house, or during the Holy Cross festivities.
alt_translation1: Tamal de dulce que se suele ofrecer cuando se pone adobe en las paredes de una casa, o en la celebración conocida como la Labrada de cera en honor a la Santa Cruz.

Description: Sweet tamal usually offered when adobe is applied to a house, or during the Holy Cross festivities.
alt_translation1: Tamal de dulce que se suele ofrecer cuando se pone adobe en las paredes de una casa, o en la celebración conocida como la Labrada de cera en honor a la Santa Cruz.

Description: Tamal made of corn dough and condimented only with skunk weed (Dysphania ambrosioides).
alt_translation1: Tamal de masa sencillo, solo con epazote (Dysphania ambrosioides).

Description: Small tamal made with sweet corn and steamed in a pot.
alt_translation1: Tamalito de elote cocido en olla.

Description: Small tortilla designed to hold food flat.
Type of hand made tortilla baked in a clay oven. It is round, thick and firm, with indentations that prevent it from sticking to the oven. This particular type is wider than others.
Tortilla that is fried to harden it so that it may hold food.
alt_translation1: Tortilla que se fríe para hacer tostada.

Description: Large, thin tortilla cooked on a griddle until slightly crisp.
Tamal made only with corn dough and no meat or sauce. It is shaped longer than other types of tamal and is wrapped in dried but softened corn husks.
alt_translation1: Tamal de masa, sin carne ni mole, más largo que otros tamales y envuelto en totomoxtle.

Description: Sweet tamal named "child's foot tamal" because it is quite thick.
alt_translation1: Tamal dulce que por lo grueso se les llama tamal de pie de niño.

Description: Tamal made with shrimp or fish and cooked in a clay oven.
alt_translation1: Tamal de camarón o pescado cocido en horno de barro o comiscal.

Description: Type of hand made tortilla baked in a clay oven. It is round, thick and firm, with indentations that prevent it from sticking to the oven. Given the baking method, this type of tortilla keeps well for several days.
alt_translation1: Tortilla gruesa y firme que se cuece en horno de barro o comiscal. Tiene muescas para evitar que se pegue al horno. Por el método de cocción se conserva por varios días.

Description: Tortilla that is round and thick with an edge so that it may be garnished. It is baked in a clay oven.
alt_translation1: Tortilla o memela redonda que se cuece en horno de barro o comiscal.

Description: Tortilla with an elongated shape and designed to hold food flat. It is baked in a clay oven.
alt_translation1: Memela alargada cocida en horno de barro o comiscal.

Description: Tortilla made with pumpkin seeds, and that is round and firm. It is baked in a clay oven.
alt_translation1: Totopo de semilla de calabaza cocida en horno de barro o comiscal.

Description: Soft tortilla cooked on a griddle.
Tamal made with green iguana. It is generally made around Easter when the green iguana is abundant.
alt_translation1: Tamal de iguana. Se prepara en torno a Semana Santa cuando abunda la iguana verde.

Description: Tortilla made with fresh corn and cooked on a griddle.
alt_translation1: Tortilla de maíz fresco cocida en comal.

Description: Tortilla referred to as cow's tongue due to its shape.
alt_translation1: Tortilla que por su forma se le conoce como lengua de vaca.

Description: Type of hand made tortilla baked in a clay oven. It is round, thick and firm, with indentations that prevent it from sticking to the oven. This particular type of tortilla has butter added to the dough.
alt_translation1: Totopo elaborado con mantequilla y cocido en horno de barro o comiscal.

Description: Small tortilla designed to hold food flat.

Type of hand made tortilla baked in a clay oven. It is round, thick and firm, with indentations that prevent it from sticking to the oven. This particular type of tortilla has whey added to the dough.
alt_translation1: Totopo elaborado con suero de leche de vaca.

Description: Type of hand made tortilla baked in a clay oven. It is round, thick and firm, with indentations that prevent it from sticking to the oven. This particular type is characteristic of the towns of Ciudad Ixtepec, Asunción Ixtaltepec, and San Blas Atempa.
alt_translation1: Totopo elaborado al estilo de Ciudad Ixtepec, Asunción Ixtaltepec, y San Blas Atempa.

Description: Tortilla that is hardened to hold food.
Tortilla with no added flavoring, or that is eaten without food to go with it.
alt_translation1: Totopo o tortilla a la que no se le agrega nada de sabor o que se come sin acompañar comida.

Description: Small round tortilla made with cracked, sweetened corn.
alt_translation1: Memelita de maíz quebrado y endulzado.

Description: Type of hand made tortilla baked in a clay oven. It is round, thick and firm, with indentations that prevent it from sticking to the oven. Given the baking method, this type of tortilla keeps well for several days.
alt_translation1: Tortilla gruesa y firme que se cuece en horno de barro o comiscal. Tiene muescas para evitar que se pegue al horno. Por el método de cocción se conserva por varios días.

Description: Fire, blaze, flame, spark, ember. By extension, war, battle, inflammation.
alt_translation1: Fuego, lumbre, llama, chispa, brasa. Por extensión, guerra, batalla, inflamación.

Description: Stupid, idiot. This lexeme can also refer to someone with a cognitive disability, but it does so offensively and should be avoided.
alt_translation1: Tonto, idiota, sin juicio. Este lexema también se usa para referirse a una persona con discapacidad cognitiva de manera despectiva, por lo cual debe evitarse este uso.

Description: Tamped down, stuffed. This lexeme may be used, probably pejoratively, to refer to an unmarried woman who becomes pregnant.
alt_translation1: Apisonado, atascado, apretujado. Se puede utilizar para referirse, probablemente de manera despectiva, a una mujer soltera que resulta embarazada.

Description: This adjective describes someone who farts a lot.
Town of San Pedro Huilotepec, Oaxaca, Mexico.
To become submerged, to sink, to be overtaken by water. By extension, to be consumed, to run out.
alt_translation1: Sumergirse, hundirse, ser consumido por el agua. Por extensión, gastarse, consumirse, acabarse.

Description: This lexeme refers to an entry-level community service role that men in many communities must fulfill. This role involves assisting the local authorities in a variety of tasks, as well as maintaining order in the community. By extension of the latter, this lexeme is also used to refer to a police officer.
Excrement, poop, shit. By extension, someone who is considered useless or worthless.
alt_translation1: Excremento, popó, caca, mierda. Por extensión, alguien que se considera inútil o despreciable.

Description: Paper. By extension, document, letter, written work.
alt_translation1: Papel. Por extensión, documento, carta, trabajo escrito.

Description: Jiménez Girón (1979:88) describes this lexeme as an old coin that was worth one cent.
alt_translation1: Jiménez Girón (1979:88) describe este lexema como "moneda antigua que valía un tlaco, o sea 1 centavo".

Description: Forest that is so dense that only deer can navigate through it.
alt_translation1: Monte bajo y tupido donde solo los venados pueden pasar.

Description: Dense, virgin forest, like the jungle.
alt_translation1: Monte tupido y vírgen como la selva.

Description: Locality known as Colonia Álvaro Obregón belonging to Juchitán de Zaragoza, Oaxaca.
alt_translation1: Colonia Álvaro Obregón, agencia municipal de Juchitán de Zaragoza, Oaxaca.

Description: Forest that is so dense that only deer can navigate through it.
alt_translation1: Monte bajo y tupido donde solo los venados pueden pasar.

Description: Dense, virgin forest, like the jungle.
alt_translation1: Monte tupido y vírgen como la selva.

Description: Fruit fibers as in the case of mango and mamey, or skin, nerves and sinew in meats.
alt_translation1: Fibras de fruta como el mango o el mamey, o los pellejos, tendones y nervios de la carne.
Pelusa (lit. pelo de pluma de ave).

Description: Eyelashes, according to some community members in La Ventosa.
alt_translation1: Pestaña, según algunos habitantes de La Ventosa.

Description: Some community members in Santa María Xadani translate this lexeme as eyebrow.
alt_translation1: Algunos en Santa María Xadani traducen este lexema como ceja.
Barbas en el pecho de los guajolotes.

Description: Foreskin, and possibly also the frenulum.
alt_translation1: Prepucio, y posiblemente también el frenillo del pene.

Description: Leather pad in a slingshot where the stone is placed before shooting.
alt_translation1: Almohadilla de cuero de una resortera donde se coloca la piedra para tirar.

Description: Round discoloration of the skin associated with dryness.
Exterior covering of living beings, such as skin, fish scales, the peel of fruits and vegetables, and tree bark.
alt_translation1: Recubrimiento que tienen las entidades vivas, como por ejemplo, la piel, el pellejo, las escamas de pescado, las cáscaras de frutas y verduras, y la corteza de árboles.

Description: Skin around the eye where eyelashes grow, and the eyelid.
alt_translation1: Piel en torno al ojo donde salen las pestañas, así como el párpado.

Description: Columella (i.e. the skin in between the nostrils).
alt_translation1: Columela (i.e. la piel entre las fosas nasales).

Description: Pimples that appear on the nape and the back in children. They are considered to be caused by spending time on a cold floor, eating salty foods or not receiving attention when sought.
alt_translation1: Espinillas que salen en la nuca y la espalda de las infancias Se considera que la causa es pasar mucho tiempo en el suelo frío, comer alimentos salados o no recibir atención cuando la solicitan.

Description: Illness involving seizures akin to epilepsy although conceptually distinct. Some use this term to refer to an oral condition in babies that could be candidiasis or thrush.
alt_translation1: Alferecía. Algunas llaman de esta manera a una afección de la boca en los bebés que pudiera ser la candidosis.

Description: Zoque town of San Juan Guichicovi, Oaxaca, Mexico.
alt_translation1: El pueblo Zoque de San Juan Guichicovi, Oaxaca, México.

Description: World, planet Earth. Jiménez Girón (1979:86) also uses this lexeme to refer to the universe.
alt_translation1: Mundo, planeta Tierra. Jiménez Girón (1979:86) también utiliza este lexema para referirse al universo.

Description: Town of San Francisco Ixhuatán, Oaxaca, Mexico.
Municipality of Santa María Xadani, Oaxaca, Mexico.
alt_translation1: Municipio de Santa María Xadani, Oaxaca, México.

Description: City known as Heroica Ciudad de Juchitán de Zaragoza, Oaxaca, Mexico. Jiménez Girón (1979:86) explains that the name San Vicente was imposed on the Nahuatl name Ixtaxochitlan, which referred to the white flowers of the trees Bourreria purpusii and Bourreria huanita belonging to the Boraginaceae family.
alt_translation1: Heroica Ciudad de Juchitán de Zaragoza, Oaxaca, México. Jiménez Girón (1979:86) explica que el nombre de San Vicente fue impuesto sobre el nombre de Ixtaxochitlan proveniente del Náhuatl y que hacía referencia a las flores blancas de los árboles de las especies Bourreria purpusii y Bourreria huanita pertenecientes a la familia Boraginaceae.

Description: Metal, iron. By extension, this lexeme can be used to name a variety of metal objects, ex. musical instruments, bells, fire arms, knives, computers, etc.
