Description: Spoiled, in the sense of creature comforts. Name that can be given to cattle.
alt_translation1: Consentida. Nombre que se le puede dar al ganado.

Description: Children's game for teams of 4 to 6 players. Each team has a pebble that is passed from player to player. A player from the other team has to guess who has the pebble. As they play, the players sing the song shown in the example below.
alt_translation1: Juego infantil por equipos de 4 a 6 jugadores. En cada equipo hay una piedrita que se va pasando de jugador en jugador. Un jugador del otro equipo tiene que adivinar quién tiene la piedra. Mientras juegan, cantan la cantaleta que se muestra en el ejemplo a continuación.

Description: Sound symbolic word that refers to a broody hen.
alt_translation1: Palabra derivada del sonido (simbolismo fonológico) de una gallina culeca para referirse a esta.

Description: Desert coral snake (Family Elapidae, genus Micrurus).
Heart. Also used as an endearing term akin to "dear" or "honey".
Section of the front of the house that is covered by a roof but is otherwise open. The pillars that hold the roof also serve to hang hammocks.
alt_translation1: Corredor techado que suelen tener las casas en la entrada para proteger la entrada del sol, y donde suelen colgarse las hamacas.
Postemilla, aftas o fuegos que salen en la boca.

Description: Individual who is paid to smuggle people from Mexico into the United States.
alt_translation1: Coyote, en el sentido de la persona que se contrata para pasar gente de México a los Estados Unidos.

Description: Leather strap used to tie the oxen to the yoke.
alt_translation1: Barzón, correa de cuero para uncir o amarrar la yunta.

Description: Sound of the neck of a person moving their head repeatedly and quickly.
alt_translation1: Sonido de la nuca de una persona moviendo la cabeza continuamente.

Description: Comb of a rooster, or crest in other birds.
Sound of a fruit that dries and shrinks.
alt_translation1: Sonido de una fruta que se seca y se hace pequeña.

Description: Last name Cruz. It also refers to the religious celebration known as the Passion of the Cross.
alt_translation1: Apellido Cruz. También se refiere a la celebración religiosa conocida como Pasión de la Cruz.

Description: Domestic worker. This lexeme often has a pejorative connotation.
alt_translation1: Empleada doméstica. Este lexema suele tener connotaciones despectivas.

Description: Sound used to scare off cats.
alt_translation1: Sonido que se usa para espantar gatos.

Description: Eye of an axe, shovel or adze where the wooden handle is wedged.
alt_translation1: Ojo de una hacha, pala o azuela donde se introduce el mango de madera.

Description: Sound used to call over a pig.
alt_translation1: Sonido que se usa para llamar a un cerdo.

Description: Exclamation used to stop someone, especially a young child, from touching a wound so that it can heal.
alt_translation1: Exclamación que se usa para evitar que alguien, sobre todo un niño pequeño, se toque una lesión de manera que esta pueda sanar.

Description: Dance music genre known as cumbia.
The sister of a sister-in-law or a brother-in-law.
The brother of a sister-in-law or a brother-in-law.
The brother of a sister-in-law or a brother-in-law.

alt_translation1: Cura, remedio para algún malestar de salud.

Description: Blade of a tool. Knife pleats of a skirt.
alt_translation1: Cuchilla, ya sea de una herramienta o de una falda.

Description: Nixtamalized corn dough. By extension, drinks made with this type of dough, and anything that has its consistency.
alt_translation1: Masa de maíz. Por extensión, el pozol y otros derivados de la masa y lo que se le parece.

Description: Nixtamalized maize flour made with dried corn kernels. Jiménez Girón (1979:51) describes it as corn kernels that are boiled and made to burst, then ground dry to preserve them and to take with them when working in the fields.
alt_translation1: Masa hecha de maíz seco. Jiménez Girón (1979:51) la describe como "el pozol de maíz reventado por ebullición, que se muele en seco para no descomponerse y poderlo llevar a las faenas campestres".

Description: Nixtamalized maize flour made with dried corn kernels. Jiménez Girón (1979:51) describes it as corn kernels that are boiled and made to burst, then ground dry to preserve them and to take with them when working in the fields.
alt_translation1: Masa hecha de maíz seco. Jiménez Girón (1979:51) la describe como "el pozol de maíz reventado por ebullición, que se muele en seco para no descomponerse y poderlo llevar a las faenas campestres".

Description: Cacao-based drink served in a gourd bowl.
alt_translation1: Bebida que se prepara a base de cacao y se sirve en jícara.

Description: Drink made with ground corn and cacao beans.
Nixtamalized maize dough used to make tortillas.
alt_translation1: Masa de maíz para hacer tortilla.

Description: Jiménez Girón (1979:51) describes this as a drink prepared with toasted and ground mamey seeds to give the drink its aroma and flavor, and sweetened with a type of molasses made from raw sugar. This drink used to be offered before a wedding.
alt_translation1: Jiménez Girón (1979:51) describe esta bebida como "pozol preparado con semilla o almendra tostada y molida de mamey, para dar aroma y sabor, endulzándolo con miel de panela". Esta bebida se solía tomar antes de una boda.

Description: Fresh farmer's cheese made with cow's milk.
alt_translation1: Queso fresco hecho con leche de vaca.

Description: Water used to keep maize dough moist.
alt_translation1: Agua para remojar masa y que no se seque.

Description: Corn kernels ground in a hand mill.
alt_translation1: Maíz molido con molino de mano.

Description: Maize used for making a drink known in Spanish as pozol.
Metal bucket-like container specifically used for nixtamalization of corn kernels.
alt_translation1: Olla similar a una cubeta, hecha de metal, y utilizada específicamente para cocer el maíz para nixtamal.

Description: Sash for men. This lexeme can also be used to refer to a belt made with snake skin.
alt_translation1: Ceñidor para hombres. Algunos también usan este lexema para referirse a un cinturón hecho de piel de culebra.

Description: Describes a person who speaks ill of others.
Neighborhood known as Colonia Orlando Guerra.
Swing, i.e. a short and somewhat wide plank suspended by ropes where children can swing for entertainment.
Committee of the political party known as Partido de la Revolución Democrática.
alt_translation1: Comité del Partido de la Revolución Democrática.

Description: Fermented drink flavored with fresh mango.
Fermented drink flavored with fresh nance (likely Byrsonima crassifolia).
A woman who is a healer.
A man who is a healer.
A woman who is a cook.
Convincing. This participle derives from the notion of softening. It can be used to refer to a man who is adept at seducing women.
alt_translation1: Convencedor. Este participio proviene del concepto de ablandar. Se puede usar para describir a un hombre que seduce a las mujeres.

Description: Strap of leather used to tie cattle to a yoke.
Quarter, referring to a unit of measure such as kilos, liters, etc.
alt_translation1: Cuarto, ya sea de kilo, de litro, o de alguna otra unidad de medida.
Sonido del llamado de una codorniz.

Description: Political party known as Coalición Obrera, Campesina, Estudiantil del Istmo.
alt_translation1: Partido político llamado Coalición Obrera, Campesina, Estudiantil del Istmo.

Description: Handbreadth, unit of measurement equivalent to the extension of the hand from the thumb to the little finger.
alt_translation1: Cuarta, medida equivalente a la extensión de la mano desde el pulgar hasta el meñique.
Sonido que hace el pato al graznar.

Description: This lexeme is used to refer to substances, usually plants, with chemical properties that can be toxic and/or medicinal. It is also used to refer to the various methods of administering such substances, for example, a laxative or an enema.
alt_translation1: Este lexema se usa para referirse a sustancias, generalmente plantas, con propiedades químicas que pueden ser tóxicas y/o curativas. También se usa para referirse a los distintos métodos de administración de dichas sustancias, como por ejemplo a un purgante o a una lavativa.

Description: This lexeme can be used to refer in a less vulgar way to a woman's genitals.
alt_translation1: Este lexema se puede usar para referirse de manera menos vulgar a los genitales de una mujer.

Description: Vaginal bleeding that a woman experiences when having a miscarriage or an abortion.
alt_translation1: Sangrado vaginal de una mujer que tiene un aborto ya sea espontáneo o elegido.

Description: Political party known as Coalición Obrera, Campesina, Estudiantil del Istmo.
alt_translation1: Partido político llamado Coalición Obrera, Campesina, Estudiantil del Istmo.
Chueco, que perdió su forma original.

Description: Unit of measure equivalent to four liters.
alt_translation1: Cuartillo, medida equivalente a cuatro litros.

Description: White owl, which is feared because it is believed to announce the death of the person to whom it appears.
alt_translation1: El cortamortaja, lechuza blanca temida, pues se cree que anuncia la muerte de la persona a quien se le aparece.

Description: Sound of a frog when it rains.
alt_translation1: Sonido de una rana en tiempo de lluvia.
Cuenta, en el sentido de una operación de aritmética o su resultado.

Description: Tendon (and possibly also ligament), nerve or artery.
alt_translation1: Tendón (y posiblemente ligamento), nervio o arteria.

Description: Any tendon (and possibly also any ligament) in the hand.
alt_translation1: Cualquier tendón (y posiblemente también cualquier ligamento) de la mano.

Description: Any tendon (and possibly also any ligament) in the calf or the foot.
alt_translation1: Cualquier tendón (y posiblemente también cualquier ligamento) de la pantorilla o del pie.

Description: Any of the arteries along the neck.
Any tendon (and possibly also any ligament) of the knee.
alt_translation1: Cualquier tendón (y posiblemente también cualquier ligamento) de la rodilla.
Borde u orilla de un río.

Description: Temple (i.e. flat side of the head).
Flank of a human, back of a quadruped.
alt_translation1: Costado de un humano, lomo de animal cuadrúpedo.
Región de la articulación de la mandíbula.

Description: Sound of a knock on the head with two fingers.
alt_translation1: Sonido de un coscorrón con dos dedos.

Description: Bent out of shape, ex. due to exposure to heat.
alt_translation1: Chueco, como algo que se enchueca por exposición al calor.

Description: Bird of prey considered to bring along the northern winds and announce weather changes (possibly Herpetotheres cachinnans).
alt_translation1: Ave de rapiña que se considera que llama el viento del norte y anuncia cambio en el estado del tiempo (posiblemente Herpetotheres cachinnans).

Description: Sound of scratching, as when one scratches an itch.
alt_translation1: Sonido de rasquido, como cuando se rasca una comezón.

Description: The skeleton as a representation of death rather than as the anatomical structure.

Interrogative particle that marks yes/no questions or requests agreement. Sometimes equivalent to 'right?' This particle may also mark the end of a clause in which case it may be followed by a brief pause and does not necessarily elicit a reaction from the interlocutor.
alt_translation1: Partícula interrogativa que marca preguntas cuya respuesta sería un sí o un no, o que pide ratificación. Equivalente a veces a '¿no?'. Esta partícula también marca el final de una cláusula en cuyo caso puede ser seguida de una breve pausa y no necesariamente provoca una intervención del interlocutor.
Lado izquierdo. Oeste, poniente (si se está mirando hacia el norte).
Lado derecho. Este, oriente (si se está mirando hacia el norte).

Description: South, from where the wind blows.
alt_translation1: Sur, por donde sopla el viento.

Description: Refers to the thicker type of twisted gold chain necklace. It is worn with one part wrapped around the neck like a choker and another long part hanging down. It is usually decorated with two coins: a coin known in Spanish as onza mounted on flowers and leaves, and a large coin known in Spanish as centenario (or similar) in the dangling part of the necklace. A more modest version of this necklace uses knots instead of coins.
alt_translation1: Se refiere al tipo de collar de oro torcido más grueso. Se usa con una parte enrollada en el cuello como gargantilla y otra parte larga colgando. Suele llevar dos monedas: una moneda de onza montada sobre flores y hojas, y una moneda de centenario o una moneda grande en la parte del collar que cuelga. Una versión más modesta de este collar lleva nudos en lugar de monedas.

Description: Particle that precedes an imperative form of a verb directed at two or more interlocutors.
alt_translation1: Partícula que precede a un verbo imperativo dirigido a dos o más interlocutores.

Description: Large handmade sack or bag for carrying bulk foods such as rice and similar items.
alt_translation1: Saco grande hecho a mano para cargar arroz y otros alimentos a granel.

Description: Holiday, religious festivity, celebration, onomastic observance, birthday, anniversary.
alt_translation1: Día festivo, fiesta religiosa, festividad, onomástico, cumpleaños, aniversario.

Description: Festivities in honor of Saint John in June.
alt_translation1: Celebración en honor a San Juan en el mes de junio.

Description: Festivities in honor of Saint Anthony in June.
alt_translation1: Celebración en honor a San Antonio de Padua en el mes de junio.

Description: Celebration in honor of the Saint whose name one bears.
alt_translation1: Onomástico, día del santo de una persona.

Description: Particle that follows an imperative form of a verb to present it in the form of a request.
alt_translation1: Partícula que le sigue a un verbo imperativo para expresar que se hace una solicitud.

Description: Extension of land, especially agricultural land.
Central point of the sole of the foot, arch of the foot.
alt_translation1: Punto central de la planta del pie, el arco del pie.

Description: Central point of the palm of the hand.
alt_translation1: Punto central de la palma de la mano.

Description: Central point of the palm of the hand.
alt_translation1: Punto central de la palma de la mano.

Description: Mourning. By extension, this lexeme may refer to stillness.
alt_translation1: Luto, duelo. Por extensión puede hacer alusión a la tranquilidad.

Description: Long plant fibers often used for cordage and basket weaving. This lexeme can also refer to lianas.
alt_translation1: Fibras largas que se sacan de las plantas generalmente para elaborar canastas y cuerda. También se usa este lexema para referirse a las lianas.
Luz clara y brillante de la luna.

Description: A single leather sandal without its pair and without it being worn.
alt_translation1: Un huarache solo, sin su par y sin estar puesto.

Description: A dark cloud that blocks the light.
alt_translation1: Nube negra que llega a tapar la luz.

Description: Land, plot of land, ground, floor.

Referential particle to which bound pronouns or the plural marker can cliticize. This is used in cases where the utterance does not involve a verb stem to which the bound morphemes can attach as when a referent is topicalized or focalized.
alt_translation1: Partícula que hace referencia a una entidad de la que se habla y que permite que un morfema dependiente tenga una base a la cual se pueda adherir. Esto suele ocurrir cuando no hay una raíz verbal a la cual se pueda adherir un pronombre dependiente o el marcador del plural como cuando se focaliza la entidad de la que se habla.

Description: First person plural inclusive reflexive pronoun.
alt_translation1: Pronombre reflexivo de segunda persona del plural inclusivo equivalente a 'nosotros mismos'.

Description: ¡Let's see if...!, Exclamation used in challenging someone.
alt_translation1: ¡A poco!, ¡a ver si es cierto!, ¡a ver si sí!, exclamación para retar a alguien.

Description: Third person singular reflexive pronoun equivalent to 'themselves'.
alt_translation1: Pronombre reflexivo de tercera persona del singular equivalente a 'él mismo', 'ella misma' y 'sí mismo'.

Description: Second person singular reflexive pronoun equivalent to 'yourself'.
alt_translation1: Pronombre reflexivo de segunda persona equivalente a 'tú mismo' o 'ti mismo'.
Pronombre reflexivo de primera persona del singular equivalente a 'yo mismo' y 'mí mismo'.
Se suponía que, se decía que, pensaba que.

Description: Crown, garland, halo, especially the crown of basil and/or flowers worn by the women of a bride's family during the celebration.
alt_translation1: Corona, guirnalda, aureola, sobre todo la corona de albahaca y/o flores que se ponen las mujeres de la familia de una novia durante la celebración.

Description: Medicinal wash, especially when done on a woman's genitals.
alt_translation1: Lavado curativo, sobre todo cuando se trata de un lavado en los genitales de la mujer.
El entremedio, un espacio en medio.

Description: Circular frame that hangs from the ceiling and is used to store tortillas and other foods out of the reach of rodents.
alt_translation1: Marco circular que cuelga del techo y que sirve para guardar tortillas y otros alimentos fuera del alcance de los roedores.
Uno de estos días, de vez en cuando.

Description: Gusset or crotch of pants or underwear.
alt_translation1: Tiro del pantalón o del calzón.

Description: Refers to the eye. This noun can be used on its own or in compounds to refer to the tear gland, the eyelid, the eye lashes and the eye brows.
alt_translation1: Relativo al ojo. Este sustantivo se puede usar solo o bien en compuestos para nombrar la glándula lacrimal, el párpado, las pestañas, y las cejas.

Description: Wrinkles on the side of the eye known as crow's feet.
alt_translation1: Las arrugas en las orillas de los ojos que se conocen como patas de gallo.

Description: Lagartero Viejo. This is the former name of the community of La Ventosa and means "old alligator dwelling".
alt_translation1: Lagartero Viejo, que era el nombre antiguo de La Ventosa.
Erupción de la piel de tipo venérea.

Description: Soot. By extension, something black or dark.
alt_translation1: Tizne, hollín. Por extensión, algo negro u oscuro.

Description: Bad smelling, especially in relation to smells associated with blood, fish, egg or metal.
alt_translation1: Que huele feo o a choquilla, generalmente con relación al olor de sangre, pescado, huevo o metal.

Description: Black clothing worn during a period of mourning.
Hot compress that is tied to the center of the abdomen to cover the navel and the pit of the stomach. This has several purposes among them to assist in the recovery after childbirth.
alt_translation1: Compresa caliente que se amarra al centro del abdomen para cubrir el ombligo y la boca del estómago. Se utiliza por varias razones entre ellas para la recuperación de una persona después del parto.

Description: Wet compress to lower a fever.
alt_translation1: Compresa fría para bajar la temperatura.

Description: Bed linen, ex. bed sheet, blanket.
alt_translation1: Ropa de cama, ej. sábana, cobija.

Description: Black clothing worn during a period of mourning.
Black clothing worn at a time of mourning.
Lexeme that precedes gandè, the counting unit equivalent to twenty, to indicate multiples of said unit. It is equivalent to 'by' although its use is limited to collocations with gandè.
alt_translation1: Lexema que antecede a gandè, la unidad de conteo equivalente a veinte, para indicar los múltiplos de tal unidad. Equivalente a 'por' aunque su uso se limita en colocación con gandè.

Description: Name of a river in the community of La Ventosa.
alt_translation1: Nombre de un río ubicado en La Ventosa.

Description: Tooth of a human or non-human animal. By extension, the tooth of a gear.
alt_translation1: Diente de animal humano o no humano. Por extensión, diente de un engranaje y de objetos similares.

Description: Scale (ex. the plate-like coverings of a fish).
Insect whose urine irritates the skin causing blisters. Some are small, others are green, and others are thorny.
alt_translation1: Insecto cuya orina irrita la piel y produce ampollas. Algunos son pequeños, otros son de color verde, y otros son espinosos.

Description: Measure equivalent to the extension from the thumb to the index finger.
alt_translation1: Medida equivalente a la extensión del pulgar al índice.

Description: Demonym that refers to the inhabitants of the town of El Espinal. This demonym is also used in nickname, ex. Juán Lenyú', Maryá Lenyá'.
alt_translation1: Gentilicio referente a los habitantes de El Espinal. Se usa en ciertos apodos como por ejemplo, ej. Juan Lenyú', Mariá Leniá'.

Description: Sound of a common house gecko.
Metal file (i.e. metal tool for smoothing surfaces).
Cleaning in general (ex. house cleaning). Cleansing (ex. spiritual cleansing).

Cata (2012:11) explains that the term libanà simply means 'speech' and is associated with the speech delivered by the xuaana 'main leader' during the ceremony of blessing the bride and groom, called guendariuundaaya. This speech introduces and integrates the newly married couple into Zapotec society, teaching them the social and religious value of marriage, family, neighborhood and friendship.
alt_translation1: Cata (2012:11) explica que "El término libanà significa a secas 'discurso'... Algunos lo han vinculado con el discurso que pronuncia el xuaana ‘señor principal’, durante la ceremonia de la Bendición de los novios, llamado guendariuundaaya’... cumple con la función de presentar a la nueva pareja matrimonial ante la sociedad zapoteca e insertarla en ella, de inculcar el valor social y religioso del matrimonio, de fortalecer los vínculos familiares, de vecindad y amistad."

Description: Completion of a duty or responsibility, ex. the completion of a work day.
alt_translation1: Conclusión de un compromiso, ej. fin de una jornada de trabajo.

Description: Fence built with cinder blocks or bricks.
alt_translation1: Barda hecha de tabiques o de ladrillo.

Description: Any living creature's dwelling, ex. house, nest, den. hive.
alt_translation1: Vivienda de cualquier ser vivo, ej. casa, nido, guarida, panal.

Description: Cultural center in Juchitán de Zaragoza, Oaxaca.
alt_translation1: Casa de la Cultura en Juchitán de Zaragoza, Oaxaca.

Description: Free second person singular pronoun which may may serve as subject as well as object.
alt_translation1: Pronombre independiente de segunda persona del singular que puede cumplir la función de sujeto y de objeto, equivalente a 'tú' y a 'tí'.

Description: Tied up, entangled. By extension, to be squeezed tight within a crowd.
alt_translation1: Amarrado, atado, enredado. Por extensión, apretujado en una multitud.

Description: Pleasant view. Name that can be given to cattle.
alt_translation1: Linda vista. Nombre que se le puede dar al ganado.

Description: Pleasant afternoon. Name that can be given to cattle.
alt_translation1: Linda tarde. Nombre que se le puede dar al ganado.

Description: Someone with a bachelor's degree in areas such as the humanities, social and natural sciences, or law.
This adjective describes a woman who is obsessed about money and shows it off by squandering it on alcohol or gambling.
alt_translation1: Este adjetivo describe a una mujer que se vuelve loca por el dinero y lo presume malgastándolo en alcohol o en juegos de azar.

Description: This adjective describes a man who is obsessed about money and shows it off by squandering it on alcohol or gambling.
alt_translation1: Este adjetivo describe a un hombre que se vuelve loco por el dinero y lo presume malgastándolo en alcohol o en juegos de azar.

Description: Cement slab built as a roof.
Heavy, describing the tongue of a person who articulates words differently from most people.
alt_translation1: Pesada, en referencia a la lengua de una persona que no articula las palabras como la mayoría de la gente.
Frente o superficie de algo. Encima o sobre algo.

Description: By analogy with the eyes of a living creature, this lexeme can also be used to refer to the headlights of a car and similar light sources in vehicles.
alt_translation1: Por analogía a los ojos de un ser vivo, este lexema se puede usar para referirse a las luces de un vehículo.

Description: Jiménez Girón (1979:109) states that this lexeme refers to the freshwater shrimp because its eyes protrude, simulating two necklace beads.
alt_translation1: Jiménez Girón (1979:109) indica que este lexema se refiere al "camarón de agua dulce... por tener los ojos completamente fuera de órbita, simulando dos cuentas de collar".

Description: A place located between Juchitán de Zaragoza and Santa María Xadani, near the sea, where the grass known as guixi donda (Sporobolus spartinus) is abundant.
alt_translation1: Paraje que se encuentra entre Juchitán de Zaragoza y Santa María Xadani, cerca del mar, y donde abunda la hierba conocida como guixi donda (Sporobolus spartinus).

Description: Row, line or queue of people.
alt_translation1: Fila, hilera o cola de personas.

Description: Expression used to refer to someone who is looking for something and cannot find it despite having it right in front of them.
alt_translation1: Expresión que se usa para referirse a alguien que busca algo y no lo encuentra pese a tenerlo justo en frente.

Description: Firstborn, the eldest child or brother.
alt_translation1: Primogénito, el primero o el mayor, refiriéndose a un hijo o un hermano.
Manzana de la montura de caballo.

Description: Butte located in La Ventosa and known in Spanish as Cerro El Merodio. Twelve wells were once drilled in this butte.
alt_translation1: Cerro El Merodio en La Ventosa donde se perforaron doce pozos.

Description: In someone's hands (ex. a decision that rests in someone's hands).
alt_translation1: En las manos de alguien (ej. una decisión que queda en las manos de una persona).

Description: Large, wide-open eyes, or eyes that look prominent because of dark circles under them.
alt_translation1: Ojos grandes, u ojos que se ven grandes por tener ojeras.

Description: With green, blue or amber-colored eyes, like a cat.
alt_translation1: Con ojos verdes, azules o color ámbar como de gato.

Description: Gaunt face. Light-skinned (neither dark nor white).
alt_translation1: Cara demacrada. Piel que no es ni morena ni blanca.

Description: Crow's-foot (i.e. the wrinkles at the outer corner of the eyes).
alt_translation1: Patas de gallo (i.e. las arrugas en las orillas de los ojos).

Description: Sad and pale look or expression.
Flatlands in the community of San Mateo del Mar.
alt_translation1: Llano de San Mateo del Mar.

Description: Flatlands in the community of Santa María del Mar.
alt_translation1: Llano de Santa María del Mar.

Description: Large, prominent eyes, resembling a deer.
alt_translation1: Ojos grandes o saltones, como de venado.

Description: Stunned or groggy look, as if drunk.
The front of a house. Window.
Forehead of a person, brow of other animals.
alt_translation1: Frente de la cara y cabeza de las personas y de otros animales.

Description: Abdominal region where the bladder is located.
alt_translation1: Región abdominal donde está la vejiga.

Description: Why?, exclamation to question an action or decision by others.
alt_translation1: ¿Por qué...?, exclamación para cuestionar una acción o decisión de otros.

Description: Bed made of reeds and plant stalks.
alt_translation1: Cama hecha de carrizo y pencas.

Description: Shaggy, bearded, with fringes, hairy, fibrous, like some sea animals, a shaggy dog, or a fibrous palm leaf.
alt_translation1: Lanudo, barbudo, flecudo, filamentoso, como algunos animales de mar, un perro lanudo, o una palma con muchos filamentos.

Description: Wool, beards, hair bangs, tassel, filaments, e.g. whiskers of some sea animals, the hair of a shaggy dog, palm fibers.
alt_translation1: Lana, barbas, fleco, filamentos, ej. barbas de algunos animales de mar, el pelo de un perro lanudo, filamentos de palma.

Description: ¡Woman!, ¡girl!, exclamation to call attention of a woman of any age.
alt_translation1: ¡Mujer!, ¡chica!, exclamación para llamar la atención de una mujer de cualquier edad.

Description: Sound of a person who ate something bitter.
alt_translation1: Sonido de una persona que comió algo amargo.
Sonido de un ternero de vaca.

Description: Sound of a moan because of a headache.
alt_translation1: Sonido de un quejido por dolor de cabeza.

Description: Sound of anger towards a child.
alt_translation1: Sonido de enojo hacia un niño.

Description: The municipality of Magdalena Tequisistlán, Oaxaca.
Really?, exclamation to prompt an interlocutor to confirm the veracity of their statement.
alt_translation1: ¿A poco?, exclamación para incitar al interlocutor a que confirme la veracidad de su enunciado.

Description: Ailment characterized by facial paralysis, alterations to the eyes or even death. It is caused by a current of air that is considered to be supernatural and can enter the body of a person while outside at night and even when warmly dressed. This ailment is associated with the cold. A healer is often consulted to alleviate this ailment through a healing ritual.
alt_translation1: Mal aire que puede causar parálisis de la cara, alteraciones de los ojos o incluso la muerte. Se considera que es un aire sobrenatural que puede llegarle a uno al salir de noche aun estando abrigado. Este mal está asociado con el frío. Para aliviarlo se recurre al curandero para santiguarse.

Description: This refers to a digestive ailment that can be loosely described in English as indigestion. However, culturally, this ailment is considered to be dangerous to the point of being fatal. It is caused by excessive consumption of something (ex. an infant who drinks too much maternal milk) and is perhaps a motivator for self-control. This lexeme may also refer to heart ailments.
Nickname given to a man by the name of Román as he is missing teeth. Chimuèllu is a Spanish loanword meaning 'missing teeth'.
alt_translation1: Apodo que designa a un hombre llamado Román por estar chimuelo.

Description: Nickname given to a man by the name of Román. Flàcu is a Spanish loanword meaning 'skinny'.
alt_translation1: Apodo que designa a un hombre llamado Román.

Description: Nickname given to a man by the name of Román as he is lean.
alt_translation1: Apodo que designa a un hombre llamado Román por ser magro.

Description: Nickname given to a man by the name of Román as he is large or tall. Ngola means 'male' and also 'big'.
alt_translation1: Apodo que designa a un hombre llamado Román por ser grande. Ngola significa 'macho' y también 'grande'.

Description: Nickname given to a man by the name of Román as he is missing a finger. Rúcu means 'truncated'.
alt_translation1: Apodo que designa a un hombre llamado Román por faltarle un dedo. Rúcu significa 'truncado'.

Description: Nickname given to a man by the name of Pedro.
alt_translation1: Apodo que designa a un hombre llamado Pedro.

Description: At that moment, as soon as, then.
alt_translation1: Pronto, en cuanto, de una vez, luego luego.

Description: Is it time now? Are you ready now? Are you / is it done now?
Really? No kidding! (Said to question the veracity of a statement.)
alt_translation1: ¿A poco? (Dicho para restarle credibilidad a una afirmación.)

Description: A man who is a healer and can determine if someone is the object of witchcraft so that he can free the person from it.
alt_translation1: Curandero que puede determinar si a una persona le están haciendo brujería y la puede santiguar.

Description: For many celebrations, people close to the person being celebrated are selected and asked to gift important elements of the festivity. These chosen people then enter into a close relationship of support with the person and close family members, especially the person's parents that is as strong as a kinship relationship. This lexeme is used to refer to the woman who enters into this relationship and to the mother of the person who is celebrated. It can also be used by a mother to refer their child's mother-in-law.
A woman who accepts to bless a child but does not acquire the responsibilities of a godmother.
alt_translation1: Comadre que santigua a un niño, pero no adquiere mucho compromiso.

Description: A woman belonging to a Huave community.
Mommy!, vocative used by crying children to get their mother's attention.
alt_translation1: ¡Mamá!, vocativo que usan los niños que están llorando.
Manchas en la piel, incluyendo las pecas.

Description: Skin discoloration that spreads, moves or multiplies.
alt_translation1: Mancha en la piel que se extiende, se desplaza o se multiplica.

Description: Fermented drink flavored with fresh mango.

alt_translation1: Manso, en relación con los animales.

Description: The month of March. From Spanish "marzo".
Master mason, carpenter or tailor. Also school teacher.
alt_translation1: Maestro albañil, carpintero, o sastre, así como maestro de escuela.

Description: The month of May. From Spanish "mayo".
Darling, sweetie, to endearingly address a woman of any age.
alt_translation1: Mami, dirigido a una mujer de cualquier edad para demostrarle cariño.

Description: Figurine or sculpture of a person, whether a man or a woman.
alt_translation1: Figurilla o escultura de una persona, ya sea hombre o mujer.

Description: Colloquial way to refer to a wank, or male masturbation.
alt_translation1: Manuela o chaqueta, forma coloquial de referirse a la masturbación de los hombres.

Description: Name given to María and Alberto as a couple.
alt_translation1: Pareja formada por María y Alberto.

Description: For a marriage ceremony, people close to the bride and groom are selected and asked to gift important elements of the ceremony. This lexeme refers to a woman who accepts to gift wedding coins to a couple.

For a marriage ceremony, people close to the bride and groom are selected and asked to gift important elements of the ceremony. This lexeme refers to a woman who accepts to gift the wedding rings to a couple.

For a marriage ceremony, people close to the bride and groom are selected and asked to gift important elements of the ceremony. This lexeme refers to a woman who accepts to gift wedding clay jugs to a couple.

For a marriage ceremony, people close to the bride and groom are selected and asked to gift important elements of the ceremony. This lexeme refers to a woman who accepts to gift the wedding ring cushion to a couple.
For a ceremony, people close to the person being celebrated are selected and asked to gift important elements of the ceremony. This lexeme refers to a woman who accepts to gift the celebration cake.
For a marriage ceremony, people close to the bride and groom are selected and asked to gift important elements of the ceremony. This lexeme refers to a woman who accepts to gift the bride's bouquet.

For a marriage ceremony, people close to the bride and groom are selected and asked to gift important elements of the ceremony. This lexeme refers to a woman who accepts to gift the wedding cord to a couple.
alt_translation1: Madrina de velación y de mancuerna.

Description: Strap made of leather or natural fibers that is placed on the forehead and holds a load carried on the back.
A group of animals or insects, ex. dogs, cats, birds, fish, lobsters, bees.
alt_translation1: Grupo de animales o insectos, ej. perros, gatos, pájaros, peces, langostas, abejas.

Description: Animal. This lexeme can also be used to refer to the horse more specifically.
alt_translation1: Animal. También se puede usar para referirse más específicamente al caballo.

Description: Owl. It is considered to announce a bad omen.
alt_translation1: Cortamortaja. Se considera de mal agüero.

Description: Small bird (lit.). By extension, an insect plague that affects crops, as well as merry-go-round.
alt_translation1: Pájaro pequeño (lit.). Por extensión, plaga de la siembra, así como el tiovivo, el caballito, el carrusel.
Fuste de la montura de caballo.

Description: Cannabis addict. Prone to starting fist fights.

Nickname given to a man who was exiled to the state of Durango by Pancho León who was the Municipal President of Juchitán de Zaragoza. Mariànu Xhabá' returned to Juchitán on foot and remained in hiding. However, it is said that someone gave him up which allowed Pancho León to find him and kill him.
alt_translation1: Apodo que designa a un hombre llamado que fue desterrado al estado de Durango por Pancho León quien fue Presidente Municipal de Juchitán de Zaragoza. Mariànu Xhabá' regresó a Juchitán a pie y permaneció escondido. Sin embargo, se dice que fue delatado lo que permitió que Pancho León lo encontrara y lo matara.

Description: Scarf or neckerchief worn by the bride and groom for their civil wedding.
alt_translation1: Mascada que llevan los novios en la boda civil.

Description: Service provided to a community by one of its members which consists of organizing a religious festivity and sponsoring it.

People who dress as old men wearing a grotesque wooden mask and yellow clothes with black polka dots to simulate a jaguar. They carry a leather whip or a handkerchief in their hands and go through the streets dancing, hugging young women and whipping the men. By extension, this lexeme can be used to describe someone with an angry or sour face.
alt_translation1: Personas que se visten de viejito con una máscara de madera grotesca y ropa amarilla con motas negras que simulan un jaguar. Llevan un chicote de piel torcida o un pañuelo en la mano y van por la calle bailando, abrazando a las muchachas y dando azotes con el látigo a los hombres. Por extensión, este lexema puede usarse en el sentido de malencarado.

Description: Jiménez Girón (1979:111) defines this lexeme as an adjective that describes someone with a bald head.
alt_translation1: Jiménez Girón (1979:111) define este lexema como adjetivo que describe a alguien "de cabeza calva".

Description: For many celebrations, people close to the person being celebrated are selected and asked to gift important elements of the festivity. These chosen people then enter into a close relationship of support with the person and close family members, especially the person's parents that is as strong as a kinship relationship. This lexeme is used to refer to a man who enters into this relationship and to the father of the person who is celebrated. It can also be used by a father to refer their child's father-in-law.

For many celebrations, people close to the person being celebrated are selected and asked to become sponsors. These chosen people then enter into a close relationship of support with the person and close family members, especially the person's parents that is as strong as a kinship relationship. Jiménez Girón (1979:63) describes that among the most important relationships is that with the godparents who become so before the church, in this case, at the time of baptism.
alt_translation1: Jiménez Girón (1979:63) describe que entre los compadres principales se encuentran el "compadre y comadre ante Dios. Los que bautizan".

Description: For many celebrations, people close to the person being celebrated are selected and asked to become sponsors. These chosen people then enter into a close relationship of support with the person and close family members, especially the person's parents that is as strong as a kinship relationship. Jiménez Girón (1979:63) describes that among the most important relationships is that with the godparents who become so before the church, in this case, at the time of confirmation.
alt_translation1: Jiménez Girón (1979:63) describe que entre los compadres principales se encuentran el "compadre y comadre que ahíjan en la iglesia. Los que confirman o comulgan".

Description: For many celebrations, people close to the person being celebrated are selected and asked to gift important elements of the festivity. These chosen people then enter into a close relationship of support with the person and close family members, especially the person's parents that is as strong as a kinship relationship. Jiménez Girón (1979:63) describes that among the most important relationships is one with the couple who register their godchild in a book that is kept by the corresponding Brotherhood in a sacred chest or trunk (guiña) of the Saint chosen during the Lenten celebrations. When a virgin is celebrated, or at baptism, these persons buy the child their festivity clothing or bathe them in flowers.
alt_translation1: Jiménez Girón (1979:63) describe que entre los compadres principales se encuentran el "compadre y comadre de apuntación religiosa: Los que asientan a sus ahijados en un libro que se guarda por la Hermandad correspondiente en un cofre o baúl (guiña) sagrado del Santo elegido en las celebraciones de cuaresma". En la celebración del día de la vírgen o en el bautizo, estos compadres le compran la ropa al infante o lo bañan en flores.

Description: Sound of something heavy that falls down to the ground, as in the case of a person falling backwards, or two people falling.
alt_translation1: Sonido de algo pesado que se cae, como por ejemplo una persona que se cae de espalda, o dos personas que se caen.

Description: With a prominent forehead, especially due to a receding hairline.
alt_translation1: De frente prominente, sobre todo por falta de cabello al frente.

Description: Sound of a green mango that falls on a metal table.
alt_translation1: Sonido de un mango verde que cae sobre una mesa de metal.

Description: Sound of an empty can being hit with a spoon.
alt_translation1: Sonido de una lata vacía siendo pegada con una cuchara.
Sonido de las campanas de la iglesia.

Description: Sound of drops falling into an empty tray.
alt_translation1: Sonido de gotas cayendo en una bandeja vacía.
Sonido de una moneda que se cae.

Description: Sound of a bucket falling to the bottom of a well.
alt_translation1: Sonido de un tambo cayendo al fondo de un pozo.

Description: Very big, large, oversized. With respect to marbles, it refers to the biggest in a set.
alt_translation1: Muy grande, grandote, grandulón. Con respecto a las canicas, se refiere a la canica más grande.

Description: Sound of a door closing or slamming.
alt_translation1: Sonido de una puerta que se cierra o se azota.
Sonido de algo pesado que se cae.

Description: Nickname given to a man by the name of Lieber as he is light skinned.
alt_translation1: Apodo que designa a un hombre llamado Lieber por ser güero.

Description: Sound a female goat makes when looking for her offspring, or that a male goat makes when following a female to mate.
alt_translation1: Sonido que hace una chiva buscando a sus hijos, o que hace un chivo cuando anda tras de una hembra para aparearse.

Description: Name that can be given to a horse.
alt_translation1: Nombre que se le puede dar a un caballo.

Description: Name given to Amelia and Arcides as a couple.
alt_translation1: Pareja formada por Amelia y Arcides.
Persona proveniente de Ciudad Ixtepec, Oaxaca.

Description: Demonym used to refer to someone from Ciudad Ixtepec, Oaxaca in reference to their variety of Didxazá. This demonym may have pejorative connotations.
alt_translation1: Gentilicio para aquellos que provienen de Ciudad Ixtepec, Oaxaca y que hace referencia a su variante del didxazá. Es posible que este gentilicio sea despectivo.

Description: Meter. It can be measured by the span of legs spread out or from one shoulder to the fingertips on the opposite arm, and is considered different from a yard.
alt_translation1: Metro. Se puede medir con las piernas abiertas de un pie al otro o del hombro a la punta de los dedos del otro brazo, y es distinta que una vara.

Description: Blond or of fair skin, in relation to a woman.
Blond or of fair skin, in relation to a man.
Medal. Religious medallion worn as a pendant.
Last name Mijango which is common in La Ventosa.
alt_translation1: Apellido Mijango, común en La Ventosa.

Description: Altar in honor of a saint.
alt_translation1: Mesa o altar para un santo.

Description: Demonym to refer to Mixe people.
alt_translation1: Gentilicio para designar a las personas mixes.

Description: Sound used to call a cat.
alt_translation1: Sonido para llamar a un gato.

Description: Nickname given to a man by the name of Fermín.
alt_translation1: Apodo que designa a un hombre llamado Fermín.

Description: Nickname given to a man by the name of Fermín. Rèncu is a Spanish loanword meaning 'with a limp'.
alt_translation1: Apodo que designa a un hombre llamado Fermín.

Description: Nickname given to a man by the name of Benjamín.
alt_translation1: Apodo que designa a un hombre llamado Benjamín.

Description: Nickname given to a man by the name of Fermín as he resembles someone by the name of Eduardo.
alt_translation1: Apodo que designa a un hombre llamado Fermín por parecerse a alguien que se llama Eduardo.

Description: Nickname given to a man named Fermín as he is a drunk. Xúdxi means 'drunk'.
alt_translation1: Apodo que designa a un hombre llamado Fermín por ser borracho. Xúdxi significa 'borracho'.

Description: Nickname given to a man by the name of Herminio as he is the brother of Toño Nde. Nde means 'vulva'.
alt_translation1: Apodo que designa a un hombre llamado Herminio por ser hermano de Toño Nde. Nde significa 'vulva'.

Description: Name given to Camilo and Natividad as a couple.
alt_translation1: Pareja formada por Camilo y Natividad.

Description: Nickname given to a man by the name of Domingo as he is blind. Ché'pa' means 'blind'.
alt_translation1: Apodo que designa a un hombre llamado Domingo por ser ciego. Ché'pa' significa 'ciego'.

Description: Nickname given to a man by the name of Domingo as he is the son of Lorenzo.
alt_translation1: Apodo que designa a un hombre llamado Domingo por ser hijo de Lorenzo.

Description: Nickname given to a man by the name of Domingo as his last name is Lùchu.
alt_translation1: Apodo que designa a un hombre llamado Domingo por tener el apellido Lùchu.

Description: Demonym to refer to people from San Miguel Chimalapa.
alt_translation1: Gentilicio para designar a las personas de San Miguel Chimalapa.

Description: Demonym to refer to people from San Miguel Chimalapa.
alt_translation1: Gentilicio para designar a las personas de San Miguel Chimalapa.

Description: Demonym to refer to people from San Miguel Chimalapa.
alt_translation1: Gentilicio para designar a las personas de San Miguel Chimalapa.

Description: In association to the ancestors of the Zapotec peoples, this lexeme refers to human figurines made out of clay, both those that are considered archeological pieces as well as contemporary ones.
alt_translation1: Se les llama así a las estatuillas de barro, tanto aquellas que se consideran piezas arqueológicas como las contemporáneas, en asociación con los antepasados a los que se les atribuyen los orígenes de los pueblos zapotecos.

Description: Extremely small, a very short person.
Sound of someone from the United States of America speaking English.
alt_translation1: Sonido de los estadounidenses hablando inglés.

Description: Mass held nine days after someone's passing.
alt_translation1: Misa de los nueve días posteriores al fallecimiento de una persona.

Description: Funeral mass in which the body of the deceased is present.
Mass held forty days after someone's passing.
alt_translation1: Misa que se celebra cuarenta días posteriores al fallecimiento de una persona.

Description: Sound of a moan of pleasure.
alt_translation1: Sonido de un gemido de placer.
Sonido de una persona haciendo puchero.

Description: Mocha, type of short machete with a hooked tip used to cut sugar cane.
alt_translation1: Mocha, tipo de machete corto con la punta en forma de gancho que se usa para cortar caña.

Description: Pretty, good-looking, in reference to a young woman.
alt_translation1: Bonita, hermosa, con respecto a una muchacha.

Description: Mold (i.e. object designed to shape a malleable substance).
Mix of various spices, often toasted, ground and fried, then mixed with broth to make a sauce.
This lexeme describes a well-dressed, well-groomed woman who moves and speaks with many gestures, to the point of being pretentious.
alt_translation1: Este lexema describe a una mujer bien vestida, muy arreglada y que se mueve y habla con muchos ademanes, lo que la hace parecer presumida.

Description: This lexeme describes a well-dressed, well-groomed, pretentious man.
alt_translation1: Este lexema describe a un hombre bien vestido, muy arreglado, y presumido.

Description: Pretty, good-looking, in reference to a young woman.
alt_translation1: Bonita, hermosa, con respecto a una muchacha.

Description: Wooden whisk designed for beating hot chocolate.
Wooden whisk designed for beating hot chocolate, and similar objects.
alt_translation1: Molinillo para batir chocolate, y objetos similares.

Description: White owl, which is feared because it is believed to announce the death of the person to whom it appears.
alt_translation1: El cortamortaja, lechuza blanca temida, pues se cree que anuncia la muerte de la persona a quien se le aparece.

Description: Fine (i.e. money charged as punishment for an offense).
Satchel generally made of natural fibers and of a single piece of cloth or weave folded in half and stitched on the sides.
Doll. Name that can be given to a dog.
alt_translation1: Muñeca. Nombre que se le puede dar a un perro.

Description: This lexeme refers to a biologically male individual who has sexual preferences and societal roles that do not conform to those followed by heterosexual men. It is important to note that there are those who stray from these notions, and use this lexeme to accuse a person of being cowardly, or to make fun of an effeminate behavior.
alt_translation1: Este lexema se refiere a una persona que es biológicamente hombre y que tiene preferencias sexuales y de roles sociales que no se adhieren a las de hombres heterosexuales. Es importante saber que hay quienes se desvían de estas nociones para usar este lexema para acusar a otro de ser cobarde o miedoso, o para burlarse de un comportamiento afeminado.

Description: Indefinite pronoun that refers to an undefined person.
alt_translation1: Pronombre impersonal que se refiere a una persona indefinida.
Que se ha hecho o convertido en algo.

Description: Having been assigned a post, a job or a responsibility.
alt_translation1: Que ha obtenido algún puesto de trabajo, cargo o responsabilidad.

Description: Imagining or pretending, in the sense of imagining a scenario as in the case of putting oneself in someone else's shoes to have compassion for them.
alt_translation1: Imaginándose una situación, sobre todo en el sentido de ponerse en el lugar de otra persona para tenerle compasión. Esta expresión es comparable a la del castellano "haz de cuenta".

Description: Expression used in the libanà discourse and that evokes those who love the word or who are true to the word. It is used similarly to the English expression “as the saying goes”.
alt_translation1: Expresión proveniente del libanà que evoca a aquellos que aman la palabra o que son verdaderos en la palabra. Se usa de manera similar a las expresiones del castellano "dice el dicho" o "dice el refrán".
Con la mollera o fontanela sumida.
Que sabe, que tiene conocimientos o sabiduría.

Description: In the know, knowing better (than to do something that should not have been done).
Describes that the subject of the conversation has something.

alt_translation1: Que tiene un puesto de trabajo.
Ligeramente encajado o atascado, pero que fácilmente se saca.

Description: Covered in something, especially as it refers to being dressed (i.e. covered with clothes).
alt_translation1: Cubierto de algo, sobre todo cubierto de ropa en el sentido de estar vestido.

Description: Covered or soaked in something, stained or smeared with something, ex. a stained piece of cloth, a tree carrying abundant fruit.
alt_translation1: Cubierto, embarrado, manchado o bañado, ej. una tela manchada, o un árbol con abundante fruta.

Description: Proximal demonstrative that identifies someone or something that is nearby. Equivalent to 'this'.
alt_translation1: Demostrativo que señala algo o alguien que está cerca. Equivalente a 'este', 'esta', y 'esto'.

Description: Proximal demonstrative that selects someone or something close to the speaker among various options. Equivalent to 'this one'.
alt_translation1: Demostrativo que señala algo o alguien que está cerca y lo selecciona entre varias alternativas. Similar a 'este mero', 'esta mera', y 'esto mero'.

Description: Lying down on one's side, sideways, slanted, next to.
alt_translation1: Acostado de lado, ladeado, de canto, a un lado.

Description: That. Medial demonstrative that identifies someone or something that is neither near nor far.
alt_translation1: Ese, esa, eso. Demostrativo que señala algo o alguien que no está ni cerca ni lejos.

Description: That very one. Medial demonstrative that selects someone or something that is not close to the speaker among various options.
alt_translation1: Ese mero, esa mera, eso mero. Demostrativo que señala algo o alguien que no está cerca y lo selecciona entre varias alternativas.

Description: That, no. Jímenez Girón (1979:129) defines this phrase as an expression intended as a protest against unwarranted blame.
alt_translation1: Eso no. Jiménez Girón (1979:129) define esta frase como "locución familiar negativa o de protesta con que se rechaza una inculpación indebida".

Description: Only that (and nothing else), only up to that one.
alt_translation1: Solo ese (y nada más), solo hasta ese.

Description: That very one, said with disdain or as a warning.
alt_translation1: Ese mero, esa mera, eso mero, dicho con menosprecio o como advertencia.

Description: That very one. Medial demonstrative that selects someone or something that is not close to the speaker among various options because it is the best.
alt_translation1: Ese mero, esa mera, eso mero. Demostrativo que señala algo o alguien que no está cerca y lo selecciona entre varias alternativas por ser la mejor opción.

Description: Distal demonstrative that refers to someone or something far away. Equivalent to 'that'.
alt_translation1: Demostrativo que señala algo o alguien que está lejos. Equivalente a 'aquel', 'aquella', y 'aquello'.

Description: That very one. Medial demonstrative that selects someone or something that is not close to the speaker among various options.
alt_translation1: Ese mero, esa mera, eso mero. Demostrativo que señala algo o alguien que no está cerca y lo selecciona entre varias alternativas.

Description: That very one, said with disdain or as a warning.
alt_translation1: Ese mero, esa mera, eso mero, dicho con menosprecio o como advertencia.

Description: Sequence of a distal demonstrative and a medial demonstrative to emphasize the reference to someone or something.
alt_translation1: Secuencia de un demostrativo de distancia y un demostrativo medio para enfatizar la referencia a algo o a alguien.
Que ha sido atorado, atascado, trabado.

Description: Being wedged, or squeezed or plugged into something.
alt_translation1: Que ha sido encajado, atorado o enchufado.

Description: Having something stuck within or inside.
alt_translation1: Que tiene algo metido o atorado.

Description: Being hooked or snagged. Like clothes caught in barbed wire.
alt_translation1: Que ha sido enganchado, agarrado o atorado, como la ropa que se atora en un alambre de púas.
Que ha sido cerrado, tapado o cercado.
Que ha sido cerrado, tapado o cercado.

Description: Being raised, especially with the hand, so that it can be seen.
alt_translation1: Que ha sido elevado, sobre todo con la mano, para que se vea.
Que debe algo, sobre todo dinero.

Description: With the head raised or extended as if trying to see something.
alt_translation1: Con la cabeza elevada o extendida como para ver algo.

Description: With the hand raised or extended as when greeting someone or waving at them, or to receive something.
alt_translation1: Con la mano elevada o extendida como se hace al saludar o para recibir algo.

Description: This phrasal lexeme refers to the ailment that affects a newborn baby when it is visited by a pregnant woman. This is considered to cause the newborn to be burdened with the pregnant woman's fetus. This causes the newborn baby to push, but without colic. There are practices to remedy this ailment that deserve to be documented.
alt_translation1: Este lexema de frase se refiere al mal que le cae a un bebé recién nacido cuando lo visita una mujer embarazada. Se considera que esto hace que el recién nacido cargue con el feto de la embarazada. Esto provoca que el recién nacido puje, pero sin tener cólico. Existen prácticas para remediar este mal que merecen ser documentadas.

Description: Sound of the cry of Emmanuel, the son of Rosaura López Cartas.
alt_translation1: Sonido del lloriqueo de Emmanuel, el hijo de Rosaura López Cartas.

Description: Expression aimed at invalidating what someone else has said. Equivalent to "that idiot is just talking".
alt_translation1: Expresión para invalidar lo que alguien más dice. Equivalente a "nomás habla ese tonto".

Description: Term of address for a woman by the name of Mrs. Juana.

alt_translation1: Gentilicio referente a las personas zapotecas de los Valles Centrales de Oaxaca. No se documentó si este término es despectivo o no.

Description: Demonym used to refer to the Zapotec peoples of the central valleys of Oaxaca. Whether this lexeme is pejorative or not was not documented.
alt_translation1: Gentilicio referente a las personas provenientes de los pueblos zapotecos de los Valles Centrales de Oaxaca. No se documentó si este término es despectivo o no.

Description: Sound of a knife or blade sinking into something.
alt_translation1: Sonido de un cuchillo o una navaja hundiéndose.

Description: Knock on the head. Hook punch.
Nickname given to a man by the name of José Manuel. Néegru is a loanword from Spanish meaning 'black'.
alt_translation1: Apodo que designa a un hombre llamado José Manuel.

Description: Nickname given to a man as he has dark skin.
alt_translation1: Apodo que designa a un hombre por ser de piel oscura.

Description: Right? Right... Particle that ends an utterance intended as a request for clarification or as questioning the interlocutor.
alt_translation1: ¿Eh? Partícula que cierra un enunciado para presentarlo a manera de solicitud de aclaración o de cuestionamiento dirigido al interlocutor.

Description: Nickname given to a man by the name of Ernesto. Bere huiini' means 'little chicken'.
alt_translation1: Apodo que designa a un hombre llamado Ernesto. Bere huiini' significa 'pollito'.

Description: Even if, in any event, anyway.
alt_translation1: Aún, aunque, de todas formas, de todos modos.

Description: Nickname given to a man by the name of Ernesto. Bere huiini' means 'little chicken'.
alt_translation1: Apodo que designa a un hombre llamado Ernesto. Bere huiini' significa 'pollito'.

Description: Nickname given to a man by the name of Ernesto as he stole many chickens. Bere means 'hen'.
alt_translation1: Apodo que designa a un hombre llamado Ernesto por haber robado muchas gallinas. Bere significa 'gallina'.

Description: Road. By extension, this lexeme can be used to describe the location or the direction of movement of something.
alt_translation1: Camino. Por extensión, se puede usar este lexema para describir la ubicación de algo o la dirección de algún movimiento o desplazamiento.

Description: Road connecting Ciudad Ixtepec and Santo Domingo Ingenio.
alt_translation1: Camino de Ciudad Ixtepec a Santo Domingo Ingenio.
Camino que lleva hacia el sur.
Camino que lleva hacia el norte.
Familia de la mamá de uno.

Description: In front of, facing, right (correct) side. This lexeme also refers to the correct orientation for using an object, ex., the blade of a machete or the saw of a handsaw, the correct side to apply a horseshoe, the correct side to wear a garment, etc.
alt_translation1: De frente, al frente, al derecho. Este lexema también se refiere a la orientación correcta para el uso de algún objeto, ej. el filo de un machete o la sierra de un serrucho, el lado correcto para colocar una herradura de caballo, el lado correcto de una prenda de vestir, etc.

Description: This lexeme refers to the birth of a baby feet first.
alt_translation1: Este lexema se refiere al hecho de nacer con los pies por delante.

Description: This lexeme refers to a birth in which the hands lead. This would be the case of animals such as calves that are generally born with their front legs leading.
alt_translation1: Este lexema se refiere al hecho de nacer con la mano por delante, como cuando las crías del ganado nacen con las patas de enfrente por delante.
Camino dentro de una parcela donde uno puede andar.
Oeste, poniente (lit. lado por donde se sumerge el sol).

Description: East (lit. direction from which the sun is born).
alt_translation1: Este, oriente (lit. lado por donde nace el sol).

Description: The Way of St. James, in reference to a particular cloud formation.
alt_translation1: Camino de Santiago, dicho de una formación particular de las nubes.

Description: This lexeme is used to refer to a man who is thought to be homosexual but one cannot be sure. Whether this lexeme is pejorative or not was not documented.
alt_translation1: Este lexema se usa para referirse a un hombre que se piensa que es homosexual, pero no se está seguro. No se documentó si este término es despectivo o no.

Description: Sound of an angry dog that is baring its teeth.
alt_translation1: Sonido de un perro enojado que muestra sus dientes.

Description: A woman with masculine tendencies, and that does not adhere to the imposed social preferences. It is important to note that certain individuals use this lexeme pejoratively to refer to a lesbian woman, or to an infertile woman.
alt_translation1: Una mujer con tendencias masculinas, y que no se adhiere a las preferencias sociales impuestas. Es importante notar que ciertas personas usan este lexema de manera despectiva para referirse a una mujer lesbiana, o a una mujer estéril.

Description: A woman with masculine tendencies, and that does not adhere to the imposed social preferences. It is important to note that certain individuals use this lexeme pejoratively to refer to a lesbian woman, or to an infertile woman.
alt_translation1: Una mujer con tendencias masculinas, y que no se adhiere a las preferencias sociales impuestas. Es importante notar que ciertas personas usan este lexema de manera despectiva para referirse a una mujer lesbiana, o a una mujer estéril.

Description: Hard-working man who is attentive to the needs of the home.
alt_translation1: Hombre trabajador y que atiende las necesidades de la casa.

Description: Young man, male teenager (between 13 and 18 years old).
alt_translation1: Joven, muchacho, hombre adolescente (entre 13 y 18 años).

Description: Something that is large in size.
A man who is a liar or deceiver.
alt_translation1: Hombre que es mentiroso o embustero.

Description: Sound used to speak to a baby.
alt_translation1: Sonido que se usa para hablar a un bebé.

Description: Big, large. This lexeme is used in the ceremonial discourses known as libanà.
alt_translation1: Grande. Lexema proveniente de los discursos conocidos como libanà.

Description: Chief or head of a community. More generally, an important person.
alt_translation1: Jefe o cabeza de un pueblo. Más generalmente, persona importante.
Que, quien, el que, la(s) que, lo(s) que, el cual, la cual, lo cual, las cuales, los cuales.

Description: Whatchamacallit, exclamation of hesitation in speech.
alt_translation1: Cómo se dice..., exclamación de titubeo al hablar.

Description: Whatchamacallit, exclamation of hesitation in speech.
alt_translation1: Cómo se dice..., exclamación de titubeo al hablar.

Description: Farmer (lit. one who works the land).
alt_translation1: Campesino (lit. quien hace el trabajo de la tierra).

Description: Advocate, lawyer (lit. one who speaks for me).
alt_translation1: Alcahuete, abogado (lit. quien habla por mí).

Description: Stranger (lit. one who is not recognizable).
Impatient (lit. one who does not wait).
Rich, wealthy (one who has a lot of money).
alt_translation1: Rico, adinerado (lit. que tiene mucho dinero).

Description: Midwife (lit. one who catches the child).

alt_translation1: Pasador o seguro de la puerta.

Description: Midwife (lit. one who catches the child).

alt_translation1: Lo que no tiene fin, ilimitado, infinito.

Description: Persnickety, easily angry, bad tempered, as would be the case of a fussy child who is often sick.
alt_translation1: Quisquilloso, enojón, irascible, delicado, como un niño que llora mucho, es intranquilo o se enferma con frecuencia.

Description: Milk. By extension, this lexeme can be used to refer to other white, viscous substances such as latex, semen, and toad skin secretions.
alt_translation1: Leche. Por extensión, este lexema se puede usar para referirse a otras sustancias viscosas y blancas, como el látex, el semen o la secreción de la piel de un sapo.
Secreción de la piel del sapo.

Description: Particle that negates the phrase it precedes or that coordinates two negative clauses. Sometimes equivalent to 'not' and 'not even'.
alt_translation1: Partícula que niega la frase que le sigue. También se utiliza para coordinar dos frases negativas. Equivalente a 'ni' o 'ni siquiera'.

Description: Expression to qualify a dance or a singing performance that is considered mediocre (lit. neither salt nor chilli).
alt_translation1: Expresión para evaluar un canto o un baile que se considera mediocre (lit. ni sal ni chile).

Description: Clay vessel often used with water to rinse the hands while making tortillas.
alt_translation1: Apastle, olla para enjuagarse las manos cuando uno está haciendo tortilla.

Description: Hot cornflour drink sweetened with raw sugar.
Hot cornflour drink prepared and served with corn kernels.
Hot cornflour drink made with milk.
Hot cornflour drink made without added sugar or lime (mineral). It is considered to be beneficial when one has a belly ache, diarrhea, or a hangover.
alt_translation1: Atole blanco elaborado sin azúcar y sin cal. Se considera bueno para el dolor de panza, la diarrea, y la cruda.

Description: Hot cornflour drink made with milk.
Hot cornflour drink made with fresh sweet corn.
Hot cornflour drink made specifically with dried corn kernels.
Water with Dysphania ambrosioides prepared as treatment for eye swelling attributed to a feeling of shame.
alt_translation1: Agua con epazote (Dysphania ambrosioides) que se usa para curar la hinchazón de los ojos que da por vergüenza.

Description: Water left out overnight and considered to trap night energies.

alt_translation1: Agua de baño, agua de caño que huele mal.
Baba que produce uno mientras está durmiendo.

Description: Light drizzle which coincides with sunshine and is considered to foster the growth of green worms in the corn fields.
alt_translation1: Lluvia ligera que cae cuando hay sol y que crea gusano verde de milpa.

Description: Estuary, firth, mouth of a river discharging into the sea.
alt_translation1: Estero, estuario, desembocadura de un río en el mar.

Description: Any drink that is medicinal and is ingested throughout the day at room temperature, ex. an herbal infusion.
Alcoholic beverage, ex. mezcal, moonshine, beer.
alt_translation1: Bebida alcohólica, ej. mezcal, aguardiente, cerveza.

Description: Distillate made with nance (likely Byrsonima crassifolia).
Deep and abundant waters, as when the river overflows.
alt_translation1: Agua profunda y abundante, como cuando se desborda un río.

Description: Tomato sauce whether made with raw, boiled or roasted ingredients.
alt_translation1: Salsa de jitomate ya sea con ingredientes crudos, asados o hervidos.

Description: Water with lime used for bathing a pig with lice or a dog with mange.
alt_translation1: Agua de cal. Se usa para bañar a un marrano que tiene piojos o a un perro con sarna.

Description: Watery corn dough left over after grinding corn given to pigs as fodder.
alt_translation1: Restos de maíz y agua que al final de la molienda se le da al marrano.

Description: Water-based drink made from vines that are considered medicinal.
alt_translation1: Agua de bejuco. Se considera medicinal.

Description: Fresh water (as opposed to salt water).

alt_translation1: Agua de presa, agua de riego.

Description: Liquid that becomes thick and gelatinous, like wheatpaste or an overcooked shrimp stew.
alt_translation1: Líquido que se hace espeso y gelatinoso, como el engrudo o el molito de camarón que se coció demasiado.

Description: Salt water (as opposed to fresh water).
Salt water (as opposed to fresh water).

Lagoon off the southern coast of the Isthmus of Tehuantepec known as El Mar Muerto ('The Dead Sea'), bordering the communities of Chicapa de Castro, Santa María Xadani, Álvaro Obregón, San Mateo del Mar, Santa María del Mar, and San Dionisio del Mar.
alt_translation1: Laguna de la costa sur de Istmo de Tehuantepec conocida como El Mar Muerto, enmarcada por las comunidades de Chicapa de Castro, Santa María Xadani, Álvaro Obregón, San Mateo del Mar, Santa María del Mar, y San Dionisio del Mar.

Description: Windy rain, rain that announces the northern winds.
alt_translation1: Lluvia con viento, lluvia que anuncia el norte.

Description: Name assigned to both a town and a region in the Isthmus of Tehuantepec due to the presence of hot springs. The region itself is of high ecological value.
alt_translation1: Nombre que se le da tanto a un pueblo como a una región en el Istmo de Tehuantepec por tener aguas termales. La región en sí es de gran importancia ecológica.

Description: Corn cane that is cut up with corn leaves and ears of corn as an offering for altars.
alt_translation1: Caña de maíz que se corta con sus hojas y con la mazorca y se ofrenda en los altares.

Description: For corn to reach the point prior to becoming ripe.

alt_translation1: Novia en el contexto de una boda.

Description: A woman after she has been asked in marriage. A newlywed bride after her virginity has been verified and is therefore no longer a virgin.
alt_translation1: Novia pedida. Novia una vez que se ha verificado su virginidad (y, por lo tanto, ya no es virgen).
Novio en el contexto de una boda.

Description: The month of November. From Spanish "noviembre".
Sound of the last two notes on a guitar.
alt_translation1: Sonido de las últimas dos notas de una guitarra.

Description: It is not the case that.
Destined to happen, meant to happen.
alt_translation1: Tenía que ocurrir, era el destino.

Description: Jiménez Girón (1979:133) defines this lexeme as referring to a person who is engaged to be married.
alt_translation1: Jiménez Girón (1979:133) define este lexema como "persona prometida en matrimonio".

Description: Groom, man engaged to be married.
alt_translation1: Novio prometido, hombre comprometido para casarse.

Description: Sweet, sticky liquid such as the sap of certain plants or the juice of certain fruits.
alt_translation1: Líquido dulce y pegajoso como la savia de algunas plantas o el jugo de algunas frutas.

Description: Sound of the cry of Javiercito, the youngest son of Rosaura López Cartas.
alt_translation1: Sonido del lloriqueo de Javiercito, el hijo menor de Rosaura López Cartas.

Description: Habit, and in particular, a bad habit.
Interrogative particle that can be used to mark yes/no questions which end with the interrogative particle la!.
alt_translation1: Partícula interrogativa que se puede usar al principio de una pregunta cuya respuesta sería un sí o un no y que termina con la partícula interrogativa la!.

Description: Really?, is it true?, exclamation to prompt an interlocutor to confirm the veracity of their statement.
alt_translation1: ¿A poco?, ¿será cierto?, exclamación para incitar al interlocutor a que confirme la veracidad de su enunciado.

Description: Lower extremity of the human body (leg and/or foot), hind legs of an animal or insect with more than four legs, or of an object.
alt_translation1: Extremidad inferior del cuerpo humano (la pierna y/o el pie), patas traseras de un animal o insecto de cuatro o más patas, o de un objeto.

Description: At the foot of an object.
Leg that is shorter than the other, or someone with one.
alt_translation1: Pierna más corta que la otra, o la persona que la tiene.

Description: Grasshopper leg. To alleviate ear pain, some fry grasshopper legs with garlic, and after this cools down will apply a drop in the affected ear.
alt_translation1: Pata de grillo. Para aliviar el dolor de oídos en los niños, algunos fríen las patas de grillo con un diente de ajo, lo dejan enfriar, y aplican una gotita en el oído.

Description: Bowed legs, or someone with them.
alt_translation1: Piernas arqueadas, o la persona que así las tiene.

Description: Leg that is shorter than the other, or someone with one.
alt_translation1: Pierna más corta que la otra, o la persona que la tiene.

Description: Area between the eyebrow and the eyelid.
alt_translation1: Área entre la ceja y el párpado.

Description: Misshapen leg, or someone with one.
alt_translation1: Pierna torcida, o la persona que la tiene.

Description: Bowed legs, or someone with them.
alt_translation1: Piernas arqueadas, o la persona que así las tiene.

Description: Person whose romantic partner cheats on (lit. burned feet).
alt_translation1: Persona a quien su pareja romántica engaña (lit. pies quemados).

Description: Corn kernels cooked lightly with the husk but without lime and strained two or three times to make a drink (not for making tortillas).
alt_translation1: Maíz que se cuece ligeramente con cáscara pero sin cal, y se cuela dos o tres veces para hacer atol (no para nixtamal).

Description: Type of knot joining two doubled lines.
alt_translation1: Tipo de nudo conocido en castellano como nudo o amarre de hombre.

Description: Nickname given to a man by the name of Oscar as he spies on women. Màxhi means 'someone who spies on others'.
alt_translation1: Apodo que designa a un hombre llamado Oscar por andar espiando mujeres. Màxhi significa 'persona que espía a otros'.

Description: Nickname given to a man by the name of Oscar. Nànchi is the name of the fruit from the Byrsonima crassifolia tree.
alt_translation1: Apodo que designa a un hombre llamado Oscar. Nànchi significa 'nanche' (Byrsonima crassifolia).

Description: Nickname given to a man by the name of Oscar as he is loose-lipped. Ruángo is short for 'big-mouthed' and is short for ruaa ngola 'big mouth'.
alt_translation1: Apodo que designa a un hombre llamado Oscar por ser bocón. Ruángo significa 'bocón, trompudo' y es una contracción de ruaa ngola 'boca grande'.

Description: Nickname given to a man by the name of Oscar as he is a member of the civilian sector of the National Guard.
alt_translation1: Apodo que designa a un hombre llamado Oscar por pertenecer a la Guardia Nacional civil.

Description: Nickname give to a woman by the name of Olivia.
alt_translation1: Apodo que designa a una mujer llamada Olivia.

Description: When, at the time, at that moment. In questions, it is generally equivalent to 'when?'.
alt_translation1: Hora, cuando, en el momento. En preguntas, suele ser equivalente a '¿cuándo?'.
Entonces, en ese momento, en el acto, en ese instante.

Description: Honor, as when a woman's virginity is attested at the time of marriage.
alt_translation1: Honor, como cuando se comprueba que una mujer llegó virgen al matrimonio.

Description: Fork in a tree branch, or similar, used in a slingshot.
Fork in a tree branch, cut and used to support beams in construction.
Rice drink made with gallic rose along with cinnamon, rice, pepper and rue. It is drunk on an empty stomach and is considered beneficial in treating abdominal inflammation.
alt_translation1: Horchata de rosa de castilla que se prepara con canela, arroz, pimienta gorda y un pedazo de ruda y se toma en ayunas para tratar la inflamación abdominal.

Description: The month of October. From Spanish "octubre".
Sound of a child sucking their finger and letting it go at the last moment.
alt_translation1: Sonido de un niño chupándose el dedo y soltándolo al último momento.
Sonido de algo que se desmorona.

Description: Sound of an opossum passing gas.
alt_translation1: Sonido de un tlacuache echando un pedo.

Description: Sound of a pencil being flicked with the tip of a finger.
alt_translation1: Sonido de la punta de un dedo pegando un lápiz.

Description: Sound of a fish flopping out of water.
alt_translation1: Sonido de un pescado fuera del agua pegando la cola.

Description: Sound of a mill to grind dough.
alt_translation1: Sonido de un molino para moler masa.

Description: Darling, sweetie, to endearingly address a boy.
alt_translation1: Papi, dirigido a un niño para demostrarle cariño.

Description: Sound of a hammer hitting wood.
alt_translation1: Sonido de un martillo pegando madera.

Description: Sound of a hand hitting something.
alt_translation1: Sonido de una mano pegando algo.
Sonido de una cuerda que se rompe.

Description: Sound of a rock that falls on another rock or onto the floor.
alt_translation1: Sonido de una piedra que se cae encima de otra piedra o sobre el piso.

Description: Particle, equivalent to 'if', used to form a conditional clause. Also used in combination with other lexemes and particles to articulate a question about quantity, location, or destination (see relevant entries).
alt_translation1: Partícula que se usa en una cláusula condicional, equivalente a 'si'. También se usa en combinación con otros lexemas y partículas, para formular preguntas sobre cantidad, lugar o destino (ver entradas correspondientes).

Description: Phrase that introduces doubt or lack of precision, usually with regards to place or time.
alt_translation1: Locución que se usa para expresar duda o inexactitud sobre todo con relación a una ubicación o un tiempo.

Description: Phrase that introduces a question about measurement, size or quantity. Sometimes equivalent to 'how much?', 'what amount?', 'what size?'.
alt_translation1: Locución que se usa para preguntar acerca de una medida, un tamaño o una cantidad. Puede ser equivalente a '¿qué tanto?', '¿qué medida?', '¿qué tamaño?'.

Description: Phrase that seeks to obtain precision about a measurement, size or quantity or an emphatic statement about them. Sometimes equivalent to 'how?', 'how much?', 'what amount?', 'what size?'.
alt_translation1: Locución que se usa para preguntar con precisión acerca de una medida, tamaño o cantidad, o un comentario enfático sobre estos. Puede ser equivalente a '¿mero qué tanto?', '¿qué medida exactamente?', '¿qué tamaño exactamente?', '¿qué tan?'.

Description: Phrase that seeks to obtain precision about a measurement, size or quantity or an emphatic statement about them. Sometimes equivalent to 'how?', 'how much?', 'what amount?', 'what size?'.
alt_translation1: Locución que se usa para preguntar con precisión acerca de una medida, tamaño o cantidad, o un comentario enfático sobre estos. Puede ser equivalente a '¿mero qué tanto?', '¿qué medida exactamente?', '¿qué tamaño exactamente?', '¿qué tan?'.

Description: Phrase that asks about the point of departure of movement or a trajectory. Sometimes equivalent to 'from where?'.
